jobs.title: Project Executive - Process Piping
jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Executive - Process Piping

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: South - Mechanical/Structural
Location: Multiple
Reports to: Area Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As a Project Executive within our Process Piping team, you're responsible for the overall planning, execution, and successful delivery of commercial and industrial construction projects, specifically overseeing our process piping scopes of work performed to American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) code (primarily B31.3 Process Piping). You'll oversee all phases of a project, including budgeting, scheduling, procurement, resource allocation, subcontractor management, client relations, ASME code compliance and quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) coordination, and project closeout activities. You're accountable for ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with ASME code requirements, quality standards, and contractual requirements.

You'll lead by example through strong leadership, effective communication, financial management, and the ability to proactively identify and resolve project challenges while maintaining positive relationships with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and project teams. You'll serve as the primary liaison between field operations, company leadership, and customers, ensuring successful project outcomes and customer satisfaction. You'll lead the scope of a 100+ MW large data center project with billings of $100+ million and a team of 150-200+ personnel on-site at any given time.

We are open to having someone based in any of the locations listed with the ability to travel as designated our job description:

• Lubbock, TX

• Odessa, TX

• Oklahoma City, OK

• Las Vegas, NV

• North Dakota

Role and Responsibilities

• Oversee large scale process piping construction projects from set up to close out, related to industries including power generation, industrial/process facilities, refining/chemical, mining, and semiconductor / mission critical, ensuring work is executed in accordance with applicable ASME piping codes.

• Responsible for recruiting, managing and leading teams of employees, including Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Project Coordinators.

• Ensure project execution complies with ASME B31.3 (Process Piping) and any other applicable ASME code requirements, from fabrication through field installation.

• Coordinate with QA/QC and third-party inspection on welding procedure specification/procedure qualification record (WPS/PQR), welder certification, non-destructive examination (NDE), post weld heat treatment (PWHT), hydrostatic testing, and Positive Material Identification (PMI) for pressure piping systems.

• Review piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), piping isometrics, and piping material specifications with the project team to support constructability, procurement, and fabrication/field installation sequencing.

• Supervises the daily work of employees.

• Verifies conformance of finished work product, including overseeing compliance with all contract requirements.

• Responsible for ensuring all safety and environmental requirements are met.

• Coordination of all labor, equipment, and subcontractor resources with Project subordinates and other Loenbro companies to ensure timely, cost-effective completion of project.

• Assures all employees within the team know and follow the company safety and work rules and policies.

• Ability to travel for site work up to 50%-75% of the time.

• Other responsibilities and duties as assigned.

Skills

• Working knowledge of ASME B31.3 (Process Piping) and ASME Section IX (Welding and Brazing Qualifications).

• The ability to coordinate QA/QC and inspection activities for pressure piping, including WPS/PQR, welder qualification, NDE, and hydrostatic testing.

• The ability to coordinate pipe fabrication/spool shop activities in support of field installation.

jobs.title: Senior Avionics Development Technician (Test Racks)
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

You will contribute to the build and development of avionics and software test assets for major satellite subsystems and vehicle simulation. This role will be the owner of avionics hardware installation, wire harnessing, test rack fabrication, and HITL (Hardware-In-The-Loop) test bed build and maintenance. • Support full build and maintenance of HITL (Hardware-In-The-Loop) test assets, including installation of avionics hardware, manufacturing and routing of wire harnesses, and fabrication of load simulators

• Assemble production test racks for HITL, acceptance testing, and qualification of flight hardware

• Follow engineering procedures to perform electrical checkouts such as continuity, discontinuity, and multimeter measurements on components and vehicle systems

• Assist design engineering throughout the hardware development and pre-production stages by supporting specification development, component assembly and process validation testing

• Work autonomously and coordinate cross-functionally with various engineering and technician team to meet high pace schedule and quality requirements

• Successfully use an array of hand, power, and pneumatic mechanical tools to build fixtures, interfacing panels, and tooling assemblies

Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience assembling, integrating, and testing electronic hardware in the aerospace industry

• 1+ years of SMT/through-hole soldering, using electronics equipment, and assembling test racks

• Demonstrated skill and proficiency in soldering and crimping as well as assembling cable harnesses and connectors

Nice to Have

• IPC Certified for PCB and cable harness rework (IPC-A-610, IPC-A-620)

• Hand soldering ability that meets IPC J-STD-001

• Experience designing, building, and testing electrical assemblies and test fixtures

• Experience performing crimping, wire stripping, continuity testing, connector pin outs, and routing and tie wrapping

• Ability to drill and tap holes, and use common shop equipment such as drill press, grinders, and band saws

• Ability to create, read, review, and redline electrical and test rack schematics

• Strong communication skills with ability to communicate hardware and systems problems

• Experience developing or writing company specifications and qualifying build methods for production around wire harness, test rack fabrication, and integration

Additional Requirements

• Must be able to perform repetitive tasks such as bending or twisting, grasping, standing, lifting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, carrying, and use hands to operate tools or machine controls

• Must be able to lift and carry parts or equipment up to 50 lbs. unassisted

• Must be able to stand for extended periods of time

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

Compensation and Benefits:

• Compensation will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Job Title: Senior Project Manager - Process Piping

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: South - Mechanical/Structural

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As a Senior Project Manager within our Process Piping team, you're responsible for the overall planning, execution, and successful delivery of commercial and industrial construction projects, specifically overseeing our process piping scopes of work performed to American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) code (primarily B31.3 Process Piping). You'll oversee all phases of a project, including budgeting, scheduling, procurement, resource allocation, subcontractor management, client relations, ASME code compliance and quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) coordination, and project closeout activities. You're accountable for ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with ASME code requirements, quality standards, and contractual requirements.

You'll lead by example through strong leadership, effective communication, financial management, and the ability to proactively identify and resolve project challenges while maintaining positive relationships with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and project teams. You'll serve as the primary liaison between field operations, company leadership, and customers, ensuring successful project outcomes and customer satisfaction. You'll lead the scope of a 100+ MW large data center project with billings of $100+ million and a team of 150-200+ personnel on-site at any given time.

• Odessa, TX

• Oklahoma City, OK

• Las Vegas, NV

• North Dakota

jobs.description:
STAFF CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEER

Remote, Anywhere in the US


About AnswersNow:

AnswersNow is a venture-backed digital health company delivering virtual autism care to families. Our mission is to empower and enhance the lives of those affected by autism by making personalized therapy more accessible. We connect families with expert clinicians quickly — often moving from assessment to therapy within weeks, without waitlists or commutes — and deliver outcomes that parents describe as life-changing.



Why this role matters:

We’re looking for a Staff Cloud Security Engineer who thrives on designing scalable, secure cloud systems and enabling data-driven decision-making.

 

This is our first dedicated security hire and the single owner of security across our platform, infrastructure, and corporate environment. You'll set the strategy, build the program, and do the hands-on work. You'll partner directly with the CTO and engineering team, and you'll be the technical authority on security for customers, auditors, and leadership.

This is a Staff-level role. We expect you to operate with significant autonomy, make sound risk-based tradeoffs, and raise the security maturity of the whole organization.



What you’ll do:

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

 - Architect, secure, and continuously harden our AWS environment (IAM, VPC design, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, WAF, etc.)

 - Secure our serverless and data layers, including Lambda, S3, and PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora): encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege access, network isolation, backup integrity, and audit logging

 - Implement Infrastructure-as-Code security guardrails and policy-as-code

 - Own secrets management, key management, and certificate lifecycle

 - Manage and harden Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) infrastructure, including cluster security, network policies, and container runtime security

Application & API Security

 - Secure our APIs and application stack: authentication/authorization, session management, rate limiting, input validation, and OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 risks

 - Embed security into the SDLC with threat modeling, secure design reviews, SAST/DAST, dependency and container scanning, and CI/CD pipeline security

 - Secure our proprietary real-time video platform (WebRTC/media transport, session access controls, recording storage, and encryption)

 - Run our vulnerability management and penetration testing program, including vendor selection, scoping, and remediation tracking

AI Security & Governance

Compliance (SOC 2 & HIPAA)

Endpoint & Corporate Security

Detection, Response & Resilience

jobs.title: Paralegal
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

Summit is looking for an experienced, technology-minded Legal Operations Paralegal to help shape how our legal department works. Reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer, you will lead efforts to make our legal operations more efficient. Your main focus will be administering, optimizing, and championing our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system.

This role combines hands-on paralegal work with operational leadership. You will be the go-to expert on how contracts move through the business, train colleagues across departments, and support a broad range of legal matters, including contracting, litigation, securities, intellectual property prosecution and litigation, compliance, and other general matters. If you enjoy improving processes, adopting new technology, and working with teams across the company, this role offers real visibility and impact.

This role is based at our Palo Alto office and will work onsite Monday–Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Friday. Additional remote days may be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

Legal Operations and CLM Administration

• Lead efforts to improve legal operations, with a primary focus on administering, optimizing, and maintaining the company's CLM system.

• Configure and refine CLM workflows, templates, clause libraries, approval routing, and reporting to support efficient contracting.

• Find opportunities to streamline legal processes, reduce turnaround times, and improve data quality and visibility across the contract portfolio.

• Keep accurate contract records, metadata, and repositories so that obligations, renewals, and key dates are tracked reliably.

CLM Subject Matter Expert and Trainer

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for the CLM system across all departments.

• Onboard new users and deliver training sessions, both live and recorded, tailored to different business teams.

• Answer end-user questions, troubleshoot issues, and create user guides, FAQs, and best-practice resources.

• Work with the CLM vendor on system updates, enhancements, and issue resolution.

Due Diligence Support

• Support due diligence efforts in connection with corporate transactions, financings, partnerships, and other strategic initiatives as they arise.

• Organize and manage data rooms, track diligence requests, and summarize key contract terms and findings.

Litigation Support

• Assist with litigation matters, including discovery, document collection, document review, and production as the need arises.

• Coordinate with outside counsel on case logistics, deadlines, and document management.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work day to day with the Chief Legal Officer, in-house patent and transactional attorneys, and outside counsel to resolve legal issues and meet operational needs.

• Partner closely with Research & Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Business Development, Procurement, and Finance, as well as third-party vendors, to support the business.

• Build strong relationships with business stakeholders to understand their needs and make the legal department a responsive, effective partner.

Contract Drafting, Review, and Management

• Review, draft, and manage a range of agreements, under supervision of an attorney, such as NDAs, SoWs, and amendments, applying a strong command of contract language and in-house legal processes.

• Manage contracts through their full lifecycle, from intake and negotiation support through execution, storage, and renewal.

• Escalate non-standard terms and risk issues to attorneys as appropriate.

Qualifications and Requirements

• 6+ years of paralegal experience, preferably in an in-house legal department.

• Demonstrated experience with CLM systems (e.g., Agiloft, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign CLM, Conga) or equivalent platforms.

• Strong technology aptitude and comfort learning and using legal tech tools.

• Deep understanding of contract law, contract language, and in-house legal processes.

• Experience supporting litigation and due diligence matters.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, outside counsel, and vendors.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• A strong understanding of how to maintain and protect the confidentiality of sensitive information.

• Paralegal certificate or relevant degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in industry, e.g., life sciences, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industry, including familiarity with agreements common to that sector e.g., clinical trial agreements, CDAs, CRO/vendor agreements, licensing agreements.

• Extensive knowledge of contracts in general, across a variety of agreement types.

• Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CLM system.

• Familiarity with e-discovery platforms, e-signature tools, and legal matter management or spend management software.

• Experience building dashboards, reports, or metrics to measure legal operations performance.

• Knowledge of legal operations frameworks and best practices

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$139,000—$163,000 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training or promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.



We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.



Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.



Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Plasmidsaurus is looking for its first full-time General Counsel to help us navigate the legal complexities of a rapidly growing, high-impact, global business.

You’ll be a key advisor to our founders and leadership team, helping us make better decisions, pursue opportunities, and identify material risks before they become costly problems. We’re looking for a leader who we can rely on for strong commercial and corporate legal expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to turn complicated legal questions into clear paths forward.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be a part of the team navigating exceptional growth opportunities for the company, and you’ll be trusted to build a lean, effective legal function that supports our ambitions without slowing us down.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Advise the business. Partner with our founders and leadership team on consequential decisions, proactively identifying material legal risks and opportunities, evaluating trade-offs, and developing practical paths forward.

 - Lead commercial legal matters. Structure, draft, and negotiate customer, supplier, technology, and strategic partnership agreements, personally leading high-stakes negotiations and establishing efficient processes for routine agreements, while balancing commercial objectives with appropriate protections.

 - Guide our global corporate strategy. Advise on international operations, entity structures, inter-company arrangements, expansion, and significant corporate transactions, identifying gaps and exposures as our global business evolves.

 - Protect our intellectual property and business interests. Partner with scientific and technical leaders to establish an effective approach to IP protection, ownership, licensing, and commercialization, leveraging specialist counsel where appropriate.

 - Navigate regulatory and compliance matters. Help leadership anticipate and address legal implications of new products, markets, and business models, including laboratory and clinical regulation, data privacy, cross-border movement of biological materials, export controls, and other relevant requirements.

 - Own corporate legal and governance matters. Support the CEO and board on governance, corporate obligations, strategic transactions, and other significant legal matters.

 - Build our legal function. Establish the processes, resources, and outside counsel relationships needed to provide responsive, reliable legal support across the business, prioritizing by business impact and keeping bureaucracy and costs in check.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Our founders and leadership team consider you a trusted adviser, engaging you early in important decisions and relying on your judgment to navigate complex situations.

 - We have a clear understanding of our most consequential legal risks and opportunities, including issues we hadn't previously recognized, with practical plans to address the issues that matter most.

 - Our commercial agreements and legal processes support business growth, protect our interests, and enable teams to move quickly.

 - Our global corporate structure and legal approach support our current operations and future expansion, with priority cross-border and regulatory issues identified and actionable plans in place.

 - We've established a dependable, efficient legal function that brings the right expertise to the right problems without unnecessary bureaucracy.


WHO YOU ARE

 - A seasoned legal leader who thrives in a growing business. You've operated as a senior in-house legal adviser, ideally in a fast-growing company navigating increasing scale, complexity, and international expansion.

 - A sharp commercial mind. You understand how businesses make money, negotiate complex agreements with confidence, and know when to push hard, when to compromise, and how to get important deals done.

 - A versatile corporate and international legal expert. You bring meaningful experience in corporate law, governance, international structures, and cross-border matters, with the range to navigate unfamiliar legal territory.

 - Exceptional judgment. You see around corners, distinguish real risks from theoretical ones, and help leaders make smart decisions when the answers aren't black and white.

 - A builder who gets things done. You're equally comfortable advising on consequential decisions, rolling up your sleeves to solve problems, and creating systems that make Legal more effective as we scale.

 - An expert who makes complexity simple. You bring deep legal expertise, intellectual rigor, and common sense. You communicate clearly, offer practical recommendations, and make legal matters approachable. You earn trust by making difficult things easier, not more complicated.

 - Resourceful and pragmatic. You know what deserves your attention, what can be simplified, and when to bring in specialized expertise. You build capabilities without building bureaucracy.

 - Intellectually curious and technically comfortable. You quickly get up to speed on complex scientific, technical, and regulatory questions. Experience in life sciences, biotechnology, or another technically complex or regulated industry is a plus.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - A JD from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with a U.S. state bar.

 - Experienced working in life sciences, biotechnology, scientific services, or another technically complex or regulated industry, or able to demonstrate strong judgment navigating unfamiliar technical and regulatory environments.

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com. careers@plasmidsaurus.com

jobs.title: Manager, Cyber - Applied AI Architect
jobs.description:
The Cyber Applied AI Architect Manager leads a team of customer-facing architects who partner with customers throughout the full lifecycle—from technical discovery and architecture design through implementation, deployment, and adoption. As a hands-on people leader, you’ll hire, coach, and develop the team while helping shape its technical approach and customer engagement model. You and your team will work closely with Sales and Solutions Engineering to understand customer security priorities and design AI-enabled solutions using OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows.

After a customer commits, your team will remain engaged to translate the proposed solution into a production-ready implementation. You’ll provide architectural guidance, support complex technical decisions and escalations, and ensure consistent delivery across customer engagements. The work spans security workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, SOC operations, and GRC automation.

In this role, you will:

 - Hire, coach, and develop a team of Cyber Applied AI Architects, setting clear expectations for technical excellence, customer impact, and career growth.

 - Establish team priorities, allocate resources, and balance pre-sales engagements with post-sales implementation and adoption.

 - Lead technical discovery with security executives, practitioners, architects, and engineering teams.

 - Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering on AI solution design, demonstrations, workshops, technical validation, and proofs of concept.

 - Guide your team in translating customer requirements into clear solution architectures, implementation plans, success criteria, and technical milestones.

 - Oversee solutions from pre-sales architecture and prototyping through production deployment and adoption.

 - Serve as a senior technical partner for strategic customers, coordinating stakeholders and internal Product, Engineering, Security, and GTM teams.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager of eCommerce, Amazon
jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

The Sr. Manager eCommerce, Amazon owns OLIPOP’s business on Amazon (1P, 3P, Fresh) and Whole Foods Market digital. You are accountable for revenue and profitability, the digital shelf, advertising, inventory signals, and day-to-day account operations.

You will run merchandising, media, promotions, forecast, and the tools that explain the business including management of Cartograph and Stackline. You will also partner with lighthouse accounts so Amazon campaigns and promotions line up with the rest of Commercial, not compete with them.

The right person knows Seller and Vendor Central, how Amazon search and the digital shelf actually works, and how to turn data into a plan. You will work across Demand Planning, RGM, Sales, Finance, Digital, Brand, Creative, Supply Chain, IT, CX, Kepler, and other agencies.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

About the role

This role owns OLIPOP on Amazon (1P, 3P, Fresh) and Whole Foods Market digital. You are accountable for the P&L, relationship management, digital shelf, media, inventory signals, and the customer experience on those platforms.

You will run the accounts, not just report on them: listings, ads, promotions, forecast, operations, and the tools we use to monitor the business (Cartograph and Stackline). As part of the Commercial Team, you will align Amazon with the rest of Commercial to ensure promotions and offers on Amazon align to market.

Success looks like profitable growth, a clean and findable shelf, in-stock product, and media that adds demand. As OLIPOP’s Amazon subject-matter expert, you will independently set the approach for the channel and lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives with company-level impact, in close partnership with the VP, eCommerce and senior leaders.

What you own

Account management & P&L

• Deliver annual sales and profitability goals for Amazon 1P, 3P, Fresh, and WFM digital.

• Act as primary point of contact for Amazon, Fresh, WFM, Kepler, and internal partners.

• Own 1P / 3P / Fresh mix, vendor negotiations, and the operating cadence with Amazon.

• Keep listings on-brand and on-platform (content, claims, imagery, A+ / store).

• Lead the monthly forecast forum with Demand Planning; communicate risk early.

Sales & Revenue Growth

• Build and run the growth plan: visibility, conversion, Subscribe & Save, bundles, launches, and whitespace.

• Work with Digital, Shopper, Brand, Creative, RGM, and Sales on launches, content, and key programs.

• Partner with lighthouse accounts so Amazon promotions, LTOs, price architecture, and campaign timing match the commercial calendar.

• Flag conflicts before they go live (stacked discounts, price training, media flying into an OOS).

Digital Merchandising

• Own titles, bullets, A+ content, images, keywords, store, and category placement.

• Manage assortment and discoverability against Amazon search behavior.

• Keep content aligned with brand—not only with what converts this week.

Advertising & Promotions

• Own the Amazon media brief, budget, and strategy with Kepler.

• Plan and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP.

• Separate brand defense, category, and conquest. Judge spend on incrementality, NTB, ACoS, TACoS, and contribution—not last-click ROAS alone.

• Plan deals, coupons, LTOs, and seasonal events with Shopper and Brand.

Inventory & Operations

• Partner with Supply Chain and Demand Planning to forecast demand and protect in-stock.

• Work with the Operations / Customer Service Manager on pickups, chargebacks, shortages, and COS / NetPPM leakage.

Insights, Tools & Reporting

• Own Cartograph and Stackline: structure, access, hygiene, and how the company uses them.

• Be the Amazon Voice of the Customer and the competitive set—search, share, content, ratings, inventory, and syndicated eCommerce data (Stackline, NielsenIQ, Cartograph).

• Publish weekly and monthly updates for senior leadership: performance, priorities, risks and root causes, and the actions you are taking.

• Travel to represent OLIPOP with Amazon, at events, and at internal offsites (~15%).

What you bring

• 12+ years in eCommerce, with deep, hands-on Amazon expertise; 1P required, 3P strongly preferred. Fresh and WFM a plus.

• You have run a large Amazon P&L, forecast, and vendor negotiations.

• Hands-on with Vendor Central, Seller Central, Cartograph, and Stackline (or equivalent). Profitiero / NielsenIQ a plus. Shopify a plus.

• You are a recognized expert in both Amazon retail and Amazon media, including search and the digital shelf, and you stay ahead of platform and industry changes.

• You work cleanly with lighthouse account teams and can defend a promo calendar across banners.

• You make high-stakes decisions independently and can align senior leaders and cross-functional partners with clear rationale.

• You are comfortable in Slack and Teams.

• You care about OLIPOP and about how real customers shop.

Who you partner with

Demand Planning, Revenue Growth Management, Sales (including lighthouse accounts), Finance, Digital Marketing, Brand, Creative, Supply Chain, IT, CX / Operations, Kepler, and other contracted agencies.

Measures of success

Net sales and contribution vs plan · in-stock and found rate · organic vs paid mix and TACoS · search and content quality · star rating and review health · NTB and Subscribe & Save · chargebacks / shortages · forecast accuracy · promo and campaign alignment with lighthouse accounts · a Cartograph / Stackline cadence the business actually uses.

REPORTS TO:

VP, eCommerce

COMPENSATION:

$135k-$155k plus bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

• Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.

• Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.

• Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.

• Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

• Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks

• Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment

• Value real human connection and honest collaboration

• Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or other needs during the application process and employment. To request an accommodation, please contact The People Team at recruiting@drinkolipop.com.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  OLIPOP will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, gender (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

Submission of Application Materials
Applicants are required to submit only the materials specifically requested as part of the application process. Please do not include any unsolicited materials, as they will not be reviewed or considered.

Unsolicited materials may include, but are not limited to:

By submitting any materials beyond those explicitly requested, you agree that:

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Record to Report
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Vice President, Global Record to Report to lead Versant’s global Record to Report (R2R) function and shape the future-state accounting operations model for a newly independent, publicly traded media and entertainment company.  This critical accounting operations executive will be responsible for enterprise-wide R2R service delivery, including supporting Corporate and Business Unit Controllers in close operations, journal entry governance, account reconciliations, , internal and external reporting support, and related controls. The role will provide executive leadership across internal teams and outsourced service providers, ensuring timely, accurate, controlled, and scalable execution of the global close and reporting cycles.

The Vice President will play a critical role in creating and driving the strategies necessary to delivering Versant’s evolving operating model by driving standardization, strengthening governance, improving service levels, and leading transformation across R2R processes, technologies, and organizational capabilities. This includes oversight of offshored BPO-delivered activities, expansion of centralized accounting operations, adoption and optimization of enabling technologies such as BlackLine and Promenta, and successfully leading R2R through Versant’s ERP modernization and finance transformation efforts underway.

This leader will partner closely with Controllership, Finance, Technical Accounting, Risk & Compliance, Internal Audit, Treasury, Technology, business unit leadership, and third-party providers to ensure the R2R function delivers operational excellence, financial integrity, and strong stakeholder service.

This role is based in Orlando and will lead a growing organization of senior internal management level resources and outsourced BPO resources located both onshore and offshore.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership & Operating Model

• Lead the global Record to Report function, setting the strategic direction for R2R operations across Versant.
• Own the future-state R2R operating model, including centralized general accounting operations, business segment support, shared services, and outsourced delivery.
• Drive the continued evolution of R2R roles, responsibilities, governance, and service delivery expectations in alignment with Versant’s needs.
• Lead R2R readiness for major transformation initiatives, including ERP modernization, automation, process redesign, and further centralization of accounting activities.
• Partner with Controllership leadership, Finance, Treasury, and Technology to design scalable, standardized, and controlled R2R processes.
• Serve as a senior escalation point for R2R matters involving business segments, Controllership leaders, external providers, and executive stakeholders.

Service Delivery

• Oversee end-to-end R2R operations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, close coordination in revenue and costs of revenue related accounts, intercompany, fixed assets, cash and treasury accounting, compensation and benefits accounting, edit checks, suspense clearing, and reporting support.
• Ensure timely, accurate, and complete month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close execution in partnership with Corporate Accounting, Consolidations, Technical Accounting, and business-unit Controllership teams.
• Provide executive oversight of commitments to close calendars, journal entry workflows, reconciliation quality, reporting packages, and issue resolution.
• Ensure accounting operations support is aligned to business segment needs across TV Networks, Digital, Corporate Accounting, Central Accounting, and other evolving Versant business areas.
• Lead service delivery governance for outsourced and offshore resources, including performance management, issue escalation, workload planning, and accountability for service commitments.
• Ensure continuity and scalability of R2R services as Versant centralizes additional activities and supports potential growth, acquisitions, or structural changes.

Standards, Controls & Compliance

• Own the R2R control environment, ensuring processes are SOX-compliant, audit-ready, transparent, and consistently executed.
• Ensure adherence to accounting policies, internal controls, close governance, reconciliation standards, and documentation requirements.
• Partner with Technical Accounting, Risk & Compliance, Internal Audit, External Audit, Treasury, Tax, Legal, and Corporate Controllership to align R2R execution with policies and evolving standards.
• Oversee governance of journal entry and account reconciliation controls.
• Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, playbooks, escalation protocols, and control documentation across R2R teams and providers.
• Strengthen accountability for control performance across internal teams and outsourced providers.

Performance & Transformation

• Define, monitor, and improve R2R performance through KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, scorecards, and governance forums.
• Drive operational improvements that enhance close timeliness, reconciliation quality, journal entry accuracy, productivity, transparency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
• Lead standardization of R2R processes across business units, regions, and providers.
• Identify and execute automation opportunities across reconciliations, journal entries, workflow management, reporting, and exception resolution.
• Oversee adoption and optimization of BlackLine, Promenta, SAP ECC, and future ERP or close-management platforms.
• Address manual process challenges, including opportunities related to cash accounting, treasury / banking activity, transaction matching, high-risk reconciliations, and centralized workload expansion.
• Lead root cause analysis for recurring issues and drive sustainable process and control improvements.
• Support the transition from legacy or transitional processes to scalable standalone Versant capabilities where applicable.

BPO, Shared Services & Governance

• Own executive-level governance of outsourced R2R delivery, including Accenture and other third-party providers.
• Ensure outsourced teams meet agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, control requirements, and service expectations.
• Establish governance routines that provide transparency into performance, backlog, issue resolution, capacity, controls, and continuous improvement.
• Drive alignment between internal retained teams and outsourced resources to ensure clear ownership, efficient handoffs, and effective service delivery.
• Evaluate provider performance and recommend structural, staffing, process, or technology changes to improve outcomes.
• Build strong, accountable partnerships with service providers while ensuring Versant retains appropriate governance, oversight, and process ownership

People Leadership & Collaboration

• Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing global R2R organization, including internal Versant staff and outsourced/onshore/offshore resources.
• Build organizational capability to support expanded scope, greater centralization, ERP transformation, and future-state accounting operations.
• Attract, retain, coach, and develop talent capable of delivering operational excellence and transformation.
• Provide leadership to senior managers, directors, managers, and process leads across business-unit and central accounting teams.
• Promote a culture of accountability, customer service, collaboration, continuous improvement, ownership, and strong controls.
• Partner effectively with senior leaders across Accounting Operations, Controllership, Finance, Treasury, Technology, Audit, Compliance, Tax, Legal, and business units.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field
• 15+ years of progressive experience in controllership, corporate accounting, shared services, accounting operations, or Record to Report functions.
• Significant leadership experience managing large, complex R2R or accounting operations teams in a global, matrixed environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close operations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, consolidation support, and reporting packages.
• Deep knowledge of US GAAP, SOX controls, internal control frameworks, audit readiness, and close governance.
• Experience managing third-party BPO, shared service, offshore, or outsourced accounting operations providers.
• Proven ability to define and manage KPIs, SLAs, performance dashboards, governance routines, and continuous improvement programs.
• Experience leading process transformation, automation, centralization, or operating model redesign.
• Strong systems knowledge across ERP, close, reconciliation, and workflow tools, including SAP ECC, BlackLine, Promenta, or similar platforms.
• Executive-level communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, resolve escalations, and drive alignment across functions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA, MBA, or equivalent advanced accounting or business credential.
• Experience in media, entertainment, digital, advertising, news networks, streaming, technology, or similarly complex industries.
• Experience in a spin-off, IPO-readiness, post-merger integration, carve-out, transformation, or newly public company environment.
• Experience standing up or scaling standalone accounting operations capabilities.
• Finance ERP transformation experience.
• Experience with BlackLine transaction matching, reconciliation automation, journal entry workflow, or AI-enabled finance operations tools.
• International accounting operations experience, including managing global teams and regionally distributed service providers.

Why Join Us

• Lead a critical enterprise accounting operations function during a pivotal stage of Versant’s formation, growth, and transformation.
• Shape the future-state Record to Report model for a new modern publicly traded media and entertainment company.
• Partner directly with senior leadership across Controllership, Finance, Technology, Treasury, Audit, Compliance, and business operations.
• Drive measurable improvements in close quality, service delivery, controls, automation, scalability, and stakeholder experience.
• Build and develop a global team focused on accountability, operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Additional Information:

• Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Subject to change based on business need. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.
• Salary information: $200,000-$240,000 (long term incentive and bonus eligible)

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager
Remote, Anywhere in the US



About AnswersNow

At AnswersNow, we are trailblazing the future of autism therapy, making it more immediate, accessible, and effective for families everywhere. Our innovative virtual ABA therapy platform is thoughtfully designed by clinicians to recreate the focused, supportive environment of in-person therapy, complete with distraction-free features and interactive activities that enhance engagement and progress.

Our team operates fully remotely—meaning you’ll have the flexibility to work from home, and will never have to report on-site to provide client support. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact and join a team that's reshaping autism therapy, we’d love to hear from you!



About the Role

As a Staff Product Manager, you will own strategy and outcomes for a significant product area. You will identify the highest-impact opportunities, define the product strategy to address them, sequence a roadmap against measurable goals, and lead cross-functional teams from discovery through execution and iteration.

You’ll operate as a hands-on individual contributor, working closely with Design, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations to shape solutions, drive delivery, and connect product decisions to broader company goals.



About You

 - You are deeply curious and a strong critical thinker who asks questions, challenges assumptions, and gets to the root of a problem.

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, using strong judgment to create structure, move quickly, and know when to go deeper or change course.

 - You form strong points of view and are comfortable advocating for them, while staying open to new evidence and changing your mind when warranted. You are collaborative, low ego, and communicate clearly through complexity and disagreement.



Required Qualifications

 - 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex product areas or high-impact initiatives.

 - A track record of defining product strategy, sequencing a roadmap, and driving measurable outcomes.

 - Strong product judgment and systems thinking, with the ability to make good decisions in ambiguous, complex environments.

 - Comfort working closely with Engineering and Design teams that use AI-enabled tools and modern development practices to prototype, iterate, and ship quickly.

 - Active use of AI tools in your own product management workflow to improve the speed and quality of your work.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Successfully shipped and driven outcomes through AI-enabled products, including workflow automation or LLM-powered capabilities.

 - Experience building products that span both customer-facing and internal operational workflows.

 - Have working knowledge of healthcare, insurance, ABA therapy, or another regulated service environment.



What You’ll Do

Drive Product Strategy and Outcomes

 - Own a significant product problem space, driving solutions that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

 - Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, data, and business context.

 - Align cross-functional partners and senior leaders around strategy, priorities, success metrics, and key tradeoffs.

 - Continuously assess whether the strategy is working and adjust direction based on results, customer insight, and changing business needs.

Build and Sequence the Roadmap

 - Develop and refine a roadmap designed to achieve outcomes rather than deliver a predetermined set of features.

 - Sequence work based on impact, learning, dependencies, and technical foundation to deliver near-term value in service of the longer-term strategy.

 - Partner with Engineering and Design on solution approaches, technical tradeoffs, and build-versus-buy decisions.

Lead Execution

 - Lead cross-functional teams through discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and iteration, creating clarity around goals, decisions, dependencies, and tradeoffs.

 - Stay close to execution, including requirements, scope, prioritization, and product quality, while identifying risks early and keeping important work moving.

 - Measure results and determine when to iterate, scale, change direction, or stop.

Use Data and Customer Insight

 - Establish the metrics and instrumentation needed to understand performance, diagnose problems, and measure impact.

 - Combine product analytics, operational data, research, feedback, and frontline observation to guide decisions and form testable hypotheses.

 - Build deep expertise in the needs of the families, clinicians, and operational teams we serve and use that understanding to shape product direction.
   

What We Offer

 - $186,000 - $207,500 annual salary + equity

 - Flexible PTO with an remote-friendly team culture
   
   

More About AnswersNow

At AnswersNow, we believe that innovation should be inclusive. We welcome team members from all backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Our fully-remote team operates with trust, autonomy, and respect. Learn more about us at  http://getanswersnow.com/getanswersnow.com http://getanswersnow.com.

For more information, view the E-Verify Participation https://static-assets.ripplingcdn.com/webapp-static/apps/everify/us_poster_participation.pdf and Right to Work https://static-assets.ripplingcdn.com/webapp-static/apps/everify/us_poster_righttowork.pdf posters in English and Spanish.

What makes Personal Training with Equinox stand out?

Equinox is proudly recognized as the industry leader in Personal Training expertise, with the first in-house education of its kind through the Equinox Fitness Training Institute. For over twenty years EFTI has elevated our trainers to design comprehensive client fitness programs that are safe, effective and results driven. Equinox offers the highest compensation structure in the industry, with an earning potential of $100K+. In addition, Equinox offers all trainers a competitive benefits package including medical, dental and retirement planning options.

Under the guidance of two dedicated managers you will develop and refine an approach to programming, education, business, and financial planning that ensures your Personal Training career is as unlimited as your passion. Secure a stronger future and help us redefine the science of fitness and the art of living.

PT Business Management

Service and Hospitality

Professional Development

jobs.title: Marketing Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
Our Story:

Story Cannabis was built by misfits on a mission — people bold enough to shift the cannabis narrative and create something better. Founded in 2021 by industry veterans, Story is a vertically integrated company headquartered in Phoenix, operating across Arizona, Maryland, Ohio, and Louisiana, and we’re just getting started.

Our vision is to bring hope, happiness, and healing to the world through cannabis, and we’re doing it one state, one store, and one customer at a time.

Leadership defines how we show up. Data drives how we grow. Gratitude keeps us grounded. Unity fuels our momentum. And growth, in every sense, inspires everything we do.

If you’re ready to challenge what’s expected and shape the future of cannabis, your next chapter starts with Story.

Overview:

The Marketing Communications Specialist manages Story Cannabis's day-to-day email, SMS and social media communications strategy and execution across retail (B2C) and wholesale (B2B) channels in all markets. The Specialist independently evaluates channel performance, audience needs, campaign objectives and established regulatory requirements to determine communication approaches, timing, segmentation and optimization opportunities. This role also coordinates creative assets, engages with our online community, manages assigned vendor relationships and leads communication initiatives that advance the broader marketing strategy.

Responsibilities:

• Manage daily loyalty program communications, including point-earning, rewards and member-only campaigns.

• Build, QA and deploy scheduled email and SMS campaigns for retail (B2C) and wholesale (B2B) audiences per the content calendar.

• Perform pre-send QA on links, personalization, compliance language, opt-out language and send timing; track error rates and resolve issues before deployment.

• Build and refine tailored audience segments to optimize digital programmatic advertising.

• Maintain segmentation list hygiene and opt-in/opt-out accuracy in line with TCPA, carrier and state regulations.

• Develop and execute testing strategies across subject lines, content, audience segments and send times; independently evaluate results and implement changes to improve future campaign performance.

• Develop and manage the social content strategy and calendar, making recommendations on content mix, channel approach, timing and audience engagement based on business priorities, performance data and platform trends.

• Determine and optimize email, SMS and social communication timing, audience segmentation and channel approach based on campaign objectives, customer behavior and performance results.

• Evaluate campaigns for compliance with established state cannabis advertising requirements and platform policies; identify compliance risks, determine appropriate corrective action within established guidelines, and escalate novel or material issues when necessary.

• Manage assigned marketing vendor relationships, evaluate vendor performance and service needs, resolve issues, and recommend changes to vendors, services or spending based on business needs and performance.

• Collaborate with Brand Ambassadors to capture field & event content.

• Coordinate with Creative Services on assets and copy to meet production deadlines.

• Monitor comments and direct messages, respond per brand guidelines, and escalate customer service or compliance issues to the appropriate team.

• Produce and deploy communications to third party partners, including new product launches, promotions and sell-in materials, and co-branded campaigns in partnership with the Wholesale team.

• Analyze weekly and monthly performance across email, SMS and social channels; identify trends, risks and opportunities; and develop and implement recommendations to improve engagement, conversion, redemption, deliverability and audience growth.

• Serve as a subject-matter resource to Marketing and business partners on email, SMS and social channel strategy, audience segmentation, campaign performance and communication best practices.

• Lead assigned cross-functional marketing initiatives and recommend communication approaches that support broader marketing and business objectives.

KPIs / Success Metrics

• On-time send/publish rate against the content calendar, across email, SMS, and social.

• Pre-send QA defect rate (errors caught before send vs. after).

• Social response time to comments/messages against defined service standard.

• Campaign and content performance trends (open/click/redemption/engagement rate) reported monthly.

• Social media growth metric reporting.

Qualifications & Requirements:

• 2+ years marketing experience; email/SMS platform experience (Klaviyo, Springbig, Alpine IQ, or similar) preferred.

• Familiarity with social media scheduling/publishing tools and platform-specific best practices (Meta, YouTube, TikTok, etc) required.

• Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and comfort with a daily production cadence across multiple channels.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Self-motivated with a proactive approach to tasks.

• Punctual, reliable, and adaptable to occasional evening and weekend work.

• 1+ years CRM platform experience (Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.) a plus.

Physical Requirements:

• Occasional lifting, carrying, or transporting of marketing materials, signage, or event supplies (up to 25 pounds) may be required.

• This role requires prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Our Benefits:

• Paid time off (PTO) including 8 paid holidays per year*

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance*

• 401k retirement savings plan*

• Company paid Short-Term & Long-Term disability*

• Company paid Life Insurance*

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)*

• Employee referral program

• Commuter benefits*

• Product discounts

• Additional compensation incentives (tips, bonuses, etc.)

*For full-time positions only

We want our story to be one that fosters an inclusive culture and provides an enriching employee experience. As an equal-opportunity employer, we embrace individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We believe in providing equal opportunities to all individuals, including those who may have encountered legal issues related to previous marijuana laws. We understand that these laws have disproportionately impacted certain communities and individuals. We are committed to considering all candidates based on their qualifications, skills, and potential to contribute to our team, rather than focusing solely on past legal encounters. We encourage individuals from diverse backgrounds, including those with past involvement with the legal system, to apply for positions within our organization.

Why Join the Drata Team?
At Drata, you're not maintaining legacy compliance software - you're building the agentic AI platform defining what trust looks like for the next generation of companies. Here's what makes the work itself worth showing up for:

 - Problems without a playbook: You'll work at the edge of AI and security, building agentic governance, continuous compliance, and real-time trust verification to solve problems that don't have an established answer yet. You're writing it as you go.

 - Real ownership, not just process: Our values center on owning outcomes and raising the bar, not checking boxes. You're expected to have opinions and back them.

 - A seat at the table: Your perspective is unique and valued. Open debate and diverse viewpoints are built into how decisions actually get made here, at every level.

 - Growth at rocketship speed: Drata is scaling fast, which means scope grows fast too. High performers get more ownership, visibility, and experience.

 - A crew, not just coworkers: Dratanauts consistently describe a "come as you are" culture with sharp, curious people—the kind of team that makes hard problems genuinely fun to solve. See what they say here https://drata.com/about/careers/life and follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/drata/posts/?feedView=all for company news, employee stories, and career updates.

Job Summary:

Drata's Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) platform helps companies identify, assess, and continuously manage the risks that come from their vendors and other third parties. Instead of manually reviewing only their highest-risk vendors, our customers use Drata to run rigorous, consistent reviews across their entire vendor portfolio — maintaining a complete vendor inventory, collecting evidence like SOC 2 reports and ISO certifications, evaluating it against their own criteria with Drata's AI agent, and producing audit-ready reports. The agent accelerates the assessment work; humans stay responsible for final risk and approval decisions.

 

We're looking for a Staff Product Engineer to build these workflows, integrations, and AI-powered experiences — and to own them end to end. At Drata, engineering doesn't stop at a merged pull request. You'll follow a feature from problem definition through design, rollout, documentation, and production monitoring, making sure customers are actually using and benefiting from what you ship. Strong engineering is expected, but the engineers who thrive here are defined by judgement, ownership, and communication at least as much as by code.

What you’ll do:

 - Own features end to end — from understanding the customer problem, through design and implementation, to rollout, documentation, and post-launch monitoring.

 - Manage your own releases — own feature-flag strategy and the actual rollout, rather than handing off at merge.

 - Treat UX and documentation as part of the deliverable — a feature isn't done until it's usable and understood.

 - Monitor production health for your product area — catch and resolve issues from strong signals, not from customer complaints or escalations.

 - Partner closely with Product — understand the problem before implementing, and propose better approaches when you see them.

 - Address bugs and tech debt as part of the work, rather than deferring them indefinitely.

 - Build with AI — develop and improve the AI agent experiences at the core of our assessment workflows.

What you’ll bring:

Technical skill is the foundation — but the qualities below are what set our best Product Engineers apart, and we weight them heavily:

 - Judgement — You see the end-to-end picture from the customer's perspective and make sound decisions without needing every step specified.

 - Ownership — You treat rollout, UX, documentation, and production health as yours, not someone else's.

 - Comfort with ambiguity — You make meaningful progress on under-defined problems.

 - Multiplier effect — You raise the people and teams around you through mentorship, strong reviews, and unblocking others.

 - Domain depth — You invest in understanding our product and our customers' world (vendor risk, TPRM, compliance).

 - Clear prioritization & communication — You judge urgency accurately, escalate at the right time, think one step ahead, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.

Requirements:

 - Professional software engineering experience building and owning production systems end to end 8–10+ years

 - Proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript across the stack. (must have)

 - Backend experience with Node.js / NestJS; front-end experience with React.

 - Experience with event-driven architecture and durable workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal).

 - Solid grounding in relational databases, testing, observability/telemetry, and modern CI/CD practices.

 - Operates across teams and product areas; owns architecture and long-term technical direction.

 - Sets technical direction for others and serves as a primary escalation point.

 - Makes decisions that span multiple areas and longer time horizons.

 - Mentors across the team and closes gaps between disparate parts of the system.

 - Plans for the long term and avoids short-term-only solutions.

Bonus qualifications:

 - Experience in TPRM, vendor risk, GRC, or compliance domains.

 - Experience building or working alongside AI-powered product features

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata https://drata.com/about/life-at-drata?utm_source=chatgpt.com.

 - Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

 - Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

 - Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

 - Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

 - Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

 - Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $165,000 - $270,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role. 

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.
