jobs.title: Registered Dental Assistant
jobs.description:
Title: Registered Dental Assistant
Practice: Associated Oral & Implant Surgeons
Location: Johnson City, TN - Bristol, TN Kingsport, TN
Hours:

• Monday:8:00 AM - 4:00 PM

• Tuesday:8:00 AM - 4:00 PM

• Wednesday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM

• Thursday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM

• Friday: 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM

• Saturday: Closed

• Sunday: Closed

Please note that this position requires travel between all three locations. Travel schedules will be planned in advance to allow sufficient time for any necessary arrangements. Additional details regarding the travel schedule, expectations, and responsibilities will be discussed during the interview process.

Position Purpose:

The Registered Dental Assistant (RDA) is responsible for delivering compassionate, safe, and high-quality clinical care in support of the oral and maxillofacial surgeons. This role requires advanced clinical competency, strong knowledge of surgical protocols, and the ability to anticipate surgeon needs during procedures. The CSA ensures efficient surgical workflow, maintains patient comfort and safety, and upholds the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance.

Essential Functions:

Patient Care & Clinical Support

• Provide exemplary patient care and ensure the highest level of service during all interactions.

• Communicate with patients and families in a professional, empathetic, and educational manner.

• Prepare patients for surgical procedures, including reviewing medical histories, confirming documentation, and ensuring patient understanding of pre- and post-operative instructions.

• Assist oral surgeons throughout all surgical procedures, anticipating needs, maintaining sterile technique, and ensuring all instruments and materials are available and functional.

• Monitor and record patient vital signs during surgery, reporting concerns promptly.

• Provide postoperative care and patient education, ensuring clear communication of aftercare instructions.

Surgical & Clinical Operations

• Set up, maintain, and break down surgical operatories following strict aseptic and safety protocols.

• Sterilize, organize, and maintain surgical instruments, equipment, and supplies.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all patient encounters and surgical procedures.

• Demonstrate strong knowledge of surgical instrumentation, oral surgery procedures, and infection control standards.

• Support sedation and anesthesia workflows in compliance with practice and regulatory requirements.

Compliance, Safety & Quality Assurance

• Adhere to all clinical, OSHA, HIPAA, and infection control standards.

• Participate in monthly safety and compliance checks, including:

• Crash cart/verifications

• Fire extinguisher checks

• Emergency preparedness attestations

• X-ray unit calibration

• Omni-cam calibration

• Controlled substance log accuracy and inventory

• Oxygen tank maintenance

• Controlled substance invoice documentation

• Ensure strict adherence to controlled substance handling and safety procedures.

Teamwork & Professional Development

• Foster a collaborative, respectful, and professional team environment.

• Participate in regular staff meetings, training sessions, and continuing education as required.

• Support workflow efficiency by maintaining organized, clean, and fully stocked clinical areas.

Qualifications:

Education & Certification

• High School Diploma or equivalent required; relevant college coursework preferred.

• Certified Surgical Assistant (CSA) credential required (or equivalent surgical assisting certification).

• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required; training provided if not current.

• ACLS or DAANCE certification preferred (or willingness to obtain).

Experience:

• Previous experience in oral surgery or dental surgical assisting preferred; will provide training for candidates meeting certification requirements.

Performance Requirements:

• Advanced knowledge of oral surgery procedures, surgical instruments, and sterile techniques.

• Strong ability to anticipate surgeon needs and respond quickly in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and patient-interaction skills.

• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and exercise sound judgment.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in clinical documentation.

• Proficiency with computer systems, electronic health records, and digital imaging.

• Ability to work independently while supporting a high-performance team environment.

• Positive, professional, and adaptable demeanor.

What we do for you:

• We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance plans to our full-time employees.

• Two out of the three medical plans offered include Health Savings Account (HSA) eligibility.

• Company-paid Life, AD&D and Long-Term Disability coverage.

• Additional Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance for you and your family!

• Voluntary Short-Term Disability Insurance available to you as well

• Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) offered.

• Immediately begin saving for retirement through our 401(k) starting with very first paycheck!

• Employer 401(k) contribution and Profit Sharing after six months of employment

• PTO and 8 Paid holidays for fulltime employees!

DISCLAIMER

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this work.  This is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities.  OSP’s management reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet business and organizational needs as necessary.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director - New Orleans
jobs.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

• Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake

• Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities

• Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond

• Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time

• Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

• Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region

• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers

• Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge

• Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact

• Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

• Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts

• Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies

• Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts

• timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution

• Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments

• Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions

• Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

• Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards

• Manage regional budgets and resources effectively

• Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline

• Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

• 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience

• 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role

• Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals

• Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred

• Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred

• Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent

• Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment

• Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

• A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams

• Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure

• Collaborative and able to influence across functions

• Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

• This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range:  $180,000 - $215,000

jobs.title: Bilingual Onboarding Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Onboarding Coordinator is responsible for delivering a seamless and compliant onboarding experience for new hires from offer acceptance through successful integration into the organization. This role serves as the primary point of contact for new employees and internal stakeholders, coordinating orientation, pre-employment requirements, system access, badging, equipment requests, and onboarding activities. The Onboarding Coordinator partners closely with Human Resources, Recruiting, Operations, Security, IT, and hiring managers to ensure new employees are prepared, engaged, and ready for success on their first day.

• Coordinate all onboarding activities for newly hired employees.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires before and during their onboarding experience.
• Verify completion of onboarding requirements, including badge creation documentation, offer documentation, background screening, employment authorization, and new hire paperwork, prior to orientation.
• Ensure completion, accuracy, and retention of required employment documentation, including Form I-9s and employment eligibility verification.
• Initiate, monitor, and verify background screening results and escalate any discrepancies for appropriate review.
• Maintain onboarding trackers, records, and reporting to ensure compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
• Facilitate new hire orientation sessions and ensure completion of required onboarding documentation.

• Communicate start dates, orientation schedules, reporting instructions, and first-day expectations.

jobs.title: Field Management Superintendent
jobs.description:
AECOM Hunt is seeking an experienced Field Superintendent to support a major stadium construction project  in the Tampa Bay, Florida area.

The Field Superintendent will be responsible for overseeing daily field construction activities, coordinating subcontractors, maintaining project schedules, and ensuring work is performed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project plans, specifications, and quality standards.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in large-scale commercial construction, preferably with experience delivering sports stadiums, arenas, entertainment venues, or other complex, high-profile projects.

• Provide overall on-site administrative and technical management for a wide range of construction projects.
• Responsible for the organization and direction of construction and related activities within assigned area of responsibility, which may be a single area, multi-area or a multi-discipline construction project.
• May be the primary client contact for all jobsite day to day activities, or may coordinate with client’s resident representatives on jobsite activities within assigned area of operations.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) plus 8 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience supervising field construction activities on large-scale commercial construction projects.
• Working knowledge of construction means, methods, sequencing, and subcontractor coordination.
• Knowledge of construction safety regulations, quality control procedures, and project scheduling.
• Valid Driver's License

Preferred Requirements:

• 8+ years of progressive field construction experience, including experience in a Superintendent or Field Superintendent role.
• Experience working for a large general contractor or construction management firm on complex, multimillion-dollar projects.
• Experience on sports stadiums, arenas, entertainment venues, convention centers, or other large public assembly facilities strongly preferred.
• Experience managing multiple subcontractors and trades on large, fast-paced construction projects.
• Experience with complex construction sequencing, logistics planning, and schedule-driven project delivery.
• Familiarity with Procore, Primavera P6, Bluebeam, and other construction management software.
• OSHA 30 certification preferred.
• Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
• Experience working on high-profile projects with multiple stakeholders and demanding schedules.
• Familiarity with Florida construction practices, building codes, and permitting requirements.

Physical Demands:

• The following physical demands represent those typically required of individuals working in construction field roles, with or without accommodation. Construction field positions require physical stamina and mobility, including the ability to climb ladders and stairs, use personnel hoists, and move through various terrain and active construction zones. Vision requirements include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Team members must be capable of using their hands to handle tools and materials, and perform activities such as sitting, standing, walking, speaking, hearing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling. Lifting and carrying materials weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted may be necessary on an occasional basis.

Work Environment:

• Individuals in construction field roles work primarily on active job sites where exposure to environmental and job-related hazards is common, with or without accommodation. These environments may include proximity to heavy machinery, elevated work areas, airborne particles, varying weather conditions, and potential electrical risks. Noise levels may vary from moderate to high depending on the phase of construction. Employees may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and must remain alert to ensure safety. Additional duties may be assigned as needed based on the scope and progress of the project.

Additional Information:

• This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization now or in the future.
• Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
• This position is not hybrid nor remote.
• For positions with driving responsibilities, Motor Vehicle Records are reviewed as part of AECOM’s background check process to ensure compliance with the Company’s driving standards.

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
DOES YOUR DEFINITION OF SUCCESS MEAN EMPOWERING OTHERS?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Customer Onboarding Specialist to join our Success team!

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be. The way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011, but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

Our Success team works together with other teams and stakeholders to bring our company values to life for our customers. By being humble, supportive, and truly giving a sh*t, the Success team ensures that our customers are successful in Jobber. This team thrives on meaningful and impactful communication with one another and with our customers, and plays a significant role in the lives of the entrepreneurs and business owners that utilize Jobber.

The role

Reporting to a Manager, Customer Onboarding, our Customer Onboarding Specialists play a pivotal role in welcoming new home service businesses to Jobber and setting them up for long-term success. By removing technical barriers, streamlining digital payments, and guiding Service Providers (SPs) through a structured onboarding journey, we ensure a smooth start and position them to get real value from Jobber quickly.

As a Customer Onboarding Specialist, you’ll manage a portfolio of home service businesses and act as their trusted advisor through onboarding. You’ll guide each customer through a defined progression, from their first kickoff conversation to full activation in their first 90 days, working to clear milestones and service commitments along the way. You’ll consult on Jobber features, workflows, and integrations, recommend tailored solutions that move their business forward, and use scalable tactics to support many customers well at once. You’ll also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Jobber, including Sales, Customer Success, and R&D, to keep improving how we onboard.

What you’ll do

 - Guide a portfolio of new customers through a structured onboarding progression, from kickoff to activation, hitting clear milestones and timelines along the way.

 - Be a product expert so our customers are set up for success from day one, driving the value of features, workflows, and how to use Jobber effectively for their business.

 - Actively listen to customers’ needs, build strong relationships, and deliver customer focused solutions rooted in empathy.

 - Be patient and reliable for our customers when things aren’t going the way they expected.

 - Use AI-assisted workflows every day for session prep, follow-ups, and account context, so more of your time goes to the customer conversation itself.

 - Drive and encourage feedback loops that strengthen a customer retention mindset across the team.

 - Strive for execution excellence by helping optimize our tooling, processes, and workflows.

 - Become an ambassador of our culture by being humble, supportive, and someone who truly gives a sh*t!

To be successful, you’ll need

 - Customer service experience, ideally in a role providing high touch customer service. Bonus points for high volume and SaaS environments.

 - A track record of exceptional customer support and onboarding of new customers to complex products.

 - Comfort operating inside structured systems: defined playbooks, milestones, and metrics, while still bringing judgment and a personal touch to every customer.

 - Next level communication and relationship building abilities. We move fast, which means you’ll need to build a high degree of trust with peers, key stakeholders, and the customers who are our life blood.

 - Experience with a modern CRM and scheduling stack (we use Salesforce, Chili Piper, and Slack) and the ability to pick up new tools quickly.

 - Hands-on comfort using AI tools in your daily work, and the adaptability to keep pace as our tooling and workflows evolve.

 - A performance driven, achievement oriented mindset with a bias for action and an eagerness to take initiative.

 - Agility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment. We’re growing fast and things change every day. What worked yesterday might not work anymore, and you need to be energized by that kind of challenge.

 - An incredible passion for our customers and a connection to our purpose: to help small businesses be more successful.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role comes with a fixed compensation structure, starting at $59,000 CAD.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

If you have any questions about our compensation approach, we encourage open conversations throughout the hiring process!

 

Please note: To better support our customer our Customer Onboarding Specialist team works a weekday shift and will require the ability to work one weekend day every four weeks to better serve our customers. This changes depending on daylight savings time. 

In the winter the schedule would be Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm MT and in the summer, it would be Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm MT, inclusive of a 1-hr lunch. 

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Growth Platforms

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Decisioning Studio Integrations Team
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join the Decisioning Studio Integrations team building BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™. Decisioning Studio is a reinforcement learning platform that runs continuous experiments to personalize customer engagement for each individual. Its results depend on the data it learns from and on the channels that carry its decisions to customers. Our team owns both. We ingest enterprise customer data of any schema and at a very large scale from warehouses, engagement platforms and other enterprise systems. We also deliver the recommendations from our RL pipelines across email, SMS, push, in-app and other channels. These are high-impact, customer-facing features.

In this role, you will:

• Lead complex integration projects from design through build and rollout, and set technical direction for the Decisioning Studio integration platform

• Design and build integrations with cloud data warehouses, customer engagement platforms and other enterprise systems, for both data ingestion and activation orchestration

• Build ingestion pipelines that handle every way customers send data, including batch pulls, file drops, APIs and streaming, and accept arbitrary schemas without letting bad data reach our models

• Build event-driven, fault-tolerant activation pipelines that deliver recommendations on schedule, recover cleanly from partial failures and never send twice

• Design for multi-region deployment and compliance requirements, including data residency and PII handling

• Own your systems in production. Instrument them with Datadog, take part in the on-call rotation, and take incidents all the way to the root cause

• Work with data scientists, ML engineers and product managers to turn integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities

• Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, testing and design review

WHO YOU ARE

• 6+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production

• A track record of technical leadership: owning complex projects end to end, making architecture decisions and setting direction for other engineers

• Experience building data pipelines or integrations that move very large volumes of data between systems, including schema changes, backfills and partial failures

• A strong grasp of event-driven architecture and reliability patterns: message brokers such as Kafka, idempotency, retries with backoff, dead-letter handling, and at-least-once versus exactly-once tradeoffs

• Proficiency in Python and SQL

• Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred) and Kubernetes

• Experience with AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when they help and when they don't

• A clear communicator who works well with engineering, data science and product

• A self-starter who finds problems and works around obstacles without waiting for direction

Bonus points:

• Experience integrating with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift

• Experience integrating with customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Klaviyo

• Experience building multi-region systems under data residency and compliance requirements

• Experience running ML systems in production

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $156,364 and $279,957/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $172,000 and $306,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. jobs.title: Middle School: Dean of Students - Greater Boston (2027-2028)
jobs.description:
Dean of Students at KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School

KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School Dean of Students will proactively help shape and lead our school culture to ensure our students and teachers continue their growth and development. The Dean will manage our restorative discipline system, including directly working with students, managing Associate D, teachers, and/or other school-based staff (dependent on staffing structure year to year), running professional development for staff regarding restorative practices, and monitoring our consistency across our campus.  The Dean will also execute the school’s vision on campus by leading professional development, giving teachers feedback, and being a part of the Leadership Team to further drive our impact within our instructional coaching and classrooms.  The Dean of Students is a critical role in helping to amplify our children’s potential by creating a school experience that affirms, values, and challenges students each day.

This role requires consistent and reliable demonstration of the following essential job functions and key responsibilities:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

School Culture Responsibilities

• Highly present and visible during school hours, relentlessly ensuring the school has a strong culture in and out of the classroom
• Proactively circulating throughout classrooms and hallways during the day to gain valuable context on student behavior and to help support a positive school culture
• Lead all transitions including arrival/dismissal, hallways transitions, breakfast and lunch, and other school-wide transitions
• May be in charge of setting the tone and leading whole school lunch
• Model positive interactions with students and a variety of ways to handle behavioral disruptions
• Provide students in crisis with space and strategies to cope and to improve classroom and school-wide behaviors
• Model and facilitate restorative practices between and with students and staff

Family Engagement

• Serve as the point person for students and families regarding all disciplinary actions and culture issues
• Attend and support at-risk for retention conferences with students and their families as needed
• Communicate with families of our most struggling students on a consistent basis to provide feedback on their performance and progress
• Handle culture-based concerns brought to school leadership by families
• Facilitate family meetings between students, families, and teachers
• Oversee proactive school-wide family engagement structures

School Leadership Responsibilities

• Work closely with school leaders as part of the Leadership Team to ensure a joyful, safe, and effective school experience for all staff and students
• With the Leadership Team, develop and implement a vision for school culture that includes routines, procedures, and structures that affirm, value, and challenge students each day
• Provide ongoing professional development and feedback to all staff on issues of relationship building, school-wide behavioral plans, and ways to maintain positive culture within the school
• Collaborate with teachers, counselors, students, and families to create and implement effective behavioral plans accessible to all students
• Set ambitious goals and gather data to monitor and report progress of self, staff, and students
• Supervise and manage Associate Dean(s), teachers, and other school-based staff (dependent on annual staffing structure) with responsibilities that include coaching, hiring, and termination decisions.

General Requirements and Responsibilities

• Embody KIPP MA’s Code of Conduct by acting with integrity, leading with humanity, centering self-awareness and critical consciousness, taking personal responsibility, and engaging productively
• Participate and engage in regional professional development and community events as required
• Demonstrated ability to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and make reasonable judgments and decisions in a timely manner in accordance with the needs of the school
• Self-awareness, flexibility and emotional intelligence to navigate a setting with students who express diverse needs
• The consistent use of interpersonal and self-management skills to effectively support behavioral and emotional needs of students to ensure a safe and inclusive environment, as well as build relationships and manage conflict with students, staff, and caregivers
• Effective communication skills to perform assigned duties and to meaningfully exchange information with students, staff, families and others in person, through written communication, in front of groups, and on virtual platforms
• Physical mobility to move self in various positions in order to execute duties effectively, which may include kneeling, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, twisting, turning, bending, stooping and reaching overhead
• Physical strength sufficient to periodically lift and/or carry 20 pounds of materials or supplies and to physically restrain a student to keep from harming themself and/or others in an emergency situation
• Manual dexterity sufficient to perform repetitive hand/wrist/arm motions and to operate a computer and office equipment

KIPP MA staff are supported in their demanding work by experienced and dedicated leadership and staff who have themselves proven successful in the teaching role. Our leaders maintain consistent school-wide systems and procedures - academic, behavioral, cultural, logistical - designed to permit teachers to do their best work.

In addition to the responsibilities listed above, there will occasionally be other duties as assigned that staff will engage in to help promote a positive and calm learning environment and culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Deep alignment with KIPP MA’s mission and values, including the unwavering belief in the high potential of all students
• Demonstrated ability to drive student growth and achievement and to create a warm, inclusive, rigorous learning environment
• 2+ years of full-time teaching experience (teaching background required)
• Bachelor’s Degree required
• Computer literacy and baseline familiarity with Google Suite
• Pass Criminal Background Checks

What We Offer

The minimum salary range for this exempt position is $71,000 to $91,600 (per 1.0 FTE/45 hours), depending upon years of relevant experience after your Bachelor's degree and any advanced degrees (+$3,000 for 1st advanced degree and +$1,500 for 2nd advanced degree). The role includes a $1,000 signing bonus—and an annual $2,000 retention bonus in subsequent years, as well as other bonuses, when eligible. This role follows our Extended School Year calendar.  For more about what we offer, how to apply and more about KIPP MA, please visit this link HERE.

KIPP MA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in building a vibrant and welcoming school community that advances our mission of ensuring that all KIPP students graduate with the skills and confidence to lead fulfilling lives. This includes a commitment to attracting and developing individuals who understand the experiences of the students and communities we serve. We hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Delivery Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Supply Chain Delivery Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the movement and final delivery of containerized cargo from port, rail, and warehouse locations to customer delivery sites. This role serves as the primary point of contact for delivery scheduling, appointment management, shipment visibility, exception resolution, and customer communication. The position works closely with customers, trucking providers, warehouses, terminals, and internal operations teams to ensure deliveries are executed on time and in accordance with customer requirements. The Supply Chain Delivery Coordinator is responsible for proactively managing shipment milestones, identifying service risks, and providing timely updates throughout the delivery process. This role will initially support a dedicated Key Account with the opportunity to expand support across multiple customers and Delivery Management programs.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

Operations:

• Schedule and manage the daily drayage plan for all inbound containers to the customer’s distribution centers (including Expeditors managed, Expeditors third party partners, customer-operated and customer-contracted locations)
• Ensure timely movement of containers to mitigate all accessorial costs
• Produce multiple reports as required (daily or otherwise), including but not limited to volume forecasts, expected arrival to the marine terminals, delivery schedules, load location, and empty reports
• Understand and document current operational process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency
• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed as per the Customer SOP
• Timely responses to emails in both personal and group mailboxes
• Conduct daily operations calls as needed with drayage partners, delivery locations, and the customer(s).
• Ensure the system reports including but not limited to the below list are utilized at the Learn and utilize systems configured specific to this operation (possible EDMS configuration)

• Support the manager in the following areas:
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with vendors: facility operations, trucking companies, on-site team employees
• Support after hours operations, if needed, by utilizing email on phone and laptop access
• Monitor compliance at all times to regulations. This includes internal policies and procedures such as Operational Process Standards (OPS) and external government regulations (FMC, Denied Party Screening, etc) or customer requirements.

Finances:

• Meet weekly or more if required with the department manager/supervisor
• Support the manager as required and applicable in the following areas:
• Ensure company credit procedures are followed, and utilized effectively (Credit Extensions, Branch Credit Requests, CASH account procedures, FRL process, DAP policy)

Sales:

• Support the manager and or the sales department where needed:
• Support Account Management with relevant and current information regarding key performance measurements for regularly scheduled business reviews
• Take an active role in the transition of new business/ updates to existing business including rate schedule updates, SOP creation & maintenance, account review with operations staff, introductory meetings with customers, and proactive establishment of tactical account management by having service provider included into the transition process.

Systems:

• Ensure department is using all system tools to their greatest advantage based on your department size and organization. (e.g. using edoc import database, and other system generated reports to manage by exception)
• Be open to implementing new system changes and enhancements into your department.
• Be involved and suggest system/process improvements.
• Set the tone of this environment within your department.

Culture:

• Actively promote the company’s 10 cultural attributes: Appearance, Attitude, Confidence, Curiosity, Excellence, Integrity, Pride, Resolute, Sense of Humor, and Visionary.
• Behavioral Absolutes

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
• 2+ years related experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Clear understanding of the movement of containers in large volumes to and from ports, inland depots, and customer distribution centers along with material flows domestically to final consumption points.
• Effective interpersonal skills, including proven abilities to listen, comprehend, effectively communicate clearly and concisely to obtain positive results.
• Pro-active, strong organizational skills.

jobs.title: Structural Drafter/Designer (3+ years Revit Production)
jobs.description:
As a Structural Revit Designer/Drafter at Coffman Engineers, you’ll help deliver innovative engineering solutions focused on our clients’ success. You’ll be part of a collaborative, creative, and high-performing team that believes in making a difference for our clients and our communities, in a culture where your growth and contributions truly matter.

Coffman Engineers is seeking a Structural Revit Designer/Drafter for our Portland office. The successful candidate will play a key role in developing structural building models, construction documents, and project deliverables using Revit and Building Information Modeling (BIM) technologies. Working closely with structural engineers and project teams, this individual will be responsible for creating, coordinating, and maintaining detailed 3D models and drawing sets for a variety of project types.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Revit-based structural modeling and documentation, as well as an understanding of BIM workflows and interdisciplinary coordination. Experience with AutoCAD and other design software is beneficial; however, Revit proficiency and BIM expertise are the primary focus of this role. The successful candidate will independently complete design and drafting assignments while maintaining a high level of quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery.

• Strong Revit experience with 3 or more years’ experience in Revit drafting and design.
• Advanced CAD, layout, and BIM skills.
• Computer skills necessary for daily activities including email, Microsoft Teams, word processing, spreadsheets, BlueBeam, and graphics.
• Ability to work from engineering sketches to produce computer-generated drawing sets including plans, details, schedules, technical specifications and notes.
• Ability to work efficiently with numerous project teams to help with project completion.
• Drafting experience with structural buildings and framing preferred.
• Technical or associate degree in architectural/structural design and drafting or related engineering field preferred.
• Experience with the latest release of AutoCAD is beneficial but not required.
• Broader knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows and interdisciplinary coordination is preferred.

This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

Why You Want To Work Here

You could choose to work anywhere, so why work at Coffman Engineers? Because we are different – our culture sets us apart. Simply stated, we are a group of creative, high-performing people who like working together and believe that what we do makes a difference. Employees say that it feels like working with a group of friends in a small office while enjoying the benefits and perks of working for a large firm. Our culture is not the only thing that makes us different, but it drives everything we do.

Coffman offers comprehensive benefits, including a flexible PTO program and a fun office environment. Our Portland office is located on the 19th floor of Sixth & Main in the heart of downtown. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Payroll
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Global Payroll to oversee our US, international and EOR payrolls. You'll lead the team, approve payroll before each submission and handle the most complex pay, tax and compliance issues.

 


YOU WILL

 - Review gross-to-net results and pre and post payroll reconciliations for each run, and process off-cycle payments and final pay.

 - Build the payroll roadmap for system, provider and process improvements, and bring recommendations to Accounting leadership.

 - Train and develop the payroll team, review their work and act as the escalation point for complex pay issues.

 - Manage US multi-state payroll tax registrations, agency notices and amendments, and quarter-end and year-end filings.

 - Manage Canadian payroll across provinces, including statutory deductions and remittances, ROEs and T4 reporting.

 - Coordinate with EOR and in-country providers on international payroll and local compliance questions.

 - Partner with Equity on ISO exercise reporting and NSO payroll withholding and reporting, including international equity awards.

 - Work with People Operations, Legal, Accounting and Equity on pay policies and the employee data and approvals that feed payroll.

 - Prepare payroll journal entries, accruals, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis for the monthly close.

 - Reconcile benefit and 401(k) deductions and remittances, and support year-end 401(k) work and payroll audits.

 - Document payroll procedures, maintain controls and automate manual steps.

 - Run provider implementations and migrations, and resolve service and data issues.

 - Oversee payroll setup for new countries or entities.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of payroll experience, including 3+ years of multi-country payroll with external providers.

 - Hands-on experience with US multi-state and multi-province Canadian payroll.

 - Strong knowledge of US payroll tax, including quarter-end and year-end filings.

 - Knowledge of Canadian payroll requirements and provincial differences, and when to bring in local specialists.

 - Experience with at least one payroll provider implementation or migration.

 - Payroll accounting experience, including journal entries, reconciliations, audit support and equity withholding.

 - Experience managing payroll staff and handling confidential pay matters under tight deadlines.

 - Strong Excel and data analysis skills, and experience working with People Operations, Accounting, Equity and providers.




NICE TO HAVES

 - You've worked with EOR arrangements and HRIS-to-payroll integrations.

 - You've used Paylocity and NetSuite; familiarity with BambooHR, Carta or Pebl is helpful.

 - You hold a CPP, PCP or CPM certification.



The salary range for this role is $142,000 - $210,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

 


PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners for hybrid employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit for hybrid employees

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

 - 💸 401k plan
   

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Director, Revenue Growth
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is looking for a Director of Revenue Growth Platforms to lead product strategy for capabilities that support growing and emerging areas of our advertising business. Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales Revenue and Platforms, this role will focus on improving how sellers identify opportunities, engage prospects, manage leads, and move business through the sales lifecycle.

The role will support key growth areas including Programmatic, Universal Ads, Local, and SMBG, with a particular focus on lead generation and prospecting, sales workflows, and the platforms that enable them.

This person will bring a strong understanding of sales technology and the lead-to-revenue lifecycle, including how prospecting and lead intelligence platforms connect with CRM and downstream sales workflows. They will partner across Sales, Product, Operations, Data, and Technology to define product strategy, identify opportunities, and develop scalable capabilities that improve seller productivity, speed, and revenue growth.

The Platform Solutions team provides support and builds business solutions for Sales, Planning, Marketing, Research, Account Management, and Finance departments across a national and global ad sales landscape. The Director of Revenue Growth Platforms will support NBCUniversal’s National Ad Sales team in the development and execution of all Ad Sales processes in Salesforce.

Responsibilities

• Define and drive product strategy and roadmap for Revenue Growth products supporting newer and growing areas of NBCUniversal's advertising business
• Develop a deep understanding of the needs and workflows of Programmatic, Universal Ads, Local, and SMB sales teams and translate those needs into product opportunities
• Own product strategy across the lead and prospecting lifecycle, including prospect identification, enrichment, qualification, assignment, engagement, and conversion
• Evaluate how lead generation, prospecting, sales intelligence, and CRM capabilities should work together to create a connected seller experience
• Assess external platforms and emerging technologies to determine where NBCUniversal should buy, integrate, enhance, or build capabilities
• Partner with Sales leadership and users to identify friction within existing workflows and determine where better tools, data, integrations, or processes can improve seller productivity and revenue outcomes
• Translate business opportunities into clear product strategies, requirements, priorities, and success measures
• Partner with Salesforce Product and Technology teams to define how lead and prospecting capabilities integrate into Salesforce and the broader sales technology ecosystem
• Understand upstream and downstream system dependencies and ensure new capabilities fit within the broader sales and advertising workflow
• Partner with Programmatic Sales and Operations teams to understand evolving business needs and identify opportunities for product and workflow improvements
• Identify common capabilities that can scale across sales teams while recognizing where different business models require differentiated workflows
• Use seller feedback, adoption, workflow performance, and business outcomes to evaluate product effectiveness and inform future investments
• Develop business cases and recommendations for new platforms, integrations, capabilities, and product investments
• Build alignment across a highly matrixed organization, connecting business strategy with Product, Technology, Data, and Operations execution
• Stay current on sales technology, lead intelligence, prospecting, CRM, programmatic, and advertising industry trends to inform product strategy
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners responsible for Revenue Growth capabilities.
• Drive product management best practices, including roadmap planning, requirements management, stakeholder engagement, and value measurement.
• Act as an escalation point for complex business, process, and technology decisions impacting Revenue Growth platforms.

Required Qualifications/Skills

• 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Sales Technology, Revenue Technology, or a related role supporting complex sales organizations.
• Strong understanding of the lead-to-revenue lifecycle, including prospecting, lead generation, enrichment, qualification, lead management, and conversion.
• Experience with sales prospecting, lead intelligence, or data platforms and an understanding of how these capabilities integrate with CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
• Strong understanding of sales technology ecosystems and the role technology and data play in enabling different sales motions.
• Experience developing product strategy and roadmaps based on business needs, user workflows, market capabilities, and technology considerations.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate technology solutions and make thoughtful build, buy, and integrate recommendations.
• Experience partnering with Sales, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology teams to deliver cross-functional capabilities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
• Experience leading and developing Product Managers, Business Analysts, or cross-functional product teams.
• Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across a highly matrixed organization.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences and clearly present product recommendations.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working within advertising, media, streaming, ad tech, or a large enterprise sales organization.
• Experience supporting SMB, emerging business, Local, or other high-volume sales organizations.
• Knowledge of programmatic advertising sales and operational workflows.
• Experience with lead generation, prospecting, enrichment, and sales intelligence technologies
• Understanding of Salesforce lead, account, contact, and opportunity workflows and how external sales platforms integrate with CRM.
• Familiarity with data enrichment, identity, account matching, lead routing, and sales engagement capabilities.
• Understanding of linear, digital, streaming/CTV, and programmatic advertising business models.
• Experience assessing emerging technologies and translating market capabilities into an enterprise product strategy.
• Experience working across multiple Product teams to create connected end-to-end seller experiences.

Additional Requirements

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Remote Available - within USA.

About the Role

Fortune Brands runs on Boomi. The platform carries 445 integrations and roughly 1.75 million transactions a day, spanning 11 brands and 35 business capabilities, and nearly every customer-facing system we operate connects through it. It runs around the clock.

As Senior Boomi Integration Developer, you are the United States-based technical lead for that estate. You own integration architecture, you design, build, test, deploy and support the integrations themselves, and you make the call when something breaks in production.

You are also the bridge between two groups who need each other. Business teams describe what they need in their own language. Offshore developers build against your designs. Translating the first into the second, and holding the quality of what comes back, is a large part of this job and a large part of why it matters.

This is a platform with real scale and real consequences, and you would be the person accountable for it. How we win here is not complicated. Execute every day. Be accountable. Do what needs to be done.

· Translate business and end-user requirements into clear, feasible, and scalable technical specifications.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer 2, TPRM
jobs.description:
Drata is building the trust layer between great companies - automating compliance, managing risk, and helping organizations prove trust continuously as they scale. We're Dratanauts: a global crew of 600+ professionals united by a culture that rewards integrity, ownership, and raising the bar, no matter where in the world we're working from.

Why Join the Drata Team?
At Drata, you're not maintaining legacy compliance software - you're building the agentic AI platform defining what trust looks like for the next generation of companies. Here's what makes the work itself worth showing up for:

 - Problems without a playbook: You'll work at the edge of AI and security, building agentic governance, continuous compliance, and real-time trust verification to solve problems that don't have an established answer yet. You're writing it as you go.

 - Real ownership, not just process: Our values center on owning outcomes and raising the bar, not checking boxes. You're expected to have opinions and back them.

 - A seat at the table: Your perspective is unique and valued. Open debate and diverse viewpoints are built into how decisions actually get made here, at every level.

 - Growth at rocketship speed: Drata is scaling fast, which means scope grows fast too. High performers get more ownership, visibility, and experience.

 - A crew, not just coworkers: Dratanauts consistently describe a "come as you are" culture with sharp, curious people—the kind of team that makes hard problems genuinely fun to solve. See what they say here https://drata.com/about/careers/life and follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/drata/posts/?feedView=all for company news, employee stories, and career updates.

Job Summary:

Drata's Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) platform helps companies identify, assess, and continuously manage the risks that come from their vendors and other third parties. Instead of manually reviewing only their highest-risk vendors, our customers use Drata to run rigorous, consistent reviews across their entire vendor portfolio — maintaining a complete vendor inventory, collecting evidence like SOC 2 reports and ISO certifications, evaluating it against their own criteria with Drata's AI agent, and producing audit-ready reports. The agent accelerates the assessment work; humans stay responsible for final risk and approval decisions.

 

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to build these workflows, integrations, and AI-powered experiences — and to own them end to end. At Drata, engineering doesn't stop at a merged pull request. You'll follow a feature from problem definition through design, rollout, documentation, and production monitoring, making sure customers are actually using and benefiting from what you ship. Strong engineering is expected, but the engineers who thrive here are defined by judgement, ownership, and communication at least as much as by code.

 

What you’ll do:

 - Own features end to end — from understanding the customer problem, through design and implementation, to rollout, documentation, and post-launch monitoring.

 - Manage your own releases — own feature-flag strategy and the actual rollout, rather than handing off at merge.

 - Treat UX and documentation as part of the deliverable — a feature isn't done until it's usable and understood.

 - Monitor production health for your product area — catch and resolve issues from strong signals, not from customer complaints or escalations.

 - Partner closely with Product — understand the problem before implementing, and propose better approaches when you see them.

 - Address bugs and tech debt as part of the work, rather than deferring them indefinitely.

 - Build with AI — develop and improve the AI agent experiences at the core of our assessment workflows.

What you’ll bring:

Technical skill is the foundation — but the qualities below are what set our best Product Engineers apart, and we weigh them heavily:

 - Judgement — You see the end-to-end picture from the customer's perspective and make sound decisions without needing every step specified.

 - Ownership — You treat rollout, UX, documentation, and production health as yours, not someone else's.

 - Comfort with ambiguity — You make meaningful progress on under-defined problems.

 - Multiplier effect — You raise the people and teams around you through mentorship, strong reviews, and unblocking others.

 - Domain depth — You invest in understanding our product and our customers' world (vendor risk, TPRM, compliance).

 - Clear prioritization & communication — You judge urgency accurately, escalate at the right time, think one step ahead, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.

Requirements:

 - Professional software engineering experience building and owning production systems end to end 5+ years.

 - Proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript across the stack. (must have)

 - Backend experience with Node.js / NestJS; front-end experience with React.

 - Experience with event-driven architecture and durable workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal).

 - Solid grounding in relational databases, testing, observability/telemetry, and modern CI/CD practices.

 - Owns a product area end to end.

 - Delivers with minimal supervision and knows when to escalate.

 - Makes sound calls within their area and challenges unclear requirements.

 - Lifts peers and raises the review bar.

 - Plans and delivers reliably through a project milestone.

Bonus qualifications:

 - Experience in TPRM, vendor risk, GRC, or compliance domains.

 - Experience building or working alongside AI-powered product features.

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata https://drata.com/about/life-at-drata?utm_source=chatgpt.com.

 - Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

 - Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

 - Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

 - Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

 - Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

 - Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $157,500 - $252,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role. 

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.

jobs.title: Veterinary Receptionist
jobs.description:
Veterinary Receptionist

Indian Tree Animal Hospital is seeking a skilled and compassionate veterinary receptionist to serve as the primary point of contact for our clients and their pets. This position plays an integral role in the overall client experience, requiring a professional who can balance administrative precision with genuine warmth across a wide range of interactions — including those of a sensitive or emotionally complex nature.

Qualified candidates will bring demonstrated experience managing high-volume front desk operations, a calm and composed presence under pressure, and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality customer service in a clinical setting.

What to Expect

As you join our mission, expect to be supported in your work and home life with:

• A comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off and a 401(k) plan for full-time employees

• Professional development opportunities

Salary: $21.00-$23.00 per hour dependent on skills and experience

Schedule: Must have availability Monday- Thursday 7AM-8:30PM, Fridays 7AM-6:30PM, Every other Saturday

Responsibilities

• Greet and check in clients and patients, verify and update medical records, and confirm appointment details using practice management software

• Answer and manage a multi-line telephone system, responding to inquiries regarding appointment scheduling, prescription refill requests, vaccination records, and general hospital information

• Perform client check-out, including processing payments, posting charges, explaining invoices, and scheduling follow-up appointments

• Communicate medical information, diagnoses, and care instructions accurately and compassionately, including in emotionally sensitive situations such as euthanasia scheduling and end-of-life discussions

• Maintain accurate electronic medical records (EMR) and ensure timely data entry in the veterinary practice information management system (PIMS)

• Coordinate with veterinarians, veterinary technicians, and support staff to relay client communications, flag urgent cases, and maintain efficient patient flow

• Maintain cleanliness and organization of the reception area and waiting room to ensure a positive client experience

Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year of experience as a veterinary receptionist is required

• Experience with veterinary practice management software; Cornerstone, Avimark, ImproMed, eVetPractice, or ezyVet preferred

• Knowledge of veterinary medical terminology, vaccination protocols, and basic diagnostic procedures

• Proficiency in appointment scheduling, multi-line phone management, medical records management, and payment processing

• Proven customer service skills; ability to manage high-volume client relations with composure and accuracy

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including active listening and conflict resolution

• Comfortable handling animals of varying sizes, breeds, and temperaments, including fearful or reactive patients

About Indian Tree Animal Hospital

Indian Tree Animal Hospital is an award-winning veterinary practice with deep roots in the Arvada, CO community since opening its doors in 1990. Over the years, clients have come to depend on our veterinary team for consistently stellar clinical care and stand-out client service.

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.
