jobs.title: Patient Care Tech-GI Surgical Oncology 12E Full-time Nights
jobs.description:
The Patient Care Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Patient Care Technician’s primary function is to assist and support the Professional Registered Nurse in all aspects of direct and indirect patient care activities.  The Patient Care Technician functions as a member of the unit staff under the direction and supervision of the professional Registered Nurse.

Responsibilities:

• Direct Patient Care Activities Assists with admission, transfer, and discharge process.Takes and records temperature, pulse, respirations, weight for adults and/or neonates, height, and blood pressure.Measures and records intake and output including output from drains.Applies cardiac monitor/oximetry.Obtains EKG.Adheres to the infant security protocol (accurate assessment of band placement).Performs normal newborn hearing screening.Obtains capillary blood glucose for adults and/or neonates.Performs phlebotomy.Applies Fetal Monitor equipment on pregnant patients.Discontinues heplocks and foley catheters. Administers enemas.Collects specimens (urine, stool, blood and sputum) on adults and/or neonates. Makes rounds of patients and anticipates their needs and observes newborns in the nursery.Responds to patient call lights in a timely manner, especially emergency lights.Distributes fresh drinking water and nourishments to patients. Prepares patients for meals; assists or feeds patients as necessary. Feeds normal newborns as assigned.Provides morning care, bed baths and evening care according to established Nursing Care Procedures. Provides peri-care to appropriate patients.Provides newborn care to the infant including bath, dressing, obtaining foot prints, assistance with feeding (bottle and breast), glucose checks.Makes occupied and unoccupied beds.Ambulates patients and instructs on walker, cane and crutch walking as appropriate for assigned unit. Assists with pre-and post-operative care; positions patients as ordered; applies special equipment for safety; lifts and turns patients with proper and safe body mechanics and available resources.Applies comfort and safety measures (side rails and call lights). Sets up oxygen and suction equipment and other respiratory equipment for adults and/or neonates.Applies dressings to Stage I and Stage II skin breakdown. Prepares patient room for MD or RN assessment, evaluation, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Assists with procedures in the normal newborn nursery as directed.Transports patients, equipment and/or supplies during urgent and emergent situations and to front door on discharge.Responds to emergency situations, secures assistance and initiates basic life support.Reports observations and documents appropriately. Promptly notifies RN of any change in patient condition.Performs post-mortem care and transports bodies to the morgue when necessary.Assumes responsibility for the care of patient’s prosthetic devices, hearing aides, dentures, eye glasses, etc.Follows established policies, procedures and standards of care in all areas of practice.

• Indirect Patient CareMaintains a safe and clean environment. Duties may include: maintaining temperature logs on, defrosting, and cleaning refrigerator, straightening linen, cleaning utility rooms, cleaning IV poles, cleaning scale, cleaning and returning equipment to SPD, replacing and disposing of soiled linen bags.Performs duties delegated by the RN to facilitate patient care and the efficient operations of the assigned patient care unit.Collects and inventories patient belongings on admission, transfer and discharge.Completes charges using appropriate documentation.Orders supplies on-line or appropriate requisitions and stocks in appropriate location.Obtains necessary equipment and supplies to facilitate patient care.Assures room readiness for incoming patients.Checks designated equipment for proper functioning.Counts instruments and sterile trays sent and received from SEP as appropriate for assigned unit.Stocks and removes linen from patient rooms.Sets up and breaks down delivery table.Participates in staff meetings.Demonstrates cost effective approach to patient care in terms of equipment, supplies and other resource use.Participates in quality improvement activities.Participates in daily/weekly/monthly QC’s.Participates in orientation of new staff.Performs related duties as assigned.Uses established communication channels to resolve work related problems.Understands and consistently demonstrates principles of “Patient’s First” philosophy.Carries out assigned tasks and activities on a shift basis, as delegated by the RN.Assumes responsibility for meeting mandatory requirements.

Required:

• CNA Certification or currently enrolled in School of Nursing who has successfully completed basic clinical rotations.
• CPR recognition by the American Heart Association (BLS for Healthcare Providers).
• Minimum of 90% correct on annual mandatory Health and Safety Training quizzes.
• Unit based recognition for Capillary Blood Glucose Monitoring.
• High school diploma required. One year of college or nursing education or equivalent experience preferred.
• Previous experience in a health care setting preferred with a demonstrated ability to relate to patients, family, nursing and medical staff.

Preferred:

• Associates or Bachelor’s degree.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Marketing Operations Manager is an individual contributor responsible for executing and optimizing marketing operations processes within established frameworks, with a strong focus on campaign operations, lead management, marketing automation, reporting, and data governance. This role partners closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Sales teams to improve operational efficiency, apply approved AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline workflows, and provide actionable insights that support business growth. Reporting to the Manager, Marketing Operations, this role delivers operational excellence and consistent, scalable marketing execution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Manage and optimize lead processing, scoring, routing, and lifecycle workflows within established operational frameworks to ensure accurate data, timely follow-up, and effective handoff to Sales.
• Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations stakeholders to improve day-to-day processes that increase funnel efficiency and conversion performance.
• Diagnose and resolve routine lead flow, routing, and data quality issues, and escalate complex or recurring issues that require architectural or system-level resolution.
• Build, execute, and optimize marketing automation programs supporting demand generation, customer marketing, lead nurturing, and campaign execution.
• Apply established automation patterns, templates, and standards to reduce manual effort and improve consistency across campaigns.
• Recommend refinements to existing workflows and standards based on hands-on execution experience.
• Apply approved AI-enabled tools and prompt libraries to improve reporting, campaign production, audience management, documentation, and quality assurance.
• Operate within established AI governance practices and surface new use cases where AI could improve productivity or process efficiency.
• Develop, maintain, and analyze dashboards and reports that measure marketing performance, lead management effectiveness, campaign outcomes, and operational KPIs.
• Deliver actionable recommendations that support continuous improvement across marketing programs and operational processes.
• Partner with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success stakeholders to align operational processes, improve communication, and support business objectives.
• Serve as a day-to-day resource for marketing operations best practices and process improvement requests.
• Follow and reinforce established marketing operations standards, data governance practices, naming conventions, and process documentation.
• Share practices, tools, and working knowledge with Marketing peers and stakeholders to support consistent execution across the team.
• Contribute to standards documentation and participate in operational or architecture reviews led by senior team members.

YOU’VE GOT WHAT IT TAKES IF YOU HAVE:

• Bachelor’s degree
• 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation operations, revenue operations, or a related marketing function.
• Working knowledge of Salesforce, Pardot, Marketo, HubSpot, or comparable enterprise marketing automation platforms.
• Working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable business intelligence platform.
• Familiarity with B2B SaaS marketing operations, including lead lifecycle stages, funnel terminology, and sales handoff practices.
• Familiarity with data privacy and consent requirements as they apply to marketing communications and contact data.

IT WOULD BE NICE IF YOU:

• Experience supporting a healthcare, education, or other regulated B2B SaaS marketing organization.
• Familiarity with multi-touch attribution models and analytics tooling.
• Working knowledge of SQL or comparable query methods.
• Relevant platform certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Marketo Certified Expert, or Pardot Specialist.

jobs.title: Commercial Lease Administrator
jobs.description:
The Commercial Lease Administrator supports the Legal Department in managing the Company’s real estate portfolio by maintaining accurate lease records, monitoring critical dates, and coordinating lease-related documentation. This role reviews and interprets lease information and partners with internal teams, landlords, and other business partners to support ongoing lease administration. The Lease Administrator manages multiple priorities while ensuring lease information and obligations are accurately tracked and addressed.

jobs.title: Electrical Commissioning Technician
jobs.description:
LotusWorks is an Engineering Services provider specializing in managing Commissioning, Construction Services, Calibration, Operations & Maintenance scopes of work within global manufacturing facilities. LotusWorks operates globally across EMEA and North America partnering with the world's leading manufacturers across the Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical & Biologics, Medical Device and Data Center sectors. Our team of Engineering and Technical professionals is immersed in cutting-edge technologies and innovations. LotusWorks is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, integral to our people-first approach.

LotusWorks is seeking an experienced Commissioning Technician to support the testing, verification, and commissioning of mechanical, electrical, and control systems within a large-scale, mission-critical data center environment. This role will support commissioning activities from equipment installation verification and startup through functional performance testing, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and final turnover. The position will focus on electrical systems, including MV/LV switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, ATS/STS, PDUs, and electrical distribution systems, as well as mechanical cooling equipment, BMS, EPMS, and associated control systems. The successful candidate will work alongside Commissioning Engineers, Leads, and Managers to execute testing procedures, document results, troubleshoot deficiencies, verify system redundancy, and ensure equipment operates in accordance with project specifications, safety requirements, and client expectations.

Responsibilities:

• Support commissioning activities for mechanical, electrical, and control systems within mission-critical data center facilities across Levels 2–5 (L2–L5).

• Perform equipment installation inspections, construction verification, and pre-functional checks.

• Assist with equipment startup, vendor testing, functional performance testing (FPT), and Integrated Systems Testing (IST).

• Support commissioning of electrical systems, including MV/LV switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, ATS/STS, PDUs, and electrical distribution equipment.

• Assist with commissioning mechanical systems, including chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, cooling towers, pumps, and associated cooling infrastructure.

• Verify BMS, EPMS, alarms, setpoints, interlocks, control sequences, and equipment communication interfaces.

• Witness OEM and third-party testing and assist with electrical and mechanical system redundancy and failover testing.

• Document test results, complete commissioning checklists, and track deficiencies using platforms such as CxAlloy or Facility Grid.

• Assist with troubleshooting, deficiency resolution, retesting, and final commissioning documentation and turnover.

• Follow site safety procedures, including LOTO, electrical safety requirements, job hazard analyses, and controlled energization protocols.

• Coordinate daily testing activities with Commissioning Engineers, Leads, Managers, contractors, vendors, and client representatives.

• Perform any other duties or responsibilities that may be assigned as part of the role.

Skills Required:

• Working knowledge of electrical systems, including switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, ATS/STS, and electrical distribution.

• Familiarity with mechanical cooling systems used in data center environments.

• Understanding of commissioning processes, including L2 installation verification, L3 startup, L4 functional performance testing, and L5 integrated systems testing.

• Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings, equipment specifications, and testing procedures.

• Basic understanding of BMS, EPMS, controls, alarms, interlocks, and equipment operating sequences.

• Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to identify equipment deficiencies and support root-cause investigation.

• Ability to accurately document test results, commissioning progress, and deficiency reports.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills when coordinating with engineers, contractors, vendors, and clients.

• Commitment to safety procedures, including LOTO, electrical safety, and controlled energization.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, mission-critical data center construction and commissioning environment.

• Familiarity with commissioning documentation platforms such as CxAlloy or Facility Grid is preferred.

Education / Licenses / Certifications

• Electrical degree or Journeyman Electrician license preferred.

• OSHA 10 certification required.

• Life, Short-Term, Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Training and Education Assistance

• 401k Retirement Plan

• Extra Annual Leave with Years of Service

• Maternity/Paternity Leave

• Recognition Rewards

jobs.title: Inpatient Coder II, HB coding
jobs.description:
The Inpatient Coder II reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Inpatient Coder II is the coding and reimbursement expert for ICD-10-CM diagnosis coding and ICD-10-PCS procedure coding for complex inpatient acute care discharges. Possesses a strong foundation in coding conventions, instructions, Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting and Coding Clinics. Has a deep understanding of disease process, anatomy/physiology, pharmacology and medical terminology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Utilizes technical coding expertise to assign appropriate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes to complex inpatient visit types. Complexity is measured by a Case Mix Index (CMI) and Coder II’s typically see average CMI’s of 2.2609. This index score demonstrates higher patient complexity and acuity.

* Utilizes expertise in clinical disease process and documentation, to assign Present on Admission (POA) values to all secondary diagnoses for quality metrics and reporting.

* Thoroughly reviews the provider notes within the health record and the Findings from the Clinical Documentation Nurse in the Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Department who concurrently reviewed the record and provide their clinical insight on the diagnoses.

* Utilizes resources within CAC (Computerized Assisted Coding) software to efficiently review documentation and select or assign ICD-10-CM/PCS codes using autosuggestion or annotation features.

* Reviews Discharge Planning and nursing documentation to validate and correct when necessary, the Discharge Disposition which impacts reimbursement under Medicare’s Post-Acute Transfer Policy.

* Utilizes knowledge of MS-DRG’s, APR-DRG’s, AHRQ Elixhauser risk adjustment to sequence the appropriate ICD-10-CM codes within the top 24 fields to ensure correct reimbursement and NM’s ranking in US News and World Report.

* Collaborate with CDI on approximately 45% of discharges regarding the final MS or APR DRG and comorbidity diagnoses.

* Educates CDI on regulatory guidelines, Coding Clinics and conventions to report appropriate ICD-10-CM diagnoses.

* Interprets health record documentation using knowledge of anatomy, physiology, clinical disease process, pharmacology, medical terminology to determine the Principal Diagnosis, secondary diagnoses and procedures.

* Follows the ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, ICD-10-PCS Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Coding Clinic for ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS, coding conventions and instructional notes to assign the appropriate diagnoses and procedures.

* Utilizes coding expertise and knowledge to write appeal letters in response to payor DRG downgrade notices.

* Resolves Nosology Messages/Alerts and Coding Validation Warning/Errors.

* Meets established coding productivity and quality standards.

Minimum Requirements:

Certification:

• RHIA, RHIT or CCS credential

• AHIMA membership

Experience:

• 3 years of inpatient coding experience in an acute healthcare setting

Preferred:

• Associate’s degree in related field
• RHIA, RHIT with CCS or CDIP/CCDS credential
• 4 years of inpatient coding experience in a teaching hospital

jobs.title: Manager, Global Pipeline Strategy & Sales Development Planning
jobs.description:
SLSQ427R609

The Global Pipeline Strategy & Execution team sits at the heart of Databricks’ GTM engine. We set the pipeline targets the company runs on, monitor global pipeline health, evaluate performance, and architect the future top-of-funnel operating model.

We are seeking a strategic, high-leverage Manager / Senior Strategy Lead to serve as the central strategic spine for global pipeline strategy, executive pipeline governance, and long-term Sales Development (xDR) capacity and talent planning.

In this role, you will lead the global pipeline strategy narrative, architect executive Cross-Functional Pipeline Councils, and drive capacity, coverage, compensation, and target-setting frameworks across our global Sales Development organization. As AI and automation transform routine prospecting tasks, you will redefine how our Sales Dev org operates - pairing AI-native capabilities with specialized human roles to unlock optimized coverage ratios while powering our enduring engine for Account Executive talent development.

You will bridge high-level corporate strategy with operational execution - ensuring executive leaders have clear visibility, aligned targets, and structured strategic choices to maximize pipeline generation across all channels.

The Impact You'll Have

1. Executive Pipeline Governance & Strategic Spine

• Executive Pipe Councils Framework: Architect, scale, and orchestrate Executive & Cross-Functional Pipeline Council frameworks, operating cadences, and executive communications alongside senior leadership.

• Central Pipeline Strategy Narrative: Own the global pipeline strategy narrative, synthesizing complex, multi-workstream performance insights into coherent executive presentations and leadership decision frameworks.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Foster seamless alignment across Sales, Sales Development, Marketing, Partner, Programs, and Product GTM teams to ensure leadership remains unified behind top strategic growth bets.

2. Next-Gen Sales Development (xDR) Strategic Planning & Talent Engine

• Capacity & Coverage Modeling: Design and implement scalable xDR capacity and coverage models that integrate automation to optimize territory coverage, improve rep productivity, and drive deeper strategic account engagement.

• Evolving Role Archetypes: Shape the long-term vision and pilot frameworks for specialized Sales Dev role archetypes aligned directly with company-wide growth, product expansion, and sales productivity targets.

• Future AE Talent Architecture: Partner with Sales Dev leadership to design in-seat career progression architecture. Establish target-setting philosophies, compensation structures, and performance gates that develop xDRs into technically credible, high-performing Account Executives.

3. AI-Native Workflows & Operating Rigor

• Operating Frameworks: Install repeatable cadences, standardized review frameworks, and governance models that increase velocity, eliminate friction, and improve cross-functional decision-making.

• AI Builder Mindset: Proactively deploy AI tools (e.g., LLMs, conversational analytics, custom agents) to improve strategy team workflows, automate strategic reporting, and raise the bar for AI capabilities across the GTM strategy org.

What We Look For

• Radical ownership and speed: You own outcomes at pace, not just tasks. You are measured on the impact you deliver, not on effort.

• Run-the-business operator: You want to own a business end-to-end and operate on the leader's behalf, not support from the sidelines. You earn trust through immersion and reliability, you're a doer as much as a designer, and you bring structure to ambiguity.

• Technical and analytical horsepower: You want your hands in the data and to build, not just direct it - modern data & AI tools (advanced Excel, SQL, BI platforms, conversational analytics, custom agents), and you pick up new tools fast.

• AI-fluent, and on the frontier: AI is part of your daily workflow as a multiplier, and you proactively keep up with the latest tools and trends. You enjoy being an early adopter, learn new technology fast, and turn it into enterprise-quality work while offloading operational load to it.

• Proactive strategic instinct: You don't wait for the question; you spot the pattern, form a point of view, and bring the recommendation, framed around the leader's decisions.

• Zero-defect operational rigor: Accurate, on-time, exec-ready output. You trace discrepancies to the root cause and won't ship something you can't defend. Strategy and operations are equally weighted.

• Connective tissue, with sound judgment: You run toward cross-functional partnership, understand other teams' incentives, and make it easy to say yes. You see the org as a system rather than silos - with high honesty, integrity, and judgment. You document and teach what you build.

• Executive presence and excellent communication: Command in front of Senior Directors, VPs, and BU leadership; you synthesize complex data into leader-ready decks, exec summaries, and quantitative business cases.

• Relevant Experience & GTM Depth: Prior experience in GTM Strategy, Strategy & Operations, Sales Operations, or Management Consulting at a high-growth technology company, with deep understanding of capacity planning, coverage ratios, and top-of-funnel mechanics.

What This Role Isn't

• Not a pure strategy role: If you want to think but not execute, this isn't the right role. The operational parts of the job aren't optional - strategy and execution are equally weighted, and you are expected to build and run what you design.

• Not an arm's-length role: This job rewards deep immersion in the business: the accounts, the team, the numbers. If you prefer to stay at the analytical surface or delegate execution from the sidelines, this isn't the right fit.

• Not a "maintain-the-status-quo" position: Designed to continually evaluate and evolve target-setting philosophy, coverage models, and executive alignment frameworks as the company scales.

jobs.title: Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
CTEC is a leading technology firm that provides modernization, digital transformation, and application development services to the U.S. Federal Government. Headquartered in McLean, VA, CTEC has over 300 team members working on mission-critical systems and projects for agencies such as the Department of Homeland Security, Internal Revenue Service, and the Office of Personnel Management. The work we do effects millions of U.S. citizens daily as they interact with the systems we build. Our best-in-class commercial solutions, modified for our customers’ bespoke mission requirements, are enabling this future every day.

The Company has experienced rapid growth over the past 3 years and recently received a strategic investment from Main Street Capital Corporation (NYSE: MAIN). In addition to our recent growth in Federal Civilian agencies, we are seeking to expand our capabilities in cloud development and footprint in national-security focused agencies within the Department of Defense and U.S. Intelligence Community.

Position Summary
CTEC is seeking  Acquisition Specialist to join our team. The Acquisition Specialist provides day-to-day acquisition and contracting support to CBP BEMSD program teams, assisting with acquisition documentation, procurement actions, contract administration, reporting, and coordination with government stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist with acquisition planning, market research, requirements development, solicitations, evaluations, awards, modifications, and closeout.

• Prepare and maintain acquisition documentation, trackers, briefings, correspondence, and contract files.

• Support development and review of SOWs/PWSs, IGCEs, acquisition strategies, evaluation materials, and related procurement documents.

• Track procurement milestones, actions, deliverables, funding status, and outstanding issues.

• Assist with cost/price analysis, proposal reviews, invoice or funding documentation, and contractor performance monitoring.

• Coordinate with Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, CORs, program managers, technical teams, and other stakeholders.

• Conduct research and provide recommendations regarding acquisition requirements and applicable policies.

• Maintain accurate records and support audit/readiness activities.

Required Qualifications

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with government, contractor, and technical stakeholders.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.

• 5+ years of federal acquisition, contracting, procurement, or related program-support experience.

• Bachelor's degree in business, management, finance, acquisition, or a related discipline preferred.

• Working knowledge of FAR and federal acquisition processes.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple acquisition actions simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

• DHS/CBP acquisition experience.

• FAC-C, FAC-P, DAWIA, NCMA, or related certification.

• Experience supporting federal IT or systems acquisition programs.

• Experience with SharePoint, acquisition tracking tools, or contract management systems.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Contract Management, Acquisition, Finance, or a related field preferred.

Clearance: Preferred Active CBP clearance. Candidates must be U.S. citizens and able to obtain and maintain the required clearance.

Pay Range- $105K/yr - $115K/yr + Benefits(Compensation and employment offer are negotiable and will be finalized based on the candidate's relevant experience and interview assessment.)

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Cybermedia Technologies management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, where applicable and available, reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions of this position.
Please note: Candidate(s) will be required to go through pre-employment screening.
Cybermedia Technologies, Inc. is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer! (EOE; M/F/D/V)

If you are looking for a fun and challenging environment with talented, motivated people to work with, CTEC is the right place for you. In addition to employee salary, we offer an array of employee benefits including:

• Paid vacation & Sick leave

• Health insurance coverage

• Career training

• Performance bonus programs

• 401K contribution & Employer Match

• 11 Federal Holidays

jobs.title: Senior Web Engineer
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.



The CKD Clients Engineering team contributes to NerdWallet’s growth engine by building tools in Next.js http://next.js, React.js, http://react.js and Astro.js http://astro.js leveraging WordPress that enables SEO-optimized customer experiences. We create applications that empower content and marketing teams to launch high-traffic, consumer-facing, performant pages at scale. Our efforts are backed by front-end best practices, strong observability and a focus on quality. Joining CKD Engineering means working on business-critical, high-impact engineering at the intersection of platform, growth, and consumer experience.



We’re looking for a Senior Web Engineer who can drive technical excellence, front-end performance, and platform scalability while collaborating with stakeholders to shape the future of our organic shopping products.



This is a front-end role with full-stack elements, UI/UX, accessibility, and web performance. You’ll work on initiatives that enhance Core Web Vitals (CWV), technical SEO, and observability, ensuring our pages are blazing fast, user-friendly, and optimized for discovery. Beyond the front-end, you’ll also work on back-end APIs and integrate with Machine Learning systems that power these experiences, enabling personalization and data-driven decision-making at scale.



As a Senior Web Engineer, you’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders, contribute to best practices, and drive architectural projects that balance speed, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You’ll be hands-on, writing production-quality code, mentoring junior work on both high-quality execution and fast iteration, acting as a multiplier to help the team deliver impact.



This role reports to the Senior Manager, Engineering.




WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

 - Shape the future of NerdWallet’s highest-traffic organic pages by improving performance, SEO, and user engagement.

 - Partner with product, Organic Growth, and data teams to run experiments, measure impact, and iterate quickly.

 - Take input from and partner directly with engineering leadership to drive technical initiatives to enhance performance, observability, scalability, security, and developer experience.

 - Contribute to platform stability and resilience through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.

 - Ensure high standards of technical excellence, maintaining a high-quality codebase and modernizing our stack.

 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineering team members, promoting best practices in coding, testing, and architecture.

 - Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality, performance, and adherence to standards, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the engineering team.

 - Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in the tech and finance industries through a practice of continuous learning and self-improvement.


YOUR EXPERIENCE:

We recognize not everyone will meet all of the criteria. If you meet most of the criteria below and you’re excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we’d love to hear from you.

 - Minimum of 5+ years in software engineering, with a strong background in client focused full stack development.

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

 - Expertise in ES6, TypeScript, Node.js and the web platform; proficient in other modern languages such as Rust, Go, Python, etc.

 - Expert in modern front-end frameworks such as Astro.js, http://astro.js Nuxt.js http://nuxt.js, Next.js, React.js, Tailwind, etc.

 - Deeply knowledgeable about Web Performance, Core Web Vitals & Technical SEO.

 - Passion for design, usability, and user experience. Understanding of accessibility best practices.

 - Experience in Observability and running a production website or application at scale.

 - Experience with database systems, microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, IAC, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (Vercel, AWS, GCP, or Azure).


WHERE:

 - This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

 - We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.


WHAT WE OFFER:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

 - Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

 - Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

 - New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

 - Mental health support

 - Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

 - Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

 - Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

 - Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

 - Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

 - Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

 - Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction 

 - Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

 - 401K with 4% company match

 - Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

 - Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

 - Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Industrial IoT / Deep Tech)
jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative (Industrial IoT / Deep Tech)
Industry: Industrial IoT / Deep Tech — AI-powered fire prevention & predictive maintenance Location: Remote, anywhere in the US Schedule: Full-time, core working hours with flexibility Department: Sales




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is a deep-tech startup building AI-powered thermal monitoring technology that stops industrial fires and equipment failures before they happen. Their infrared cameras and machine-learning software watch the components most likely to overheat — motors, bearings, conveyors, electrical cabinets — and alert plant teams before a hot spot becomes a fire or a shutdown. The platform is already protecting facilities across multiple countries, with zero customers lost in three years.

They're now building their first-ever US commercial team, and this SDR role is a founding seat on it. You won't be dropped into an existing playbook with a big team of peers — you'll be one of the first people building the outbound motion from scratch, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the founding Account Executives.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Prospect into industrial and manufacturing accounts — plant managers, maintenance and reliability leaders, safety directors — using cold calling, email sequencing, and social selling

 - Build and run outbound cadences using modern sales engagement tools (sequencers, dialers, CRM)

 - Qualify inbound and outbound interest and hand off well-prepared meetings to the Account Executive team

 - Help build the playbook as you go — there's no fully mature process yet, and your input will shape it

 - Represent the company at trade shows and occasional plant visits, learning the product and market from the ground up


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Tool and tech fluency is the bar, not industry background. You're comfortable and effective with sequencing platforms, power dialers, and CRM systems — you pick up new tools fast

 - A track record of hitting or exceeding outbound targets (calls, meetings booked, pipeline generated)

 - Real comfort operating in a lean, early-stage environment without a big team or a fully built process around you — you build as you go rather than waiting for structure

 - Strong, clear communication — you can hold a conversation and qualify interest quickly

 - A genuine growth mindset: this role has a defined path toward an Account Executive seat as you prove yourself (typically within about a year)

Nice to have, not required: exposure to industrial, technical, or B2B hardware/software sales. If you've sold into plant or facility environments before, that's a bonus — but it's not a gate.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary

 - Uncapped variable tied to meetings booked and pipeline generated

 - Travel covered for conferences, trade shows, and occasional plant visits

 - Remote-first role with flexibility, and a clear, fast path to promotion as the US team scales


WHY THIS ROLE

 - Founding-team seat. You're not backfilling — you're helping build the first US sales motion from day one

 - Fast growth path. Early hires on this team have a clear, near-term trajectory into a closing (AE) role

 - Real ownership from day one. Small team, high trust, direct visibility into what's working and what isn't

 - Mission that matters. The work directly prevents industrial fires and protects people, not just software metrics

Our client is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Manager I, Engineering - Reference Tables Access
jobs.description:
The Reference Tables Access team owns the UI, MCP, APIs, and control plane that customers use to bring external data into Datadog. Reference Tables lets them use their own reference data to enrich and filter observability data without leaving the platform. The team also owns the table identity, metadata, permissions, quotas, validation, and lifecycle services behind these experiences.

Beyond the current product, the team is developing a consistent tabular abstraction that product teams can use without needing to manage the details of the underlying storage systems. This abstraction supports use cases from log enrichment and security to emerging analytical workflows built on Datadog’s internal Data Lake (ADP Lakehouse).

We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to guide the team’s roadmap and develop these capabilities into a reliable platform. This role will shape how Datadog teams manage and build product experiences on top of tabular data.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead a team of engineers, ensuring effective project execution.

• Partner with product managers and staff engineers to define and drive the team’s technical direction.

• Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to shape the team’s roadmap and contribute to the broader organization’s technical direction.

• Establish and uphold engineering best practices, ensuring consistency and quality.

• Mentor and coach engineers, supporting their career growth and development.

• Foster an inclusive and collaborative team culture.

Who You Are:

• Technically adept, with a strong foundation in large-scale distributed systems and/or customer-facing platform development. You can dive deep into technical details in code and designs when needed.

• A problem solver at heart, eager to take on complex technical challenges with confidence and experience.

• An engineering leader, skilled in prioritization, escalation, and clear communication, helping teams make progress through ambiguity.

• Experienced with mission-critical systems and high-stakes operations, including supporting infrastructure that demands high reliability and rapid incident response through a 24x7 on-call rotation.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

• Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions

• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

• Competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:

$192,000—$240,000 USD

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. jobs.description:

Prior home care experience as a Speech Language Pathologist, SLP is a plus, but not required.

As a home care Speech Language Pathologist, SLP, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides rehabilitative care and skilled nursing to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

Speech Language Pathologist, SLP Responsibilities:

• Make home visits to clients in designated geographic territories.

• Perform thorough evaluations to assess, diagnose, and provide therapeutic interventions for clients who are experiencing speech, language, communication, or swallowing difficulties.

• Develop a treatment plan based on the evaluation, physician’s orders, and recommended goals.

• Continually assess and revise the speech therapy care plan, and participate with BAYADA clinicians in the multidisciplinary care plan, as appropriate.

• Educate and instruct patients, family members, or other patient representatives, in rehabilitative care and activities necessary to promote the client's health, safety, and independent living.

• Accurately document observations, interventions, and evaluations pertaining to patient care management and services provided, utilizing a state-of-the-art touch pad tablet.

Speech Language Pathologist, SLP Qualifications:

• A current license as a Speech Language Pathologist in Vermont

• Possess a certificate of clinical competence in speech from the American Speech and Hearing Association, or;

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Principal Software Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Chantilly, VA, you will design flight software in support of spacecraft for Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Play a key role supporting the development of payload flight software for our Space Systems programs.

• Focus on deployment of novel algorithms into austere environments on Size/Weight/Power constrained sensor systems.

• Lead cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and deliver integrated solutions.

• Provide technical leadership in all aspects of software design and development starting with requirements generation and following through implementation, testing, deployment.

• Define and influence software architecture, design patterns, interfaces, and technical standards to ensure scalable, maintainable, and extensible solutions.

• Drive core software fundamentals of performance-oriented programming leveraging a variety of accelerator technologies.

• Mentor engineers across experience levels, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

• Support technical planning, effort estimation, risk identification, dependency management, and milestone delivery while communicating technical status and risks to stakeholders.

• Be part of a team of driven pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering.

• 12+ years of experience in embedded software engineering experience.

• Experience in designing complex multithreaded application.

• Experience designing flight software.

• Ability to obtain and maintain an U.S. Government security clearance.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Familiarity with high-performance and parallel processing.

• Exposure to novel architectures including FPGA, CUDA, etc.

• Familiarity with flight software system management.

• Experience with algorithm implementation.

• Exposure to Python and MATLAB is highly desired.

• Familiarity with numerical computing principles.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans, dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, and other discounts and perks.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the state of Virginia’s pay transparency requirements. Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$198,900—$324,800 USD

Base Salary

This role owns the processes, systems, data, reporting, and operating cadence that allow Partnerships leadership and relationship managers to focus on partnerships and revenue growth. The Manager leads one direct report, with the opportunity to expand the team as the function grows, and serves as a primary operational partner to Business Development, Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

People Leadership

 - Lead the operations function and directly manage, coach, and develop one team member; own hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance management, and future team development as the function scales.

 - Set clear priorities and workload distribution across the team; hold the team accountable to service levels, quality standards, and deadlines.

 - Build the team's bench strength through structured training, documentation, and career development plans; maintain current, accessible process documentation (SOPs/runbooks) for core recurring workflows to ensure continuity of operations during absences or turnover; create capacity for the function to scale with the business.

Operations & Process Ownership

 - Own the end-to-end operating process for partner-referred opportunities, including intake, routing, accurate partner attribution, service-level expectations, pipeline visibility, issue resolution, and performance measurement.

 - Design, document, and continuously improve the core operating processes of the Business Development team; identify friction points and lead the effort to remove them.

 - Define and track operational and commercial KPIs, including referral volume, referral-to-opportunity conversion, opportunity-to-close conversion, cycle time, attribution accuracy, data quality, partner response time, and program revenue performance; regularly report insights and recommendations to Sales and Business Development leadership.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point for internal and external operational issues; resolve cross-functional blockers and set expectations with partners and stakeholders.

Systems, Data & Reporting

 - Maintain accuracy of supporting operational tools and access systems — including partner rep territory/coverage mapping and program-related communication channels — ensuring they reflect current program eligibility and team composition.

Business Partnership & Planning

 - Partner with Sales and Business Development leadership on planning cycles, resource planning and operational readiness for new programs and partnerships.

 - Lead the implementation of new programs and initiatives across the BD team — including scoping, stakeholder alignment, rollout, enablement, and post-launch measurement.

 - Own the recurring operating cadence for partner program enrollment and onboarding, including cross-functional eligibility reviews, training assignment and completion tracking, and go-live enablement (system access, communications, territory updates); govern eligibility changes as reps move in or out of adjacent compliance or development programs, including account reassignment protocols.

 - Coordinate with Compensation and HR partners to ensure new program participants are assigned appropriate compensation plans and that related compensation records are updated accurately and on time.

 - Plan and execute partner- and customer-facing events (regional partner meetings, industry trade shows and conferences, vendor-hosted events), including venue and attendee coordination, RSVP management, and liaison with external event partners and vendors.

 - Proactively manage communication and information flow between the BD team and internal and external audiences; ensure leadership has the context needed to make decisions.

 - Oversee preparation of strategic work product, including executive-level presentations and materials, using Microsoft Office Suite, Google Suite, and other cloud-based software.

Financial & Administrative

 - Own the departmental budget tracking process, including purchase requisitions, accounts payable submissions and research, payments, and reconciliation; partner with Finance on forecasting and variance.

 - Own the planning and execution of internal business development events and team offsites.

 - Manage other special projects and assignments as needed, including work in direct support of the Sales leadership team.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team — including setting direction, managing performance, and building capability in others.

 - Exceptional organizational and program management skills with excellent attention to detail; able to understand, translate, and distill complex details into clear and simple information that enables decision making.

 - Strong analytical mindset; uses data to diagnose inefficiency, prioritize work, and identify creative solutions geared toward automation.

 - Proven ability to design and implement process at scale, not just execute within it.

 - Customer service mindset and/or client management skills with strong communication skills — can readily align one's interpersonal style with the individual needs of internal and external partners, up to and including executive audiences.

 - Commitment to teamwork; ability to collaborate and manage projects with and through others; ability to influence action without direct authority.

 - Willingness to adapt when necessary; comfortable with ambiguity and flexible to changing business dynamics and priorities.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience coordinating cross-functional enablement, training, or compensation-adjacent processes preferred.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

The Director of Compliance will provide strategic leadership over Extend's regulatory compliance function, setting the direction and long-term roadmap for the infrastructure that underpins Extend's service contract and insurance programs across North America, including all licensing. Reporting directly to Extend's VP, Deputy General Counsel, this person will serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to the executive team on regulatory strategy, risk, and governance, representing compliance in front of regulators, auditors, and cross-functional leadership. This is a strategy and leadership role: you'll set the vision for how compliance scales with the business, build out the team and its structure, and be the executive-level voice for compliance across the company.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Set the strategic direction and long-term roadmap for Extend's regulatory compliance program, spanning licensing, service contract terms and conditions, and insurance partner relationships, ensuring the function scales with the business.

• Serve as the executive-level owner for regulatory and licensing matters across both business-as-usual operations and new products or initiatives, providing judgment and direction where complexity or risk requires it.

• Partner with the rest of the compliance team to set priorities, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and continuously improve how terms and conditions, license applications, filings, approvals, and renewals get done.

• Represent Extend in significant regulatory examinations, inquiries, and audits, working alongside the compliance team and outside counsel.

• Monitor the regulatory landscape, proactively advising leadership on emerging requirements and risk.

• Coach and develop the compliance team, and help define the function's long-term structure and career paths as Extend scales.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to embed compliance requirements into merchant onboarding, customer experience, contracting, product workflows and program design.

• Provide active guidance to leadership on how compliance strategy supports business goals, balancing rigor with the speed the business needs.

• Establish and monitor KPIs for licensing accuracy, timeliness, and cost, and drive continuous improvement across processes and vendor relationships.

• Set direction on service contract terms and conditions in partnership with outside counsel, reviewing for regulatory accuracy and completeness.

• Build and maintain the internal controls, documentation and reporting needed to demonstrate compliance to regulators, auditors and partners.

• Identify and champion opportunities to use AI and other technology to modernize and streamline licensing, filing, and regulatory reporting processes, improving speed, accuracy, and scalability as volume grows.

What We're Looking For:

• Proven, action and solution-oriented compliance leader with the ability to operate effectively in both strategic and hands-on environments.

• Significant experience in insurance, service contract, or regulatory compliance, including experience setting strategy and governance at scale.

• Experience adding critical value at the executive level as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to proactively tie compliance strategy to the company's commercial needs.

• Prior experience building, developing, and mentoring high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment, ideally within tech or a regulated industry.

• Demonstrated expertise managing regulatory relationships, licensing operations, and cross-functional compliance programs at scale.

• Bachelor's degree required; JD or relevant advanced degree a plus.

• Excellent organizational and management skills with a high level of attention to detail.

• Direct, clear, concise, and exceptional communicator.

• High IQ & EQ with excitement to hit the ground running.

• Bias toward action, accountability, and proactivity with an ownership mentality.

• Solutions-oriented, strong problem solver willing to roll up sleeves.

• An entrepreneurial mindset.

• Collaborative leader with a strong ability to influence without direct authority.

• Skilled at earning trust and credibility quickly with an established team.

• A curious, detail-oriented operator with deep empathy for merchant partners' different needs.

Expected Pay Range: $180,000 - $200,000 per year salaried*

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer and Power BI
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

You will help modernize data management, workflow automation, and reporting for complex cloud infrastructure and hardware planning initiatives. By combining AI-powered solutions, data engineering, and business intelligence, you will transform manual, spreadsheet-based processes into efficient, automated, and accessible reporting systems. You will integrate data across multiple platforms, build and maintain Power BI dashboards, and identify opportunities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and accelerate decision-making. This role offers an opportunity to apply emerging AI technologies to real-world business challenges while building expertise in cloud infrastructure and enterprise data operations.

Responsibilities

• Assess existing business workflows, establish baselines for manual effort, and identify opportunities for AI-driven automation based on business impact.

• Integrate and consolidate data from SharePoint, Azure DevOps, Excel, and cross-functional databases into a centralized, governed source of truth.

• Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Power BI dashboards that deliver timely, accurate, and actionable business insights.

• Build and implement AI-powered solutions for workflow automation, data reconciliation, change summaries, natural-language querying, and report generation.

• Automate data refresh processes and implement data validation, quality checks, and reporting controls to improve reliability and consistency.

• Use Power Platform tools and integrations to streamline data collection, processing, reporting, and operational workflows.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and clear, executive-ready visualizations.

• Document technical solutions, develop user guidance, and support adoption of automated workflows and reporting tools.

• Measure and communicate the impact of implemented solutions through metrics such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction, and improvements in data quality.

• Continuously evaluate existing dashboards and processes to identify opportunities for optimization, efficiency, and improved user experience.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics automation, or a related technical discipline.

• Demonstrated experience implementing AI solutions to improve workflows, automate repetitive tasks, or increase operational efficiency.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, data refresh, deployment, and row-level security.

• Experience with Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power Automate and Power Apps, to support business process automation and data-driven solutions.

• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, including queries, Analytics/OData, and REST API integrations.

• Experience working with SharePoint Online, advanced Excel, SQL, and Python for data integration, analysis, transformation, or automation.

• Ability to aggregate and reconcile data from multiple platforms and systems while maintaining data accuracy and consistency.

• Experience developing or implementing generative AI solutions using tools such as Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, AI Builder, or Microsoft 365 Copilot.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.

• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical solutions, document workflows, and present data insights to business stakeholders.

• Ability to demonstrate a previous AI implementation through a live project walkthrough, without disclosing confidential employer, customer, or proprietary information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with hardware planning, cloud infrastructure, supply-chain data, product roadmaps, or portfolio reporting.

• Experience optimizing AI workloads or implementing AI-enabled workflow improvements in an enterprise environment.

• Experience consolidating data across organizational systems into a centralized reporting or analytics solution.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse, or Kusto Query Language (KQL).

• Experience with Power Platform application lifecycle management (ALM), Git, or related version control practices.

• Experience developing governed, scalable data solutions with automated refresh processes and data-quality monitoring.

• Relevant certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, or Azure AI.

Salary Range

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $90000– $95,000 USD/Annually.  Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.
