jobs.title: Product Safety Engineer
jobs.location: Mountain View CA USA; San Francisco CA USA
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

In this hybrid role, you will report to Risk Management, Safety Engineer

You will:

• You will manage autonomous vehicle product safety for safeaty excluding collision risk. This includes discovery, evaluation, escalation, mitigation, and acceptance.

• You will partner with domain experts from systems, hardware, software, and operations to build robust risk assessments with sustainable overhead for execution and flexibility in the face of an expanding product scope.

• You will review proposed mitigations, write requirements and test coverage, and identify KPIs for field monitoring - all to ensure risk is sufficient managed with strong regression protection.

• You will propose an evaluation framework and acceptance criteria, drawing on industry practice and standards where applicable. Within the framework, you will architect best practices for risk assessment methodologies, including publishing internal guidance on risk model, data sources and computation methods.

• When necessary, you will translate complex probabilistic risk models and statistical analyses into clear, actionable safety arguments and executive summaries for technical leaders, cross-functional partners, and safety review boards.

• You will champion and promote a robust safety culture and the continuous improvement of the Waymo safety program across the engineering and operations organizations.

You have:

• An advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering or other relevant technical field OR 4 years of practical experience involving safety risk assessments and systems engineering.

• Proven experience managing product risk for physical products or services, using quantitative or semi-quantitative risk models to manage risk.

• Strong foundation in the process of risk management, including the end-to-end lifecycle of risk: identification, assessment, mitigation and acceptance of risk (e.g. following ISO 31000/31010 or equivalent standards).

• Solid understanding of safety critical system designs and the systems engineering “Verification and Validation” process.

• Demonstrated technical project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple parallel, cross-functional safety-critical projects and teams. Ability to thrive in ambiguity.

We prefer:

• Deep background in product safety spanning both physical product design, human-machine interfaces, and service.

• Experience performing system safety risk management in autonomous vehicles, aerospace, defense, robotics, rail, or medical device industries.

• Experience using user studies, data science and testing to drive quantitative risk reduction solutions, safety insights for leadership, and assess performance.

• Success as a safety culture champion, influencing engineering culture, ensuring safety is a first-class citizen in every design discussion. In particular, experience mentoring or training engineering teams on safety-by-design and safety principles.

• Proven leadership experience in working with external partners, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory bodies/auditors.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$204,000—$252,000 USD

jobs.title: Lab Lead, Space
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Space Manufacturing team is seeking a hands-on Lab Lead to join our team. The Space Manufacturing team is responsible for the assembly, integration, and test of ground support equipment, PCBA, unit-level, and integrated systems that are vital for our aerospace and defense operations. This role keeps the day-to-day operation, readiness, and discipline of our Space Manufacturing lab spaces running across three locations — our operational space lab, the temporary cleanroom now being built, and the new facility (graded ISO 5–8) now being built to support development and low-rate builds of spaceflight hardware.

This is a working, hands-on role — you are the person on the floor who keeps the labs and cleanrooms running. You will personally maintain and troubleshoot lab equipment and facility systems, run the gowning and contamination-control routines, handle consumables and material flow, support safety and hazardous-material handling, and keep each space ready for build and test. You will coordinate vendors and specialists for work beyond your scope, and over time you may help bring on and guide additional technicians as the sites scale — but the core of this job is doing the hands-on work yourself to keep demanding lab and cleanroom environments operating to spec, in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. If you are someone who likes to roll up your sleeves and be the person the floor relies on, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Keep the three Space Manufacturing lab spaces — the space lab, the temporary cleanroom (under construction), and the new facility (under construction) — running day-to-day, including gowning/anterooms, air showers, test bays, subassembly and assembly zones, and storage, so build and test run without facility-driven downtime.

• Perform hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of lab equipment and critical components, and coordinate specialists or vendors for work beyond your scope to keep equipment available through regularly scheduled maintenance.

• Run the day-to-day contamination-control routines for each cleanroom (graded ISO 5–8): gowning and air-shower discipline, particle monitoring, supporting certification cadence, and keeping consumables (garments, gloves, wipes) stocked and flowing.

• Operate and maintain cleanroom and facility support systems hands-on — HVAC/air conditioning, environmental monitoring, compressed and specialty gases (including nitrogen purge), pumps, chillers, compressors, and DI water systems — taking readings, servicing on schedule, and coordinating vendors for larger work.

• Serve as the day-to-day, floor-level safety point of contact: follow and enforce safe work practices, handle and store hazardous materials and specialty gases safely, ensure safety instructions are in place before hazardous lab work begins, and support EHS on chemical handling, permits, and inspections.

• Manage lab equipment, assets, and material flow: tool/fixture check-in/check-out and asset tracking, calibration/metrology scheduling (in-house and via vendors), preventive maintenance, and receiving/kitting/stores/consumables flow in coordination with supply chain and quality.

• Keep each space audit-ready: maintain cleanroom operating procedures, gowning and contamination-control work instructions, safety procedures, and certification/monitoring records.

• Support the stand-up and transition of work into the new facility as it comes online — help set up new areas, move and install equipment, and support the wind-down of temporary space as capability moves.

• Partner day-to-day with AI&T, manufacturing engineering, and program teams to keep work and WIP moving across the sites, and communicate statuses, issues, and suggestions clearly.

• Over time, help onboard and guide additional technicians/specialists as the sites scale (potential growth into a team-lead/people-manager scope).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of hands-on experience maintaining and operating lab, cleanroom, or manufacturing facility equipment and systems in a controlled production or lab environment.

• Hands-on experience with mechanical, electrical, and facility-systems — experience with diagnosing, maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting equipment and building/lab systems (e.g., HVAC/air conditioning, pumps, chillers, compressors, DI water), and reading and interpreting procedures, manuals, and instructions.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience working in or supporting an ISO-classified cleanroom (ISO 5–8 or equivalent) or other contamination-controlled environment, including gowning and cleanliness discipline.

• Hands-on safety experience with hazardous-material and compressed/specialty-gas handling and storage, including serving as a floor- or lab-level safety point of contact.

• Experience maintaining lab equipment and supporting calibration/metrology scheduling, preventive maintenance, and inventory/consumables flow to keep equipment available and reduce downtime.

• High school diploma or equivalent; technical training, trade certifications, military technical experience, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

• In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Hands-on experience in aerospace, defense, semiconductor, medical-device, or optics/sensor manufacturing, including support of prototype or flight-hardware testing.

• Familiarity with ISO 5 (Class 100) operations and ESD precautions and cleanliness requirements for sensitive hardware.

• Experience helping stand up or set up a new lab or cleanroom, including equipment moves, installation, and setup.

• Hands-on experience with specialty-gas and pressure systems (e.g., regulators, pressure relief valves, nitrogen purge, gloveboxes) and hazardous-waste handling/recycling programs.

• Prior experience as a team lead or supervising/scheduling a small facilities/technician team (growth path toward people-management).

• Strong organization, multitasking, and documentation discipline, comfortable in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment.

• Active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Restaurant Manager - Red 8
jobs.description:
Salary $72,836 - $72,836

The Encore Boston Harbor Restaurant Manager will manage the daily operations of their designated restaurant. The Restaurant Manager will be responsible for all aspects of daily operations including staffing and labor management, ordering and inventory, guest service and execution of all associated Food & Beverage to standards of preparation and presentation. This includes but is not limited to; the management of the department strategy and ensuring alignment with overall Encore Boston Harbor strategy; maximizing opportunities for departmental and company success; maintaining all Encore Standards: and ensuring excellent guest and team member experience. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

•    Ensures all Encore Boston Harbor core values and property and department standards are implemented and applied.

•    Manages short-and long-term departmental goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates operational effectiveness; effects changes required for improvement.  Identifies key drivers of success.

•    Manages the departmental performance, and the accuracy, confidentiality, and thoroughness of departmental policies and procedures, records and reports.

•    Manages the performance of team members under his/her area of responsibility.

•    Monitors all activities of the department to ensure that all applicable internal policies, federal and state laws, rules, regulations and controls property wide are enforced.

•    Ensures department delivers and maintains a maximum level of property-wide service and satisfaction.

•    Facilitates communication throughout the property by organizing and presiding over regularly scheduled meetings with team members within the department and with other departments as appropriate to ensure property wide communication.

•    Responsible for hiring, performance management, and employee engagement within the department.  Provides training opportunities, constructive and positive feedback to team members within area of responsibility.  Creates a motivating environment.

•    Keeps informed of all new developments within the department and makes recommendations designed to maximize department and company success.

•    Effectively manages internal and external guest relations, which will require levels of patience, tact and diplomacy. Responsible for addressing guest and team member issues as appropriate.

•    Manages multiple priorities simultaneously and meets deadlines, often in stressful and high-pressure situations.

•    Must have the ability to promote positive, fair, and ethical relations with all team member, with all Encore contractors, and in all interactions within the Host and Surrounding communities as an ambassador of the Encore brand.

•    Oversees the Implementation of standards as detailed in the departmental standards and procedures manual.

•    Ensure staff are diligent in their opening and closing procedures and that the facility is always correctly prepared.

•    Check environmental elements including sound, lighting and temperatures are always correctly set.

•    Conduct effective shift briefings ensuring all staff are aware of VIPs, special occasions, daily specials, product features and property-wide events.

•    Encourage and motivate staff to provide optimum service during all shifts.

•    Share recommendations and guest comments to the General Manager or Director of Restaurants to reflect guest feedback.

•    Resolves guest’s complaints and team member difficulties.

•    Works with safety as a priority and follows department and company safety standards.

•    Maintains relevant knowledge of industry through continuing education and training.

•    Performs any other job-related duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Age, Gaming and Certifications:

21 years of age or above.

Will be required to obtain and maintain registration, or a license issued by the Massachusetts Gaming Commission.

Must be able to obtain an alcohol awareness card.

Education and/or Experience:

High School degree or equivalent required. Bachelor’s Degree in a hotel or restaurant management field or equivalent experience preferred.

Minimum 5 years of full-service restaurant experience required, 3 years in a leadership role preferred.

Requires strong computer skills and proficiency in POS Systems, Purchasing Software, Warehouse Requisition Software, Time-Keeping Software and Microsoft Office

Candidate must have experience with planning and project management.

Must possess outstanding organizational, interpersonal, and administrative skills, as well as excellent attention to detail.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI
jobs.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior product marketer with a deep understanding of AI to shape how the market understands Moby. You’ll connect how the technology works, the practical value it delivers to customers, and what makes it different from other options. You’ll own Moby’s positioning, messaging, content, and competitive intelligence for alternative AI solutions in the market. This is a highly visible, influential role. Success requires the ability to prioritize, plan, execute, and learn as the product and AI market evolve.

What you’ll do

Positioning and messaging

• Own Moby’s positioning, messaging, and value propositions. Develop a clear point of view that connects AI technology to practical customer outcomes and meaningful differentiation.

• Build consensus with executive leadership, Product Management, and other key stakeholders, driving the business toward a shared position and consistent messaging.

• Use customer interviews, sales conversations, and win/loss insights to refine use cases and routinely update messaging as customer needs and the market evolve.

Competitive intelligence

• Own competitive intelligence for alternative AI solutions in the market, including general-purpose tools and industry-specific products.

• Evaluate those products directly, track their capabilities and claims, and turn findings into clear recommendations for Moby’s positioning and product direction.

• Put competitive intelligence to work across go-to-market teams through enablement, battlecards, and practical guidance for customer conversations and campaigns. Drive adoption and use team feedback to improve how that intelligence is applied.

Content creation

• Be a public face and evangelist for Triple Whale’s AI capabilities, showing customers what’s possible through demos, video, events, and thought leadership.

• Partner with Content and Social to develop AI-first campaigns that make our capabilities tangible and connect them to customer needs.

• Own and create sales collateral, including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, product explainers, demo narratives, and objection-handling materials. Keep it current, credible, and useful.

• Create presentations, graphics, and scripts for audio and video that make Moby’s value clear and engaging.

Cross-functional collaboration

• Work with Product and Engineering to understand capabilities, validate claims, and connect technical decisions to customer value.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand customer needs, test narratives, and improve the usefulness of sales materials.

• Partner with Growth to build feedback loops around customer acquisition, activation, and adoption. Share customer insights, competitive intelligence, and campaign learnings to understand what’s working. Use those insights to strengthen positioning, messaging, and enablement across teams.

• Collaborate with Brand, creative teams, the launch lead, and channel teams to bring a consistent product story to market.

• Bring customer and competitive insight to executive leadership, with clear points of view and recommendations.

What you’ll bring

• A strong record in B2B product marketing, with ownership of messaging, positioning, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement for complex technology products.

• Direct experience marketing AI products or working at an AI company.

• Deep, current understanding of AI, informed by hands-on use and evaluation of AI products. You understand how models and agents use context and tools, where they create value, and their limitations.

• An AI-first mentality in how you work, using AI to research, create, and improve workflows while applying sound judgment to the results.

• The technical fluency to work closely with Product and Engineering, evaluate competing claims, and explain complex ideas simply to business audiences.

• Excellent writing and visual storytelling. You can create strong decks and collateral yourself and shape a clear story across graphics, audio, and video.

• Sound judgment, curiosity, and follow-through. You listen closely, test your assumptions, and use what you learn to improve the work.

Especially valuable

• Experience with industry-specific AI, commerce, marketing technology, or data and analytics products.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City

About the role

Cloudflare’s Strategic Partnerships team operates at the intersection of technology, media, and emergent AI business models. We sit at the tip of the spear—bridging what Cloudflare builds with executive market needs, navigating complex ecosystem shifts, and driving "zero-to-one" commercial and strategic initiatives.

We are seeking a Strategic Partnerships Operations Manager to bring structural rigor, operational efficiency, and scalable execution to our team. In this role, you will be the connective tissue between Strategic Partnerships and core internal functions like Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing.

What you'll do

You will design and run the team's operational backbone, build mechanisms to synthesize and scale external feedback back into our product roadmaps, and craft high-impact collateral for new solutions we bring to market. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical fluency, operates with high autonomy, and leverages modern AI tools to scale their impact.

Responsibilities

1. Operational Infrastructure & Rhythm

• Workflow Automation: Utilize modern AI tools and automated workflows to centralize partner data, streamline pipeline management, and reduce manual reporting overhead.

2. Cross-Functional Feedback Loops

• Field & Enablement Alignment: Partner with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to ensure partner learnings, tactical objection handling, and market narratives are operationalized across customer-facing teams.

3. Product Collateral & Go-To-Market Execution

• Collateral Architecture: Create executive-ready product collateral—such as message houses, solution one-sheets, presentation decks, and enablement briefs—to commercialize strategic initiatives.

• Technical Storytelling: Translate complex technical infrastructure, AI Gateway mechanisms, crawler policies, and edge-computing capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for external partners and internal leaders.

• Launch & Pilot Enablement: Coordinate pilot rollouts and partnership launches, ensuring marketing, product documentation, and collateral are aligned for external execution.

Who You Are

• Execution-Driven & Structured: You bring order to ambiguous environment. You enjoy building processes from scratch and making team operations run like clockwork.

• Technically Fluent: You understand modern internet infrastructure, APIs, web crawling, and the AI/LLM ecosystem. You can comfortably engage with product managers and engineers on technical nuances.

• AI-Native Mindset: You actively use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, workflow automation agents) in your daily work to multiply your output, synthesize data, and automate routine tasks.

• Master Communicator: You possess exceptional written and visual storytelling skills. You can distill dense technical details into crisp, polished executive collateral.

• Collaborative & Proactive: You thrive in cross-functional matrixed environments. You don't wait for a playbook—you build it while collaborating seamlessly across teams.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Product Marketing, Management Consulting, or Program Management within a high-growth tech environment.

• Technical Aptitude: Demonstrated ability to comprehend complex technical products, platform infrastructure, or developer tools.

• Track Record: Proven success in establishing cross-functional operating models and authoring external customer/partner collateral.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
With over 30,000 customers, including a third of Fortune 500 companies, Tempo is trusted by organizations across the globe to make their workflows work better.

We create a suite of integrated solutions for time management, resource planning, budget management, roadmapping, program management, reporting and more. We create the tech that enables the modern team to deliver – for every step from first vision to value.

Since our beginning in 2007 as a project to make a time-tracking tool to help a client – Tempo has expanded to become the #1 time management add-on for Jira, and we have developed and acquired a multitude of tools to become one of the most trusted names in the Atlassian ecosystem.

We want everyone to work better – but we also want to be a tech company with a heart. Join us as we continuously innovate our award-winning products, create new solutions, and help the world work smarter, not harder.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer who will be working at the intersection of LLMs, real-time signal processing, and enterprise decision-making. This is not a research role or an isolated AI team position. You’ll sit alongside domain engineers as you ship production AI systems to enterprise customers.

This is not the typical AI/ML engineering role. We’re looking for someone who uses AI heavily in their own daily work, has built and shipped features powered by LLMs and autonomous agents, and has strong opinions on what good AI product engineering actually looks like. If your go-to move when facing a complex problem is to reach for an agent pipeline rather than a static script, you’re the kind of engineer we have in mind.

You’ll initially pair with our external AI partners to absorb their work and establish the patterns the broader engineering team will follow. Over time, you become the internal anchor for AI engineering — the person the rest turn to for prompt design, evaluation strategy, model selection, and agent architecture decisions.

What you’ll do:

Signal detection and anomaly detection

Statistical and ML-based detectors that identify meaningful patterns in portfolio signals — velocity changes, capacity saturation, dependency risks — from CDC event streams and external tool integrations. Not simple threshold alerts; intelligent pattern recognition that knows the difference between noise and a real problem.

Insight synthesis engine

An LLM-powered correlation engine that takes raw signals and produces actionable insights with root causes, confidence scores, and evidence chains. Not just “something is wrong” — but “why it’s wrong, what it means, and what you should do about it.”

Planning Rules compiler

A translation layer between natural language planning rules (written by portfolio managers) and the structured parameters that drive our Monte Carlo scheduling engine. The LLM interprets intent; the deterministic engine computes schedules. You’ll design how these two layers communicate reliably.

Evaluation and testing frameworks

The pipelines that ensure AI outputs are reliable, consistent, and improving over time. Regression suites for prompt changes, A/B testing infrastructure for model updates, confidence calibration — because vibes-based testing doesn’t scale at enterprise scale.

MCP tool definitions

LLM-ready tool specs for domain capabilities (Item Store queries, capacity lookups, scenario simulations) that Tempo AI can discover and invoke at runtime within a hub-and-spoke MCP architecture already in production.

Who you are:

Must Have

 - A track record of shipping LLM-powered features or products — prototypes don’t count; we want to see things that real users have relied on.

 - Hands-on experience orchestrating agents — multi-step reasoning, tool use, autonomous action with guardrails. Frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent (including rolling your own).

 - Deep LLM engineering fundamentals: prompt engineering, RAG architectures, function calling / tool use, context management, evaluation-driven development.

 - Production-quality engineering practices — you write code with tests, participate in code review, care about CI/CD and observability. You build systems that run reliably in production, not notebook prototypes.

 - Experience with event-driven or streaming data systems — CDC events, real-time pipelines, and the patterns that come with them.

 - 5+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years focused on AI/ML in production systems.

 - Ability to work embedded in a product team — collaborating daily with domain engineers, product managers, and designers, not just other AI specialists.

Strongly Preferred

 - AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or GCP Vertex AI — we’re running on Bedrock with Claude today.

 - MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-use / agentic frameworks.

 - Anomaly detection, time-series analysis, or statistical signal processing.

 - Building confidence scoring or calibration systems for AI outputs.

 - A track record of absorbing work from external partners and making it your own — you know how to inherit an architecture, evaluate its decisions, and improve what you find.

 - Proficiency in Kotlin or TypeScript alongside Python — our product platform is Kotlin/TypeScript; our AI platform is Python. You’ll work across both.

Nice to Have

 - Monte Carlo simulation, optimization algorithms, or scheduling systems.

 - Background in portfolio management, project management, or resource planning.

 - Experience in enterprise SaaS — multi-tenancy, compliance, audit trails.

 - Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.

Mindset

jobs.title: Marketing Events Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT SPRIG

Sprig is building the AI-native successor to legacy survey tools, like Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey. We believe the future of experience research won’t be powered by slow, siloed platforms. It will be fast, intelligent, and deeply integrated into how modern teams build great products.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on. With Sprig, product teams no longer guess. They know. We are creating a future where AI uncovers insights, accelerates workflows, and enables teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences in real-time.

Companies like Notion, Figma, Coinbase, and TripAdvisor already use Sprig to stay closer to their customers than ever before. We’re scaling quickly toward $100M ARR, launching new AI-powered capabilities, and expanding our impact across the world’s most innovative companies.

If you're energized by bold ideas, rapid growth, and the opportunity to redefine an entire category, we'd love to meet you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Marketing Events Lead to own Sprig’s mid-sized event programs, including our flagship summits and customer events. Events are at the heart of this role: you’ll take programs from planning through execution, ensuring every experience runs flawlessly, achieves its goals, and leaves a lasting impression on the research and product leaders who attend.

You’ll work closely with the Go-To-Market team to bring Sprig’s event calendar to life, coordinating across internal teams, vendors, speakers, customers, and partners to deliver polished, high-impact experiences.

This role is ideal for someone with a few years of marketing or events experience who is ready to take on greater ownership. You thrive on logistics, love the energy of live experiences, and know how to turn a plan into a polished, well-executed event.

This role requires 4 days per week in our San Francisco HQ (Wednesday is optional WFH day).




YOUR IMPACT

 - Partner with the marketing team to plan and execute Sprig’s mid-sized events, including the Sprig Experience Research Summit, regional summits, and customer events: venue, vendors, budgets, timelines, run-of-show, and on-site execution

 - Manage the keynote speaker and customer experience, from outreach and prep to logistics and day-of coordination

 - Shape the attendee experience, including invitations, registration, agenda flow, and post-event follow-up to conversion

 - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align events with business goals, drive attendance from target prospects and customers, and ensure strong pre- and post-event follow-through

 - Track event performance, including attendance, engagement, and pipeline influenced, and surface insights that help us improve our programs and investment

 - Support smaller programs as needed, such as executive dinners, meetups, and direct mail and gifting tied to events and customer engagement

 - Support integrated campaign launches by coordinating marketing assets, communications, and program timelines

 - Willing and able to step in and support Sprig’s broader marketing and pipeline-driving efforts as needed


YOUR STRENGTHS

 - 2-4 years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a related B2B marketing role

 - Experience independently owning mid-sized events, such as summits, customer conferences, or multi-session programs, from planning through execution

 - Hands-on experience managing venues, vendors, speakers, and event budgets

 - Enthusiastic about collaborating with teammates on-site 4x per week to execute faster and more efficiently

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with confidence coordinating vendors, speakers, customers, and internal stakeholders

 - Highly detail-oriented (an absolute must!) and proactive, with strong judgment and the ability to solve problems quickly when plans change

 - Genuine enthusiasm for events, community building, and creating memorable in-person experiences

 - Experience with B2B or SaaS marketing programs is a plus

 - Adaptable to evolving priorities, with a willingness to travel up to 10%.


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive Salary

 - Competitive Employee Equity

 - 401K Program

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits

 - FSA/HSA Benefit

 - $175/month Commuter Benefit

 - Additional Wellbeing Benefits

 - Flexible Paid Time Off

 - Paid Parental Leave

 - Professional Development Stipend

 - Hybrid Office Policy

 - Lunch and dinner daily

 - Company Sponsored Social Events

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by Fortune as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In. Come join our mission of building products users love and have a real impact on Sprig’s future.




OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We prioritize diversity within our team and value different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

The salary range for this full-time position is $115,000 - $140,00+ Equity + Benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all locations (San Francisco, CA; New York, NY). The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

PURPOSE

Responsible management of the Microbiology laboratory and personnel and execution of the site Environmental and Personnel Monitoring program. This individual is expected to have strong, hands-on, and technical experience of microbiological assays (Endotoxin, Bioburden, TOC) and Environmental Monitoring.

The Microbiology Manager ensures strict adherence to all cGMP/GMP policies and standard operating procedures, provides microbiology technical expertise, and communications effectively with other departments.

The Manager will also have a proven track record with Continuous Improvement and be a champion for the change within the Microbiology team and the QC organization as a whole.

• Engage with Continuous Improvement projects cross-functionally that support site improvements and cost efficiency.

• Support and participate in internal and external inspections and audits including regulatory inspections.

BS in Microbiology/ Biology, or related scientific discipline

Essential

Essential

Committed to Science

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Device Platform
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

The Device Platform team owns the backend between Verkada's cloud and the hardware we ship — device provisioning, OTA firmware rollout, and the licensing layer that turns devices into a business. Verkada already operates at millions of devices, and we're scaling the platform for the next order of magnitude — with the consistency, latency, and uptime guarantees our enterprise customers depend on.

Hitting that scale isn't just a technical problem. We're creating the IoT core that every product team across Verkada relies on to accelerate their roadmaps. We do as much cross-team alignment as deep systems design, and hold a high bar on both execution and communication with our peers.

We're five senior engineers today, with a new-grad joining us this summer — and we're hiring more as the platform's reach across Verkada grows. We're high-trust and inclusive: we give and receive feedback directly, we learn out loud, and we get better together because of it.

What You'll Do

• Senior engineers on this team architect, ship, and bring others along. We learn and teach as we build.

• Design and lead major platform features end-to-end, such as the IoT core, the device-metrics platform, or the licensing ledger.

• Lead operational improvements that increase system robustness, reduce pager noise, and help the team learn from incidents when they occur.

• Teach as you ship — through design reviews, code reviews, crisp written communication, and direct mentorship.

• Listen to other Verkada teams, and help drive the platform's roadmap toward the company's biggest long-term bets.

What You Bring

• 6+ years of experience building backend services with consistency, latency, and uptime guarantees at scale.

• Fluency in at least one server language — Python or Go preferred; adjacent languages like Ruby or JavaScript (NodeJs) welcome.

• Skilled at listening to other engineering teams, shaping shared technical direction, and shipping changes they can build on without surprise.

• This role requires U.S. citizenship or permanent residency for FedRAMP compliance, and onsite presence five days per week.

• We want to build an inclusive team. Research consistently shows that candidates from underrepresented groups apply less often than is warranted — if this opportunity is a positive challenge for your career, please apply.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

• Professional development stipend

• Wellness/fitness benefits

• Healthy lunches provided daily

• Commuter benefits

Additional Information

• This role does not offer visa sponsorship. Verkada sponsors for many other engineering roles — see open positions at https://www.verkada.com/careers/

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

$190,000—$275,000 USD

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

The Kitchen brings together a range of disciplines and capabilities. It’s a team of creatives, producers, data analysts and social experts working together to deliver remarkable ideas that live in a variety of mediums, from social to TV. This team moves at the speed of culture. It is built to respond to trends and events as they happen, coming up with ideas that transcend social media to capture the spirit of the moment, earn media impressions, and get the country talking.

Are you ready to join an award-ambitious team that's making waves in the advertising industry? Our incredible team has been recognized internationally by industry giants like Cannes, One Show and was named Campaign's Global In-House Agency of The Year, further solidifying our position as a leader in the industry. Join us and be a part of something truly special, a team that's dedicated to creating ground-breaking work and pushing limits.

At The Kitchen, we're not just looking for individuals who want to be a part of the advertising industry, we're looking for trailblazers who are ready to lead the way to the next big thing. We want individuals who are passionate about producing award-winning work and have an innate drive to their craft and are eager to generate innovative ideas both within and outside of the brief.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

In this role as Content Creator, you work alongside a team of Creatives and a Producer to plan, shoot, edit and optimize a wide range of content. From clever TikToks shot natively on device to deliciously staged food photography, you will work to create a range of still and video assets for some iconic brands. You’re an expert in social content – with a deep understanding of the platforms and what kind of content audiences expect on each. You enjoy the creative process and you’ll be part of a team that makes the kind of ideas, brand acts, and social content that gets people talking.

You’ll use your experience as a Content Creator to plan, shoot, edit, and design content at the speed of culture. You are on top of the latest trends and are well-versed in creating content for all platforms – you know what works on Instagram, twitter, and just how different both those platforms are from TikTok. You are a storyteller and use all your skills every day to create content that sets us apart from other brands online.

Your work will make a meaningful impact with a multi-talented team in North America (Toronto & Chicago) that blurs the lines of what advertising can be in today’s always-on, socially connected industry.

RESPONSIBILTIES:

• SOCIAL EXPERTISE: You can identify trends and opportunities as they emerge in social and quickly ideate and present concepts for content that will stay true to our brands but participate in the online dialogue.

• SOCIAL STRATEGY: Work with the team to ideate on planned content monthly and quarterly to ensure an always-on social approach. Research and proactively recommend ideas, solutions and new content for the brands

• CONTENT CREATION: You use a robust skillset from photography to videography, design, and platform native tools to create a wide range of content that suits the moment and the idea. From quick social posts to beautiful shoots, you have the range and the ability to switch quickly between styles.

• STORYTELLING: You’re able to ideate, build, shoot, and edit effective stories that match the quality of each social platform.

• COLLABORATION: Work collaboratively with a large team of creatives from ideation to execution – helping to ensure ideas are created and brought to life faithfully.

• WORKFLOW MANAGEMENT: Can manage multiple priorities and assignments. Execute with rapid turnaround times for real-time moments, capture trending moments, editing quickly and efficiently to deliver high-quality work, on-time and with accuracy.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• 1 to 3 years of experience in a design or content creation role where you have made a wide range of content.

• A high-quality portfolio displaying a range of quality social content, ideally produced in a creative agency environment.

• Understanding of design programs such as Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, and After Effects, including best practices for all social channels.

• Demonstrated ability to make relevant content across all platforms with extraordinary skills in visual storytelling, videography, and video editing. Graphic design experience is a plus.

• A passion, curiosity, and experience in making creative content on social media platforms - Instagram visuals, TikTok videos, YouTube edits, and more.

• Proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite and eager to continue to learn and evolve in other ways to make social-first content.

• Experience creating high-quality content for clients with high standards of quality and excellence.

• Ability to problem solve and recommend production/design-appropriate solutions.

• Highly organized with an ability to work under tight deadlines and shift priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Passion for food that enhances the authenticity and appeal of brand marketing in the culinary industry.

• A desire to do award-winning, internationally recognized work.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Launches & Core Platform
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

About the role

Triple Whale is looking for a creative product marketer to own our go-to-market launches and support product marketing for our platform team.

You’ll combine a content creator’s instincts with a launch manager’s organization to lead weekly drops and larger monthly launches. Inspired by how consumer brands build anticipation, you’ll create content across formats that gets people to notice, share, and try our products. You’ll bring an AI-first mindset to move quickly from idea to execution.

Our platform team focuses on the technology that makes Triple Whale exceptional, including data, infrastructure, and UI components. You’ll translate that work into clear positioning, messaging, and customer communications that explain what’s changing, why it matters, and how customers benefit.

What you’ll own

Go-to-market launches and weekly drops

• Own the launch calendar and execution. Coordinate weekly drops and monthly launches with clear timelines, owners, and deliverables. Keep teams aligned on product readiness and messaging while reducing coordination work for other product marketers.

• Build a recognizable weekly drop program. Develop its creative approach and keep formats fresh. Feature new capabilities, useful improvements, and existing features customers have yet to discover.

• Shape the story and create the content. Partner with product marketers on the audience, customer benefit, and desired action. Write copy, record demos, and produce videos, carousels, or simple visual assets without requiring a full production cycle.

• Make social and creators central to launches. Collaborate on product reveals, walkthroughs, and other formats worth sharing. Match the format to the story; weekly drops do not require a blog post.

• Coordinate the customer experience. Work with Growth, Lifecycle, and other channel owners to align social, email, in-app messages, and supporting launch activity.

• Measure and improve. Define success for each launch, from reach and engagement to activation and adoption. Use focused debriefs and audience feedback to improve the next drop.

Platform product marketing

• Lead product marketing for the platform team. Partner with Product on the roadmap, prioritize marketing support, and translate technical or behind-the-scenes improvements into clear customer value.

• Own positioning and messaging. Explain what changes, who benefits, and why it matters. Develop stories that connect platform capabilities to customer needs.

• Bring customer and market insights into product decisions. Conduct research, gather feedback from Sales and Customer Success, and assess competing approaches to inform the roadmap and messaging.

• Support customer understanding and adoption. Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Success on communications and education. Equip customer-facing teams with demos, talk tracks, and FAQs, then track adoption and feedback with Product.

What you’ll bring

• 5+ years of experience in product marketing, launch marketing, integrated campaigns, or a related role. We welcome backgrounds in B2B SaaS, consumer software, and D2C or e-commerce brands.

• Experience taking launches from idea through execution, with a clear understanding of what drove results and what you would improve.

• Strong creative instincts and confidence creating content yourself across formats, including written copy, short-form video, product demos, and visual storytelling.

• An AI-first mindset. You actively use AI for research, ideation, content production, and repeatable workflows, while applying your own judgment to accuracy and quality.

• Product marketing fundamentals, including customer research, positioning, and translating features into benefits. You’re comfortable learning software and demonstrating it through recorded or on-camera content.

• Strong project management and collaboration skills. You can manage overlapping timelines, resolve blockers, and drive accountability without adding unnecessary process.

• Good judgment about scope and measurement. You know when a release needs a larger campaign, when a well-made video is enough, and how to distinguish attention from adoption.

Especially relevant experience

• Building recurring content series, product drops, or creator collaborations that give audiences a reason to return.

• Marketing to e-commerce operators or working within the tools and communities they use.

What success looks like

Triple Whale has a consistent launch rhythm, with creative weekly drops and well-coordinated monthly launches. Product marketers spend less time chasing deliverables. Customers understand platform changes and how to use them, and launch results inform what we do next.

The expected base salary for this role is $115,000–$125,000 per year.

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred?  Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way!  They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead / Director
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City

About the role

The web is undergoing a structural transition from a search-first economy to an AI-mediated, agentic ecosystem. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the world's web traffic, providing an unmatched, front-row view of how Large Language Models (LLMs), AI bots, and autonomous agents interact with digital content.

We are seeking a Strategic Partnerships Lead / Director to join Cloudflare’s Strategic Partnerships team. In this high-impact, zero-to-one role, you will define and execute our strategy to transform Cloudflare’s rich network and CDN data into actionable business, marketing, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) intelligence.

What you'll do

You will act as the crucial bridge between enterprise customers, Product & Engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. Your mission is to build and commercialize the "Analytics of the Agentic Era"—helping non-technical business leaders, CMOs, and digital publishers measure content value, track agentic traffic, and optimize brand visibility across AI answer engines.

Responsibilities

1. Product Influence & Analytics Suite Definition

• Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to translate raw CDN, bot, and network traffic signals into executive-ready dashboards and commercial analytics products.

• Help design first-party analytics tools tailored for business personas—focusing on metrics like scraping-to-referral ratios, prompt library integrations, LLM brand presence, and content gap analysis.

• Run design partner programs with top enterprise customers and media brands to gather feedback, validate feature roadmaps, and co-develop analytics prototypes.

2. GTM Strategy & Sales Enablement

• Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Enterprise Sales and GTM teams to package, price, and position the Advanced Analytics Suite for commercial buyers.

• Create sales playbooks, value frameworks, and pitch materials that translate complex technical infrastructure data into compelling business stories for non-technical buyers.

• Serve as a domain expert in high-stakes customer meetings, executive briefing centers (EBCs), and pilot programs.

3. Expanding the Buyer Horizon Beyond CISOs

• Champion Cloudflare’s strategic positioning beyond security (CISOs) and infrastructure (CTOs), actively expanding our mindshare among CMOs, digital strategists, and commercial leaders.

• Educate external stakeholders on critical concepts in the agentic web, such as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and synthetic web traffic attribution.

4. Ecosystem & Strategic Alliances

• Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships with adjacent players in the marketing tech and AI ecosystem (e.g., AEO measurement platforms, attribution providers, AI ad networks, and commercial data platforms).

• Leverage ecosystem relationships to enrich Cloudflare’s analytics capabilities and build joint go-to-market motions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• 10+ Years of Experience: Demonstrated track record in strategic partnerships, business development, product marketing, or strategy within digital media, martech, web analytics, or data platform ecosystems.

• Technical + Commercial Fluency: Exceptional ability to understand complex technical infrastructure (CDNs, bot management, traffic logs, APIs) while possessing a keen empathy for marketing and business mechanics (KPIs, CAC/LTV, attribution, content monetization).

• 0-to-1 Builder Mindset: Proven experience taking early-stage, ambiguous product concepts from ideation to scaled commercial distribution.

• C-Suite Storytelling & Communication: Superior written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting to C-level executives (CMOs, CEOs) and simplifying complex developer concepts into strategic business imperatives.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong experience orchestrating alignment across engineering, product management, sales, legal, and executive leadership teams.

• Location: Based in or willing to work hybrid from our San Francisco, CA or New York, NY or Austin, TX offices.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $195,000 - $268,000

• For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $186,000 - $255,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

• Perform general building maintenance and repairs, including drywall, painting, lighting, plumbing, and furniture systems.

If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.



About the role:

Hi there! We're seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Senior Compensation Operations Manager to own the design, implementation, and governance of our enterprise sales compensation program. This senior-level individual contributor role reports to the VP of Revenue Operations and serves as the architect and steward of compensation strategy across our diverse go-to-market organization.

You'll partner with GTM Leadership, Finance, and People Operations to build world-class compensation programs that attract talent, drive the right behaviors, and align with business objectives. You'll manage the full lifecycle of compensation—from design through implementation, compliance, analytics, and continuous improvement—across Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Leaders, Partner Managers, Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers and other functions on variable compensation plans.

Note: This role focuses on compensation design and operations. Our Finance team manages commission accounting and invoice processing in Xactly.



What You Will Do




COMPENSATION STRATEGY & DESIGN

 - Own the strategic design of annual sales compensation programs for all eligible roles and adjust for market conditions, competitive landscape, and business priorities

 - Benchmark compensation against market data and peer software companies; conduct pay equity analysis and recommend adjustments to ensure competitiveness and fairness

 - Design commission structures, accelerators, quotas, and incentive mechanics that drive desired sales behaviors and align with revenue goals

 - Design and own SPIFF and other incentive programs outside of the official incentive plan

 - Lead cross-functional design reviews with Sales, Finance, and executive leadership to validate programs before launch


PROGRAM IMPLEMENTATION & OPERATIONS

 - Manage the end-to-end program launch calendar; coordinate cross-functional efforts and communicate timelines, changes, and deadlines to stakeholders

 - Build and maintain the primary source of truth for all compensation program documentation, including plan documents, commission schedules, quota assignments, and policy guidelines

 - Configure compensation programs in Xactly and SFDC; validate data integrity, test calculations, and ensure system configurations reflect approved plan design

 - Develop training materials and lead training sessions for sales teams on compensation plan mechanics, commission calculations, and incentive rules


GOVERNANCE & COMPLIANCE

 - Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies across all geographies where we operate

 - Manage exceptions, disputes, and appeals related to commissions, quotas, and incentive payouts; work with VP RevOps, Finance and HR to resolve efficiently and fairly

 - Maintain audit trails and documentation for all material compensation decisions and changes


ANALYTICS & REPORTING

 - Build dashboards and reports to monitor role based performance metrics, compensation spend, payout distributions, plan attainment, and ROI on incentive investments.  Including SPIFF reporting metrics

 - Conduct post-program analysis (win/loss, attainment distribution, program metrics) and deliver insights to leadership on plan effectiveness

 - Recommend program adjustments mid-year based on market shifts, business performance, and feedback from sales leaders


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Partner with VP of RevOps to align compensation with business strategy and sales priorities; maintain regular feedback loops with Sales Leaders

 - Work directly with Commission Accounting on attainment data, payouts, calculations and discrepancies

 - Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and year-end reporting of incentive spend

 - Work with People Operations on equity, total rewards strategy, and talent retention initiatives

 - Communicate compensation strategy and changes to the broader organization with clarity and confidence



What You Will Bring to the Role




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation, incentive design, or related revenue operations roles (within software, SaaS, or enterprise sales environments preferred)

 - Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing compensation programs for multiple sales roles and structures

 - Advanced proficiency with sales compensation platforms (Xactly, Anaplan, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); strong data analysis and Excel skills

 - Deep understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and comfort configuring objects, fields, and reporting for incentive programs

 - Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfort translating complex compensation concepts for diverse audiences (sales teams, executives, finance, HR)

 - Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

 - Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and other employment law considerations affecting compensation (particularly for global organizations)


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience managing compensation programs across multiple geographic regions with different regulatory requirements

 - Background in financial analysis, FP&A, or accounting; understanding of revenue recognition impacts on compensation timing

 - Exposure to Customer Success, Services, or other non-traditional sales comp models

 - Certification in compensation (e.g., WorldatWork CECP, GRP) or related HR disciplines

 - Experience at a high-growth or publicly traded software company
