jobs.description:
Wall Street Prep is the leading provider of financial training solutions to the world’s top investment banks, private equity firms, corporations, and universities, including organizations such as Goldman Sachs and KKR. Founded in 2004, Wall Street Prep (WSP) is a fast-growing and highly profitable company backed by its founders and private equity investors.

Wall Street Prep is seeking a Business Development Executive, Individual Programs to join our growing commercial team. This role will focus on driving enrollment and revenue across our individual programs, including co-branded certificate programs with Wharton Online and Columbia, as well as our open enrollment professional courses.

Reporting to the Commercial Director, the Business Development Executive will own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through pitching and closing. This is a high-profile role within a new sales motion at WSP, offering the opportunity to work closely with leadership to build the messaging, targeting, processes, and playbook that will shape how this channel scales.

We are looking for someone with 2–4 years of full-cycle sales experience or a high-performing business development or client-facing background at an expert network, research firm, financial services firm, or similar high-volume environment. The ideal candidate is commercially driven, polished in front of finance professionals, comfortable with significant outbound activity, and excited by the opportunity to build a sales motion rather than simply execute an established playbook.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the full sales cycle for Wall Street Prep’s individual programs, from prospecting and qualification through pitching, follow-up, and closing

• Develop and convert opportunities within WSP’s existing database of past learners, alumni, engaged leads, and prospective customers

• Build and execute cold outbound campaigns targeting finance professionals across investment banking, private equity, venture capital, corporate development, Big Four deal teams, and related sectors

• Source prospective customers and accounts using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sequencing tools, and other sales prospecting platforms

• Develop highly personalized and compelling outreach designed to engage sophisticated finance professionals

• Manage both self-pay and employer-reimbursed sales opportunities, adapting the sales approach based on the buyer and purchasing process

• Help employer-sponsored prospects develop the business case needed to secure approval from managers, HR, or Learning & Development teams

• Coordinate closely with WSP’s enterprise sales team to ensure appropriate account coverage and guardrails for institutions that are existing WSP clients

• Partner with Marketing and Demand Generation to continuously improve messaging, targeting, lead generation, and conversion

• Track and report pipeline performance by source, buyer type, and program to help identify the highest-performing segments and sales strategies

• Help develop and refine the sales playbook for a new and growing revenue channel

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university

• 2–4 years of full-cycle sales experience, or experience in a high-performing business development or client-facing role at an expert network, research firm, financial services company, or similar high-volume environment

• Demonstrated ability to prospect, build relationships, and generate opportunities through outbound activity

• Strong interest in financial services, professional education, and career development

• Excellent written communication skills and the ability to craft sharp, personalized outreach for senior finance professionals

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Leaves and Accommodations
jobs.description:
The Role

The Senior Manager, Leaves & Accommodations oversees the leave of absence and accommodation Center of Excellence (COE) and serves as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on leave management, reasonable accommodations and the interactive process, and state and local leave and disability laws.

This leadership role is responsible for the administration and oversight of leave programs, including FMLA, ADA, PWFA, state and local leave laws, disability benefits, and other company-issued leave programs. The Senior Manager will help build and develop the team structure and processes, drive operational excellence, mitigate legal and compliance risk, and enhance the leave and accommodation processes at GTI, all while navigating the evolving and highly complex regulatory requirements.

This is primarily a remote position but Chicagoland candidates are preferred.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

• Function as the strategic owner of scalable policies and operational frameworks for the centralized management of leave and accommodation programs and policies

• Lead and develop a high-performing, customer service-oriented team of leave and accommodation practitioners with various backgrounds and levels of experience

• Establish performance expectations, service level agreements, and operational goals for the COE

• Identify areas for on-going and continuous process improvement and timely execute on program enhancements

• Provide counsel and technical guidance to senior leaders on complex and confidential employee matters

• Partner with cross-functional senior leaders, including Benefits, Payroll, HR, Employee Relations, Legal, and Risk

• Direct the development and delivery of educational resources to employees, HR Partners, and management about leave of absence and accommodations protocols, promoting a culture of consistency and compliance

• Leverage data and reporting to monitor trends, identify risks, and develop actionable insights and recommendations to mitigate risk and improve programs, processes, and employee experience

Compliance & Risk Management

• Maintain knowledge and ensure compliance with all applicable leave and accommodation laws

• Monitor legislative developments to ensure compliance; stay informed about changes in leave laws and regulations

• Advise HR Partners, managers, and employees on the interaction of leave laws with paid time off, workers compensation, and short-term and long-term disability benefits

• Administer company time-off programs as assigned in accordance with internal policy and applicable laws

• Ensure maintenance of complete and accurate records of leave and accommodation requests in accordance with specified legal requirements and documentation of best practices

Leave and Accommodations Administration

• Lead and maintain procedures to ensure accuracy and efficiencies related to employee payments, short-term and long-term disability claims, reconciliation and repayments of employee benefit premiums, and employees’ benefits eligibility

• Develop a procedure for monitoring the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of employees’ intermittent leave usage

• Develop and maintain reports and metrics related to leaves and accommodations and conduct analysis in a manner that is digestible and actionable for managers and senior leadership

• Serve as the primary point of contact for all third-party vendors related to leave and accommodation programs and platforms overseeing vendor performance and service delivery

• Own and optimize leave and accommodation administration systems and processes, partnering with HRIS and vendors to enhance functionality, reporting capabilities, and operational efficiency.

• Responsible for managing and owning the full lifecycle process of leave cases including intake, eligibility, notification, documentation, tracking, and return to work.

Qualifications

• 7+ years related experience

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field with an emphasis in business or finance, or equivalent years professional/analytical experience related to the above-described duties or equivalent combination of education, experience, and/or training.

• Experience with AbsenceSoft preferred.

• Demonstrated success and experience in leading a center of excellence or leave and accommodations practitioners.

• Extensive knowledge of the leave requirements and other legal protections afforded by federal, state, and local laws.

• Well versed in ERISA, employee benefit programs, including flexible benefit programs, financial analysis, and budgeting.

• Familiarity with Workers' Compensation Act, city regulations and other applicable state/federal statutes and regulations preferred.

• Proficient in analyzing complex problems, identifying sources of risk, and developing strategic solutions, with a track record of successfully resolving issues in a timely manner.

• Strong organizational abilities, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines consistently.

• Effective leadership and management skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a high-performance team.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

• Ability to critically analyze information, data, and situations to understand underlying patterns and trends, facilitating informed decision-making and problem-solving.

• Flexible and adaptable in dynamic work environments, able to quickly adjust priorities and strategies to meet changing needs and challenges.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely, and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office products with advanced Excel experience and has ability to perform mathematical calculations in computing rates, premiums, and adjustments.

• Experience with Kronos or Wurk preferred.

Additional Requirements

• Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• Must possess valid driver’s license

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (SQL)
jobs.description:
Radicle Health is a collection of human services software products designed to foster collaboration and innovation, helping organizations better serve their communities. We believe technology plays a crucial role in the success of the human services sector, but no single system can meet the diverse needs of every agency. That’s why we’ve built Radicle Health as a home for mission-driven products that support organizations in delivering essential services. Under one roof, our teams learn from each other, test ideas faster, and think holistically about the individuals and communities we serve.

At Radicle Health, you'll do meaningful work alongside people who genuinely care about our mission, our customers, and each other. Here, you're free to show up as your full self, celebrating wins, having fun, and knowing you're truly part of something bigger. You will have real ownership of your work and your contributions will have a direct impact on our success. We're invested in your growth because when you grow, so do we.

About the Role:

As a Software Engineer, you will build and ship well-defined features and bug fixes across the full stack, with a focus on the data layer: designing, writing, and tuning SQL Server queries and stored procedures that power our .NET Core APIs and React user interfaces. You will work closely with experienced engineers, who will guide you on approach and design while you build the technical depth and product knowledge needed to take on more ownership over time.

Because we work with healthcare and human services data, good data-handling practices are also part of the job. You will be expected to follow Radicle Health's HIPAA and data-handling guidelines, including when using AI-assisted tools. Development and testing should use mocked or anonymized data rather than real customer PHI.

What You'll Do:

• Build and ship well-defined features and bug fixes across the full stack, with a focus on designing, writing, and tuning SQL Server queries and stored procedures that power .NET Core APIs and React user interfaces.

• Follow our best practices for code quality, testing, and the development process, including source control and deployment workflows, with support from colleagues on approach and design.

• Take ownership of your work through launch and beyond, quickly noticing and addressing bugs, regressions, slow queries, and open questions related to the code you shipped.

• Collaborate actively with the team by giving and welcoming thoughtful feedback in pull request reviews, asking good questions in technical discussions, and asking for help early when you're blocked.

• Protect sensitive data in line with Radicle Health's guidelines for PHI, using mocked or anonymized data in development and testing, including when using AI tools.

• Build a strong understanding of our products, customers, and the Health and Human Services domain, and grow toward independently designing and delivering features with less direction.

What You Bring:

• 1–3 years of experience in software development, whether professional, internship, academic, or personal projects.

• A BS degree, or equivalent professional experience or certifications.

• Working knowledge of SQL Server, including T-SQL, joins, stored procedures, indexes, and reading execution plans.

• Working knowledge of C# and .NET Core, including building or consuming REST APIs.

• A working understanding of full-stack development and how data flows from a SQL Server database through a .NET Core API to a React front end.

• A foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• A basic understanding of source code management (such as Git) and deployment tools.

• A track record of contributing to the delivery of a feature or project, and the ability to clearly describe your role in it.

• A sense of ownership and accountability for the quality of your work.

• A collaborative approach to working with other engineers, product managers, and QA, including openness to feedback.

• An understanding of the responsibility that comes with building healthcare software, and of the importance of protecting PHI and other sensitive customer information.

Helpful, but not required:

• Experience with React, JavaScript, and HTML/CSS

• Experience with with database design and normalization, query performance tuning, and schema changes and migrations

• Experience with Fluent UI

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code or Copilot

What Success Looks Like:

Early in the role, you will focus on learning our products, codebase, tools, and development process. You should be able to reliably deliver well-defined features and bug fixes, participate actively in code reviews, and follow our practices for code quality and data handling.

As you grow, you will need less direction on approach and design. You will independently work through problems across the SQL Server, .NET Core, and React layers, notice issues in your shipped code (such as regressions and slow queries) before others do, and bring clear, well-considered questions to the team when you need support.

Success in this role is not measured by how much code you write. It is measured by how well you understand what you are building and why, how reliably your work performs once it ships, and how much your teammates can count on you for communication, collaboration, and care with sensitive data.

Why This Role:

• Your work directly contributes to the reliability of software used by organizations serving people and communities that depend on these systems every day.

• You will get hands-on experience across the full stack and the software development lifecycle, building skills in SQL Server, .NET Core, React, query performance, code quality, and secure handling of healthcare data.

• You will work closely with experienced engineers, QA, and product teams, taking on more ownership as your technical skills, judgment, and product knowledge grow.

What we offer:

• Unlimited PTO policy

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision healthcare coverage

• 401k matching

• Paid holidays

• Volunteer time off

• Paid parental leave

• Remote work stipend

• Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000

• Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Operations Engineer, Mechanical
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.
   
    


ROLE SCOPE

 - Serve as the most senior technical authority for operational mechanical and cooling infrastructure across the hyperscale AI data center fleet.

 - Lead site assessments and operational audits, and drive team technical readiness ahead of site activation.

 - Review designs and specifications from an operational lens, and feed operational learnings back into design and manufacturing as the build model becomes productized.

 - Be the senior voice on chillers, cooling towers, CDUs, and the liquid-cooling architectures AI infrastructure depends on.

 - Own mechanical operational readiness and the commissioning-to-operations handover for new sites.

 - Author and approve high-risk mechanical MOPs, EOPs, and AOPs, and lead root cause analysis on significant cooling events.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've spent a career on critical mechanical systems and you treat thermal precision as non-negotiable for AI workloads.

 - You command chilled water, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, pumps, CDUs, and direct liquid cooling in live environments.

 - You've authored and executed high-risk mechanical MOPs and led root cause analysis on significant cooling events.

 - You assess operational readiness at any site, audit the posture, and raise the standard.

 - You teach and build the mechanical readiness of teams ahead of activation.

 - Bonus: Hyperscale or large colocation at hundreds of MW. Direct liquid cooling and CDU operations. ASHRAE TC 9.9. Chilled water plant optimization. Uptime Institute.

 


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.
   
   - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.
     
     
     Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (React)
jobs.description:
Radicle Health is a collection of human services software products designed to foster collaboration and innovation, helping organizations better serve their communities. We believe technology plays a crucial role in the success of the human services sector, but no single system can meet the diverse needs of every agency. That’s why we’ve built Radicle Health as a home for mission-driven products that support organizations in delivering essential services. Under one roof, our teams learn from each other, test ideas faster, and think holistically about the individuals and communities we serve.

At Radicle Health, you'll do meaningful work alongside people who genuinely care about our mission, our customers, and each other. Here, you're free to show up as your full self, celebrating wins, having fun, and knowing you're truly part of something bigger. You will have real ownership of your work and your contributions will have a direct impact on our success. We're invested in your growth because when you grow, so do we.

About the Role:

As a Software Engineer, you will build and ship well-defined features and bug fixes across the full stack, with a focus on React user interfaces backed by .NET Core APIs and SQL Server. You will work closely with experienced engineers, who will guide you on approach and design while you build the technical depth and product knowledge needed to take on more ownership over time.

Because we work with healthcare and human services data, good data-handling practices are also part of the job. You will be expected to follow Radicle Health's HIPAA and data-handling guidelines, including when using AI-assisted tools. Development and testing should use mocked or anonymized data rather than real customer PHI.

What You'll Do:

• Build and ship well-defined features and bug fixes across the full stack, with a focus on responsive, accessible React user interfaces backed by .NET Core APIs and SQL Server.

• Follow our best practices for code quality, testing, and the development process, including source control and deployment workflows, with support from colleagues on approach and design.

• Take ownership of your work through launch and beyond, quickly noticing and addressing bugs, regressions, and open questions related to the code you shipped.

• Collaborate actively with the team by giving and welcoming thoughtful feedback in pull request reviews, asking good questions in technical discussions, and asking for help early when you’re blocked.

• Protect sensitive data in line with Radicle Health’s guidelines for PHI, using mocked or anonymized data in development and testing, including when using AI tools.

• Build a strong understanding of our products, customers, and the Health and Human Services domain, and grow toward independently designing and delivering features with less direction.

What You Bring:

• 1–3 years of experience in software development, whether professional, internship, academic, or personal projects.

• A BS degree, or equivalent professional experience or certifications.

• Working knowledge of React, including hooks, component composition, and state and props.

• Solid JavaScript skills and experience with HTML/CSS, including building responsive and accessible UI.

• Some experience with C# and with state management tools such as Redux or React Query.

• A working understanding of full-stack development and how the layers of an application communicate.

• A foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• A basic understanding of source code management (such as Git) and deployment tools.

• A track record of contributing to the delivery of a feature or project, and the ability to clearly describe your role in it.

• A sense of ownership and accountability for the quality of your work.

• A collaborative approach to working with other engineers, product managers, and QA, including openness to feedback.

• An understanding of the responsibility that comes with building healthcare software, and of the importance of protecting PHI and other sensitive customer information.

Helpful, but not required:

• Experience with Fluent UI

• Experience with front-end testing, such as Jest or React Testing Library

• Experience with a relational database, such as SQL Server, Postgres, or similar

• Experience building or consuming REST APIs with .NET Core

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code or Copilot

What Success Looks Like:

Early in the role, you will focus on learning our products, codebase, tools, and development process. You should be able to reliably deliver well-defined features and bug fixes, participate actively in code reviews, and follow our practices for code quality and data handling.

As you grow, you will need less direction on approach and design. You will independently work through problems across the React, .NET Core, and SQL Server layers, notice issues in your shipped code before others do, and bring clear, well-considered questions to the team when you need support.

Success in this role is not measured by how much code you write. It is measured by how well you understand what you are building and why, how reliably your work performs once it ships, and how much your teammates can count on you for communication, collaboration, and care with sensitive data.

Why This Role:

Your work directly contributes to the reliability of software used by organizations serving people and communities that depend on these systems every day.

You will get hands-on experience across the full stack and the software development lifecycle, building skills in React, .NET Core, SQL Server, code quality, accessibility, and secure handling of healthcare data.

You will work closely with experienced engineers, QA, and product teams, taking on more ownership as your technical skills, judgment, and product knowledge grow.

What we offer:

• Unlimited PTO policy

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision healthcare coverage

• 401k matching

• Paid holidays

• Volunteer time off

• Paid parental leave

• Remote work stipend

• Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000

• Location: Remote

Please note that all official communication regarding opportunities at Radicle Health will only come from an @radicle-health.com email address. Some fraudulent domains may look very similar at a glance, so if anything feels off, please proceed with caution.

jobs.title: Director of Tax
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos is seeking a Director of Tax to lead the company’s tax strategy, compliance, reporting, and incentive monetization activities. This role is central to maximizing the value of federal and state tax incentives—including R&D tax credits; clean electricity and advanced nuclear investment and production tax credits; and other energy-, manufacturing-, and technology-related programs—while ensuring disciplined management of the company’s broader tax obligations.

The Director of Tax will serve as the company’s senior tax advisor, partnering with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Strategy, Business Development, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and other teams to integrate tax considerations into business decisions, financial planning, new ventures, geographic expansion, transactions, and capital investment. The role will be highly hands-on initially and will build the processes, systems, controls, and team required as Kairos transitions from a development-stage company to a scaled industrial enterprise and moves toward public-company standards.

This is not a narrow compliance role. The Director of Tax will be a value-creation leader and strategic business partner—converting Kairos’ innovation and capital investment into cash benefits, integrating tax into major decisions, and building the infrastructure, controls, systems, and team required for scale and future public-market access.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Tax Strategy & Business Partnership

• Develop and execute an enterprise tax strategy that supports business objectives, optimizes tax outcomes, and manages tax risk while maintaining full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

• Advise senior leadership on the tax implications of significant business decisions, including capital investments, entity and ownership structures, financings, new ventures, geographic expansion, mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and restructurings.

• Partner with Finance, Strategy, and Business Development to incorporate tax implications, incentive economics, and cash-tax impacts into financial models, budgets, forecasts, and investment decisions.

• Monitor legislative, regulatory, and accounting developments and translate changes into clear recommendations, implementation plans, and risk-management actions.

Federal and State Tax Incentives & Credits

• Lead the identification, pursuit, documentation, and monetization of federal and state tax incentives, including but not limited to:

• Federal and state clean energy and advanced nuclear incentives, with particular emphasis on investment tax credits for eligible nuclear facilities, as well as production tax credits and other project-specific programs.

• R&D tax credits, including Section 41 qualification and related Section 174 analysis and documentation.

• Manufacturing, energy, and technology-related credits.

• Transferable credits and other monetization mechanisms, including refundable programs where applicable.

• Partner closely with engineering, operations, finance, and legal teams to:

• Identify qualifying activities, assets, and expenditures.

• Establish defensible methodologies for credit calculation and allocation.

• Prepare qualitative and quantitative workpapers, audit-ready documentation, and substantiation.

• Manage external advisors supporting incentive studies, filings, credit transferability, monetization, and examinations.

• Oversee credit utilization, carryforwards, refunds, transfer proceeds, and cash-realization timing.

• Establish processes to track and report the financial impact of credits and incentives and confirm that approved benefits are fully realized.

• Establish processes to monitor ongoing incentive conditions and commitments, identify potential recapture or repayment exposure, and coordinate corrective actions with responsible teams.

Income, Partnership & Financial Reporting

• Own U.S. federal, state, and local income tax compliance and reporting, as well as international filings and planning if required by the company’s activities.

• Oversee partnership and owner-reporting matters for entities taxed as partnerships, including partnership returns, Schedule K-1s, allocations, distributions, and owner inquiries, as applicable.

• Manage amended or restated returns, administrative adjustment requests, and related owner reporting when required.

• Manage income tax provision calculations, financial statement disclosures, and related reporting in coordination with Accounting and external advisors.

• Forecast tax liabilities and cash-tax requirements and ensure appropriate assumptions are reflected in budgets, forecasts, and long-range plans.

• Support tax planning related to entity structure, state and local taxes, intercompany arrangements, transfer pricing documentation, and future growth.

• Manage income-tax audits and inquiries and ensure that material tax positions are supported by appropriate analysis, documentation, and risk-management strategies.

Sales & Use and Indirect Taxes

• Oversee sales and use tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

• Establish processes to identify nexus, exemptions, registrations, and filing requirements as the company expands.

• Partner with procurement, construction, operations, and finance teams to ensure proper tax treatment of capital expenditures, construction activities, and operating purchases.

• Manage audits, inquiries, and controversy matters related to indirect taxes.

Property and Other Operational Taxes

• Manage real and personal property tax filings, valuations, payments, and appeals.

• Coordinate with facilities, construction, finance, and operations teams to ensure accurate asset classification and reporting.

• Oversee other operational tax filings as required, including gross receipts, franchise, excise, and similar taxes.

Governance, Controls, Technology & Public-Company Readiness

• Establish scalable tax policies, procedures, documentation standards, and internal controls that support effective tax-risk management.

• Support the design, documentation, and implementation of tax-related internal controls in preparation for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance frameworks as the company matures.

• Drive the implementation and enhancement of tax technology and data solutions to automate compliance, improve accuracy, and support scale.

• Define useful performance measures for tax compliance, incentive realization, process quality, and team effectiveness.

• Coordinate with auditors and advisors to maintain audit-ready tax processes and support quarterly and annual financial reporting, including tax-related disclosures.

• Support IPO-readiness planning and preparation for public-company tax reporting and compliance requirements.

Team Leadership & External Relationships

• Operate as a hands-on functional leader while designing the long-term operating model for the tax function.

• Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing internal tax team as the company’s needs and scale warrant, including appropriate training and upskilling.

• Manage relationships with external tax advisors, service providers, auditors, and governmental agencies.

• Lead special tax projects and continuous process-improvement initiatives across the organization.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive tax experience in a combination of public accounting and/or in-house tax leadership roles, including experience leading tax functions or significant tax engagements.

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience successfully identifying, securing, and realizing benefits from federal and state tax incentives, including clean energy investment or production tax credits and R&D tax credits, with strong working knowledge of Sections 41 and 174.

• Deep knowledge of U.S. federal and state tax regimes, including partnership, state and local, and tax-accounting matters.

• Experience overseeing income, partnership, sales and use, property, and other operational tax compliance, as well as tax provisions, financial statement disclosures, forecasting, audits, and tax-risk management.

• Experience leading cross-functional tax projects involving technical, operational, financial, and legal teams.

• Ability to balance strategic planning and executive-level advising with detailed, hands-on execution.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, nuclear, or advanced-technology companies, preferred.

• Experience with investment, refundable, and/or transferable tax credit programs, preferred.

• Experience with partnership and owner reporting, transfer pricing, international tax matters, or tax-efficient transaction structuring, preferred.

• Prior involvement in mergers and acquisitions, new ventures, geographic expansion, IPO preparation, or public-company environments, preferred.

• Experience implementing tax technology or materially improving tax processes and reporting systems, preferred.

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Juris Doctor (JD), or Master of Science in Taxation (MST) strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Expert knowledge of U.S. federal and state tax regimes, including partnership, state and local, and tax-accounting matters.

• Ability to evaluate complex tax positions, identify documentation gaps, and apply professional judgment to assess and communicate tax risk.

• Ability to prioritize competing tax obligations and projects, manage deadlines, and adjust plan as business requirements change.

• Ability to develop practical solutions to complex tax issues and perform detailed, hands-on work to implement them.

• Ability to communicate complex tax concepts clearly to executives and non-tax stakeholders.

• Ability to obtain and reconcile information from technical and business stakeholders and resolve tax issues collaboratively with internal teams, external advisors, and governmental agencies.

• Ability to translate business needs into a scalable tax operating model, including staffing, external support, processes, controls, and technology.

Physical Demands

• Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting, for prolonged periods.

• Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another.

• Communicating with others to exchange information.

Environmental Conditions

• General office environment

• Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned

• High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced

Safety and PPE

• Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs

• Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions

• Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety footwear, or other PPE as required

Travel

• Some travel may be required (up to 5%)

Certification/Licensure

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license is strongly preferred.

Additional Requirements

• Occasionally requires working weekends

• Occasionally requires schedule flexibility

• Occasionally required non-standard work-week hours

• Occasionally requires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines

The salary range for this position is $209,400 to $261,700 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, the market data for your work location, and a comparison to other employees already in the role.

jobs.title: Brand Experience Designer, Consumer
jobs.description:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

Toast is expanding into the B2C market and is looking for a Brand Experience Designer to define and build the consumer-facing brand that millions of diners will come to know. This role is critical for turning a fledgling brand into one that feels distinct, trusted, and alive at every touchpoint, across product and marketing. The Brand Experience Designer will shape how the Consumer brand looks, sounds, and behaves end to end, setting the standard for how Toast shows up to guests and giving the product and growth teams a shared identity to build on.

Toast is investing in becoming a consumer innovator. We’re using our restaurant and guest data to make dining feel personal and frictionless, and with AI in the mix, we want discovery, booking, and dining to feel genuinely memorable. Our Toast Local app is only one surface. We’re adding social features, exclusive deals, and new ways to reserve and pay. A brand that guests recognize and love is how that experience becomes more than a set of features.

About the team

You’d join a small, ambitious Consumer Design team that feels and operates like a startup within a larger company. We have autonomy and the runway to reimagine dining, and we all love to roll our sleeves up and jam together. You’ll report to the Consumer Product Design leader and work shoulder to shoulder with product designers, product managers, engineers, and our marketing and growth partners.

The competition is fierce. We’re up against established brands consumers already recognize. We’re building so that consumers and restaurants thrive and form deep relationships that keep dining a core, sustainable business in our communities. With a brand still finding its shape and a nimble, driven team raring to go, this role is where the brand gets its voice.

The Consumer brand is a sibling to the Toast Core brand, not a sub-brand of it. We honor what makes Toast trusted by restaurants, and we give guests something that feels made for them. What’s shared and what’s distinct is still being decided, and this role helps decide it. If you want a brief with every answer already in it, this isn’t that role. If you want to shape the answers, it is.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

We’re looking for a Brand Experience Designer with a proven track record of building consumer brands that people recognize, remember, and feel something about. You’ll be at the heart of our consumer push, defining how Toast shows up to millions of diners and making sure every touchpoint, from a push notification to a receipt, feels like it came from the same place. You’re the type of designer who loves to lead the way but feels there’s nothing too small to dive into.

Brand Vision and Identity: You’ll evolve our Consumer brand into a complete, living identity system: visual language, voice and tone, motion, illustration, photography, and the principles that hold them together.

Brand in the Product: You’ll partner with product designers to bring the brand into the experience itself: onboarding, empty states, celebrations, loyalty moments, transitions, sound and haptics, the emotionally resonant layer on top of the functional one. The brand system is yours. The product design system is shared, and you’ll own its expressive layer (type, color, motion, illustration) so brand and UX read as one thing.

Brand in the World: You’ll set the creative direction for how the brand appears across marketing and growth: launch campaigns, paid and social, lifecycle email and push, app store, and partner moments. You’ll work with marketing, growth, and content partners to make sure the story guests hear is the one the product tells, and build the templates and toolkits that let those teams move fast.

Brand in the Restaurant: This is the surface no competitor has. Toast is already in the restaurant: on the POS, the handheld, the kiosk, the receipt, the host stand. You’ll define how the Consumer brand shows up in those physical and in-service moments, so a guest who found a restaurant in the app feels the same brand when they walk in, pay, and come back.

Craft and Execution: You lead and you make. You’ll raise the quality of the team’s work through crit, pairing, and your own output, in close partnership with other designers, writers, product teams, and engineers. You can bring a brand to life in Figma, in motion tools, or in code, and take a concept from a sketch to shipped, pixel-perfect execution.

Why join Toast’s Consumer Design team?

Transformative Purpose: This is a rare opportunity to define a consumer brand from the ground up inside a company that’s all-in on the consumer journey. You’ll work in an environment that values experimentation, collaboration, and growth, and your work will be visible, influential, and lasting as it becomes the face of how diners connect with restaurants in an entirely new way.

Unique Data Advantage: Toast knows the restaurants and the guests, and where both are. You’ll use that to make a brand that can be local, not just national: one that flexes by neighborhood, by restaurant, and by occasion without losing itself.

A Brand with Somewhere to Go: The Consumer brand is young. You’ll have the room to make decisions about what it stands for and how it shows up, with a leadership team that wants it to be bold.

How you use AI

We use these tools constantly, and we’re specific about why. We want brand work that’s better because of how you use AI: more directions explored, more variations tested, more of the unglamorous surfaces (lifecycle email, empty states, partner co-marketing) actually designed. You know where it helps and where it produces confident mush.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

• 8+ years in brand design for consumer products, with a portfolio that shows a brand you built or meaningfully evolved, applied across product and marketing, and the reasoning behind it. We’ll spend most of the interview in your work.

• You can take a brand strategy to an identity system and an identity system to shipped work, and you’ve done it inside a product design team: you understand design systems, component thinking, and how a brand lives alongside (not on top of) a great UX.

• You’ve worked inside a product design team before and understand design systems, component thinking, and how brand lives alongside (not on top of) a great UX.

• You’re expert in Figma (variables, components, and tokens), fluent in a motion tool like After Effects or Rive, and comfortable enough in code to prototype brand moments and talk tokens, transitions, and haptics with engineers.

• You love to share, learn, and lead by example as much as you love to dive into the details alongside your design, product, marketing, and engineering teammates.

• You can explain the why behind brand decisions to people who aren’t designers, and you welcome the constraints of a sibling relationship to an established company brand.

• You’re a tinkerer at heart: you make things nobody asked for just to see if they’d work.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

#LI-REMOTE

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$190,000—$304,000 USD

Zone B

$165,000—$264,000 USD

Zone C

$149,000—$238,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

jobs.title: GTM Data Specialist, Consumption & Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: USA

About the Team

Cloudflare is changing how it grows and how it measures growth and Revenue and Consumption is becoming a core Go-To-Market (GTM) metric that shapes our GTM motions.

The Consumption Transformation Team is the design engine for that change. Working closely with GTM leaders and the Developer leadership team, we help define the metric, draft and enforce the Rules of Engagement (ROE) for Consumption, build the analytics and field reporting, and support enablement, landing, and continuous improvement. We are a partnering team and aim to work cross functionally to support our internal functions successfully in a consumption business. This is a new team, so you will be building the way we work, and we expect successful candidates to use AI every day to take on more than a team this size normally could.

About the Role

You will turn the Consumption strategy into working models, trusted data, and clear answers for the field. You will design, build, and land the targeting models, build scorecards with our cross-functional partners and Data and Analytics Leader, give Geo Ops analytics they need to run their business, and be the first stop when our field teams seek clarity on our data, reporting, and use this to improve our models.

What you'll do

• Design, model, and land targets: Build and evolve our target setting model, and own the methodology. Back-test them, land them with GTM leaders, and keep improving them.

• Execute the strategy: Take direction from the Strategy Lead and turn it into working methods and recommendations, and flag early when the data says the plan should change.

• Build scorecards: Work with our DIA and GTM Analytics teams to build and maintain scorecards with cross-functional partners covering field performance, data quality, and disputes.

• Protect data integrity: Validate actuals, baselines, targets, revenue attribution, and account ownership against source systems such as BigQuery, and tie GTM Revenue back to Finance and Billing.

• Support the field and apply the Rules of Engagement: Answer field questions and cases on baselines, quotas, crediting, and ownership, applying the Rules of Engagement consistently and keeping a record of each decision. Spot where a rule needs to change, and provide the account hierarchy and ownership data teams need to collaborate across geos on our most critical customers.

• Support territory planning and partner across teams: Provide analytics to Geo Ops and central territory design so they can deliver successful territory and coverage plans with equitable distribution of opportunity and targets. Work with Finance, Billing, data engineering, IT, RevOps, and Compensation to define data needs and move manual spreadsheet work into governed data products.

• Use AI to scale the work: Use AI tools, to write and review SQL, speed up reconciliations, draft answers to common field questions, and automate recurring checks. Review every result for accuracy and follow Cloudflare policy on confidential data.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Experience: 5 or more years in sales operations, revenue operations, business analytics, target setting or territory modelling, or data operations, ideally in a usage-based or billing-driven business

• Modelling: You can build and back-test a quota or forecast model and explain its assumptions

• SQL and data: Strong SQL on large datasets (BigQuery or similar), reconciling against CRM and billing data

• Reporting: You have built scorecards or dashboards that other teams rely on

• Controls and policy mindset: You understand why accuracy, documentation, and an audit trail matter when numbers drive pay, and you can apply a written policy such as the Rules of Engagement consistently to real cases

• Communication: You explain technical answers clearly and calmly to sellers and managers, and work well with Geo Ops, Finance, Billing, data engineering, and IT

• AI fluency: You already use AI assistants and agents in your daily work for analysis, coding, and documentation, check their output against the data, and can show examples of work you made faster or better with AI

Bonus points

• Salesforce: Experience with reports, SQL, account hierarchies, and ownership rules

• Building with AI: Experience building your own automations, agents, or prompts that handle routine analysis, reporting, or support questions

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $190,000.

• For Boston, California - Remote, Connecticut - Remote, DC Metro, Massachusetts - Remote, New Jersey - Remote, New York City, NY Metro, Remote - Washington, Washington (Kirkland), and Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $132,000 - $182,000.

• For Colorado - Remote, Illinois - Remote, Maryland - Remote, Minnesota - Remote, Nevada - Remote, New York - Remote, Rhode Island - Remote, and Vermont - Remote based hires: Estimated annual base salary of $120,000 - $165,000.

CO ONLY Application Deadline: January, 17 2027

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
SECURITY ENGINEER

We want to build agents that autonomously validate code changes. Today that looks like AI that reviews pull requests in GitHub, catching bugs and enforcing standards.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers.

Own Greptile’s security posture across the product, infrastructure, and internal systems. We’re looking for a hands-on Security Engineer to conduct penetration testing, triage bug-bounty reports, remediate vulnerabilities, and harden Greptile’s infrastructure. You’ll work directly with engineers on secure product and infrastructure improvements and critical architecture decisions.


PROBLEMS WE’RE EXCITED ABOUT

 - Coding standards can be idiosyncratic and are often poorly documented; can we build agents that learn them through osmosis like a new hire might?

 - Can we identify for each customer what types of PR feedback they do and don’t care about in order to increase signal-to-noise ratio?

 - Some bugs are best caught by running the code. Can we autonomously deploy feature branches and use agents to try to break the application?

 - How do we secure a product that processes highly sensitive code across cloud, self-hosted, and air-gapped environments?


TRAJECTORY

 - 22,000+ customers

 - 5B lines of code reviewed every month

 - Scaled from $0 to eight figures in ARR

 - Raised $80M from Menlo Ventures, Benchmark, Y Combinator, and Initialized


TEAM

 - We have assembled a small, talent dense team who have scaled critical functions at companies like Stripe, Google, Figma, etc.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own Greptile’s security posture across the product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

 - Consult on risky code changes and critical architecture decisions.

 - Conduct penetration tests, fix pentest findings and patch reported vulnerabilities.

 - Manage our bug bounty program, triage incoming reports, and coordinate vulnerability response.

 - Harden Greptile’s infrastructure and internal systems. Design, implement, test, and deploy secure product and infrastructure improvements.

 - Work directly with engineers to make security part of how we build, rather than a final review step.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - B.S. Computer Science or equivalent degree, undergraduate or higher

 - 3+ years of software engineering, DevOps, or security engineering experience

 - Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript

 - Deep knowledge of application, infrastructure, and cloud security

 - Experience working on security-critical products and complex architectures

 - Strong judgment when evaluating vulnerabilities, technical tradeoffs, and risk


YOU WILL LIKE THIS ROLE IF

 - You want to work on a product that thousands of developers rely on

 - You want real ownership over the security of a fast-growing technical product

 - The chaos of high growth and things breaking is exciting to you

 - You like being in an office every day around other smart people who are excited about what they’re building

 - You love solving very hard problems.

 - You specifically prefer working in-person over working remote

jobs.title: GTM Strategy Senior Principal / Director, Consumption Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: USA

About the Team

Cloudflare is changing how it grows and how it measures growth and Revenue and Consumption is becoming a core Go-To-Market (GTM) metric that shapes our GTM motions.

The Consumption Transformation Team is the design engine for that change. Working closely with GTM leaders and the Developer leadership team, we help define the metric, draft and enforce the Rules of Engagement (ROE) for Consumption, build the analytics and field reporting, and support enablement, landing, and continuous improvement. We are a partnering team and aim to work cross functionally to support our internal functions successfully in a consumption business. This is a new team, so you will be building the way we work, and we expect successful candidates to use AI every day to take on more than a team this size normally could.

About the Role

You will lead the strategy for how Cloudflare measures, plans for, and grows Consumption across GTM, working stakeholder first with GTM leaders and the Developer leadership team. You will shape the roadmap, bring Pricing, Finance, Product, and Sales Leadership around one approach, and coordinate the program that gets the field ready for go-live and keeps it supported as the motion grows.

What you'll do

• Define the metric and roadmap: Work with GTM leaders and Developer leadership to set the Consumption metric and multi-year roadmap, and bring hard trade-offs to executives with a recommendation.

• Target methodology: Set the central methodology for Consumption targets. Partner with Geo Ops and central territory design, who own territory carving, so opportunity, targets, and support, are distributed equitably. Help connect targets and coverage to the annual capacity plan, including hiring and ramp time for new sellers.

• Shape the Rules of Engagement: Work with RevOps and GTM leaders to draft Consumption policy on account ownership, crediting, and cross-geo allocation, set the standard for enforcing it, and help teams across geos collaborate on our most critical customers so credit and ownership are clear.

• Ready new motions: Partner with Pricing, Deal Desk, and the Developer Platform team so consumption led motions are ready for the field before they scale.

• Coordinate the program: Coordinate the integrated plan, go-live readiness, and cross-functional cadence. Help clear blockers across GTM, Product, Finance, and IT, and report plainly on program health.

• Land the metric and enable the field: Work with GTM leaders and Developer leadership on enablement and onboarding, coordinate how Consumption changes the work of sellers and support roles, and lead continuous improvement after launch.

• Lead the Specialist and use AI: Set priorities for the Data and Operations Specialist, and use AI tools and agents, to take on program reporting, analysis, and recurring updates.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Experience: 12 or more years in GTM strategy, sales strategy, revenue operations, sales planning, or sales transformation, ideally at a cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, or other usage-based business

• Program leadership: A record of running complex, multi-team programs and launching new metrics, processes, or tools to a large sales organization

• Planning depth: Prior experience in territory design, quota setting, capacity planning, and forecasting, including hiring and ramp assumptions

• Policy judgment: Experience drafting and enforcing sales policy such as account ownership, crediting, or rules of engagement, including resolving cross-geo disputes

• Consumption fluency: You understand how usage ramps, commits, overages, and PAYGO differ from subscription bookings

• Stakeholder partnership: You work stakeholder first: you weigh options, explain trade-offs plainly, and align senior leaders across Sales, Finance, Product, Developer, and Pricing teams without direct authority

• AI fluency: You already use AI assistants and agents in your daily work, check what they produce, and can show examples of work you made faster or better with AI

• Comfort with ambiguity: You can build structure where little exists and keep moving while decisions are still being made

Bonus points

• Developer-led growth: Experience supporting developer platforms or self-serve to sales-assisted motions

• Building with AI: Experience building your own automations, agents, or prompts that save a team real time

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

jobs.title: Mission Control Specialist
jobs.description:
Mission Summary:

The Mission Control Specialist supports real-time autonomous vehicle (AV) operations by monitoring fleet activity, coordinating operational workflows, and assisting with non-nominal event response across live driverless operations. Reporting to the Mission Control Manager, this role serves as a frontline operational support function responsible for maintaining situational awareness, escalating operational concerns, and supporting safe, efficient fleet performance. This position plays a critical role in day-to-day command center execution by monitoring operational systems, coordinating field support requests, documenting incidents, and facilitating communication between operational teams. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, calm communication, operational discipline, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Real-Time Fleet Monitoring & Operational Support:

• Monitor live fleet dashboards, telemetry, and operational systems to identify anomalies, service impacts, or degraded vehicle states.

• Escalate operational concerns, safety risks, and non-nominal events to Mission Control leadership following established procedures.

• Support real-time operational coordination activities to maintain fleet continuity and service reliability.

Operational Design Domain (ODD) Support:

• Monitor environmental and operational conditions including weather, road closures, construction, and major events impacting service.

• Execute approved operational changes including PuDo restrictions, routing updates, and map-related workflows.

• Document and escalate recurring operational or mapping issues impacting fleet performance.

Incident & Non-Nominal Event Support:

• Assist with triage, tracking, and coordination of non-nominal vehicle events and operational disruptions.

• Maintain accurate incident documentation, communication logs, and escalation records during active events.

• Coordinate with field teams, towing providers, or internal stakeholders under direction from Mission Control leadership.

Field Support & Dispatch Coordination:

• Dispatch field support resources, including On-Road Response Specialists (ORS) and third-party providers, based on established workflows.

• Track response times, support ticket status, and field activity updates.

• Support operational readiness activities tied to launches, expansions, and special events.

First Responder & External Agency Coordination Support:

• Support communication and coordination efforts with first responders and external agencies during operational events.

• Maintain professional communication during field interactions and incident coordination activities.

• Assist with scheduling, logistics, and preparation for first responder engagement activities or training sessions.

Map & Operational Readiness Support:

• Review operational readiness checklists and support validation of map restrictions and fleet availability.

• Assist with daily operational startup and readiness verification activities.

• Escalate identified routing, mapping, or operational discrepancies to leadership teams.

Training & Documentation Support:

• Support development and maintenance of operational procedures, quick-reference guides, and training documentation.

• Assist with tabletop exercises, operational drills, and readiness activities.

• Ensure operational logs, trackers, and incident documentation remain current and accurate.

Cross-Functional Coordination:

• Facilitate communication between Mission Control, Remote Vehicle Assistance (RVA), Fleet Operations, Safety, and Engineering teams during live operations.

• Provide timely operational updates and status reporting during ongoing incidents or service impacts.

• Support structured handoffs and shift transition communication between operational teams.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence:

• Identify recurring operational issues and escalate trends to leadership for review.

• Support process improvement initiatives, operational reporting, and workflow optimization efforts.

• Contribute feedback to improve operational procedures, tooling, and command center efficiency.

What We’re Looking For:

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Operations, Logistics, Emergency Management, Public Safety, Transportation, Business, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.

• 1–4+ years of experience in operations support, dispatch, logistics coordination, command center operations, customer operations, fleet operations, emergency communications, or related environments.

• Ability to remain calm and organized in fast-paced or high-pressure operational environments.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured operational processes and escalation procedures.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to monitor multiple operational systems and prioritize tasks in real time.

• Experience working with dashboards, operational tools, ticketing systems, or live monitoring platforms.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multiple operational teams.

• Ability to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Bonus Points (not required):

• Experience supporting autonomous vehicle operations, mobility platforms, or transportation operations.

• Familiarity with dispatch coordination, incident tracking, or field support operations.

• Exposure to emergency response, public safety coordination, or command center environments.

• Experience with mapping tools, geospatial systems, or routing platforms.

• Interest in operational process improvement, technology, or automation.

Physical Demands & Working Environment:

• Primarily office and command-center-based environment with occasional field coordination activities.

• Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while monitoring operational systems and dashboards.

• Operate standard office equipment and computer-based operational tools.

• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

#LI-CH1

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. Salary Range

$67,000—$85,000 USD

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit  www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
