jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Veza
jobs.description:
What you'll do

Identity

• Own the identity model for workloads and agents: SPIFFE/SPIRE trust domains, workload attestation, and how identities are issued, scoped, rotated, and revoked.
• Architect ephemeral authentication and authorization end to end: short-lived credential issuance, token exchange and delegation (for example RFC 8693-style flows), and revocation that takes effect in practice.
• Define runtime authorization for agents: what an agent can access, under whose delegated authority, with what guardrails, and with audit trails that hold up to review.
• Lead the identity architecture for the Agent Security roadmap, including Runtime Authorization, the Access Policy Engine, and AgentID with short-lived credentials, and its integration with the NHI program.
• Set the identity standards for non-human identities across Veza’s integrations, covering how connectors authenticate, get scoped, and rotate secrets.

Core architecture

• Define identity contracts that the graph, data model, and integrations architects build against, and review designs in those areas for identity correctness.
• Shape how identity fits into the Veza-ServiceNow integration model, including shared identity and data contracts and UI surfacing patterns.
• Partner with the integrations, graph, and deployment owners on decisions that touch identity, without taking over their domains.

Leadership

• Represent Veza’s identity architecture to customers, partners, ServiceNow Security leadership, and standards bodies.
• Mentor engineers

What you bring

• 12+ years in security or identity engineering, with a substantial share spent designing identity systems in production at scale.
• Strong background in identity and access: IGA, IAM, PAM, authorization models, access reviews, lifecycle management, or adjacent security domains.
• Deep hands-on expertise in workload identity, specifically SPIFFE/SPIRE or an equivalent, and in ephemeral credential design. You can explain trust bootstrapping and rotation failure modes without notes.
• Strong grounding in OAuth 2.x, OIDC, token exchange, and authorization models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC, and policy engines such as OPA or Cedar).
• Understanding of non-human identity (service accounts, secrets, API keys, workload identity) and emerging agent identity and authorization models.
• Experience building security products that meet their own security and compliance bar (SOC 2, FedRAMP or equivalent, data residency).
• Experience delivering production AI or agentic systems, including evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
• Active use of AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent).
• Strong Python or Go, with the ability to go deep in code and design reviews.
• Executive-level communication, with the ability to defend an identity decision to engineers, customers, and security leadership.
• Breadth to hold your own on graph data models, integration architecture, and multi-region deployment, even if you don’t own them.

Preferred

• Experience through an acquisition or platform integration, aligning an acquired architecture with a parent platform.
• Experience with integration-heavy platforms and the authentication and secrets challenges they bring.
• Familiarity with graph databases or immutable or event-sourced storage models.
• Authored or shaped identity standards or RFCs.
• Built or operated a production credential broker or identity provider.
• BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Success in the first 12 months

• A published identity architecture for workload and agent access, with committed milestones.
• A defined, adopted model for ephemeral credentials across Veza’s services and integrations.
• A runtime authorization design for agents that Product and Sales can take to customers.
• Identity contracts agreed with the graph, integrations, and deployment owners.

jobs.description:
Optical Engineer Co-Op

The Hardware Engineering Group at QuEra Computing is seeking strong candidates for an Optical Engineering Co-Op to serve as an individual contributor to the company’s mission of building state-of-the-art, manufacturable, and deployable neutral atom quantum computers. The Hardware Engineering Group plays a crucial role in accelerating the company’s technology leadership and translating the company’s scientific breakthroughs into products delivered to customers. To accomplish this mission, we are looking to hire a candidate with an undergraduate or graduate-level education in optics, optical engineering, or applied physics, paired with hands-on experience designing, building, and testing optical systems. The ideal candidate will combine a solid fundamental understanding of optics with strong laboratory skills and a desire to grow as an engineer within an enterprise engineering environment.

Key Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate with senior engineers and physicists to design, build, and test optical sub-systems, modules, and components supporting QuEra’s neutral atom computers through the full development lifecycle (R&D, productization, maintenance, and beyond).

• Execute hands-on laboratory work—assembly, alignment, cleaning, and characterization of optical systems—and contribute to engineering documentation, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Coordinate with the R&D/science team to support cutting-edge R&D and help translate scientific advances into the next generation of products.

• Assist with troubleshooting technical issues at company headquarters and, as needed, support off-site installations at customer locations (in coordination with the local support team).

Qualifications

• Work towards M.S. or PhD in optics, optical engineering, applied physics, or a closely related field (M.S. preferred).

• Experience designing, building, or testing optical and opto-mechanical systems in a non-academic (industry, national lab, FFRDC or similar) environment with enterprise engineering practices.

• Strong system-level design skills including Zemax simulation skills and CAD design skills (e.g. Inventor, Solidworks)

• Working knowledge in several of the areas of

• Free-space optics

• Fiber optics

• Modulators

• Electro-optics

• Lasers

• Optical system characterization and testing

• Strong hands-on laboratory skills (e.g. assembly, alignment, cleaning, testing)

• Experience contributing to the design of scientific instruments and apparatuses, or to bringing optical systems from concept to production.

• Excellent attention to detail, communication, and documentation skills

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As a Partner Operations Manager, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value banking and fintech partners on Wise Platform — driving continuous improvement in how payment solutions are delivered, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.

That breaks into two parts:

• Owning the operational strategy: You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio — continuously improving how payment solutions are delivered, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the strategic relationship).
• Executing cross-functionally: You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with Wise operational teams plus product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.

You will be owning Wise Platform partner volume retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners receive the most value from our product, operationally stable and ready to grow. You will also work with other functions, including product management, tech, legal, compliance, implementation and business development.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Co-own revenue retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners - leading operational initiatives with internal teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out operations for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution - ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
• Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimizing churn.
• Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximize the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
• Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
• Optimize internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organizations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
• Analyze the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.

• At least 2+ years in operations and experience working with enterprise clients or large companies.
• Experience driving projects to improve operational success metrics and SLAs and achieve tangible measurable results for clients.
• Strong problem-solving capabilities, you can identify the root cause of issues identified and can work with cross-functional teams to resolve them so the issues do not occur again.
• Data-driven decision-maker with the ability to collect, analyse, and interpret large datasets to prioritise operational improvements and measure success.
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the experience influencing C-level executives and working cross-functionally with internal teams (e.g., Product, Compliance, and Engineering) to deliver outcomes.
• Technical fluency – you understand APIs, webhooks, and system integrations. While you won’t be coding, you’ll work closely with engineers and be comfortable discussing technical solutions with partners.
• Exceptional communication skills – you can explain complex technical and operational concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Autonomous and adaptable – you’re comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities effectively.
• You must have examples of how you have unblocked solutions with product and engineering teams by articulating data, examples how you have overcome pushback

Nice to have:

• Payments/banking experience
• Comprehensive understanding of Correspondent banking product and solutions
• Have experience working directly with Tier 1 or Tier 2 banks or large fintechs in an enterprise environment.
• Are familiar with regulatory frameworks (e.g., AML, KYC, PSD2) affecting cross-border payments and banking operations.
• Have led technical onboarding or implementation projects for complex payment systems.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Observe by Snowflake
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built natively on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. Its Telemetry Lakehouse Foundation enables organizations to ingest, retain, and analyze massive volumes of telemetry more economically than traditional observability platforms while keeping data reusable across analytics and AI through open table formats such as Apache Iceberg. Its Observability Context Graph captures relationships across services, infrastructure, logs, metrics, and traces, providing the semantic context needed to reason about complex systems. A programmable AI SRE automates investigation workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate incident resolution.

Trusted by engineering teams at organizations including Capital One, HPE, and Breeze Airways, Observe ingests and analyzes hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining enterprise-scale reliability. Observe joined Snowflake through its acquisition in February 2026.

The Infrastructure team at Observe by Snowflake is responsible for architecting, scaling, and operating the development and production environments that power our observability platform. We are a small, highly collaborative team with broad scope and high ownership, focused on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure while continuously evolving the systems that support our engineers and customers.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping our infrastructure strategy, driving architectural decisions, and elevating operational excellence across the organization. Examples of the work you'd take on include launching single-tenant and multi-tenant environments for new customers on tight timelines, migrating our Kubernetes ingress from Ingress-NGINX to Envoy and the Gateway API, shifting our release process from script-driven lockstep weekly deploys to GitOps with ArgoCD, and building repeatable processes for infrastructure upgrades, refreshes, and migrations across the fleet.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the design, build, and operation of scalable, secure AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure across shared and dedicated customer environments, supporting a high-scale observability platform.

 - Help integrate Observe's infrastructure into Snowflake's platforms, including CI, source control, and container platform migrations, bridging startup-era systems with enterprise-grade standards.

 - Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and platform automation, moving our delivery pipeline toward GitOps and independent, safe service deployments.

 - Partner with the Security team to improve access controls, secrets management, and the security posture of production environments, enabling other teams (including AI and automation initiatives) to move fast without compromising security or maintainability.

 - Design and implement infrastructure patterns that ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and operational resilience.

 - Participate in the infrastructure on-call rotation and play a key role in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements that drive systemic reliability enhancements.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to ensure infrastructure strategy supports long-term platform evolution.

 - Take ownership of ambiguous projects from scoping through delivery, and help onboard and mentor newer engineers on a growing team through design and code reviews.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or related roles.

 - Demonstrated experience designing and operating production systems at scale, with deep ownership of reliability and operational excellence.

 - Strong experience with Kubernetes, including architectural decision-making and operational tuning.

 - Hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar) and GitOps tooling (ArgoCD or similar), with a focus on scalable system design.

 - Experience with least-privilege IAM, secrets management, and securing production access.

 - Strong programming skills in Go, Python, or similar languages, with a track record of building automation and infrastructure systems.

 - Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives and influencing infrastructure best practices.

 - Ability to balance immediate operational demands with long-term architectural vision.

 - Comfortable saying no or "not yet" with a clear rationale, and prioritizing ruthlessly when inbound demand exceeds capacity.

 - Track record of thoughtfully applying AI tooling to infrastructure automation while keeping production changes safe and reviewable.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience leading large migrations (CI systems, version control, deployment platforms).

 - Experience with post-acquisition or platform-consolidation work.

 - Familiarity with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or monitoring infrastructure.

 - Experience building or evolving internal developer platforms.

 - Experience working in high-growth, rapidly evolving engineering environments.



Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is in the business of creating fun games we want to play and building the art and tools we need to bring those games to life. We provide our engine technology to developers around the world and consistently strive to stay on the cutting edge of our industry. We iterate to improve everything, every day: our games, our technology, our processes, even our workspaces and people. This unrelenting focus on innovation and quality defines us.

Our QA Engineers work with product owners, developers, and QA management to define acceptance criteria, identify risks, and plan testing coverage for upcoming features and releases. QA Engineers develop and implement automation utilizing technical tooling, including Al, to expand QA coverage across multiple features. You will facilitate functional, qualitative, and performance testing efforts while using a mix of technical testing skills across your product space to analyze and report on quality. At the senior level the expectation is to be able to work in a highly autonomous environment within the gameplay pillar while regularly keeping stakeholders informed of potential quality risks.

In this role, you will

• Work with QA analysts, QA management, product owners, and other developers to define acceptance criteria, identify risks, plan test coverage, and, crucially, build tooling and automation to improve efficiency across the team

• Examine technical gaps and automation initiatives to ensure quality for both Unreal Engine and Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) developer tools and build

• Build and drive test strategies and test plans to cover multiple features in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• Use a mix of technical and manual QA skills to execute a variety of testing techniques across the product to analyze quality while discovering or troubleshooting reported defects and internal issues

• Leverage Al-assisted tools to speed up test plan, automation, and strategy where possible

• Report and track data quality and use that data to drive conversations around product quality and development health, supporting the dev team before, during, and after deployments

• Test communications between the client and backend services

What we're looking for

• Strong experience and demonstrated skills in writing test automation or QA tools, as well as reading code or scripts in multiple languages (C++/C#/Python)

• Experience developing test plans and risk mitigation strategies

• Experience using Al tools and judgement about when their output can be trusted

• QA cross team project or feature leadership, including mentoring more junior employees, providing cross team QA plans, and owning test quality improvements - gap analysis or optimization efforts

• QA Engineer skills & strengths at a senior level, which includes, strong communication skills and ability to confidently collaborate with stakeholders and with partner teams, the ability to provide mentorship and lead projects, and deliver high quality work products; looks for and suggests ways to improve / optimize/close testing gaps

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including WA).

Pay Transparency Information

Each base pay range is relevant only for individuals who are residents of or will be expected to work within the specified locale. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors, which include (but aren’t limited to) things such as skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and experience. In addition to base pay, most employees are eligible to participate in Epic’s generous benefit plans and discretionary incentive programs (subject to the terms of those plans or programs).

Washington Base Pay Range

$89,107—$130,690 USD

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

jobs.title: Associate Manager, New Verticals - Consumer GTM

jobs.description:
About the Team

The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce by expanding DoorDash beyond restaurants. We help customers get the groceries, convenience items, alcohol, retail, and other essentials they need, when they need them.

The Consumer Growth team sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, product, and marketing. We identify the biggest opportunities to grow New Verticals, develop the strategies to pursue them, and bring them to life through customer-facing launches, campaigns, and product experiences.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Associate Manager to lead Consumer Growth GTM strategy for New Verticals. This person will shape how we bring priority merchants, categories, and customer behaviors to market, with a focus on bringing structure to a high volume of GTM opportunities and helping teams prioritize and execute them efficiently.

You will own the business strategy behind major growth moments: defining the customer opportunity, sizing the potential, recommending where to invest, setting goals, and translating insights into clear GTM plans. You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Business Development to ensure our plans are both strategically sound and operationally executable.

This is a highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable digging into data, developing a point of view, and driving alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders. You will manage a portfolio of initiatives with varying levels of complexity and make clear recommendations about where DoorDash should focus its limited resources for the greatest customer and business impact.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own Consumer Growth GTM strategy. Lead strategy development for priority New Verticals growth moments, including merchant launches, category expansion, seasonal occasions, affordability initiatives, and product launches. Define the customer problem, business opportunity, target audience, value proposition, and path to impact.

• Set investment and customer strategy. Develop frameworks to prioritize GTM investments and determine the right level of support across initiatives. Create scalable playbooks for customer targeting, including audience strategy, targeting principles, and measurement approaches.

• Turn data into action. Build analyses and models using SQL and Excel to assess customer behavior, business performance, incrementality, and return on investment. Develop test-and-learn plans and translate results into clear recommendations for what we should do next.

• Lead cross-functional execution. Partner with Integrated Marketing, CRM, Paid Media, Creative, Product, Analytics, Finance, Partnerships, and Operations to bring strategies to market. Align teams on goals, audiences, measurement, timelines, risks, and decisions.

• Build the operating system for GTM. Bring rigor and structure to a high volume of growth opportunities. jobs.title: Sr. Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

Location: NAMER/EMEA 

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

Zapier is on a mission to democratize automation while protecting the security and privacy of millions of users worldwide. We safeguard sensitive data and build trust through robust security measures that enable our teams to move fast, safely.

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer to help maintain and raise the security bar across our production environments. In this role, you’ll contribute to designing and operating secure infrastructure, collaborating closely with senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined initiatives. This role is ideal for someone with a strong infrastructure security foundation who’s ready to grow in a high-impact, remote-first environment.

 


ABOUT YOU

 - You know how to secure the cloud: You have hands-on experience securing SaaS products and maintaining compliance with frameworks like SOC2,HIPAA/HITRUST, AWS FTR, or ISO 27001

 - You have an understanding of modern cloud technology components and deployment patterns: Proficient with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), AWS, Kubernetes, and Python, Go or JavaScript. Experience with security tools like a CSPM (Wiz), vulnerability scanners, and lifecycle management solutions.

 - You take data governance infrastructure seriously: Whether it’s via database column tagging, leveraging inline data sanitization, or some combination, you’re familiar with securing data as it moves betweens systems.

 - Security Mindset: You understand modern deployment patterns (isolated VMs, k8s, serverless) and can identify and mitigate common cloud security risks.

 - Collaborative Approach: You work well with senior engineers, platform teams, and other security specialists, and you’re comfortable asking questions, reviewing code & design, sharing ideas, and learning from others.

 - Remote-Ready: You excel in asynchronous communication and self-manage effectively in a fully remote, distributed team.

 - Adaptable: You’ve experienced the fast pace of a growing company and can adjust processes and tools to fit evolving needs.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Identify & Mitigate Risks: Spot and address security gaps in infrastructure to improve resilience and reduce risk.

 - Harden Infrastructure: Apply secure-by-default designs across data, endpoints, tools, and processes.

 - Build Scalable Processes: Collaborate on paved-path tooling and processes that enforce least-privilege access while enabling engineering velocity.

 - Develop & Audit IaC: Improve Terraform configurations for security, scalability, and reliability.

 - Triage Fleet Security Posture: Operate and maintain tools that detect and track misconfigurations and vulnerabilities; ensure timely patching and mitigation.

 - Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Platform, Engineering, and other Security teams to provide guidance and ad hoc support.

 - Incident handling: Active understanding and exercise of incident handling execution (detect, contain, remediate, prevent) with systems-level thinking and ability to separate noise from signals.

 


WHAT WE’RE WORKING ON

 - Data Governance: Working with our data engineering team to improve data access controls.

 - CI/CD Security: Improving CI least-privilege access, branch protections, and publishing controls.

 - Security Automation: Expanding automated guardrails for developers to ship securely and quickly.

 - Secure Access: Building paths that enable our engineers to interface with the cloud while enforcing least-privilege and audited access.

 - Kubernetes Image Hardening & IaC Standardization: Creating and deploying consistent, secure Docker images and Terraform modules.

 


WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE

You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven security team where your work directly protects millions of users. You’ll have the autonomy to drive improvements while learning from seasoned security professionals, and you’ll do it all in a remote-first, flexible environment that values results over hours logged.


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

About the Role

K Health is seeking a sharp, highly motivated full-cycle Talent Acquisition Recruiter to serve as the engine for our growth. In this impact-driven role, you will identify, engage, and attract top-tier talent across both technical and business domains. You will be the first point of contact for prospective candidates, playing a crucial role in shaping our employer brand and ensuring our pipelines are diverse, highly qualified, and aligned with K Health's mission and fast-paced culture.

This role requires onsite presence in our New York City office 4 days a week and does not provide immigration support.

What you will do

• Proactively source passive candidates for a variety of tech and business roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, research, sourcing tools and platforms, and other creative search strategies.

• Craft compelling, personalized outreach campaigns that effectively communicate K Health’s value proposition and yield high response rates.

• Conduct initial phone screens to evaluate baseline qualifications, candidate motivations, and alignment with our core values.

• Build and maintain a robust pipeline of talent for both active requisitions and strategic future hiring needs.

• Partner closely with the Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers to calibrate on profiles and refine sourcing strategies based on market feedback.

• Maintain accurate, real-time data and candidate tracking within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

What we are looking for

• Experience: 3+ years of sourcing and full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally within a high-growth startup, tech, or agency environment.

• Versatility: Proven track record of successfully sourcing both complex technical profiles and strategic business roles.

• Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in utilizing modern sourcing tools, ATS platforms (i.e., Greenhouse), Boolean and talent market analytics.

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for authentic, engaging candidate outreach and engagement from first touch to close.

• Coordination: Coordinate approvals, kickoffs, interview schedules, debriefs, offers, and close in partnership with appropriate personnel.

• Work Style: Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing multiple pipelines simultaneously.

Bonus

• Prior recruiting experience in tech, digital health, or health-tech sector.

• An established, active network of tech and business professionals.

• Experience with advanced sourcing techniques (e.g., open-source scraping, highly targeted networking events).

• Leveraging and using AI and LLM’s to automate and improve processes.

Benefits & Perks:  #LI-Hybrid

• Monday to Thursday onsite work schedule with Fridays remote

• Weekly lunches (Mon, Tues, and Thurs) and stocked kitchen with healthy snacks and beverages

• 18 vacation days, 9 company holidays, 5 sick days, and 2 personal days

• Stock options for every full-time employee

• Paid parental leave

• 401k benefit

• Commuter Benefits

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options

Compensation:

$100,000—$130,000 USD

Who We Are:

Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability.

We’re founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by over $443.5M from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners.

We offer competitive compensation packages based on industry benchmarks for function, level, and geographic location. Offer amounts are determined by multiple factors such as a candidate's experience and expertise.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, citizenship, military or veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. We’re deeply committed to building teams as diverse as the patients we serve and strive to cultivate an environment where everyone can bring their most authentic self to work. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.

We are committed to maintaining the integrity of our hiring process and ensuring a safe environment for all candidates. All communication for job offers from K Health will come from email addresses ending in @khealth.com. K Health will never ask you to provide financial information about yourself during the recruitment process. We will never use personal email accounts or other domains for official correspondence. Our official job postings are only listed on our official website and reputable job boards. jobs.title: Mine Remediation Lead
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Mine Remediation Lead to be based out of any of our locations in the western United States (AZ, CA, CO, MT, NM, NV, OR, UT). This is a full-time role.

This is an exciting growth focused opportunity to build and lead a Mine remediation group. The person in this position will support business development, project execution and have the ability to grow and lead a Mine Remediation practice.  We are seeking a leader with major project delivery experience and proven ability to build and lead technical teams in implementing Mine remediation projects. Preferential consideration will be given to experience under the CERCLA Program and strong regulatory connections.

As an experienced professional in Mine remediation, you will bring specific technical expertise, sophisticated regulatory understanding, leadership skills, and an entrepreneurial spirit along with a keen interest in evolving and growing the business and mentoring staff. Your demonstrated commitment to safety along with a strong operational understanding of safety risks in mining environments, and ability to mentor employees to support a safe work culture will supplement AECOM’s existing safety culture.

Responsibilities will include:

• Working closely with AECOM personnel in United States and Internationally to develop and implement Mine remedial solutions for clients in the public and private sector that meet regulatory requirements and protect human health and the environment.
• Identifying growth opportunities, advising on growth strategies and hiring to expand the mine remediation practice.
• Collaboration with, and coordination of, diverse technical teams including hydrologists, hydrogeologists, geochemists, risk assessors, environmental engineers, geotechnical engineers, civil engineers, water treatment specialists, biologists, revegetation, costing specialists, etc. to develop remedial solutions that meet technical and regulatory requirements.
• Reviewing technical work plans and cost estimates; interpreting data; conducting remediation/closure technology evaluations and feasibility studies.
• Technical and financial management of projects to meet commitments on budget, quality and schedule.
• Development of proposals, project teams and cost estimates.
• Delivery of projects, and technical review of reports for regulatory submission (e.g., studies, remediation and closure plans, permit applications, management plans).
• Periodically attending site visits to proposed, operating or closed mines in support of client relationship building, proposal development and project delivery.
• Business-development activities, including building and maintaining existing and new client relationships, tracking marketing leads and project opportunities, developing proposals and presentations, networking, attending conferences and sharing AECOM’s capabilities with existing and potential clients.
• Stakeholder communications, including regulatory communications and client advocacy

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in relevant engineering (Civil, Geotechnical, Environmental etc.) or science (geology, hydrogeology, environmental etc.) disciplines +10 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 2 years of leadership
• Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree or 20+ years of experience
• People management experience
• Experience managing complex environmental consulting or Engineering, Procurement, and Construction Management (EPCM) projects
• Experience with remediation under CERCLA and RCRA frameworks
• Proficient technical writing experience for investigation and design reports and regulatory document submissions
• Proficient proposals preparation and cost development experience for Mine remediation projects

jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About Axon 911

Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.

911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

Please note: This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of four days per week in our Manhattan office. Relocation assistance is available for candidates currently based in the U.S. and authorized to work for a U.S. employer.

The Role

As a Technical Recruiter, you’ll own the full recruiting cycle for technical roles across Axon 911, partnering closely with engineering and product leaders to build high-performing teams. You’ll run a high-touch, data-informed process, from intake through offer acceptance, and give every candidate a great experience whether or not they get an offer.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. jobs.title: Associate Designer - Women's
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Fashion Nova is the world’s leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.

Founder & CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online– powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.

Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!

The brand’s name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.

ROLE OVERVIEW

In this Associate Designer role, you’ll support our women’s line across assigned product categories—contributing to design execution, technical detailing, and line maintenance from initial concept to market. Joining a fast-paced, creative team, you will bring an innovative, detail-oriented, and adaptable approach to design that aligns seamlessly with our brand’s aesthetic.

In this role, you will assist in translating creative ideas into actionable design assets, collaborate with fellow designers during ideation, and partner with the Product Development and Technical Design teams to execute timely, high-quality garments. You will support cross-functional partners in fit sessions and line management, working closely with merchandising to understand customer needs and support product success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Trend & Market Research: Stay informed on emerging trends, new techniques, fabrics, and industry innovations to bring fresh ideas to the team.

• Design Execution: Design brand-appropriate fashion in alignment with seasonal concepts, creative directives, and existing product lines under the direction of senior design leadership.

• Sketching & CADs: Hand-sketch design concepts and create detailed, accurate technical sketches and CADs for assigned categories.

• Line Sheet & Sample Tracking: Assist in managing and maintaining updated line sheets, sample tracking, and seasonal design documentation for the team.

• Product Development Support: Collaborate with Product Development on developments, fabric sourcing, trim callouts, and garment details.

• Fittings & Technical Design: Participate in fit sessions alongside Senior Designers and Technical Design from prototype to approval, taking detailed notes and supporting tech pack creation.

• Pre-Production Follow-Up: Track and follow up on all design details (lab dips, fabric swatches, trims) to ensure consistency with approved brand direction.

• Calendar Alignment: Manage daily tasks within the brand calendar to ensure all key deadlines and milestones are met.

• Presentations & Board Preparation: Assist in preparing clear, compelling presentation decks, trend boards, and digital mock-ups for creative reviews and meetings.

• Process Optimization: Proactively support workflow efficiency and maintain an organized design workspace and digital asset library

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• Experience: 3–5 years of fashion design experience within a fast-paced, trend-driven apparel environment.

• Technical Skills: Strong hand-sketching abilities and proficiency in creating technical CADs.

• Software Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) and Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.

• Market Knowledge: Creative mindset with a keen eye for fashion trends, color, fabric, and inclusive design.

• Detail-Oriented & Organized: Exceptional organizational skills with precise attention to detail in technical specs and line sheets.

• Collaboration & Attitude: High team spirit, adaptable, and solutions-oriented with an "all-hands-on-deck" mentality.

• Communication: Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; comfortable presenting design concepts in team settings.

• Discretion: Ability to handle confidential design and business information with discretion.

• Education: BFA or BA Degree in Fashion Design (or equivalent experience).

• Languages: English fluency; additional language skills are a plus.

• Schedule & Location: Monday – Friday | Core business hours | Onsite in Beverly Hills

BENEFITS

• NEW state-of-the-art HQ upcoming in Beverly Hills!

• Formalized career paths for continued professional growth

• Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Comprehensive health insurance across Medical, Dental and Vision

• 401k match, with immediate vesting upon eligibility

• Weekly catered lunches & fully-stock kitchen pantry

• Opportunities to travel for trade shows and vendor meetings

• Summer Fridays Early Departure

• Team bonding events and programs

• Attractive employee discounts!

We will continue to recruit, hire, train, and advance in employment qualified individuals in all job titles without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, status as a protected veteran, criminal history, or status as an individual with a disability; and shall not discriminate against any individual, any such characteristic, nor any other classification protected by local, state and|or federal law.

jobs.title: Junior School Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Dynamis, Inc. is seeking a Junior School Compliance Analyst to support the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP) School Certification Unit (SCU) on the Adjudication and Compliance Support (ACS) contract. As a member of the SCU Intake Team, the analyst will review and verify the evidence schools submit with initial, update, and recertification Form I-17 petitions, file or cancel petitions within required timeframes, verify school fee payments, and provide analytical and administrative support to SCU Federal adjudicators. The role works on-site with structured training and quality control review from Team Leads.

Responsibilities:

• Review incoming school documents and evidence for initial, update, and recertification Form I-17 petitions in SEVIS and the Consolidated School Management (CSM) application to confirm submissions meet SEVP evidence requirements

• File or cancel petitions within two days of submission, prioritizing recertifications, and issue Notices of Confirmation of Filing, Notices of Rejection with corrective guidance, and Requests for Payment as appropriate

• Process locked petition requests (LPRqs), PDSO/DSO updates, and simple updates; record DSO updates in the Federal vetting background tracker and LPRqs in the Federal tracker for adjudicator action

• Handle, upload, and tag supporting evidence, and maintain records according to SEVIS, ICE, DHS, and National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) requirements

• Verify incoming school fee payments from pay.gov, link payments to schools, and coordinate with the SEVP Fee Management Section to maintain the monthly log of payments, unverified entries, overpayments, and refund requests

• Schedule SCU site visits in coordination with the Field Representative Unit (FRU), notify SCU Federal staff of any delays or cancellations, and scan, upload, and report site visit results within two business days of the visit

• Monitor and help respond to SIMA tickets and SCU mailboxes (School Certification, Initial, Update, Recertification, and Form I-17) using pre-approved language, escalating inquiries that require Federal approval

• Provide analytical support to SCU adjudication planning and operations, including petition queue and turnaround metrics for the Weekly Status Report (due Fridays by 10:00 AM ET) and Monthly Status Report

• Record meeting minutes for SCU meetings with SEVP leadership and deliver them within two business days

• Participate in the Intake Team’s quality control process, incorporating Team Lead feedback until cleared to file or cancel petitions independently

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in Public Administration, Business, Criminal Justice, International Relations, Education, or a related field

• Minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in document review, regulatory compliance, case processing, adjudication support, or analytical work

• Ability to conduct detailed research and analysis of technical data, including verifying documentary evidence against established requirements with keen attention to detail

• Ability to read and interpret policy, regulations, and directives

• Experience developing reports and dashboards

• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

• Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, including clear written correspondence to school officials

• U.S. citizenship and residence in the United States or its Territories for at least three of the last five years; must be able to obtain and maintain a favorable ICE background investigation and fitness determination

• Ability to work on-site in Tysons Corner, VA during core business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday)

• Ability to safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and to manage a high-volume queue against firm turnaround deadlines

Preferred:

• Competency in using the Student and Exchange Visitor Information System (SEVIS)

• Familiarity with SEVP school certification regulations (e.g., 8 CFR 214.3, including recordkeeping and advertising requirements; 8 CFR 214.4; and 8 CFR 214.2(f) and (m))

• Experience with the Form I-17 school certification process or prior work as a PDSO/DSO or in an international student services office

• Exposure to the Dynamics 365 Consolidated School Management (CSM) application, SIMA, or pay.gov

• A current, favorably adjudicated federal background investigation (Public Trust or higher) that ICE can accept through reciprocity

• Experience with Excel or Tableau for tracking queues, fee logs, and performance metrics

• Prior experience supporting DHS, ICE, or another federal adjudication or case processing mission

Salary range: $40,000-50,000

The salary range for this position represents the anticipated hiring range. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and potential contract funding.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Assistant
jobs.description:
ABOUT PHOENIX


Founded in 2019, Phoenix is building the most trusted telehealth platform in Canada, making specialist healthcare accessible to every Canadian, wherever they are. Our platform breaks down barriers to care, empowering patients to take control of their health with personalized treatment options and the guidance of licensed providers.

If you thrive where big ideas turn into real impact, you'll fit right in here. We're a team of creative problem-solvers who move deliberately and collaborate in person, because we think the best work happens that way. At Phoenix, you'll find autonomy over your work, people who care about each other's success, and a mission that's making healthcare better for Canadians.



We are Phoenix, a digital healthcare platform for men. We are dedicated to improving the relationship men have with their health, while building the future of patient-centric healthcare in Canada from diagnosing to delivery. Backed by world-class investors, including Y Combinator, we’ve quickly become a market leader. Our head office is based in Toronto, where our team of top marketers, engineers, product managers, business leaders, and pharmacists is building the future of digital healthcare.

We're looking for a Pharmacy Assistant for our pharmacy based in Richmond, BC. This role works closely with the Head Pharmacist at a mail order pharmacy to assist in filling prescriptions to ship to patients on a daily basis. The working hours for this position will start as Monday–Friday 9am–5pm and will transition to Sunday–Thursday once onboarded. Training will be provided on the job. 

This is a non-direct patient care role. 




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Accurately fill and package prescriptions for timely shipment to patients

 - Assist in routine maintenance tasks to ensure the pharmacy operates smoothly and efficiently

 - Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant pharmacy environment

 - Support the Head Pharmacist and team with daily operational duties as needed
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a high level of accuracy 

 - Works well in a team environment with a good sense of urgency

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with a task-oriented approach

 - Good communication skills with coworkers - no direct customer interaction




WHY WORK AT PHOENIX?

 - A Rewarding Mission: Through our asynchronous care model, Phoenix is reimagining patient-centric care for Canadians across the country by making diagnoses and treatment delivery faster, more accessible, and completely discreet.
   

 - Impact & Autonomy: You’ll work directly with passionate, experienced leaders who’ve seen the ups and downs of building a business and genuinely care about your growth. You won’t just execute — you’ll help shape the future of Phoenix and Raven.
   

 - Collaborative On-Site Culture: Our Operations, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams work together on-site from our downtown Toronto HQ. The Director works closely with Account Executives, CSAs, Specialists, Practice leaders, Professional Services, Managed Services, and strategic technology partners to improve solution quality, strengthen customer relationships, and support growth across Northeast accounts.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Content and Communications
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position requiring in-office attendance one day per week at our Atlanta office. Candidates must reside within a commutable distance to be considered.

Reporting to the VP, Brand, you’ll lead Fullstory’s content and communications strategy, helping people understand what our technology makes possible and why it matters. You’ll turn customer insights, product innovation, and expert perspectives into stories that earn attention, build trust, and prove our value.

This is a hands-on role spanning content strategy, editorial leadership, and PR. You’ll work with our internal teams with support from a PR agency to engage freelance writers, content creators, designers, engineers and partners on dynamic content that reinforces our market narrative and strategic objectives. As our commercial editor-in-chief, you’ll shape Fullstory’s voice, write and edit high-stakes work yourself, and help colleagues communicate with clarity and confidence.

Fullstory is embracing AI in our products and how we work. You’re already building reusable AI skills and directing AI workflows, and you’ll use them, with strong editorial judgment, to expand what our team can produce and help colleagues do better work.

In a typical day, you might:

 - Lead an integrated content and communications strategy that connects Fullstory’s positioning and business priorities to the questions our audiences care about, with a clear editorial calendar, distribution plan, and measures of success.

 - Create compelling content across formats, including original research, thought leadership, customer stories, campaign assets, and interactive experiences, partnering with subject matter experts and creative colleagues to make complex ideas accessible and useful.

 - Shape Fullstory’s voice as our editor-in-chief, writing and editing high-priority work, validating claims, and establishing practical standards that help contributors publish accurate, distinctive content with confidence and speed.

 - Drive public relations and executive communications in partnership with Matter Communications, developing story angles, announcements, and executive perspectives; guiding media outreach; and coordinating timely responses to communications needs.

 - Build reusable AI skills and workflows in Claude that help colleagues research, draft, edit, and repurpose content that’s on brand.

 - Improve the impact of our work by coordinating priorities across Brand, Campaigns, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, and Customer Success; briefing and directing freelance creators and agency partners; and using audience response and performance data to guide what we do next.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

 - A portfolio of writing and editing that demonstrates command of language, a distinctive point of view, and the ability to turn complex technology or business topics into clear, credible stories for different audiences.

 - Experience owning content strategy through execution, including setting priorities, developing and distributing content across channels, and showing how that work contributed to audience growth, engagement, or business outcomes.

 - Experience managing external communications channels, including shaping executive perspectives, developing announcements, media pitches, press releases, and working with executives, journalists, or public relations partners to amplify distribution and voice.

 - Examples of practical AI work beyond basic drafting, such as reusable skills or workflows adopted by colleagues, or interactive content built with Claude Code or comparable tools. You can explain your contribution, how you evaluated the output, and what improved as a result.

 - Experience leading editorial work across teams and external partners, including giving actionable feedback, resolving competing priorities, and helping contributors meet high standards and deadlines.

The impact you will have in 6 Months:

 - In partnership with demand, establish a shared content and communications plan, a clear editorial standard, and dependable publishing rhythms, with early results showing which stories and formats resonate with our ICP audiences.

 - Put reusable AI skills and workflows into practice across contributing teams and launch interactive content that demonstrates how these tools can improve both the quality and usefulness of our work.

The base salary for this position ranges between $132,000 - $158,000 USD. Base salary will vary based on relevant experience, job-related skills and qualifications. This role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus of up to 15% of base salary, contingent upon Fullstory meeting its performance targets.

Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Hardware Test Engineer II

As a Hardware Test Engineer, you will be responsible for validating the performance of our autonomous rail vehicles and subsystems. You will work closely with other engineers (including electrical, mechanical, and software) to derive test requirements and develop the corresponding test infrastructure and processes. You are passionate about autonomous vehicle development and will bring that enthusiasm to solving challenging problems in pursuit of a reliable and scalable testing ecosystem. As an early employee at a fast-moving startup, you will work on a multitude of technical projects and help shape the direction of the company.

Responsibilities:

• Design and maintain test solutions for in-house developed electronics components and systems

• Build and maintain test benches used for development and software regression testing

• Define and develop test cases using Python

• Produce documentation for testing including test plans, work instructions, design drawings, and test reports

• Support testing and data analysis to identify and root-cause issues

• Test vehicles at Parallel test facilities and customer sites

• Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team's technical growth

What Success Looks Like:

• After 30 Days: You're familiar with vehicle and subsystems, including functional requirements and testing. You’ve produced design drawings for a test bench and procured parts.

• After 60 Days: You’ve integrated a test bench and demonstrated functionality and ability to meet test needs.

• After 90 days: You’ve automated test bench operations and integrated into software regression testing. You're supporting ongoing testing and driving an outcome tied directly to a business objective as a trusted partner.

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a similar discipline

• 3+ years of experience with hardware development or electronics test engineering

• Experience using common test equipment such as power supplies, DAQs, DMMs, and oscilloscopes

• Proficient in interpreting electronics schematics and wiring diagrams

• Experience with software development, in Python, C, C++, Rust or similar language

Preferred Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience with hardware development or electronics test engineering

• Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a similar Engineering discipline

• Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing or hardware validation/acceptance testing

• Experience with environmental testing, e.g., MIL-STD-810, IEC 60068

• Experience in power electronics testing including power converters, battery chargers, and motor controllers

• Experience with optics calibration and testing

• Experience with soldering, crimping and use of other hand tools for electronics integration and repair
