jobs.title: Vice President, HR and Talent
jobs.description:
Location: Flexible within the US

Type: Full-time

Team: HR and Talent

Job level: LSS5 - Vice President

Start date: January 2027

Priority Application Review Deadline: November 6, 2026

About Us

Relay Graduate School of Education (Relay) is an accredited not-for-profit institution of higher education serving thousands of educators from across the country, from pre-service teachers to system-level leaders. Relay is integrating with Teaching Lab, a leading national education non-profit providing teacher and leader coaching. Together, Relay and Teaching Lab help school system partners build coherent systems that support educators throughout their educator journey, from a first-year teacher finding their footing to experienced instructional, school, and system leaders. By bringing together the talent, infrastructure, and institutional knowledge of both organizations, we will strengthen our collective ability to help educators learn, grow, and lead—so that all students have the opportunity to thrive.

Summary of Position

The Vice President, HR and Talent owns the organization's HR and Talent department, running consistent processes, governing accurate and accessible people data, and acting as a strategic partner that helps leaders, managers, and team members navigate their own people decisions. This role owns the vision for HR and Talent across four functional pillars: Talent Attraction & Acquisition, People Operations & Compliance, Compensation & Benefits, and Business Partnership & Employee Relations. As Relay and Teaching Lab integrate, the VP owns the HR and Talent aspects of integration, ensuring one coherent people function across the combined organization. This role shapes organization-wide strategy and resolves cross-departmental tradeoffs on workforce planning, organizational design, and compensation, in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and the Executive Team. The VP is accountable for the performance, sustainability, and results of the HR and Talent department.

Essential Projects, Duties, and Responsibilities:

Specifically, the Vice President, HR and Talent will hold responsibilities in the following functional areas:

Own HR and Talent Department Strategy & Integration

• Own the vision and multi-year strategy for the HR and Talent department, spanning Talent Attraction & Acquisition, People Operations & Compliance, Compensation & Benefits, and Business Partnership & Employee Relations

• Own the HR aspects of the Relay/Teaching Lab integration, ensuring one coherent people function, policy set, and system of record across the combined organization

• Shape organization-wide strategy and resolve cross-departmental tradeoffs on workforce planning, organizational design, and compensation, in partnership with the COO and the Executive Team

• Hold accountability for the performance, sustainability, and results of the HR and Talent department, including whether team members experience HR and Talent as a responsive and trusted resource

Compensation & Benefits Strategy

• Own compensation philosophy, job architecture, and pay equity practices, ensuring fair and consistent pay across the organization

• Own total rewards strategy in partnership with the Executive Team, designing direct and indirect compensation programs that fairly pay employees and contractors

• Oversee benefits design, eligibility, and ACA compliance, and oversee management of compensation and benefits vendors and data accuracy

Talent Attraction & Acquisition Strategy

• Set the vision and strategic direction for talent acquisition, ensuring recruitment priorities align with organizational goals, evolving workforce needs, and long-term talent requirements.

• Establish an org-wide talent strategy that strengthens the organization’s ability to attract, assess, and retain high-quality talent across functions and leadership levels.

• Shape workforce planning and talent forecasting in partnership with executive leadership, connecting organizational priorities, future capabilities, and staffing needs.

• Define the principles, standards, and success measures that promote equitable hiring practices, a strong candidate experience, and consistent recruitment outcomes across the organization.

• Evaluate talent acquisition effectiveness using data, market insights, and organizational outcomes to inform strategic decisions and continuous improvement.

People Operations & Compliance Strategy

• Set the vision and strategic direction for people policies and the employee/contractor handbook, ensuring they are current, legally compliant, and clearly communicated

• Set the vision and strategic direction for people data and data integrity, ensuring the organization has one accurate system of record

• Oversee the compliance calendar and lead efforts to manage organizational risk and comply with federal, state, and local legal requirements for a multi-state, multi-entity workforce

• Set the vision and strategic direction for onboarding, offboarding, and Tier 1 employee support, ensuring a consistent and welcoming employee lifecycle experience

• Oversee management of the performance review cycle end-to-end, including calibration support

Business Partnership & Employee Relations Strategy

• Set the vision and strategic direction for how HR and Talent Business Partners serve as embedded strategic partners to function leaders on org design and workforce planning

• Set the vision for the organization's approach to employee relations and manager coaching, ensuring issues are addressed early, and coaching measurably reduces repeat issues

• Oversee calibration of performance conversations and ratings across teams to ensure consistency and fairness

• In consultation with the COO, Executive Team, and General Counsel, provide guidance on the most complex employee relations, conduct, and performance matters, including investigations of alleged misconduct

People Leadership: Lead Directors and Senior Directors

• Provide vision, direction, and oversight for direct reports and project team members

• Model people-manager competencies that support a positive culture and high productivity, including coaching, feedback, and development planning

• Ensure direct reports and project team members successfully achieve annual goals

• Monitor team capacity and workload to sustain effectiveness without burnout

• Oversee hiring for open roles within the team

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with the Executive Team, department leaders, and team members at every level to generate ideas, strategies, and systems that meet organizational goals related to HR and Talent

• Provide HR and Talent written updates through various reporting channels (e.g., internal newsletter, progress monitoring, Executive Team reports), incorporating metrics on progress

• Serve as the primary point of contact for HR and Talent matters relating to organizational initiatives, policies, practices, and employee relations issues

• Lead efforts that build inclusion and belonging for all team members, embedding this lens into HR and Talent's systems and practices

Continuous Learning

• Stay abreast of key research and guidance in HR, talent acquisition, compensation, and employee relations; attend learning experiences to build relevant skills and competencies

• Continuously update job knowledge through conferences, professional publications, and professional networks

Perform other duties as assigned by the Manager, Department leadership, and/or Executive Team.

Essential Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Organizational Psychology, or a related field

• 10+ years of progressively responsible HR experience, including 5+ years at the Director level or above leading HR operations and employee programs throughout the employee lifecycle

• 5+ years managing people, including experience managing other people managers

• 5+ years of experience aligning and supporting business operations for a geographically dispersed, multi-entity workforce

• 5+ years advising leaders on complex employee relations matters related to conduct and/or performance

• Professional HR certification (e.g., PHR, SHRM-CP, or a senior-level equivalent)

• Multi-state HR experience, with knowledge of compliance across varied jurisdictions

• Demonstrated experience setting multi-year HR Talent strategy and building durable, scalable systems (e.g., HRIS, compensation architecture, compliance systems)

• Demonstrated experience leading HR through a merger, acquisition, or large-scale organizational integration

• Demonstrated ability to lead inclusion and belonging initiatives, including equitable hiring practices, pay equity audits, and employee inclusion programs, using metrics to track success

• Advanced knowledge of and experience applying Federal and State employment law across multiple jurisdictions

• Experience managing HR systems (HRIS/HRM) and overseeing HR systems integrations

• Proficient with Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite

Desirable Qualifications

• Advanced degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field

• Senior-level professional HR certification (e.g., SPHR, SHRM-SCP)

• Experience in higher education or K-12 education context

• Experience leading HR and Talent during a merger or acquisition

Compensation

Relay and Teaching Lab are committed to creating and maintaining a compensation and benefits system that supports our ability to recruit and retain a diverse and talented team. As we make decisions about compensation, we will be guided by the following values: clarity, consistency, and internal equity. The salary range for this role is $144,700 to $247,700.

Relay and Teaching Lab offer a comprehensive total rewards package. For full-time roles, this includes health insurance benefits, disability and life insurance, retirement plan, professional development, gym reimbursement, adoption assistance, paid time off (PTO), parental leave, etc.

Work Location Policy

Employees must have a primary work location within the U.S., where they are legally authorized to work.

Relay Graduate School of Education and Teaching Lab provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees.

jobs.title: High School: Special Education Lead Teacher - Greater Boston (2026-2027)
jobs.description:
Lead Teacher, Special Education (Humanities) - Inclusion at KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School

KIPP Academy Lynn Charter School is looking for talented, committed, and culturally competent Special Education Inclusion Lead Teachers who are passionate about ensuring that all of our students are growing and achieving. By providing students with a variety of supports, Special Education Inclusion Lead Teachers typically work with students through inclusive teaching and small group pull outs. Most Special Education Inclusion Lead Teachers co-teach and/or co-plan in core classes. In doing so, the Special Education Inclusion Lead Teacher collaborates with the homeroom/Lead Teacher in co-planning and co-instructing lessons and units, and co- assessing to provide the guidance and support of accommodations, modifications, and resources so that all students have access to the content and curriculum in a way that provides rigor, success, and achievement. In addition, the Special Education Inclusion Lead Teacher will write and manage IEP paperwork and meetings, communicate with students and families about student progress, and advocate for students as needed.

This multifaceted role is ideal for flexible and creative teachers who are passionate about serving our highest-need students and are excited by the challenge of digging into content, anticipating misconceptions, and implementing best practices that will lead all students to content mastery. Prior experience with Special Education laws and paperwork is a bonus, but not required as Special Education Teachers will receive training and assistance from our regional Special Education team. Special Education Teachers are empowered to use their expertise to do whatever it takes to help our students succeed.

This role requires consistent and reliable demonstration of the following essential job functions and key responsibilities:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Classroom Responsibilities

• Serve as a lead or co-lead in a classroom (or classrooms), with responsibilities that may include: leading a class independently, co-teaching, short- or long-term coverage, or stepping into a lead classroom role later in the year based on the school's needs.
• Ensure that all children feel affirmed, valued, and challenged every day
• Create and foster a positive and safe learning environment
• Support in the co-creation and internalization of rigorous and engaging units and daily lesson plans with the homeroom/Lead Teacher
• Set specific, ambitious growth goals for students on caseload and leverage all necessary resources, including student advocacy when needed, to ensure they meet them
• Ongoing progress monitoring of student progress towards IEP goals
• Use special education best practices to execute engaging instruction at a level rigorous to all students including but not limited to accommodations, modifications, monitoring of extra time, small group instruction/pull out, etc.
• Infuse core values into lessons and every school practice, implementing school-wide student culture systems and positive classroom management strategies
• Regularly analyze student work from caseload compared to other students to support in student-specific modifications and accommodations
• Support in maintaining accurate student grades/records and strong lines of communication with students and families regularly regarding students’ growth and progress
• Provide feedback and support to homeroom/Lead Teacher around curriculum and instructional best practices to support students on caseload
• Build strong working relationship with homeroom/Lead Teacher to effectively collaborate on curriculum, instruction and classroom management in support of students

School and Professional Responsibilities

• Obtain required MTEL and SEI endorsements with financial support from KIPP MA within the first year of employment in addition to free study support (please review this doc to see requirements). Preferred: Obtain special education licensure as soon as qualified to do so.
• Participate in school-wide and individual professional development, including pre-service training over the summer and during the academic year
• Take ownership for the development of your craft and seek feedback from your coach (meet 1x/1-2 weeks with coach, implement feedback, engage in co-planning and active practices, participate in live coaching, etc.)
• Perform necessary support duties including (but not limited to) coverage, bus, lunch, and dismissal duties
• Develop strong relationships with families through participating in school events and consistent phone calls home
• Be willing to offer support and receive constructive feedback from colleagues in order to create a professional working atmosphere that is conducive to accountability, change, and improvement
• Collaborate with grade level and content teams to update and advocate for students on caseload
• Write, lead, and manage IEP and 504 paperwork and meetings with students, families, and teachers
• Dependable attendance according to our school calendar

General Requirements and Responsibilities

• Embody KIPP MA’s Code of Conduct by acting with integrity, leading with humanity, centering self-awareness and critical consciousness, taking personal responsibility, and engaging productively
• Participate and engage in regional professional development and community events as required
• Demonstrated ability to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and make reasonable judgments and decisions in a timely manner in accordance with the needs of the school
• Self-awareness, flexibility and emotional intelligence to navigate a setting with students who express diverse needs
• The consistent use of interpersonal and self-management skills to effectively support behavioral and emotional needs of students to ensure a safe and inclusive environment, as well as build relationships and manage conflict with students, staff, and caregivers
• Effective communication skills to perform assigned duties and to meaningfully exchange information with students, staff, families and others in person, through written communication, in front of groups, and on virtual platforms
• Physical mobility to move self in various positions in order to execute duties effectively, which may include kneeling, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, twisting, turning, bending, stooping and reaching overhead
• Physical strength sufficient to periodically lift and/or carry 20 pounds of materials or supplies and to physically restrain a student to keep from harming themself and/or others in an emergency situation
• Manual dexterity sufficient to perform repetitive hand/wrist/arm motions and to operate a computer and office equipment

KIPP MA teachers are supported in their demanding work by experienced and dedicated leadership and staff who have themselves proven successful in the teaching role. Our leaders maintain consistent school-wide systems and procedures - academic, behavioral, cultural, logistical - designed to permit teachers to do their best work.

In addition to the responsibilities listed above, there will occasionally be other duties as assigned that staff will engage in to help promote a positive and safe learning environment and culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Deep alignment with KIPP MA’s mission and values, including the unwavering belief in the high potential of all students
• Demonstrated ability to drive student growth and achievement and to create a warm, inclusive, rigorous learning environment
• Passion for Special Education and demonstrated commitment to professional learning
• 2+ years of full-time teaching experience (in Special Education preferred)
• Preferred: Special Education licensure
• Bachelor’s Degree required
• Computer literacy and baseline familiarity with Google Suite
• Pass Criminal Background Checks

KIPP MA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in building a vibrant and welcoming school community that advances our mission of ensuring that all KIPP students graduate with the skills and confidence to lead fulfilling lives. This includes a commitment to attracting and developing individuals who understand the experiences of the students and communities we serve. We hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

The minimum base salary for this exempt position is $55,000 to $89,500 (per 1.0 FTE/45 hours per week), depending on years of experience after your Bachelors degree (+$3,000 for 1st advanced degree and +$1,500 for 2nd advanced degree). The role includes a $1,000 signing bonus—and an annual $2,000 retention bonus in subsequent years, as well as other bonuses, when eligible. This role follows our School Year calendar. For more about what we offer, how to apply and more about KIPP MA, please visit this link HERE.

jobs.title: Associate Director, U.S. Immunology Consumer Marketing - Dermatology
jobs.description:
The Associate Director for Consumer Marketing will be responsible for leading the launch planning, strategy and go-to-market execution for both Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS) launches. The Associate Director will partner with key cross-functional partners (Professional Marketing, Marketing Analytics and Business Intelligence, CI, PA, Medical Affairs, Medical and Regulatory Review, OEC, and Legal) to identify and use insights and the patient journey to develop unbranded and branded campaigns and messaging across multiple channels. This individual will also lead work with our strategic agency of record and extended agency network from a HS portfolio strategy standpoint. The Associate Director serves as the patient, brand, and product subject matter expert for consumer marketing within the organization. This role will report to the Consumer Director of Dermatology.

The Associate Director for Consumer Marketing will be responsible for leading the launch planning, strategy and go-to-market execution for both Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS) launches. The Associate Director will partner with key cross-functional partners (Professional Marketing, Marketing Analytics and Business Intelligence, CI, PA, Medical Affairs, Medical and Regulatory Review, OEC, and Legal) to identify and use insights and the patient journey to develop unbranded and branded campaigns and messaging across multiple channels. This individual will also lead work with our strategic agency of record and extended agency network from a HS portfolio strategy standpoint. The Associate Director serves as the patient, brand, and product subject matter expert for consumer marketing within the organization. This role will report to the Consumer Director of Dermatology.

Key Job Responsibilities

• Lead launch strategy development, go-to-market strategy, and tactical planning for potential new indications, including representation within the IBT through Launch Strategic and Readiness Reviews.
• Collaborate with external agencies, internal partners, and leadership to build, manage, and execute marketing plans to achieve business objectives and goals.
• Manage strategy and project development of DTC advertising for disease education, brand awareness, acquisition, and conversion initiatives through a variety of channels, which may include CRM, direct marketing, in-office, print, SEM, digital media, mobile, broadcast TV, with a strong emphasis on web-based communications.
• Manage media planning in partnership with the AbbVie Media team and external media agency.
• Work with internal cross-functional groups (Public Affairs, Professional Marketing, Legal, Regulatory, Medical, and Project Management) and external groups (Ad Agency, Digital and Media Agency, Database Agency) to ensure integration and consistency of consumer business strategies and regulatory compliance of promotional material.
• Understand trends in the marketplace impacting Consumer Marketing, using data-driven strategic insights to apply on an ongoing basis.
• Lead competitive assessments and implications that are relevant for specific indications and our patients.
• Evaluate the effectiveness of campaign strategies through campaign measurement and metrics development to ensure a positive return on investment and achieve brand objectives.
• Help patients better manage their conditions through improved patient experiences.
• Grow brand/product penetration, share, and awareness.
• Effectively track and manage the marketing budget.
• Consistently execute multiple marketing projects in a timely manner.
• Proactively advances Consumer Marketing's innovation agenda by leveraging new technologies, capabilities, and ways of working to improve organizational agility and efficiency while enhancing customer outcomes.

• BA/BS required; MBA preferred.
• Pharmaceutical launch experience preferred.
• 8+ years of consumer marketing experience with significant experience in media, including digital marketing, with the ideal candidate having broadcast and media planning leadership experience.
• Competency in core marketing capabilities such as creative development, positioning, and optimization across the marketing mix.
• Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, including timeline and budget management.
• Ability to understand medical/clinical aspects of a pharmaceutical product and its application to marketing strategy and tactical execution.
• Success working in a matrixed organization to drive alignment to brand objectives.
• Experience leading or supporting strategic and tactical planning.
• Excellent communication (oral, written, and presentation) and people skills.
• Familiarity with participating in local market and patient immersions and pulling insights through to execution.
• Experience working with and managing multiple external agencies, including advertising, digital, and database agencies, as well as internal cross-functional partners.
• Understanding of social media platforms and their application.
• Balance of analytical capability and creative vision.
• Ability to influence senior management and work with all levels in a highly matrixed organization.
• Strong planning and organization skills, diligence, execution, and follow-through.
• Demonstrated history of high performance.
• Proven people leadership experience.

jobs.description:

Greeting customers and taking orders with a smile!

Operating the cash register and collecting payment from customers.

Making consistent products within Domino’s Pizza guidelines.

Maintaining a clean and organized work environment from our customer’s viewpoint.

Maintain a professional appearance at all times in compliance within the Domino's Pizza Grooming Standards.

A fun and friendly person, who is comfortable talking to strangers.

A team player who is punctual and has a positive attitude!

- Employee Discounts!

- Paid Training

- Flexible schedules!

- Perfect job for students or extra hours after another job

- Tips paid out after shift!

- Criminal Background check required.

- Benefits:  All team members are eligible for benefits (eligibility for certain benefits dependent on approximate hours worked per week)

Did you know 90% of Domino's franchisees started out as Pizza Makers or Drivers?

-Paid sick leave per Washington law

-Health Care benefits for full time employees (30+ hours per week after waiting periods)

-Dental and Vision plans available to purchase

jobs.title: PBX Operator
jobs.description:
Our on property Call Center Agent (PBX Operator) is responsible for transporting guests virtually anywhere they would like to go at any time.\

Job Duties include:

• Provide prompt, courteous and efficient handling of all incoming calls, keep track of guests’ requests, and follow up to ensure satisfactory service and assistance for outgoing calls.
• Follow up with guests to ensure their requests or problems have been met to their satisfaction.
• Receive, record, and relay messages accurately, completely, and legibly.
• Contact appropriate individuals or departments (e.g., Bellperson, Front Desk, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security/Loss Prevention) as necessary to resolve guest calls, requests, or problems.
• Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns.
• Anticipate guests' service needs, including asking questions of guests to better understand their needs and watching/listening to guest preferences and acting on them whenever possible.
• Address guests' service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner. Engage guests in conversation regarding their stay, property services, and area attractions/offerings.
• Thank guests with genuine appreciation and provide a fond farewell.
• Answer telephones using appropriate etiquette including answering the phone within 3 rings, answering with a smile in one's voice, using the callers' name, transferring calls to appropriate person/department, requesting permission before placing the caller on hold, taking and relaying messages, and allowing the caller to end the call.
• Handle sensitive issues with employees and/or guests with tact, respect, diplomacy, and confidentiality.
• Monitor busy or unanswered lines, check back with callers on hold to update status and offer to take a message.
• Process guest requests for wake up calls, screening calls, do not disturb, call forwarding, conference calls, TDD relay calls, and non-registered guest calls.
• Thoroughly understand safety procedures and have numbers to the Police, Fire, and Telephone Repair departments.

• 1 year experience in same or similar role.
• Ability to clearly and pleasantly communicate in English, both orally and in writing.
• Ability to perform assigned duties with attention to detail .
• Ability to interact in a polite, professional, and engaging manner.
• Experience in a luxury environment is preferred.

jobs.title: Lead Accountant - Order to Cash
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Portland, Oregon, USA; San Francisco, California, USA
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as the operational bridge connecting financial strategy with global execution. Operating as the primary liaison between Revenue/Finance leadership and the Accounts Receivable (AR) Operations team, you will drive month-end close acceleration and establish governance across global workflows and projects. You will coordinate the end-to-end transformation in Order-to-Cash (OTC) by embedding AI automation, predictive risk engines, and standardized operations into our daily financial reporting cadence.

What You'll Do

1. Global Operational Liaison

• Project Management: Standardize and accelerate the project timeline, ensuring seamless coordination between cross-functional teams and pushing the projects to closures.

• SOP Standardization: Document and maintain formal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all AR workflows, establishing and designing strict human-in-the-loop validation steps to safeguard financial controls.

2. AI Automation & Process Innovation

• E2E AI Transformation: Act as the operational lead for implementing agentic and non-agentic automation.

• Predictive AI Risk Models: Partner with technical teams to deploy the Predictive Account Risk Engine, utilizing billing and consumption telemetry to automatically prioritize collections outreach.

• Workforce Scaling: Leverage Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) and automated exception-handling tools to streamline repetitive tasks (such as payment auto-matching in HighRadius), allowing the global operations team to scale efficiently.

3. Advanced AR Reporting & Analytics

• Executive Visibility: Translate complex AR aging, Collections Efficiency Index (CEI), and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) metrics into high-level liquidity forecasts and risk assessments for leadership. Act as the primary, real-time liaison between the Revenue/Finance leadership team and the AR Operations team to align on data points.

This Role Requires

• Accounting & Systems Experience: 5+ years of progressive OTC/AR/FP&A experience in SaaS or technology sectors, with hands-on proficiency in NetSuite, BillingPlatform, Zuora, and HighRadius.

• Global Operations & Data Capabilities: Proven track record of coordinating cross-regional teams, analyzing complex financial data, and building structured variance reports.

• Leadership & Compliance: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Finance, Sales, and Legal, with experience leading teams through process changes in SOX-compliant environments.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Automation Mindset: Experience implementing financial process improvements, such as robotic process automation (RPA), auto-match logic, or OCR/Intelligent Document Processing (IDP).

• Responsible AI Governance: Familiarity with corporate compliance guardrails for utilizing Generative AI (e.g., Enterprise Gemini, Claude, etc.) in financial workflows, including data security protocols (PII/MNPI masking).

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Position Overview
As a Private Duty Nurse with Centria Healthcare, you'll deliver compassionate, one-on-one care to patients in the comfort of their homes. Whether caring for a medically complex child or an adult recovering from a motor vehicle accident, you'll be making a meaningful difference every day.

About the role

Provide direct 1-on-1 skilled nursing care for an adult client with a thoracic spinal cord injury, focusing on respiratory maintenance, mobility support, and daily therapy routines. You will collaborate closely with on-site home health aides during your shift to maintain a safe, clean, and therapeutic home environment.

Who We Are
Centria Healthcare is committed to delivering exceptional, personalized care to clients of all ages. Our mission is simple: do whatever it takes to provide superior home healthcare services to individuals with medically complex conditions by putting our clients' needs at the center of everything we do.

We specialize in:

• Pediatric Care: Children with tracheostomies, ventilators, seizure disorders, and other complex medical needs.

• Adult Care: Individuals recovering from motor vehicle accidents facing injuries such as spinal cord damage, TBI, orthopedic injuries, and more.

Why Join Centria?

• Flexible Scheduling: Full-time, part-time, and per diem options to fit your life.

• Competitive Pay: Weekly & Daily pay.

• Meaningful Work: Build long-term relationships with patients and their families and truly make a difference in their life.

• Supportive Training/Resources: Virtual Reality + Hands-on Simulation Shadowing shifts Clinical Procedure Manual embedded in EMR 24/7 Clinical On-Call Support

• Professional Growth: Shared Governance Committee Clinical Quality Metrics Measured Monthly DAISY Recognition Opportunities for advancement within a growing company

• Virtual Onboarding: Making your onboarding process a breeze, along with a virtual orientation

• Comprehensive Benefits (for eligible staff): Health insurance, paid sick-time, and more

Responsibilities

• Provide skilled nursing care (trach/vent care, medication administration, catheter care, etc.)

• Monitor and document vitals, symptoms, and changes in condition

• Assist with ADLs such as repositioning, hygiene, mobility, etc.

• Support patient well-being with compassionate and attentive care

• Collaborate with families, caregivers, and the healthcare team

Qualifications

• Active RN or LPN license in the state of Michigan

• Experience in home health, private duty, or long-term care preferred

• Pediatric or adult care experience a plus (trach/vent knowledge helpful but not required)

• Strong communication skills and a passion for patient-centered care

Schedule & Benefits:

• Full-time and part-time shifts available (Day, Night, and Weekend shifts).

• Competitive pay rates based on experience.

• Flexible scheduling to accommodate work-life balance.

• Comprehensive training and ongoing support from Centria Healthcare.

• Health benefits, PTO, and career advancement opportunities for eligible employees.

• Optional Daily Pay

About the Role:

We have immediate needs for private duty nurses (RNs or LPNs) in the area to provide home care to pediatric patients. Our pediatric population ranges in ages from birth to 21 years of age.

• Weekly Pay, $28.00 - $40.00 per hour.

• Create Your Own Schedule: Although this specific position is a day shift, in general, we never mandate shifts, giving you the flexibility to balance work and personal life.

• Supportive Environment: New to home care? We have dedicated staff invested in your success.

• Healthy Work-Life Balance: Providing 1-on-1 care promotes a balanced and fulfilling professional life.

• Growing Company: We are expanding rapidly and are excited to welcome great individuals to our team.

Don't Have a Lot of Experience? No Problem!

Whether you're new to home care or need a refresher on trach care, we offer training opportunities and the chance to shadow experienced nurses to gain the comfort level needed to provide optimal care.

What We Offer:

• Competitive pay

• Comprehensive training programs

• Supportive and caring work environment

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

About Centria:

Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Farmington Hills, Michigan, Centria Healthcare is a leading provider of home-based catastrophic injury and rehabilitation care, private duty nursing, and supportive living services across the state of Michigan. Centria coordinates among multiple disciplines for its rehabilitation services including physical therapy and occupational therapy. Transcending beyond the role of traditional home healthcare providers, Centria has established itself as a market leader through its diverse expertise spanning from the rehabilitation of those who have experienced a Traumatic Brain Injury or Spinal Cord Injury to children dependent on technology. Centria has developed the most comprehensive programs to care for individuals involved in the most serious accidents with potentially long-term complications relating to those accidents.

Ready to Make a Difference?

Apply now to join a dedicated team that's redefining home healthcare — one client at a time

Sales Leadership and Management

jobs.title: Product & Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
PRODUCT & BUSINESS OPERATIONS LEAD

Blossom Health exists to solve the mental health epidemic in America by partnering with psychiatrists to expand access to affordable, timely, clinically-effective mental healthcare. Our AI-native care platform is loved by hundreds of clinicians and thousands of patients.

We’re a Series A company with $20M+ raised from Headline, Village Global, and the founders of General Catalyst, Flatiron Health, Sword Health, Grow Therapy, Fay, Elemy, Zip, Blank Street, Assured, Bridge, Birches Health, and Enzo Health.


THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance & Business Operations Lead to own the financial and analytical work behind some of Blossom’s most important business decisions.

This is not a generalist BizOps role. You’ll spend a significant amount of your time digging into the economics of the business: understanding our revenue structure, building financial models, evaluating new opportunities, and turning complex financial and operational data into decisions.

You’ll report directly to our Founder and work closely with leaders across the company as we scale.


WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE:

 - 🚀 Be early in a hyper-growth startup: Join the foundational team of a rapidly scaling company and help build the financial and operational infrastructure behind our next stage of growth

 - 📈 Work on decisions that matter: Your analysis won’t live in a deck. You’ll help answer questions that directly influence how we grow, where we invest, and how we build the business

 - 🤝 High trust and autonomy: Own meaningful work from day one, with the freedom to shape how problems are approached and solved

 - 🧠 Talent-dense team: Work alongside a top-percentile team with high standards, intellectual curiosity, and a shared ambition to build something consequential

 - 🏃 We move with speed and purpose: We value people who can move quickly, get deep into the details, and turn analysis into action


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own financial analysis and modeling across revenue, growth, unit economics, and strategic initiatives

 - Develop a deep understanding of Blossom’s revenue structure and identify opportunities to improve the economics of the business

 - Build models and analyses that inform company-level decisions around growth, investment, resource allocation, and new opportunities

 - Partner with the Founder and business leaders on high-priority strategic and operational projects

 - Translate complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations and actionable decisions

 - Build reporting, forecasting, and analytical processes as the company scales

 - Evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, markets, and strategic initiatives from both a financial and operational perspective

 - Move beyond the analysis when needed and help execute on the opportunities you identify


YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have 2–6 years of professional experience, with a strong foundation in finance and financial analysis

 - You have experience in investment banking, equity research, private equity, hedge funds, or another rigorous investing/financial environment

 - You’re exceptionally strong in financial modeling and comfortable getting deep into revenue structures, unit economics, and business performance

 - You have a track record of outperforming in highly selective, demanding environments

 - You can take a complicated or ambiguous question, structure it quickly, and arrive at a thoughtful answer

 - You’re commercially minded. You care about what the numbers actually mean for the business, not just producing the analysis

 - You have a strong bias for action and are excited to operate beyond the traditional boundaries of a finance role

 - You communicate clearly and can turn detailed analysis into a compelling recommendation

 - You’re excited by the opportunity to work directly with a Founder and take on increasingly broad ownership as the company grows

 - You’re authorized to work in the United States

 - You’re excited to be in-person in New York City 5 days a week

Bonus: You’ve spent several years in investment banking or another rigorous finance environment and have since moved into strategic finance, business operations, or a similar role at a high-growth startup.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Highly motivated, ambitious, and capable - you want to tackle large, meaningful problems and hold yourself to a high bar

 - Ownership mindset - you think long-term and put the business and our customers first

 - High velocity and high excellence - you move with urgency without sacrificing the quality of your work

 - Analytically rigorous - you’re comfortable going several layers deeper than the obvious answer

 - Commercially curious - you want to understand how and why a business works, not just report what happened

 - An explorer - you’re comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and questions that don’t have an existing playbook

 - Humble - you use your strengths in service of the team and understand that success is an output, not an input


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - $120,000–$180,000 base salary

 - Meaningful equity ownership

 - Significant growth opportunities as the company scales

 - Beautiful, sunshine and snack-filled office in the heart of Flatiron, Manhattan

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - A focus on outcomes, not hours

 - Team outings, offsites, and unlimited PTO

• Superior accuracy and attention to detail.

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Head of Global D2C Transformation

San Mateo, CA / Hybrid

The Head of Global D2C Transformation will be responsible for leading the global Direct-to-Consumer Operations transformation agenda for PlayStation. Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, they will act as the key interface between B2C/D2C commercial teams and the Operations division of Sony Interactive Entertainment globally.

Reporting into Global Operations, this role will gather, shape, prioritize, and funnel commercial and business requirements into the relevant Operations functions, ensuring that D2C activities are supported, scalable, and aligned to the global growth plan for PlayStation Direct.

The Head of Global D2C Transformation will lead the growth and development program for D2C Operations, partnering with Supply Chain, Logistics, Customer Service, Planning, Finance, Technology, and regional Operations teams to improve service levels, unlock operational efficiencies, and support continued D2C expansion.

What You’ll Be Doing:

This senior leader will build strong relationships with global commercial, business, and operations partners to ensure D2C requirements are clearly understood, prioritized, and translated into operational plans and initiatives.

Lead the global D2C Operations transformation roadmap, ensuring Operations is prepared to support PlayStation Direct growth across new markets, product categories, service models, and customer expectations.

Drive operational readiness for key D2C initiatives, including PlayStation Direct geo-expansion, expansion of the D2C product range, and the development of scalable systems, processes, and capabilities.

Create and present insights that identify opportunities for strategic and continuous improvement, providing commercial and business teams with initiatives they can capitalize on or use to support their own growth plans.

Partner with Operations functions to improve customer service levels, operational efficiency, delivery performance, cost effectiveness, and end-to-end execution for D2C customers globally.

Establish governance, forums, reporting, and performance metrics to track progress against the global D2C Operations growth plan.

Key Areas of Focus:

D2C Growth & Geo-Expansion

• Support global PlayStation Direct market expansion planning and execution.

• Coordinate operational requirements across regions and functions.

• Ensure new market launches are supported by scalable operational processes.

• Identify operational risks, dependencies, and opportunities linked to D2C growth.

Commercial & Business Requirements

• Act as the central Operations intake point for D2C commercial and business requirements.

• Translate commercial ambitions into operational capabilities, roadmaps, and delivery plans.

• Prioritize requirements with stakeholders based on customer impact, growth potential, cost, complexity, and strategic value.

• Ensure Operations teams are aligned to D2C business priorities.

• Understand systems architecture of front-end commerce, payments, fraud, through post purchase, payment & audit.

Operational Excellence & Service Improvement

• Develop systematic and operational efficiencies that improve service levels for D2C customers.

• Partner with Logistics, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Planning, Technology, and Finance to improve end-to-end D2C performance.

• Identify and remove operational barriers to D2C growth.

• Drive continuous improvement across processes, systems, governance, and ways of working.

Insights, Strategy & Transformation

• Generate and present insights that highlight opportunities for growth, efficiency, and customer experience improvement.

• Take ownership of the D2C Operations MRP Roadmap

• Use data, operational performance, and business feedback to shape transformation priorities.

• Recommend initiatives that support commercial teams and unlock further D2C growth.

• Track progress, benefits, and performance against the D2C Operations transformation agenda.

What We’re Looking For:

• 12+ years’ experience in Operations, Transformation, D2C, eCommerce, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, or a related field.

• Experience working in a global matrix organization with senior commercial and operations stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of D2C/eCommerce business models, customer expectations, and operational requirements.

• Proven ability to translate commercial strategy into operational plans and delivery programs.

• Strong program leadership, governance, and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

• Demonstrated ability to influence across functions, regions, and levels of seniority.

• Strong analytical capability, with experience turning data and insights into actionable recommendations.

• Commercial awareness and strong financial acumen.

• MBA or BA/BS in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy, or another related field preferred.

jobs.description:

We're seeking an experienced Field Service Representative to deliver exceptional on-site technical service as the primary technical liaison between Veolia and our industrial customers. You'll work independently across diverse industries, providing expert installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting services for chemical feed equipment and water treatment systems while building lasting customer relationships through technical excellence.

What You'll Do

• System Optimization & Troubleshooting: Perform water analysis, calibrate equipment, program controllers, conduct preventative maintenance, and diagnose/resolve system issues through remote support technologies and on-site interventions

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience:

Key Characteristics:

• Strong troubleshooting abilities for electrical and mechanical systems

jobs.title: Strategic Finance & Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
STRATEGIC FINANCE & BUSINESS OPERATIONS LEAD

Blossom Health exists to solve the mental health epidemic in America by partnering with psychiatrists to expand access to affordable, timely, clinically-effective mental healthcare. Our AI-native care platform is loved by hundreds of clinicians and tens of thousands of patients.

We’re a Series A company with $20M+ raised from Headline, Village Global, and the founders of General Catalyst, Flatiron Health, Sword Health, Fay, Elemy, Zip, Blank Street, Assured, Bridge, Birches Health, and Enzo Health.

 


THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance & Business Operations Lead to own the financial and analytical work behind some of Blossom’s most important business decisions and revenue drivers.

This is not a generic BizOps role. You’ll spend a significant amount of your time digging into the economics of the business: understanding our revenue structure, building financial models, evaluating new opportunities, and turning complex financial and operational data into decisions. You'll also directly own key commercial aspects of the business including relationships and workflows with health insurance payors and other strategic counterparties.

You’ll report directly to our Founder and work closely with leaders across the company as we scale.

 


WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE:

 - 🚀 Be early in a hyper-growth startup: Join the foundational team of a rapidly scaling company and help build the financial and operational infrastructure behind our next stage of growth

 - 📈 Work on decisions that matter: Your analysis won’t live in a deck. You’ll help answer questions that directly influence how we grow, where we invest, and how we build the business

 - 🤝 High trust and autonomy: Own meaningful work from day one, with the freedom to shape how problems are approached and solved

 - 🧠 Talent-dense team: Work alongside a top-percentile team with high standards, intellectual curiosity, and a shared ambition to build something consequential

 - 🏃 We move with speed and purpose: We value people who can move quickly, get deep into the details, and turn analysis into action


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own financial analysis and modeling across revenue, growth, unit economics, and strategic initiatives

 - Develop a deep understanding of Blossom’s revenue structure and identify opportunities to improve the economics of the business

 - Build models and analyses that inform company-level decisions around growth, investment, resource allocation, and new opportunities

 - Partner with the Founder and business leaders on high-priority strategic and operational projects

 - Translate complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations and actionable decisions

 - Build reporting, forecasting, and analytical processes as the company scales

 - Evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, markets, and strategic initiatives from both a financial and operational perspective

 - Move beyond the analysis and execute on the opportunities you identify


YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have 2–6 years of professional experience, with a strong foundation in finance and financial analysis

 - You have experience in investment banking, equity research, private equity, hedge funds, or another rigorous investing/financial environment

 - You’re exceptionally strong in financial modeling and comfortable getting deep into revenue structures, unit economics, and business performance

 - You have a track record of outperforming in highly selective, demanding environments

 - You can take a complicated or ambiguous question, structure it quickly, and arrive at a thoughtful answer

 - You’re commercially minded. You care about what the numbers actually mean for the business, not just producing the analysis

 - You have a strong bias for action and are excited to operate beyond the traditional boundaries of a finance role

 - You communicate clearly and can turn detailed analysis into a compelling recommendation

 - You’re excited by the opportunity to work directly with a Founder and take on increasingly broad ownership as the company grows

 - You’re authorized to work in the United States

 - You’re excited to be in-person in New York City 5 days a week

Bonus: You’ve spent several years in investment banking or another rigorous finance environment and have since moved into strategic finance, business operations, or a similar role at a high-growth startup.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Highly motivated, ambitious, and capable - you want to tackle large, meaningful problems and hold yourself to a high bar

 - Ownership mindset - you think long-term and put the business and our customers first

 - High velocity and high excellence - you move with urgency without sacrificing the quality of your work

 - Analytically rigorous - you’re comfortable going several layers deeper than the obvious answer

 - Commercially curious - you want to understand how and why a business works, not just report what happened

 - An explorer - you’re comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and questions that don’t have an existing playbook

 - Humble - you use your strengths in service of the team and understand that success is an output, not an input


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - $120,000–$180,000 base salary

 - Meaningful equity ownership

 - Significant growth opportunities as the company scales

 - Beautiful, sunshine and snack-filled office in the heart of Flatiron, Manhattan

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - A focus on outcomes, not hours

 - Team outings, offsites, and unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Manager, Financial Services
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

As a Principal Customer Success Manager you will be a senior individual contributor owning some of our most significant customers.  Acting as a trusted SME within the wider Customer Success Department you will also be temporarily assigned to assist junior colleagues with at-risk or high opportunity accounts within their book.  As a member of the Enterprise Team you will work closely with established, big-name brands to help them realise value from their investment in Braze.

What you’ll do

• Partner with Account Executives to ensure commercial alignment & drive client renewals, retention & net retention targets for your customers

• Be your customers’ main point of contact and trusted advisor at Braze

• Drive feature adoption by building a shared Success Plan with your customers, providing strategic guidance, enablement, and day-to-day advice to help them hit their objectives with Braze

• Drive customer advocacy by building strong customer relationships and creating mutual value for your customers and Braze

• Be a strategic thought leader for your customers, analyzing use-cases and recommending market/vertical best practices to enhance client marketing programs.

• Advocate for your customers, soliciting and synthesizing customer product feedback to contribute to product development

• In addition to being a dedicated contact for strategy, product training inquiries, and non-technical support for your direct accounts coordinate with other Braze teams including Technical Support, Industry Solutions, and Deliverability Services to ensure your customers receive the support they need simply and seamlessly

• Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity.

• Act as a point of escalation for customers

• Provide mentorship to colleagues, acting as a subject matter expert you will take the initiative to help them improve processes, execution, and outcomes

• You will assist junior colleagues by taking temporary assignments to help them rescue at-risk accounts and capitalise on high opportunity accounts through mentoring and engaging directly with the customer

• You will likely spend time onsite with customers and may travel internationally

Please note this job description cannot possibly cover every duty you may need to undertake, you may be asked by your line manager to handle other reasonable responsibilities commensurate with the role.

Who you are

You are a proven customer success professional, with an excellent track record, who finds satisfaction in helping your customers achieve great things and in helping your colleagues grow. You have an excellent track record in customer success or a related role and are excited to work with big name brands with over 1,000 staff.  You want to lead by example as a senior individual contributor.

• You have significant project management experience and/or formal certifications (PMP, Agile, etc).

• You have exemplary written and verbal communication skills coupled with unparalleled follow up skills. Clients have the impression that you listen and understand their problems.

• You’re known for being a “team player.” We just can’t emphasize this enough.

• High level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others.

• You have strong technical domain knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Analytics or Programming (HTML etc).

• 6 years+ experience managing complex international enterprise accounts (Fortune 100, FTSE, DAX, etc. - ACV of $500K or more) across multiple senior client stakeholders at a SaaS company

• You have a proven track record as a Success Manager, renewing and growing customers

• West Coast location is preferred (but not required)

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $79,200 and $112,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $99,000 and $140,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

• To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

• To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com.

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

jobs.title: Lead Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARGE:

Charge Robotics is a Series A startup building robots that build solar farms.

Demand for new solar projects is booming (1/5th of all the solar that exists in the US was installed last year!), but today’s construction companies can’t keep up due to limited labor resources.

We thought this was insane, so we started working on robots to directly address this bottleneck and speed up the world’s transition to renewables.

Charge is a fast-moving company which means constant opportunities for learning and growth. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company and our product, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. And you get to work with 🤖 giant robots 🤖.

If you are excited to work on interesting technical problems with direct climate impact, you’re going to fit right in at Charge Robotics.

Read more about Charge in recent press:

 - Fast Company - Solar Building Robots to Solve One of Climate's Biggest Problems https://www.fastcompany.com/91108331/these-solar-assembling-robotic-arms-could-solve-one-of-the-industrys-biggest-problems

Charge’s funding:

We’re MIT-founded and backed by top generalist and climate tech investors, including Lux Capital and Y Combinator (S21).

You'll be substantially responsible for growing our passionate and amazing team as we work together to transform the solar industry.




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Build our talent function and recruiting processes from scratch

 - Own the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to negotiating and closing

 - Be a strategic partner to hiring managers across the company, collaborating on candidate strategy and ensuring that hiring goals are met in a timely manner with top-tier candidates

 - Report to and collaborate closely with our founder/CEO

 - Be the face of Charge Robotics and help us build a stellar employer brand

 - Have 5+ years of experience doing full-cycle recruiting for technical roles

 - Have excellent verbal and written communication skills

 - Have superb negotiation and relationship management skills

 - Are detail-oriented with a ruthless ability to prioritize

 - Have a metrics-driven mindset, leveraging data to understand pipeline health and improve velocity, quality, retention

 - Believe in treating all people with dignity and respect, regardless of title or tenure

 - Are proficient in ATS and other HR technologies to support data-driven decision-making and process optimization. A few tools that we use: Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Gusto

jobs.title: Solar Maintenance Technician II – Field Operations (Batesville, MS)
jobs.description:
Silicon Ranch is a fully integrated provider of customized renewable energy, carbon, and battery storage solutions for a diverse set of partners across North America.

• We are known for putting community partnerships first, and are the only renewable energy company in the U.S. that owns and operates all of its solar ranches and has a 100% track record for successful delivery.

• We have the largest utility scale agrivoltaics portfolio in the country under Regenerative Energy®, our nationally recognized holistic approach to project design, construction, and land management. Our model incorporates regenerative ranching and other regenerative land management practices to restore livelihoods and soil health, biodiversity, and water quality.

• Through our subsidiary, Clearloop, we are able to help businesses of all sizes reclaim their carbon footprint with a direct investment in building new solar projects while also helping bring renewable energy and economic development to distressed communities.

By joining Silicon Ranch, you will be joining a team of experienced and dedicated individuals who have proven time and again that it is indeed possible to not only “make solar do more”, but to make the promise of carbon-free, renewable energy that benefits people right where it comes from a tangible, measurable, and replicable reality.

Silicon Ranch is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is reflective of the communities in which we work and serve. We are an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Job Description

Position: Solar Maintenance Technician II – Field Operations

Location: On-site, Batesville, MS

Overview: This position is responsible for the performance of corrective and preventative maintenance tasks within a defined set of facilities. These tasks include the inspection, troubleshooting, diagnosis, and remedy of issues impacting the production of the solar PV facility. This includes repair and/or replacement of electrical and mechanical components and subcomponents such as contactors, breakers, motors, bearings, PV modules, PLCs, transformers, etc. This position may also act as a safety second and assist more senior technicians as needed.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a strong mechanical inclination and verifiable experience performing in the electrical trade, electrical or multicraft maintenance, or solar operations and maintenance. COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

KKR REAL ESTATE CREDIT AND K-STAR INVESTMENT SERVICES OVERVIEW

KKR Real Estate Credit was formed in January 2015 to invest in real estate credit products and complement KKR Real Estate’s private equity platforms. Within KKR Real Estate Credit, we seek opportunities where we have a sourcing, underwriting or execution advantage by leveraging KKR’s brand, industry knowledge and relationships. KKR Real Estate Credit currently invests through eight separately capitalized vehicles across our Direct Lending and Securities portfolios and consists of 120+ dedicated professionals based in New York, San Francisco, Houston and Dallas.

K-Star Asset Management LLC ("K-Star") was formed in 2022 and is a wholly owned subsidiary of KKR. K-Star is a dedicated investment services platform that supports underwriting, asset management, loan origination, securities investing, risk management, and client experience for KKR Real Estate Credit as it continues to scale. The K-Star team includes industry specialists in special servicing, asset management, due diligence, and loan closing, among other functional areas. For additional information about K-Star, please visit K-Star’s website at www.ksam.com.

POSITION OVERVIEW

K-Star is seeking an intelligent, analytical, and proactive asset manager to join the Credit Asset Management team. The asset manager will be responsible for the oversight and reporting on a portfolio of loans secured by stabilized, light to high transitional and possibly construction projects located throughout the United States. The asset management team takes the lead in all required loan modifications including foreclosures up to title transfers. The qualified candidate will also be expected to participate in special projects and assignments related to the growth of the platform. With a goal of process development and execution, this candidate must be an exceptional communicator and have the ability to build strong partnerships across the various KKR businesses, including the Firm’s real estate credit originations, legal, finance, and asset management teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Analyze and evaluate draw requests, lease approvals, loan modifications and various other borrower requests and periodic underwriting of collateral

• Monitor portfolio performance for potential adverse credit issues and trend analyses

• Analyze and utilize monthly and/or quarterly financial statements and rent rolls with comparison against underwriting and budgets

• Monitor national, regional and local market dynamics to assess tenant credit risks and concentrations

• Prepare and present asset performance reports to company management and other investor parties

• Collaborate with construction consultants and other members of the project team to monitor schedules, budgets, leasing and business plans in real time

• Interpret complex loan documents to confirm and track satisfaction of relevant loan terms and covenants

• Work closely with investment team on relationship management of transaction sponsor

• Partner with internal and external legal counsel when evaluating legal issues and documenting various transactions arising from the asset management of the portfolio

• Mentor and coach portfolio analysts in analyzing operating statements and rent rolls and supporting other asset management responsibilities

• Manage special projects, including implementation of new technologies to support K-Star’s platform

• Travel on an as needed basis

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferably in a related course of study

• 5-7+ years of related work experience in asset management of loans secured by commercial real estate

• Fundamental knowledge of commercial real estate, fixed income, and general financial concepts

• Superior analytical and financial modeling skills

• Excellent organizational, verbal, and communication skills

• Exceptional attention to detail and thoroughness is required to ensure accuracy in all data and work product

• High proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook

• Special Servicing, Argus, construction loan or development experience a plus

• Team Player with collaborative and strong relationship building skills with the ability to work independently in a way that reflects the company’s culture and core values

• Skilled at developing and maintaining personal, social and business relationships representing KKR in a professional manner
