jobs.title: Senior Estimator – Industrial and Maritime Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Construction Estimator to support large-scale industrial and maritime construction projects and programs. This role will be responsible for developing, managing, and validating estimates throughout the project lifecycle, from early feasibility and conceptual planning through detailed design and preconstruction.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive estimating experience within industrial, maritime, port, shipyard, marine, manufacturing, heavy industrial, or complex infrastructure projects. They will have a strong understanding of construction methodologies, market conditions, labor and material pricing, quantity takeoffs, value engineering, and cost benchmarking. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and project teams, providing accurate, data-driven cost guidance that supports strategic project decisions and successful project outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you must be an excellent communicator with a proven track record of delivering accurate estimates across multiple project phases and geographic regions. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

• Developing cost plans and estimates from concept through detailed design across multiple geographic regions; with internal and external staff.
• Delivering and presenting updated cost plans at appropriate design milestones.
• Experience in providing program-level estimates for specific scopes of work
• Coordinate, manage, and supervise the work of support staff.
• Reviewing proposed design changes/new technologies and preparing estimates within appropriate accuracy levels.
• Help drive cost model trends by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing cost information from completed projects.
• Assess cost effectiveness of alternate products and value engineering ideas at a program level.
• Support training to Development and external Estimating teams on new project estimating tools/templates.
• Support preparation of leadership presentations for the client’s Preconstruction and Estimating team.
• Delivering Life Cycle Costing models.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
• Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience
• Experience in a construction cost management role such as Cost Manager, Quantity Surveyor, Estimator, Cost Engineer, Project Engineer, Project Cost Controls etc.
• Experience providing conceptual estimating services and/or pre-construction services at a construction management or related firm.
• Experience supporting large scale construction projects and programs
• Good knowledge of construction industry technical matters, such as value management and value engineering.
• Excellent communication skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $135K-$160K USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a GRC Analyst to join our Compliance & Security team and help make risk management, audit and compliance a continuous part of how Supabase runs. You’ll work closely with engineering, security, IT, and legal to help us define our risk tolerance, keep our compliance programs (including SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022) current, test controls on a rolling basis, and answer customer and vendor security reviews quickly and accurately.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Run risk assessments across the company and major product changes. Score likelihood and impact, propose treatments, and bring the results to leadership to inform risk tolerance decisions.

 - Maintain the risk register, track remediation to closure, and report status to compliance and security leadership.

 - Monitor controls on a rolling basis, using automated tests where they exist and manual testing where they don’t. Triage failures, prioritize by the risk register, and align each finding with an owner and a due date.

 - Support internal audit, whether performed by an external partner or in-house: propose scope from the risk register, supply evidence, and track findings to closure.

 - Run day-to-day operations for our compliance programs: evidence collection, control owner follow-up, and readiness ahead of each audit period.

 - Extend continuous control validation beyond what our compliance platform covers. Build custom tests with AI coding tools, work with engineering and IT to pull evidence from source systems instead of collecting screenshots, and check that each test proves what the control requires.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 3+ years of experience in GRC, internal audit, or security compliance at a SaaS or technology company

 - Are comfortable working with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, a compliance platform such as Drata, Vanta, and evidence from systems like AWS, GCP, Google Workspace, and Okta

 - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

 - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Corporate- Accountant- Washington DC
jobs.description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, and Bedford, IN, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an experienced Corporate Accountant to support accounts receivable, accounts payable, and general ledger activities. Reporting to the Controller, this role manages government contract billing, collections, vendor and employee payments, reconciliations, and closing support. The successful candidate is a detail-oriented self-starter who meets deadlines, resolves discrepancies, and maintains accurate records and strong internal controls.

Accounts Payable and Employee Expenses

• Process vendor and PO invoices, rent, utilities, and employee reimbursements in Costpoint; verify coding and documentation, coordinate approvals, prepare payments, and resolve discrepancies and reclassifications.

• Review and approve expense reports within delegated authority or return them for correction; manage T&E exports and imports, review and post resulting vouchers, and help employees with expense authorizations and receipt issues.

• Reconcile corporate credit card activity and suspense balances, coordinate cardholder coding, and maintain vendor records, the invoices inbox, and supporting documents in SharePoint.

Accounts Receivable

• Prepare, review, and submit cost-reimbursement, FFP, and T&M government customer invoices through WAWF/PIEE, IPP, or customer portal/email, with supporting documentation.

• Maintain complete billing packages and submission records in SharePoint.

• Record cash receipts, monitor aging, and follow up with customers on outstanding invoices, revisions and payment discrepancies.

Payroll

• Coordinate timecard completion with project managers and business unit leads; reconcile timesheets to labor distribution and investigate discrepancies.

• Perform gross and net payroll variance analysis by employee, research differences, and coordinate corrections with the appropriate teams.

Procurement

• Track purchase requisitions and approval status; retain vendor quotes and supporting procurement documentation.

• Create and issue purchase orders within the accounting system in accordance with approved requisitions and company procedures.

General Ledger Reporting and Accounting Support

• Prepare supported journal entries, accruals, amortization, and corrections; reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts and AR/AP subledgers to the general ledger.

• Support monthly and year-end close and respond to audit requests with accurate schedules, analyses, and transaction documentation.

• Prepare weekly AR/AP aging and billing status reports, recommend vendor payments, attend the weekly AR/AP meeting, and distribute reports every Thursday morning.

• Coordinate timecard completion with project managers and business unit leads; maintain project workforce assignments, labor categories, and charge codes.

• Update contract modification summaries and Costpoint modification history; maintain accounting records and procedures, improve processes, and protect confidential information.

Required Qualifications

• U.S. Person status and eligibility to obtain a security clearance

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or an equivalent combination of relevant education and progressive accounting experience.

• Three to eight years of relevant experience with a small to midsize government contractor, including AP, general ledger accounting, and customer invoicing.

• Hands-on proficiency with Deltek Costpoint 8, including billing, AR, AP, and general ledger functions.

• Working knowledge of government contract accounting, cost-reimbursement, FFP, and T&M billing, FAR cost principles, and DCAA audit requirements.

• Knowledge of applicable GSA and JTR travel requirements and employee expense review.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for reconciliations, analysis, and supporting schedules.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills; attention to detail; and the ability to meet deadlines and work independently and collaboratively.

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated compensation range for this position is $85,000–$100,000 annually. The stated range represents Barbaricum’s good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, education, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable contract requirements.

Benefits: Eligible employees are offered a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan with company contributions; accrued paid time off (PTO) for vacation and sick leave; paid company holidays; and other applicable leave and voluntary benefit programs. Benefit eligibility, coverage, and terms are governed by the applicable benefit plans and company policies.

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - PubMatic AgenticOS (Buy Side Bidding Platform)
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Principal Software Engineer - PubMatic AgenticOS to lead the design and development of highly scalable, low-latency buy-side ad tech systems. This role is ideal for someone with deep expertise in Golang, real-time bidding systems, and campaign pacing and optimization algorithms, with strong exposure to DSP / performance advertising domains.

As a technical leader, you will own critical components of the bidding and optimization stack, influence system architecture, mentor senior and junior engineers, and work closely with product, ML, and data teams to drive measurable performance outcomes across large-scale advertising campaigns.

What You'll Do

• Architect, design, and build high-throughput, ultra-low-latency real-time bidding systems for buy-side advertising platforms.

• Lead development of bidder services handling millions of QPS with strict latency and reliability SLAs using Golang/C/C++.

• Design and implement campaign pacing, budget management, and delivery optimization algorithms across multiple objectives (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR).

• Own core systems for deal execution, auction participation, bid shading, and supply path optimization.

• Build and evolve real-time and near-real-time data pipelines for impressions, clicks, conversions, and attribution using Kafka, Flink, or Spark.

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers to productionize models such as bid optimization, contextual bandits, reach forecasting, and incrementality models.

• Integrate and maintain support for programmatic advertising protocols (OpenRTB, VAST, CTV-specific standards).

• Drive architectural decisions around scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and latency optimization.

• Ensure data quality, governance, privacy, and compliance across the performance advertising stack.

• Conduct deep performance profiling, latency tuning, and debugging of distributed systems in production.

• Mentor engineers, set coding and design standards, and lead technical reviews across teams.

• Evaluate and introduce new technologies, auction strategies, and optimization frameworks to keep the platform competitive.

We'd Love for You to Have

• Eight plus years of software engineering experience, with significant depth in ad tech / performance advertising/Building DSP bidder (Buy side).

• Strong hands-on experience with Golang in building low-latency, high-scale backend systems.

• Proven experience designing and operating real-time bidding platforms, bidders, or ad serving systems.

• Deep understanding of campaign pacing, budget allocation, and performance optimization algorithms.

• Experience with streaming and distributed systems (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).

• Strong familiarity with OpenRTB, VAST, and programmatic advertising workflows.

• Solid knowledge of SQL,PostgreSQL and large-scale analytics platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and distributed system design.

• Experience working cross-functionally with product, data science, analytics, and ML teams.

• Demonstrated ability to own systems end-to-end, influence architecture, and deliver at scale.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to drive technical direction and mentor others.

Qualifications:

• Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well-known Institutes / Universities.

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide such as, paid leave programs, paid holidays, healthcare, dental and vision insurance, disability and life insurance, commuter benefits, physical and financial wellness programs, unlimited DTO in the US (that we actually require you to use!), reimbursement for mobile and fully stocked pantries plus in-office catered lunches 5 days per week.

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

#LI-HYBRID

New hires and current team members are typically compensated toward the middle of our pay range. The actual amount may vary, based on non-discriminatory factors such as location, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities. In addition to salary PubMatic also offers a bonus and a competitive benefits package.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

jobs.title: Test Engineer, Pilot Reactor Systems
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Lydian is developing the lowest cost sustainable fuels from waste CO2, water, and renewable electricity to decarbonize the aviation industry. Our breakthrough technology replaces oil and gas refining with fully electrified, modular, and flexible reactor systems that produce fuel with 95% lower emissions than traditional jet fuel.

Since our founding in 2021, Lydian has achieved key milestones in record time, including the production of our first liquid fuel from our pilot system, capable of producing ~10,000 gallons of fuel per year for a fraction of the capital and time of alternative approaches. Lydian is backed by top climate investors including Congruent Ventures, Galvanize Climate Solutions, Union Square Ventures, Voyager Ventures, Grok Ventures, and Overture. We are building a motivated, diverse, and collaborative team that is passionate about addressing the growing climate crisis and is committed to excellence in their work. In particular, we look for tenacious people who are energized by solving the hardest, highest impact problems that come their way.



POSITION OVERVIEW

Lydian is looking for a Test Engineer, Pilot Reactor Systems. Reporting to Lydian's Pilot Test Lead, you will plan and execute test campaigns on our pilot-scale reactors. You will take charge of day-to-day pilot test preparation, operations, and troubleshooting. In collaboration with the Pilot Test Lead and other engineers, you will contribute to experiment design and planning, data analysis, and presenting results to the broader team. As a front-line test engineer, you will identify critical needs for system improvements or upgrades and collaborate with teammates on design, procurement, and implementation.

We are looking for someone who can build a test plan, execute it, and troubleshoot any issues that arise. We need someone with a keen eye for seeing what matters most, as well as the confidence, planning prowess, and hands on lab skills to execute their ideas. You'll work closely with process, mechanical and controls engineers on bringing reactors online and operating them. Our ideal candidate loves working in the lab to get things done rigorously, safely, and with a sense of urgency.

This role is based onsite in Charlestown, MA and requires in-person collaboration five days per week.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop experiment plans: Work with the Pilot Test Lead to translate testing campaign objectives into detailed plans, including operating conditions, required measurements, test sequences, and success criteria. Take ownership of assigned tests from preparation through analysis, with plans and significant changes reviewed by the lead

 - Execute pilot tests: Help prepare, start up, monitor and shut down pilot reactor campaigns, including shift coverage during extended runs. Assemble and install reactor components. Run the pilot systems through the HMI, adjust setpoints per the test plan, respond to alarms and necessary troubleshooting, and log observations. Work with teammates including technicians and engineers to ensure rapid turnaround and high uptime on test systems including run monitoring and troubleshooting outside of normal work hours.

 - System commissioning, maintenance, and upgrades: Develop a deep understanding of our reactor architecture, sub-component design, and testing platforms. Troubleshoot and resolve software, electronic, fluid handling, and mechanical issues on test equipment. Help install instrumentation, commission test stands, perform routine maintenance. Collaborate with teammates to redesign reactors, components, and infrastructure to expand our testing capabilities

 - Document and standardize: help improve existing procedures; develop and document newly developed methods

 - Improve the process: spot issues during runs and suggest changes to hardware, procedures or the test plan

 - Manage and analyze data: keep rigorous experiment records and maintain accurate experiment databases; support processing time-series data to determine key reactor performance metrics and trends

 - Present results: Analyze, document, and present experimental data and results. Use past results to drive future experimental direction, and communicate plans to the team

 - Work safely: follow and help improve SOPs, lockout/tagout, and gas-handling procedures; contribute to hazard reviews before new tests




QUALIFICATIONS




REQUIRED

 - B.S. or higher in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field

 - 2+ years of experience in a lab setting, executing tests and analyzing data

 - Strong attention to detail, with prior hands-on experience in assembly and testing of laboratory systems such as reactors, electrolyzers, or other process equipment

 - Comfort with hand tools, mechanical assembly, and reading P&IDs and mechanical drawings

 - Ability to apply engineering principles including thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat and mass transport to analyze experimental data and solve problems

 - Comfortable working independently to define and execute projects

 - Clear written and verbal communication; able to turn a dataset into a short, well-organized summary

 - Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

 - Enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and at times outside of normal working hours, is energized by challenges, and relishes in getting the job done




PREFERRED

 - Familiarity with Ignition, LabView, DAQFactory or another data acquisition platform

 - Experience with reactor operation, mass and energy balances

 - Experience handling compressed or flammable gases

 - Basic understanding of PID control and instrumentation

 - Experience with design of experiments (DOE) or statistical analysis

 - CAD experience

 - Experience developing and writing Standard Operating Procedures

 - Prior startup experience




COMPANY CULTURE AND BENEFITS

 - Challenging, collaborative, and meaningful work and an important voice in company development

 - Competitive salary commensurate with experience

 - Meaningful equity compensation

 - Unlimited PTO and expectation that all employees take significant time off to rest, recharge, and enjoy life outside work

 - Excellent insurance with 100% of healthcare, vision, and dental premiums covered for the employee, and 80% coverage for dependents

 - 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Communications Manager
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States; Chicago, Illinois, United States
jobs.description:
Chart Your Journey at Secretariat

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT THE FIRM

Secretariat professionals are trusted in the highest-stakes legal, risk, and regulatory matters around the world.

When you join Secretariat, you become part of a rapidly growing elite team of bright minds and passionate problem-solvers. Your skills and expertise will be utilized on day one – working with the world’s most renowned law firms, leading corporations, and influential institutions to answer complex questions that shape critical financial, economic, and strategic business decisions.

Our globally integrated teams are united by the ambition, energy, and commitment they bring to every challenge. We inspire and empower an open, collaborative culture that embraces ongoing professional development, recognition, diversity, and – most importantly – you.

Make your impact at Secretariat.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Communications Manager plans and delivers firmwide communications that convey a consistent Secretariat voice and perspectives across internal and external channels. The role helps expand the firm’s reputation-building initiatives, manages internal communications and employee engagement initiatives, and executes programs across awards and rankings, social media, and digital content. Working across practices, regions, and corporate functions, this person turns firm priorities and insights into clear, timely stories and campaigns.

Brand, Reputation & External Communications

• Execute firmwide external communications strategies to strengthen Secretariat’s reputation and support growth priorities through PR, digital channels, social media, and awards and rankings.

• Develop and edit website, campaign, social, email, and digital content; package announcements, research, events, and expert insights for relevant audiences and channels in collaboration with design and digital colleagues.

• Develop and pitch media stories based on firm news, research, and expert perspectives; prepare press and spokesperson materials, and coordinate interviews and media inquiries.

• Help prioritize awards and rankings based on strategic value; manage submissions with practices and leadership, working with the Marketing & Communications Associate to coordinate deadlines and maintain the awards calendar.

• Contribute to social media strategies, identifying opportunities to amplify executive and expert perspectives and engage target audiences.

• Contribute to firmwide messaging and editorial standards so external communications reflect a consistent, credible Secretariat voice.

• Track results of communications initiatives, including media coverage, awards outcomes, and digital and social performance; use the results to refine plans and recommend changes to priorities.

Internal Communications & Employee Engagement

• Partner with HR, Talent, Learning, and practice leaders to shape and coordinate internal communications campaigns supporting recruiting, onboarding, recognition, culture, and employee engagement.

• Oversee the continued development of the firm’s global intranet, The Post, setting content priorities and identifying improvements that increase its reach and usefulness to employees.

• Work with leaders and corporate teams to develop messages about firm priorities, organizational changes, milestones, and employee programs; draft high-priority communications and guide their delivery to different internal audiences.

• Set priorities and coordinate stakeholders, reviews, and approvals across internal communications channels, working with the Marketing & Communications Associate on implementation and using results to improve future communications.

Practice Content & Firmwide Promotion

• Partner with practice marketers and the Editorial Manager to plan how thought leadership, client alerts, and other expert-led content will be published and promoted.

• Bring practice, regional, and expert stories into firmwide campaigns and channels, identifying opportunities to connect related work across the firm.

• Advise on audience, framing, and messaging for high-visibility practice initiatives, helping teams present expert insights in a consistent Secretariat voice.

• Coordinate approvals, communications support staff, and external partners to keep cross-practice content moving on schedule and improve shared workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

• At least six years of experience planning and executing communications in a professional services, consulting, legal, or similarly complex expert-led environment.

• Strong writing, editing, and interviewing skills, with sound judgment and the ability to work with senior leaders and translate technical subjects for different audiences.

• Demonstrated experience with internal communications and public relations, including media pitching and spokesperson preparation.

• Ability to manage simultaneous initiatives, build relationships across teams, and use performance data to guide decisions. Use data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to continuously improve programs, processes, and return on marketing investment.

A rewarding career above all

There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure.

Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself.

Our people are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers.

To learn how Secretariat collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
ABOUT FARMRAISE

FarmRaise helps farmers unlock the programs that pay them for good stewardship. Our platform, Passport, lets partners launch and run grower programs, from government grants to conservation and low-carbon incentives such as the federal 45Z clean fuel credit.

We work with land-grant universities, government agencies and some of the largest agribusinesses in North America. As enterprise partners scale with us, we're launching Grower Concierge: a white-glove service that guides every grower from welcome to audit-ready records, delivered in our partner's name.




THE ROLE

We're a nimble, fast-moving team, so you'll have true ownership from day one and see your impact immediately. You'll own everything a partner experiences after the contract is signed: implementation, ongoing success, renewal, and the Grower Concierge service their growers rely on. This is a builder role. You'll take the playbook we're running today, scale it and make it your own. Treat Grower Concierge like a business you're launching inside FarmRaise, owning its customers, team, quality and economics. You'll set the strategy and still be on partner calls and in the details. You'll be part of our leadership, partnering directly with our founding team. A great first year means partners launch fast and renew, growers finish what they start, and Grower Concierge runs as a profitable, repeatable service.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The partner journey. Own the lifecycle from sales handoff through implementation, adoption and renewal, and partner with sales to grow each account. Cut the time from signed contract to live program.

 - Grower Concierge. Launch and grow our white-glove grower service as its own business line: hire, train and manage a seasonal team, evolve the playbook, and own quality, results and unit economics.

 - The team. Lead and develop implementation, partner success and concierge staff. Set clear roles, hand-offs and escalation paths.

 - A repeatable operating system. Turn what works into templates, playbooks and after-action reviews, so every new partner launch is easier than the last.

 - Metrics. Define and report partner health, grower outcomes, satisfaction and cost to serve.

 - Executive relationships. Be the senior day-to-day partner for enterprise accounts, alongside our founders.

 - The voice of the customer. Turn partner and grower feedback into clear, prioritized input for product and engineering.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must-haves

 - 7+ years in customer success, implementation or account management, including 3+ years leading teams.

 - An entrepreneurial track record: you've built something from scratch, such as a company, a new service line or a team, and owned its results.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: you make good calls with incomplete information, then adjust fast.

 - Experience managing hourly or seasonal teams and training them on complex, rules-heavy work.

 - Executive presence with enterprise customers, and comfort being the face of the company.

 - Fluency with operating metrics and the cost of delivering a service.

 - Experience using automation or AI to scale a service team.

Nice-to-haves

 - A background in agriculture, or experience working with farmers.

 - Experience with government, conservation or carbon programs.

 - Contact center or managed-service operations experience.


THE DETAILS

This is a remote role based anywhere in the United States, with periodic travel to partners and team offsites. The base salary is $150,000–$175,000, depending on experience, and the total package includes performance-based variable compensation and equity. We also offer competitive health, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k), flexible paid time off and a remote-work setup stipend.

FarmRaise is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds!

jobs.title: Telehealth Physician (MD/DO) - Remote, Geriatric
jobs.description:
🏥 ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

For most older adults, healthcare doesn’t fail in one place—it fails across many. Mental health, physical health, medications, and day-to-day realities all interact, but the system treats them separately. The result is confusion, missed care, and worsening outcomes.

Sailor Health is building a new model of care for older adults that brings the mind and the body together. We combine behavioral health, medical insight, and hands-on care navigation to help patients and families understand what’s going on and what to do next. By taking a more holistic and preventative approach, we aim to catch issues earlier, reduce avoidable crises, and keep patients in their homes instead of the hospital.




⭐ ABOUT THE ROLE

You are the clinical gateway for patients navigating chronic conditions and complex care needs. Through telehealth visits, you assess the full medical picture and partner closely with healthcare advocates to define and oversee care plans that patients can actually follow.

While therapists lead the work on the mind, you lead the clinical perspective on the body—bringing medical clarity to situations that are often fragmented or poorly coordinated.

You will be one of the first physicians in this role at Sailor, and you’ll play a key part in shaping how it evolves. We’re looking for someone who is excited by growth, comfortable with change, and motivated by the opportunity to help build something from the ground up while delivering excellent care.




💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Conduct comprehensive telehealth assessments for older adults with chronic and complex conditions

 - Identify clinical risks and gaps in care across diagnoses, medications, and recent utilization

 - Oversee patient care plans in partnership with healthcare advocates, addressing both medical needs and social determinants of health

 - Collaborate with therapists and care teams to ensure physical health is fully integrated into ongoing care




✅ WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - MD or DO, licensed in Florida, Maryland, Pennsylvania, and Texas and additional states preferred

 - Board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or related specialty

 - At least 5 hours of availability a week

 - Experience caring for patients with chronic and complex conditions, especially older adults

 - Strong clinical judgment and ability to synthesize incomplete information into clear plans

 - Comfortable using technology and excited about leveraging AI to improve care delivery

 - Passionate about mental health and holistic care

jobs.title: Executive Affairs Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Office of the President, North America is hiring an Executive Affairs Program Manager — a rare blend of senior executive assistant and program manager who can run the full mechanics of a demanding executive office while exercising real judgment about what deserves the President's attention.

This role builds on traditional executive support with greater ownership of decisions, preparation and follow-through. You’ll be trusted to resolve routine matters on the President’s behalf, shape the information she needs for key engagements, and coordinate across teams to ensure decisions translate into completed actions.

It will suit someone who has supported a senior executive in a high-stakes, externally visible environment, is energized by ambiguity, moves without being asked twice, and can hold their own with senior internal leaders and external partners alike.

Key responsibilities:

Calendar & executive time management

• Manage a complex executive calendar aligned to strategic priorities set by the President and the VP of Commercial Operations & Strategic Programs, executing against those priorities day to day.
• Serve as the single point of entry for scheduling requests, coordinating across Executive Assistants, external executive offices and event organizers.
• Hold protected time, resolve conflicts early, and keep the calendar accurate and current at all times.
• Provide a rolling two-to-three-week forward look, surfacing conflicts with lead time and a proposed solution rather than raising them the morning of.

Travel, expenses & logistics

• Own domestic and international travel end to end — booking, itineraries, visas, ground transport and on-the-ground logistics.
• Manage expense reporting and reimbursement, including receipt capture, coding, submission and approval tracking.
• Handle invoices, purchase requests and vendor coordination on behalf of the office.
• Track budget for events, offsites and travel, flagging variances proactively.

Inbox management & decision filtering

• Read and triage the executive inbox daily — surfacing what matters, redirecting what belongs elsewhere, and closing what does not require the President.
• Draft correspondence and responses in the President's voice, and trigger the prep or follow-up an item requires rather than simply flagging it.
• Exercise delegated approval authority over defined categories of routine decisions — for example scheduling commitments, routine external confirmations, and approved quotes and standard requests — with full scope agreed during onboarding and a clear escalation line for anything outside it.
• Maintain a live view of open commitments, decisions and follow-ups so the President is never the system of record for her own actions.

Meeting readiness & briefings

• Own the prep standard for the office: tier every engagement, assign the owner, and ensure materials land ahead of time.
• Build briefings for board, client executive, partner and leadership engagements — objective, attendees and context, key issues, what good looks like, and what the team needs out of the session.
• Keep briefings current when engagements move or context changes; a rescheduled top-to-top gets a refreshed brief, not the original pack.
• Set the expectation upstream that anyone requesting executive time either runs a prep session in advance or books review time on the calendar.

Operating rhythm & follow-through

• Support the leadership operating rhythm — agendas, pre-reads, materials and run-of-show for recurring forums, leadership reviews and in-person sessions.
• Capture decisions and commitments from the President's meetings, assign owners and due dates, and drive them to closure, surfacing risk early rather than at the deadline.
• Maintain shared trackers, decision logs and document repositories so the office runs on a single source of truth.
• Identify friction in how the office operates and fix it — this role is expected to improve the operating model, not just execute it.

Stakeholder & external engagement

• Coordinate executive engagement with customers, strategic partners, industry organizations and external stakeholders.
• Close the loop on external commitments — confirmations, attendance and follow-ups — so nothing sits unanswered and credibility with key partners is protected.
• Maintain stakeholder context: relationship history, prior commitments, internal ownership, and what remains outstanding.
• Represent the Office of the President externally with polish and discretion.

Program & project delivery

• Manage discrete projects on behalf of the President — offsites, leadership events, cross-functional working sessions and special initiatives — from plan through delivery.
• Partner with the Commercial Initiatives PMO where executive commitments intersect with the initiative portfolio.
• Translate complex inputs into concise, decision-ready summaries for the President and her leadership team.

What success looks like:

• Calendar integrity- Nothing reaches the President's calendar that this role did not place or knowingly approve. Conflicts surface with lead time and a recommendation.
• Meeting readiness- Every engagement that matters has a current briefing in hand ahead of time. No walking in cold, no last-minute scrambles.
• Filtering- The President's attention goes to what only she can do. Routine items are closed without her, correctly.
• Follow-through- Decisions and commitments are tracked to done. Nothing is rediscovered late.
• External reliability- Commitments to external partners are confirmed, honored and closed out. No dropped threads.
• Judgment- Sound calls in situations no process anticipated, with escalation when the stakes warrant it.

• 8+ years supporting senior executives in an executive assistant, business operations, chief-of-staff, executive affairs or program management capacity.
• Proven track record operating with genuine autonomy — making judgment calls on an executive's behalf and being trusted with them.
• Strong program and project management discipline: planning, governance, tracking, and driving cross-functional work to closure.
• Exceptional written communication, including the ability to write credibly in an executive's voice.
• Executive presence and polish sufficient to represent the office with board members, senior clients and external partners.
• Comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias to action — able to work from direction rather than instruction.
• Absolute discretion with highly confidential and sensitive information.
• Advanced proficiency across Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint and Excel; fluency with AI-assisted ways of working is a strong plus.
• Experience in legal, banking, professional services or a similarly rigorous executive environment is preferred.
• Based in Chicago.

Our Benefits

• Flexible working environment
• Volunteer time off
• LinkedIn Learning
• Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

jobs.title: Branch Driver
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Branch Driver to join our PLATT team in Bakersfield, CA!

Summary:

The Branch Driver I is responsible for delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

What You'll Do:

• Inspect company vehicle for visual and operating defects; responsible for completing a daily inspection report
• Keep company vehicle clean, serviced, and maintained; alert supervisor of repair and/or service needed
• Must follow Department of Transportation (DOT), local and state driving laws and regulations
• Load or unload vehicle and ensure all material for each order is correct (quantity and type of material) and that material is free of damage before departure
• May assist in preparing orders for delivery
• Ensure all appropriate documentation is thoroughly completed at the time of delivery, including delivery receipt is signed by the customer, packing list and branch/warehouse manifest
• Pick up material returns from customers; responsible for inspecting the condition of the material and verifies quantities and catalog numbers
• Pick up material from company suppliers
• May be required to perform other job functions within a branch when required including but not limited to counter sales, preparing and filling orders and/or receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material, and maintaining branch equipment
• Perform other duties as assigned

Job Duties Disclaimer:

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

What You'll Need

• In lieu of experience, must attend company driver training
• Must have a valid driver’s license
• Must be at least 21 years of age
• Must pass a pre-employment and annual review of the Motor Vehicle Record
• Must obtain verification of non-expired medical certificate as required by law within 60 days of hire
• Must not have had a suspended driver's license for a traffic accident/violation within the past 3 years

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to handle basic issues and problems
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations and be familiar with traffic and driver laws
• Willingness to adhere to assigned routes, schedules, safety procedures, and transportation laws
• Excellent organizational and time management skills; ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Use hands to finger, handle, or feel: Operates a computer and other office machinery - Constantly – at least 51%
• Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl: Must be able to crouch down to stock shelves, pick up boxes, or position oneself to maintain computers in the lab/under desks/in server closet - Occasionally – up to 20%
• Climb or balance: Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder, forklift, pallet jack, or other warehouse equipment - Occasionally – up to 20%
• Talk, hear, taste, smell: Must be able to use senses to effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions - Constantly – at least 51%

Weight and Force Demands:

• Up to 10 pounds - Constantly – at least 51%
• Up to 25 pounds - Constantly – at least 51%
• Up to 50 pounds - Frequently – 21% to 50%

Working Environment:

• Exposed to electrical hazards; risk of electrical shock - Occasionally – up to 20%
• Handles or works with potentially dangerous equipment - Frequently – 21% to 50%
• Travels to offsite locations - Constantly – at least 51%

jobs.title: Environmental Driver Specialist CDLB
jobs.description:
In the CDL Driver role, you will be traveling to locations along an assigned route where you will be responsible for packing, transporting, and properly disposing of waste materials in accordance with our environmentally responsible policies and procedures. This position requires the maintenance of records with accuracy and attention to detail, the ability to follow instruction, and to work independently once provided proper training.

This position requires up to 4 overnights and some weekend work. You will be provided with a company card to pay for a hotel and given a daily stipend to cover food and other expenses.

Job Details

• Package and transport waste safely according to all federal, state, and local rules and regulations.
• Complete required paperwork in accordance with appropriate regulations and customer policies, practices, and procedures.
• Load and secure materials and waste or unload truck at various customer sites or Clean Earth locations.
• Prepare and load truck with necessary supplies.
• Provide the highest level of customer service to assigned accounts daily while communicating any issues to the Manager or Dispatcher for resolution.
• Perform a documented pre-trip and post-trip check on assigned truck prior to leaving and closing each day.
• Plan schedule/route based on customer needs by reviewing daily paperwork (e.g. manifests, route sheets, etc.).
• Follow routing software route schedule.
• Follow all DOT guidelines while driving.
• Perform other duties and responsibilities as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

• At least 21 years of age
• High School diploma or General Educational Development (GED) required
• Understand, read, and write English
• Able to repeatedly lift and carry up to 75 lbs.
• Able to stand, bend, and walk for extended periods of time
• Basic knowledge of Windows-based software (Word, Excel, etc)
• Willing and able to wear company-provided personal protective equipment such as eye protection, foot protection, Tyvek coveralls, and respirator (as needed)
• Valid Class B Commercial Driver’s License (CDL)
• Hazmat endorsement
• Able to pass a DOT physical, drug test, and DEA background check

Preferred Qualifications

• Valid TWIC Card
• At least 1 year of route driving experience
• Knowledge of hazardous materials and OSHA regulations

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Marketing
jobs.location: Rochester, New York; Cincinnati, Ohio; Allentown, Pennsylvania; High Point, North Carolina; West Palm Beach, Florida; Sarasota, Florida; Saint Petersburg, Florida; Irving, Texas; Tempe, Arizona; Phoenix, Arizona; New York, New York; Chicago, Illinois
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.
Overview

Leads the product marketing function for Paychex with accountability for the commercial strategy of every product set: the ideal customer profile, the positioning and value narrative, the pricing and packaging architecture, the go-to-market strategy, and the market intelligence that helps inform the product roadmap. Serves as the voice of the market inside Paychex, translating industry, buyer, competitive, and regulatory signal into evidence-based recommendations on what we build, who we build it for, what we charge, and how we win. Partners with Product to influence roadmap direction, owns the pricing and bundling recommendation brought to governance, and supplies the points of view and messaging strategy that Content, Design, Demand Generation, and Enablement execute against. Transforms product marketing from a request-driven execution function into a market-facing strategic partner to Product, Sales, Finance, and the broader organization — and builds the team, standards, decision rights, and operating cadence required to sustain it.

Responsibilities

• Market intelligence and roadmap partnership. Own continuous sensing of the HCM market — industry and technology trends, regulatory and compliance change, competitive movement, win/loss findings, analyst and channel influencer input, and market sizing. Bring a written, evidence-based point of view to every product roadmap review to influence prioritization and investment decisions, while Product Management retains the prioritization decision.
• Ideal customer profile and buyer insight. Own the definition, maintenance, publication, and organizational adoption of the ICP, buyer and user personas, buying committee dynamics, and journey maps for every product set. Establish the voice-of-customer research program — primary interviews, advisory boards, and survey research — and hold the organization accountable to targeting, building for, and serving the profiles defined.
• Pricing, packaging, and bundling strategy. Own the monetization strategy, analysis, and recommendation for each product set: pricing model and metric, tiering, packaging fences, bundle architecture, willingness-to-pay research, competitive price positioning, price change programs, and discount guardrails. Partner with Finance, Product, and Sales for input and modeling, and secure approval through the pricing governance forum.
• Positioning, messaging, and value narrative. Own portfolio-level and product-level positioning and the messaging architecture that cascades across every channel. Translate product capability into customer benefits and quantified business outcomes, deliver points of view and messaging briefs to Content, Design, Demand Generation, Brand, and Enablement, and govern message consistency across the enterprise.
• Launch and go-to-market orchestration. Own the launch tiering model, go-to-market plans, and cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Sales, Enablement, Service, Compliance, and the partner channel. Hold go/no-go authority on go-to-market readiness, accountability for 30/60/90-day post-launch performance, and ownership of end-of-life and migration go-to-market.
• Lifecycle, adoption, and expansion. Own the post-sale commercial narrative: activation and time-to-value messaging, feature adoption strategy, cross-sell and attach strategy by ICP, the retention and renewal narrative, and the customer proof and reference agenda.
• Talent, structure, and capability building. Build and lead a team organized by product set, including Directors and Principal or Senior Product Marketing Managers. Define the job architecture and competency model, assess and develop existing talent, recruit scarce capabilities in pricing and monetization, competitive intelligence, and primary research, and coach the team to author and defend points of view.
• Executive influence, governance, and measurement. Represent the market point of view to executive leadership. Establish and operate the interlocks the function depends on — roadmap review participation, the pricing governance forum, and messaging governance — and define and report the business outcome metrics that replace activity-based measures of the function.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Communications, or related field - Required
• Master's Degree in MBA or related advanced degree - Preferred
• 12 years + Product marketing, product management, or commercial strategy in a B2B technology, SaaS, or business services environment, including responsibility for a multi-product portfolio.
• 5 years of experience in Leading a product marketing team, including leading other people leaders, with accountability for hiring, developing, and organizing the function.
• 3 years of experience in Direct ownership of pricing, packaging, or monetization strategy with measurable accountability for revenue, margin, or attach outcomes. - Preferred
• 3 years of experience in Influencing product roadmap decisions through market, buyer, and competitive evidence in a matrixed organization, without direct authority over the roadmap.
• 3 years of experience in HCM, payroll, HR technology, benefits, insurance, or financial services experience serving small and mid-sized business customers. - Preferred
• Transforming a product marketing function from a request-driven, execution-oriented model to a strategic, market-facing one. - Preferred
• Market sensing and synthesis Expert
• Customer and buyer insight Expert
• Commercial and monetization acumen Expert
• Narrative and message craft Expert
• Go-to-market orchestration Expert
• Influence without authority Expert
• Executive communication Expert
• Analytical rigor and measurement Advanced
• Organizational leadership and talent development Advanced
• Decisiveness under ambiguity Expert

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the starting base pay range for this position is $240,000 - $290,000 annually. Please keep in mind that this range is the base pay only and does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range.

Live the Paychex Values

• Act with uncompromising integrity.

• Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.

• Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.

• Work in partnership and support each other.

• Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.

• Treat each other with respect and dignity.
What's in it for you?

• We value your well-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) + employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.

• We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.

• We value your development: Our award-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.

• We value your perspective: Our company culture reflects the diversity of our employees. We want you to be you and your voice to be heard.

• We value our communities: We offer paid time off for volunteerism and promote many company-wide and local initiatives that benefit organizations you care about.

Note: The benefits described apply to full-time employees. Benefits for part-time, contract, and intern roles may vary.
Not sure if you meet every requirement?

At Paychex, we know that great talent comes in many forms. If you're passionate about the role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the right fit - either for this position or another opportunity with us.

jobs.title: Procurement Supervisor
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Procurement Supervisor to serve as the operational lead to our site-level buyers. This is a pivotal role at Techo-Bloc — one that keeps the procurement team aligned, supported, and running at a high level across all sites.

You will be the first point of contact for our Procurement team on day-to-day challenges — helping resolve supplier issues, setting priorities, reviewing complex purchasing decisions, and coordinating across departments. At the same time, you will carry your own portfolio of suppliers and purchasing responsibilities, setting the standard for what great procurement execution looks like at Techo-Bloc.

This role is ideal for someone who has grown beyond individual-contributor procurement work and is ready to take on a leadership dimension — someone who builds trust with their team, thrives in a fast-paced operational environment, and is motivated by team success as much as personal execution.

Key Responsibilities

Team Support & Supervision

• Act as the primary day-to-day resource and first escalation point for site buyers, providing guidance on purchasing decisions, supplier issues, and cross-functional coordination.
• Help the team prioritize urgent needs, shortages, and competing demands across multiple sites.
• Support onboarding, training, and the ongoing development of procurement team
• Monitor team purchasing activity and flag risks or escalations to the Procurement Manager as needed.
• Ensure purchasing controls, documentation standards, and process consistency are maintained across the team.
• Run regular team check-ins, support workload balancing, and contribute to performance feedback, objective follow-up, and coverage planning.
• Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying process gaps and helping implement practical improvements across the team.

Operational Purchasing

• Lead resolution of escalated supplier situations requiring senior judgment — pricing disputes, lead time negotiations, and critical shortages.
• Communicate supply risks, delays, and changes to internal stakeholders clearly and in a timely manner.
• Track and report KPIs — on-time delivery, cost savings, PO cycle time, supplier performance — and drive corrective action when targets slip.
• Enforce purchasing policy, approval workflows, and internal controls, and maintain audit-ready purchasing records across the team.
• Partner with Planning and Operations to support inventory health, MRP review, min/max accuracy, shortage prevention.

Master Data & ERP Oversight (D365)

• Support master data quality across the team's work in D365, including item masters, vendor setups, UOM configurations, and item-vendor relationships.
• Review and support approval of data changes that carry operational or financial risk.
• Ensure data accuracy across sites to support reliable purchasing, planning, and inventory reporting.
• Support change management for D365, reporting tools, and new procurement processes by helping train users, reinforce adoption, and identify gaps after implementation.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Serve as a senior procurement point of contact for Operations, Logistics, Customer Service, Finance, and Yard teams when escalations or cross-site issues arise.
• Help the team navigate competing priorities and align with internal stakeholders on timelines, stocking plans, and delivery ETAs.
• Partner with the Procurement Manager on supplier strategy and team development priorities.
• Lead or support vendor performance reviews, supplier scorecards, corrective action follow-ups, and recurring discussions with key suppliers when chronic issues arise.

• 5+ years of experience in purchasing, supply chain, or a related operational environment.
• Prior experience leading, mentoring, or supervising a team — formal or informal.
• Strong hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 (AX, SAP, or similar also considered).
• Proven ability to manage supplier relationships, resolve escalations, and make sound purchasing decisions under pressure.
• Available to travel between sites as needed, with occasional on-site presence to support the team, suppliers, or cross-functional priorities.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; comfortable with data analysis and reporting.

Key Competencies

• Natural leader who leads by example and builds trust with peers and direct reports alike.
• Strong sense of urgency with the ability to triage and prioritize in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple files and priorities simultaneously.
• Excellent communicator — clear and effective with suppliers, team members, and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Collaborative problem-solver with a continuous improvement mindset.
• Resourceful and results-driven, motivated by team success as much as individual contribution.
• Strategic mindset paired with strong operational execution.

Success in This Role

• Buyers are more autonomous, aligned, and confident in day-to-day decisions.
• Operational escalations are resolved faster with better visibility and follow-through.
• Purchasing data, supplier performance, and KPI discipline improve across sites.
• Processes are clearer, more consistent, and easier for the team to follow.

jobs.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn’s Data Infrastructure organization builds and operates the foundational platforms that store, process, and serve data across LinkedIn. The organization spans online relational databases, document stores, and key-value serving systems, as well as offline analytical, streaming, batch processing, and orchestration platforms. These systems power LinkedIn’s products and support the growing demands of AI applications at global scale.

We are looking for a Principal Staff Software Engineer with deep expertise in database internals, relational database performance, and large-scale distributed systems. This role will lead database performance and efficiency optimization, with an initial emphasis on relational systems and an opportunity to extend that work across online and offline data platforms.

You will work on query planning and execution, indexing, storage efficiency, and application access patterns to improve performance and make better use of LinkedIn’s infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of online transactional databases and can apply that expertise to offline analytical systems and the convergence of these architectures, including query federation and hybrid transactional and analytical processing (HTAP).

This is a highly technical leadership role for a hands-on builder who can set direction and drive implementation across multiple teams. You will partner closely with database, data platform, and application engineers, engage directly with code and design decisions, and turn optimization opportunities into production improvements with company-level impact.

Responsibilities

• Set technical direction for database performance and efficiency optimization across LinkedIn’s online and offline data infrastructure.
• Lead improvements to database and offline systems, including query planning and execution, indexing, storage, and application access patterns.
• Diagnose performance bottlenecks across application, database, and storage layers, and drive improvements in latency, throughput, resource utilization, and infrastructure cost.
• Extend optimization approaches across offline analytical, nearline, streaming, and batch systems, identifying opportunities to improve query execution and storage efficiency.
• Shape architectures that connect online transactional and offline analytical systems, including query federation and converged data platforms.
• Remain hands-on through code and design reviews, performance investigations, and proofs of concept that validate technical approaches.
• Make architectural tradeoffs across performance, consistency, availability, reliability, scalability, and cost.
• Partner with platform and application teams to translate workload requirements into efficient data access and execution patterns, including emerging AI workloads.
• Lead initiatives across teams from problem identification and design through implementation, production rollout, and adoption.
• Mentor senior engineers and strengthen engineering practices for database design, performance analysis, and optimization.

Basic Qualifications

• BA/BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 10+ years of industry experience in software engineering, database systems, distributed systems, or related infrastructure areas.
• 5+ years of experience in an architect, technical lead, or senior technical leadership capacity, driving architecture and technical direction across complex systems or multiple engineering teams.
• Experience designing, building, or optimizing production database systems, including relational databases, query execution, indexing, or storage components.
• Experience diagnosing and improving database or distributed system performance through changes to query execution, storage, or application access patterns.
• Hands-on programming experience and experience leading technically complex initiatives across team or organizational boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field, with experience operating at Principal Staff or equivalent scope.
• Deep expertise in database internals, including query optimizers, execution engines, indexing, storage engines, and consistency and availability tradeoffs.
• Experience spanning online transactional databases and offline analytical systems, including query federation, HTAP, or relational interfaces over data lake storage.
• A track record of delivering measurable improvements in performance, hardware utilization, or infrastructure cost across large production data platforms.
• Experience building or optimizing relational and distributed database platforms such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, or comparable systems.
• Experience with the internals or performance optimization of analytical, streaming, or batch processing platforms such as Spark, Flink, or comparable systems.
• Understanding of the performance and storage implications of AI-oriented workloads, including vector embeddings, text search, and inference-related operations.
• Demonstrated ability to set technical strategy, align senior engineers and leaders, and drive implementation and adoption across multiple teams while remaining hands-on.

Suggested Skills

• Database Systems
• Database Performance Optimization
• Distributed Systems
• Technical Strategy
