jobs.title: Industrial Technician - Decatur, AL
jobs.description:
JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• This is a safety sensitive position.
• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Konecranes moves what matters. Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer - Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled/Other Protected Category.

Konecranes, Inc. and its affiliates will not accept resumes from external recruiters or agencies without a Service Agreement and Agency Portal submission. Any resumes sent without a Service Agreement and Agency Portal submission with Konecranes, Inc. are void of any fees and free for internal use. Applicable Konecranes data protection obligations are the responsibility of the agency.

jobs.title: Sales Associate - Part Time - The Summit - Birmingham, AL
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

In 2012, Mizzen+Main set out to end the trade-off between looking sharp and feeling comfortable, and in doing so helped create the performance menswear category. We re-engineer classics with better materials and considered construction, built to keep pace with the life our customer leads.

We are now entering our next chapter: evolving from a performance shirt company into a premium menswear brand. Our customer is an established, accomplished professional. He values substance over show, is loyal to the few brands that earn it, and expects his clothes to meet his standards. We are building a brand worthy of him.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Mizzen+Main is seeking a highly motivated, energetic, and customer-focused Retail Sales Associate to join our growing team. As a Sales Associate, you will serve as a brand ambassador and help deliver an exceptional shopping experience for every customer. Applicants should possess a passion for fashion, strong interpersonal skills, and a drive to meet and exceed sales goals.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

• Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Mizzen+Main’s products, values, and brand story, and represent the brand with professionalism and enthusiasm at all times.

• Engage customers with a personalized, consultative sales approach — assisting with product selection, providing detailed product information, and creating a seamless checkout experience.

• Process all customer transactions accurately, including sales, returns, and exchanges, while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing sales floor through effective and visual merchandising, folding, hanging, and replenishment of inventory.

• Execute store operations including opening/closing procedures, stockroom organization and replenishment, and daily upkeep tasks, while always prioritizing customer service.

• Stay up to date on in-store and online promotions, events, and new product launches to provide customers with timely and relevant information.

• Support and help execute in-store events in alignment with brand expectations and presentation standards.

• Actively participate in achieving store sales goals and contribute to a positive, team-oriented environment.

• Follow all company policies and procedures, including operational and safety guidelines.

• Proactively build and expand the customer base through strategic networking, community outreach, and consistent client follow-up.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Prior retail or customer service experience preferred, but not required.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

• A team player with a positive attitude and a passion for helping others.

• Flexibility to work varied hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

• Dependable and punctual, with the ability to follow direction and take initiative.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• Able to bend, reach, stretch for product as well as lift, carry, and move at least 40 lbs.

• Comfortable climbing ladders, moving around regularly, and standing for extended periods of time.

While this job posting emphasizes the key responsibilities and requirements, there may be additional duties, responsibilities and qualifications for this job.

Why Mizzen+Main?
At Mizzen+Main, we believe in combining performance fabrics with modern style — and our people are just as dynamic. Join a company where innovation, quality, and exceptional customer experiences are at the heart of everything we do. Do what you love and love what you do. Why wait? Today's a Good Day For It.

You were born to be the boss.  We know.  You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do.  Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss.  You just do that because you've always done it.  Well maybe it's time you moved up.  You want to be the boss?  Well now's your chance - Domino's is hiring bosses - more specifically shift leaders.  It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you.  Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math, and the ability to multitask.

at least 18 years or older

jobs.title: Associate Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Learn the Platform: Become an expert on Sierra's platform and how AI agents transform customer experiences, from agent design and workflows to integrations, so you can speak credibly with technical and business stakeholders.

 - Discovery & Demos: Participate in efficient discovery calls to understand customer needs, answer technical questions (ideally in a single conversation), and grow to deliver standard product demos and account coverage for the sales team.

 - Proofs of Concept: Support senior SEs in building demos and proofs of concept, and keep demo environments current and ready for customer use.

 - APIs & Integrations: Educate customers on Sierra's APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns, and build and deploy scripts against a test environment on demand.

 - RFPs & Collateral: Help the team respond to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, and create presentations, positioning statements, and other sales collateral.

 - Partner with Sales: Advocate for your AEs and customers in internal technical conversations, join customer meetings and events, and keep CRM records and opportunity data accurate.

 - Close the Loop with Product: Act as a bridge between Sales and Product, translating customer feedback into actionable input and enrolling the right customers in beta programs.

 - Grow Your Craft: Complete product, sales, and process training and certifications, with structured coaching and mentorship from senior Sales Engineers.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 1+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, technical support, or consulting. Strong internships or early-career experience count.

 - Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Working knowledge of at least one of: cloud software, APIs and integrations, or networking and automation systems.

 - Curiosity about how businesses run and a genuine interest in building trusted relationships with customers.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and attention to detail, plus comfort with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and standard productivity software.

 - A collaborative, quick-learning mindset: someone who treats sales as a team sport and takes feedback well.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Hands-on experience with APIs/webhooks, JSON, and scripting (e.g., Python or JavaScript).

 - Familiarity with AI and ML concepts, workflows, or conversational AI and customer experience platforms.

 - Exposure to consultative selling, or experience responding to RFPs and security questionnaires.

 - A history of tinkering, whether with hardware, sensors, or side projects, that shows you learn by building.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Transit Systems
jobs.description:

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary engineering teams, manage complex engineering consulting contracts, and serve as the primary client liaison for strategic transportation and transit infrastructure projects. The initial assignment will include management of a major transit systems engineering contract supporting infrastructure modernization, with responsibility expanding to additional East Region clients and projects as the regional portfolio grows.

• Manage transportation and transit engineering consulting contracts from project initiation through closeout.
• Serve as the primary contract manager and client liaison, leading scope, budget, schedule, staffing, risk, quality, and project controls.
• Direct multidisciplinary engineering and technical teams to deliver high-quality services while meeting project objectives, schedules, and budgets.
• Coordinate closely with clients, contractors, subcontractors, project partners, and internal technical disciplines throughout project execution.
• Support business development activities, proposal preparation, interviews, strategic pursuits, and respond to client-issued RFQs/RFPs.

Minimum Requirements

• BA/BS in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering ore related field and 10 years of transportation, transit, or infrastructure project experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Requirements

• Licensed Professional Engineer (PE)
• Experience managing engineering consulting contracts, multidisciplinary engineering teams, project budgets, schedules, contract administration, and financial performance.
• Demonstrated experience communicating effectively with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams through exceptional written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.

About AECOM

AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: H&M  Seasonal Sales Advisor- Beverly Center
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $18.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Associate HRBP
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2005, the 2K label includes some of the most talented game development studios in the world today including: Firaxis Games, Visual Concepts, Hangar 13, 2K Czech and Cat Daddy Games.  Our world-class team of engineers, developers, graphic artists and publishing professionals are stewards of a growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, NBA 2K, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).

2K develops and publishes interactive entertainment globally for console systems, handheld gaming systems and personal computers, including smartphones and tablets, which are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, casual, and family entertainment.

Our vision at 2K is to create a diverse and inclusion environment to “Come as You are and Feel Equipped to do Your Best Work!” We are dedicated to promoting diversity, multiculturalism, and equality in all that we do. Our communities are focused on increased access and personal growth, and their greatness depends on a diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, and perspective. We're an equal opportunity employer, and we're excited to build the future of co-living with the world's most hardworking and passionate people.

jobs.title: Nurse - Clinical Review
jobs.description:
The Clinical Review Nurse makes prospective medical necessity determinations on prior authorization requests for HealthHelp’s specialty programs, including Diagnostic Imaging, Cardiology, Musculoskeletal, Physical Medicine, Sleep, Oncology, and Genetic Testing. Reviewers apply HealthHelp’s proprietary, evidence-based clinical guidelines, approve requests that meet criteria, and refer those that do not to Physician Reviewers.

This is a full-time, fully remote, production-based role. Reviewers work to daily productivity (cases per hour) and quality (QA audit) standards. New reviewers complete structured training on HealthHelp’s guidelines and systems, then move into production with a supported ramp period.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Performs prospective utilization review of prior authorization requests to determine whether each request meets medical necessity criteria under HealthHelp’s clinical guidelines, client medical policies, and applicable state and federal requirements.
• Identifies the clinical indication, the criteria met or not met, and any missing documentation; approves requests that meet criteria and refers those that do not to Physician Reviewers with a clear, concise clinical summary.
• Meets established productivity (cases per hour) and quality (QA audit) standards, and completes reviews within state, federal, and client turnaround timeframes.
• Documents each review accurately and completely according to HealthHelp’s documentation policy.
• Contacts ordering and rendering providers, office staff, and members to obtain additional clinical information and communicate determinations professionally.
• Handles escalated and expedited cases that require special handling.

• Supports Physician Reviewers and Medical Directors to keep cases moving within review timeframes.
• Identifies and refers potential quality-of-care concerns to UM Leadership.
• Participates in the HealthHelp Quality Management Program, including QA audits and calibration, and applies feedback to improve accuracy.
• Keeps current with guideline, policy, and regulatory updates from the Compliance Department and Nursing Management, and adheres to URAC, NCQA, HIPAA, and state and federal requirements.
• Works in multiple computer systems at the same time to manage cases and document reviews.
• Collaborates with client personnel and internal teams to resolve concerns, and contributes to a team environment of respect, cooperation, and inclusion.
• Performs other related duties and projects as assigned to meet business needs.

Required

• Graduate of an accredited RN or LPN/LVN nursing program.
• Current, active, unrestricted RN or LPN/LVN license in a U.S. state or territory.
• Minimum of two (2) years of experience reviewing prior authorization or utilization review requests against clinical criteria (e.g., prior authorization, pre-service review, precertification, or utilization review).
• Ability to work in a production environment with daily productivity and quality standards.
• Accurate, efficient typing and clinical documentation skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to learn new healthcare software and work in several systems at once.
• Reliable high-speed internet and a private, HIPAA-compliant home workspace.

Preferred

• Experience making prospective medical necessity determinations at a health plan, utilization management organization, specialty or radiology benefit manager, or workers’ compensation utilization review program.
• Track record of meeting a measured daily case target and QA or accuracy standard.
• Working knowledge of InterQual, MCG, ODG, or other evidence-based criteria sets.
• Working knowledge of Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs).
• Review experience in Diagnostic Imaging, Cardiology, Musculoskeletal, Oncology, Sleep, Genetic Testing, or another HealthHelp program area.
• Multistate (compact) nursing license.
• Experience working remotely.

WHAT TO EXPECT

• Full-time, fully remote position. This is a dedicated role; other employment must be disclosed in line with HealthHelp policy.
• Structured new employee orientation on HealthHelp’s clinical guidelines and review platform, followed by a production ramp period with regular QA audits and coaching.
• Productivity is measured in cases per hour; quality is measured through regular QA audits.

Training Schedule (First 6 Weeks): Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM (CST)

Regular Schedule After Training: 10:30amCST - 7:00pm CST

Location: Remote (United States)

Compensation Disclosure

The base salary for this position is $65,000 [LVN/LPN], $75,000 [RN] annually. This represents the base pay range that we reasonably expect to offer for this position.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for performance-based bonuses, incentive pay, or commissions, which are not included in the listed base salary range.

WNS complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency laws, including those in California, Colorado, New York, Washington, and Illinois.

jobs.title: Agile Project Manager
jobs.description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

SUMMARY

Avetta is evolving beyond traditional Agile and SAFe delivery frameworks into an AI-Augmented Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC) a structured pipeline where AI agents assist at every stage, from product discovery through to production release, while humans retain ownership of every key decision.

As an Agile Project Manager (APM) in the AI-PDLC, you are the connective tissue of that pipeline. You don't just track progress, but you ensure the right human judgment is applied at the right gates, so AI-generated work meets Avetta's quality bar before it moves forward.

This role is ideal for a mid-level Agile delivery professional who is confident running cross-functional initiatives, comfortable working directly with product and engineering pod teams, and genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping software delivery.

Candidates residing within 30 miles of an Avetta office are required to follow a hybrid work schedule of three days in the office and two days working from home each week. Candidates residing more than 30 miles from an Avetta office may be considered for remote employment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Pipeline Coordination & Flow Management Own end-to-end delivery flow for one or more initiatives across Avetta's 5-zone AI-PDLC pipeline — from validated discovery through to production release.

• Track initiative progress using the 3 Red Box milestone model (pipeline entry → approved spec → production), with cycle time and throughput as primary delivery metrics.

• Coordinate zone-to-zone handoffs, ensuring the right sign-offs are in place before any AI-generated artifact like spec, task breakdown, or code advances downstream.

• Facilitate the Spec Agreement gate: the checkpoint where both the Product Manager and Tech Lead confirm intent and approach before AI-assisted coding begins.

• Maintain the Gate Decision Log in Confluence for each initiative: what was reviewed, what was decided, and what changed: the audit trail proving human judgment drove every step.

• Flag missing or incomplete dependencies (such as the SDAP coding rulebook) early; no AI coding work moves forward without them.

• Cross-Pod Dependency Orchestration

• Coordinate across 3–5 person delivery pods, acting as the integration point for work spanning multiple teams, domains, or codebases.

• Facilitate cross-pod syncs focused on AI pipeline blockers, spec quality issues, and zone-to-zone handoff readiness, replacing traditional Scrum of Scrums.

• Own RAID and decision logs at the initiative level, with specific attention to AI pipeline failure modes such as unresolved spec questions and AI output drift.

• Partner with Scrum Masters to surface and escalate pod-level blockers before they become pipeline bottlenecks.

• Stakeholder Management & Communication

• Act as the primary communication point between Product Management, engineering pod leads, Release Management, and senior stakeholders for initiative status, risks, and key decisions.

• Prepare concise, data-driven updates for monthly C-level reporting, structured around pipeline volume, spec approval rate, and production throughput.

• Communicate spec quality issues and AI agent output concerns clearly, with proposed mitigations not just escalation.

• Help PMs set stakeholder expectations around AI-PDLC timelines, which may differ from traditional Agile estimates.

• Spec Quality & Gate Integrity

• Apply the Spec Rubric (a pass/fail quality checklist) at the approved-spec gate to ensure no work is greenlighted below the agreed quality standard.

• Surface and report spec rejection patterns as early-warning signals — high rejection rates predict downstream delivery slowdowns.

• Ensure Definition of Ready criteria are met before any initiative enters the delivery zone.

• Track open spec questions across initiatives and ensure they are resolved — not bypassed.

• Tooling, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain delivery data in Jira, Aha!, and Confluence aligned to the AI-PDLC pipeline; log gate timestamps accurately for cycle time reporting.

• Build and maintain dashboards tracking key metrics: cycle time, throughput, spec rejection rate, PR review cycles, and human gate hours per initiative.

• Use AI productivity tools (Glean, Claude, Jira automation/Scriptrunner/Atlassian Intelligence) to reduce manual tracking overhead and surface blockers proactively.

• Coach pod teams and stakeholders on AI-PDLC process expectations, HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) gate responsibilities, and how to engage productively with AI agents.

• Champion the principle: “The AI generates artifacts; humans own decisions.”

• Contribute improvement observations back into the AI-PDLC framework: this is a living system and your insights matter.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

• Experience 3–5 years in Agile delivery, project management, or program coordination in a SaaS or software environment.

• Hands-on experience with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Design).

• Background in organizations undergoing Agile or technology transformation; AI-augmented delivery experience is a strong plus.

• Agile & AI-PDLC Skills

• Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks with ability to adapt ceremonies to AI-augmented team models.

• Familiarity with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — understanding that input spec quality directly drives AI output quality.

• Working knowledge of human-in-the-loop (HITL) gate concepts and the distinction between AI-generated artifacts and human-owned decisions.

• Tools

• Proficiency with Jira, Scriptrunner, Confluence, and Aha! for initiative tracking, gate logging, and reporting.

• Experience with AI productivity tools (Atlassian Intelligence, Glean, Claude, or equivalent).

• Comfortable with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for distributed team collaboration.

• Soft Skills

• Strong written and verbal communication: able to translate AI pipeline status into clear, business-relevant updates for any audience.

• High judgment and organizational discipline; able to manage multiple initiative workstreams without losing sight of gate integrity.

• Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable influencing without direct authority.

• Change-agent mindset with genuine openness to rapid iteration as the AI-PDLC framework matures.

• Education

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience in Agile delivery or program coordination roles.

• Certifications (Preferred, Not Required)

• SAFe and AI fluency credentials (SAFe (SA / SSM / SASM / SPC), AWS AI Practitioner, Google AI Essentials) are weighted above traditional PM certifications (CSM / PSM I–II, CAPM / PMP for this role.

At Avetta, we are committed to salary transparency to ensure equitable hiring practices and promote trust. The salary range included in this job posting is based on internal and market data and the role's responsibilities. The final compensation offered to a candidate will be determined by several factors, including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The salary range for this position is $114,000 - $128,000 USD per year.

Benefits included:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 401(K)

• Paid Time Off

To apply for the Agile Project Manager position, please submit your online application by December 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM PST.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT 8FLEET

8Fleet is hiring! We are a fast-growing technology and logistics company building the operational backbone for rideshare fleets, both driver-operated and autonomous. We run 24/7 operations with full-time drivers, a managed fleet of vehicles and a team that keeps it all moving. As we launch in Chicago, we are building our local team from the ground up.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator, based in Chicago, to keep our new market running every day. You will keep driver shifts covered, vehicles assigned and ready, and the team working from the same information. When something breaks at 6 a.m., you are the person who already knows and is fixing it.

This is an on-site, hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace, thinks in systems and enjoys being the person everyone relies on. You will work closely with Chicago market leadership and help build the processes and reporting the team uses as the market grows. Strong coordinators here grow into supervisor, analyst and management roles.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried, on-site in Chicago. This role supports a 24/7 operation, so some early mornings, evenings or weekends are expected, especially around launch.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own Daily Coverage: Build and manage driver schedules and shift coverage, fill gaps quickly and keep vehicles earning.

 - Keep Vehicles on the Road: Coordinate vehicle assignments, handoffs and availability with the Fleet Support and Maintenance teams so downtime stays low.

 - Be the Operational Hub: Be the first point of contact for drivers and supervisors on day-to-day issues, and route what you cannot solve to the right owner fast.

 - Run the Numbers: Track daily metrics such as coverage, utilization, attendance and vehicle status, and turn them into clear updates for leadership.

 - Fix What Slows Us Down: Spot recurring problems, document how things should work and help put better processes and tools in place.

 - Support the Launch: Help with onboarding logistics, driver communications, supplies and site needs as we stand up the Chicago market.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years in operations, dispatch, logistics, fleet, transportation or another fast-moving operations environment.

 - Strong organization and follow-through: you close loops without being chased.

 - Comfort with data. You are strong in Google Sheets or Excel and like using numbers to make decisions.

 - Clear, calm communication with drivers, teammates and leadership, especially when things go sideways.

 - Flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including some early mornings, evenings or weekends.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in rideshare, delivery, rental car or fleet operations.

 - Experience with scheduling or fleet tools such as Deputy, Samsara, Fleetio or similar.

 - Experience launching a new market, site or operation.

 - Bilingual (English/Spanish).

WHY 8FLEET

 - Get in early and help build the Chicago operation, not just run it.

 - Clear paths into supervisor, analyst and operations management roles as we scale.

 - Medical, dental and vision, 401(k), paid time off and sick pay.

COMPENSATION

 - $65,000 - $70,000 per year, plus equity

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

8Fleet is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer | Accounting
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Finance teams need a dependable way to turn everyday spending and payments into accurate books. Ramp's Accounting team builds the systems that carry accounting context across our products, help customers categorize and reconcile activity, and keep their records in sync. When those systems work well, finance teams spend less time correcting data and more time understanding their business.



We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build across that accounting experience. You could work on the services behind accounting rules and data models, the flow of transactions into the books, or the reliability of sync and reconciliation workflows. You'll own complex projects from design through production and work with product, design, and engineering partners to make accounting workflows simpler and more trustworthy for customers.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build backend services, APIs, and data models that support accounting workflows across Ramp's products

 - Make financial data accurate, traceable, and resilient as transactions move through coding, reconciliation, and sync

 - Improve the reliability and visibility of workflows that span Ramp and customers' accounting systems, including how they handle failures and changes

 - Partner with product and engineering teammates to understand finance teams' needs and turn them into practical technical designs

 - Own substantial projects from design and implementation through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - Strong system design judgment, especially around data correctness, reliability, and keeping complex systems understandable

 - A track record of independently owning complex projects and shipping high-quality software

 - The ability to investigate problems across services and data flows and turn what you learn into durable improvements

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions and feedback




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with accounting, payments, spend management, or other financial data products

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Working as a key member of the Sourcing team, the CapEx Sourcing Manager will focus on the Capital Expenditure (CapEx) Category Management, leading sourcing initiatives for manufacturing equipment, tooling, automation, and test systems critical to Oura’s new product introduction and mass production readiness. This role partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, and Finance to ensure that all capital investments meet business requirements for cost, quality, scalability, and reliability.

What You Will Do:

• Develop and implement commercial strategies for capital equipment, tooling, and manufacturing systems used across Oura’s global contract manufacturing network. Identify and drive reuse, standardization, and cost-optimization opportunities to minimize overall capital spend.

• Build and execute sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency, innovation, lead-time, scalability, and long-term supplier capability to support Oura’s growth, new product introductions (NPI), and technology roadmap.

• Develop a deep understanding of equipment and tooling technologies used in high-precision manufacturing, automation, and enclosure production. Continuously monitor market trends, supplier capabilities, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for process improvement, equipment reuse, and cost reduction.

• Identify, qualify, and manage strategic supplier relationships. Conduct business reviews, supplier capability assessments, and drive alignment on performance metrics, continuous improvement, and innovation initiatives.

• Lead commercial negotiations and contracting for all CapEx-related procurements, including equipment, tooling, installation, and service agreements. Ensure compliance with NDAs, T&Cs, and lifecycle cost management best practices.

• Develop and maintain cost models, should-cost analyses, and benchmarking frameworks for capital investments, incorporating total cost of ownership (TCO), depreciation, and ROI analysis. Support budget planning and forecasting across global programs.

• Partner with Hardware Engineering, NPI Manufacturing, and Operations to define technical and functional specifications for equipment and tooling, and ensure supplier deliverables align with Oura’s production readiness timelines.

• Champion continuous improvement in sourcing processes, supplier engagement, and capital investment governance. Support system adoption, asset reuse, and global alignment on equipment lifecycle management practices. Influence cross-functional teams to implement best-in-class CapEx management methodologies.

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

What you'll bring

• 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management, with a focus on CapEx, equipment, or manufacturing systems

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field

• Proven track record in supplier negotiations, RFQ/RFP management, and contracting

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, automation systems, and tooling

• Excellent analytical, financial modeling, and project management skills

• Exceptional collaboration and communication skills with cross-functional teams

Nice to have:

• A strategic mindset with the ability to balance cost, quality, and speed

• Comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced hardware development environment

• Passion for building scalable sourcing systems and supplier partnerships that enable world-class manufacturing performance

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary and equity packages

• Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources

• Experience developing and implementing software drivers (C/C++/Python) to interface with FPGA designs

• Experience with FPGA Ethernet IP blocks (1G/10G/40G/100G)

• Experience with git

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

jobs.description:
Innovate with purpose

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company

Join BILL as a Principal Product Manager on our Embed & Integrations team and own the products that connect BILL to the accounting systems our customers use to run their business. Every bill, payment, vendor, and expense that moves through BILL has to land correctly in the general ledger. That connection is why finance teams and accountants trust BILL, and it plays a big part in whether customers choose BILL and stay.

In this role, you will collaborate with the team to shape the strategy and multi-year roadmap for our Sync, Integrations, and App Center portfolio. This includes partnering on our existing integrations—drawing on your experience with two-way syncs for ERPs such as Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and Blackbaud—as well as driving the development and launch of entirely new syncs; the APIs and file-based integrations that extend them; and the App Center, where customers find and connect partner apps. You will set direction across several product areas, build the business case for where BILL invests, and lead Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, and CX toward measurable results in adoption, sync reliability, retention, and revenue. This is a senior individual contributor role with the scope of a product leader. You will own the outcomes for an area of strategic importance to the company.

What you’ll do

Lead the product

• Strategic Depth & Portfolio Ownership: Help drive the strategy for our integrations ecosystem, creating and executing multi-year roadmaps spanning several product areas. You will innovate new approaches that enhance customer satisfaction and drive significant business results (market share increase, revenue growth, customer acquisition.

• Find and size new opportunities using customer research, usage data, and market and competitive insight, and turn them into funded business cases with Finance.

• Set the goals, OKRs, and annual forecasts for the portfolio, define KPIs that ladder up to company objectives, and keep a clear record of results and lessons learned.

• Lead discovery with customers, accountants, and partners so the team understands the problem before it commits to a solution.

• Build a testing and experimentation roadmap that lets the business try bigger bets with confidence.

• Lead cross-functional virtual teams across Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, Product Marketing, Sales, and CX, and partner directly with leaders in other pillars wherever your work creates dependencies.

• Drive execution from discovery through launch and iteration: manage dependencies and risks, negotiate trade-offs, and work with GTM, Sales, and CX on launch, enablement, and adoption.

• Keep executives and stakeholders informed on opportunities, progress, risks, and decisions through clear written narratives and reviews. When something goes off plan, own it, explain what happened, and adjust.

Sync, Integrations, and the App Center

• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and ecosystem partners to advance BILL’s deep ERP integrations—moving beyond baseline data synchronization to deeply partner with ERPs and automate advanced accounting workflows across AP, AR, and Spend & Expense.

• Set the bar for sync reliability and customer effort using measures such as sync success rate, error rate, and CX contact rate, and lead the work that moves them.

• Modernize how customers set up, connect, and manage integrations, including the move to one App Center experience for every customer.

• Grow the App Center and partner ecosystem: decide which apps and next-generation ERPs to prioritize, how partners are vetted and launched, and how we measure connected organizations and their payment volume.

• Shape BILL’s ERP and partner strategy, including when to build, partner, or embed, as ERP platforms change how they open and price access to their APIs.

• Work with the Developer Platform and Embed teams on shared foundations such as APIs, OAuth, and partner onboarding, so integrations scale without one-off work.

We’d love to chat if you have:

• A Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of related professional experience, a Master’s degree with 10+ years, a PhD with 8+ years, or equivalent experience, with a substantial part of it in product management.

• Experience at Principal, Group, or Director level scope: owning a portfolio of related products or a strategically important area, and delivering multi-year roadmaps that span several product areas.

• A track record of business results you can point to, such as revenue growth, market share, customer acquisition, or retention.

• Strong product strategy skills, including funded business cases, financial modeling and forecasting with Finance, and use of customer, competitor, and market insight.

• Data fluency: you set goals and forecasts, explain how KPIs drive the business, and use data and experiments to make portfolio decisions.

• Proven cross-functional leadership without formal authority, including with senior leaders across functions and pillars.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including with executives.

Sync, Integrations, and ERP expertise

• Deep expertise in integrations, APIs, and major ERPs and accounting systems such as Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations.

• A strong understanding of accounting workflows (AP, AR, general ledger, reconciliation, and close) and of how data has to flow between a financial operations platform and the ledger.

• Experience building or growing an app marketplace, App Center, or partner integration ecosystem, including partner selection, launch, and measurement.

• Enough technical fluency to work with engineers on sync architecture, data mapping, API design, and reliability trade-offs.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience at an ERP, accounting software provider, or fintech that serves SMB and mid-market finance teams and accounting firms.

• Experience with OAuth-based app ecosystems, iPaaS or file-based integrations, or AI and agent connectors.

• Experience with ERP partner programs, co-marketing, or partnership commercial terms.

• Hands-on use of AI tools in your own product work, and experience shipping AI-assisted experiences. #LI

jobs.title: Lead, Executive Support
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Executive Support Team Lead is responsible for driving exceptional outcomes for our customers by ensuring that our Executive Support team is consistently achieving their goals. They lead and manage their team, providing strategic direction, ongoing coaching, data analysis, project management, and overseeing daily operations. This role includes leading, supervising, presenting, cross functional work, communication, and more.

The Team Lead is a strong leader and figurehead for their team. They answer agent questions, handle escalations of their own, oversee key directives towards shared goals, and distribute critical updates to the team. The Team Lead proactively identifies opportunities for continuous operational improvement through root cause analysis, deep dives into tickets or data, and shadowing interactions. Based on these insights, they collaborate with cross-functional partners and to implement both short-term and long-term solutions to enhance overall customer outcomes.

The ideal candidate is passionate about leadership and driving results and improvement on their team. They are empathetic, compassionate, and capable of leading in a fast paced, ambiguous environment. They is highly organized, focused, and thrives in a fast-paced work environment. They excel in navigating ambiguity and are exceptional at root cause analysis, continuous improvement, clear communication, flexibility, leadership, and team building.

Responsibilities:

• Lead shoulder to shoulder to deliver outstanding results, driving shared outcomes measured through key performance indicators such as SLA, CSAT, TAR, QAR scores, and beyond.

• Lead a team of associates to provide a world-class customer experience by offering continuous support, coaching, development, and mentorship in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and foster a culture of excellence and growth.

• Continuously evaluate and refine best practices and processes within the team to ensure consistent and exceptional customer experiences. Implement innovative solutions to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

• Understand and optimize operational efficiencies by benchmarking industry best practices, analyzing data and processes, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing changes to enhance customer obsession and satisfaction.

• Take ownership of the associate experience by regularly assessing and measuring behaviors that drive positive outcomes. Encourage the development of individual skills, knowledge, and understanding of their roles, fostering a supportive and growth-oriented environment.

• Maintain a visible and active leadership presence by engaging in day-to-day team activities, holding team members accountable, and collaborating with the Lyft Leadership Team. Lead by example and inspire confidence and trust within the team.

• Work closely with other Specialized Support team leaders to enhance both internal and external customer experiences. Share insights and strategies to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

• Analyze team performance data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for improvement. Effectively communicate and present this data to senior leadership, telling a compelling story that highlights successes and areas for growth.

Experience:

• 2+ years experience in customer support

• Ability to build relationships with cross functional stakeholders and drive shared outcomes

• Customer obsessed with a track record for going above and beyond for the customer

• Ability to lead in a fast­-paced environment subject to rapid change and ambiguity

• Relevant technology, social media, and customer care experience.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Problem solving, Decision making, and Time management skills are a must.

• Experience with process improvement and excellence is a plus

Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule following the establishment of a Lyft office in Nashville — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

jobs.title: Recovery Engineer II - Rocket Transport and Recovery
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Offshore Recovery team is responsible for designing, building and operating the maritime vessels used to land and recover the Terran R launch vehicle. This isn’t your standard desk job. We are a lean, fast-moving team who cover the full project lifecycle – beginning with system requirements definition and design, hands-on with build and activation in the shipyard, all the way through supporting critical offshore recovery missions at sea. We collaborate with teams across the company, including Terran R designers, launch pad builders and rocket engine testers!

About the Role:

• Lead the design, integration, checkout, and operation of recovery subsystems in preparation for and during Terran R flight campaigns.

• Develop and maintain operational procedures for the Terran R recovery vessel to support safe, reliable, and effective recovery operations.

• Collaborate with Terran R and recovery vessel engineering teams to identify system improvements, resolve technical challenges, and optimize recovery operations.

• Plan and execute activation and checkout testing for barge subsystems, including high-pressure fluid and high-voltage systems, using established safety procedures and risk mitigation controls.

• Analyze system performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate corrective actions to support operational readiness.

• Support recovery operations in dynamic environments, including offshore settings and extended-duration flight campaign activities.

About You:

• You have a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline, along with at least two years of relevant professional experience.

• You can analyze complex systems, apply engineering fundamentals, and develop practical solutions to technical challenges.

jobs.title: Fluidstack Labs Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE FLUIDSTACK LABS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Qualify the hardware the frontier runs on before it runs anywhere else. First samples of next-generation accelerators, switches, storage, and liquid cooling land here, and leave as production-ready platforms with runbooks the whole fleet inherits.

 - Compress silicon-to-production to weeks. The lab closes the gap between vendor sample and customer-ready gigawatt infrastructure, and every week cut here pulls the entire 10s-of-GW deployment curve forward.

 - Run the lab like a production site. Provisioning, telemetry, demand management, and liquid cooling mirror production architecture exactly, so a qualification pass in the lab is a deployment guarantee in the field.

 - Prove the power envelope nobody else will touch. Dynamic demand management lets AI compute deploy beyond nominal electrical capacity, and the lab validates the full detection-to-shutdown response chain that makes it safe.
   


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the NPI lab end to end: a direct-liquid-cooled facility with CDU-fed rows and an air-cooled zone that mirror production architecture, and take it fully operational by end of year.

 - Build and lead the on-site team of data center technicians and lab qualification engineers, and serve as the first escalation point for facility-floor issues.

 - Schedule and deconflict qualification programs across vendor sample timelines: next-generation accelerator platforms (NVIDIA, AMD, custom accelerators), Ethernet switching on the Broadcom Tomahawk and Jericho families and NVIDIA Spectrum, converged NVMe storage platforms (Weka, Hammerspace, VAST Data), and CDU platforms (nVent, CoolIT, Vertiv). You own operations, scheduling, and execution while an NPI technical program manager and per-domain technical leads (compute and storage, networking, optics and fiber, cooling and controls) drive the technical content of each program.

 - Run the multi-party access model under which hardware partners and customers qualify their own equipment in the lab, including customer-owned hardware, NDAs and access agreements, badging coordination, vendor escort, and provisioned remote access.

 - Own lab logistics: equipment receiving, asset inventory, rack-and-stack execution quality, RMA handling, migration and standup of lab infrastructure, and coordination of CDU manifold connections and leak inspection with deployment engineering.

 - Host the power oversubscription and demand-management validation program, from rPDU commissioning and stress harnesses through the full detection to load-shed to shutdown response chain.
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've run a hardware lab, NPI program, or qualification facility and owned its day-to-day operation, from equipment intake to floor discipline to schedule.

 - You've managed technicians and engineers directly, set the standard for work quality on the floor, and been the escalation point your team called first when something broke.

 - You've worked hands-on with liquid cooling and high-density power, close enough to a CDU loop and a 100 kW rack that technicians take your direction seriously.

 - You've hosted vendor or customer engineering teams on your own floor and kept their equipment, access, and confidentiality boundaries clean.

 - Inventory and asset discipline are habits, not afterthoughts: every device you've received, racked, RMA'd, or shipped was accounted for without an audit scramble.

 - You've stayed calm when multiple vendors' sample schedules collided in the same week, and you deconflicted with a plan rather than an apology.

 - Bonus: DLC and CDU commissioning depth. NPI experience at a hyperscaler or major OEM. ITIL-grade lab operations. Standing up a facility from scratch.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets.
