jobs.title: Senior Living Occupational Therapist
jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care is currently seeking an experienced Occupational Therapist, OT, for a per diem opportunity performing Senior Living visits for our New Hampshire Facilities office, located in Londonderry, NH.  This office services adult and geriatric patients on a per visit basis in homes throughout Nashua and surrounding towns.

As a home care Occupational Therapist, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides rehabilitative care and skilled nursing to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

Occupational Therapist, OT Responsibilities:

• Perform outpatient therapy evaluations in order to develop a plan of care for patients in designated senior living communities or in a group home setting for adults with intellectual disabilities Professionally operate at top of licensure utilizing current research-based approaches to care in order to maximize functional independence for your clients Work closely with your home health therapy partners to appropriately transition care from home health to outpatient services in order to achieve client centered goals in their living environment, allowing the right care, at the right time for each client Educate the client, family and community caregivers on the care plans created for your clients in order to achieve a team approach to maximizing functional independence Perform evaluations, treatments and proper discharge planning for your clients utilizing out outpatient EMR platform to deliver and document on your individualized treatment approaches to meet the needs of your clients

Occupational Therapist, OT Qualifications:

• A current New Hampshire Occupational Therapist license.

• Prior home care experience preferred, but not required

• A minimum of one year of recent work experience as an Occupational Therapist.

• Graduation from an occupational therapy program accredited jointly by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation of the AMA and the AOTA, as indicated by school transcript or diploma.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

• Strong interpersonal skills, organizational skills, and problem solving skills.

• Solid computer skills; prior experience with electronic medical records (EMR) preferred.

BAYADA believes that our employees are our greatest asset:

• Enjoy being part of a team that cares and a company that believes in leading with our values.

• Develop your skills with training and scholarship opportunities.

• Advance your career with specially designed career tracks.

• Be recognized and rewarded for your compassion, excellence, and reliability.

• Benefits may include mileage reimbursement; weekly pay and direct deposit; scholarship opportunities; one-on-one training; recognition programs; referral bonuses; 401(k) with company match; and opportunities for career advancement.

BAYADA believes that our clients and their families deserve home health care delivered with compassion, excellence, and reliability.  Be part of a caring, professional team that is instrumental in providing the highest quality care while developing your career with an industry leader.  Apply now for immediate consideration.

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

BAYADA Home Health Care, Inc., and its associated entities and joint venture partners, are Equal Opportunity Employers. All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, military status, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.  Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs CMC
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Director, Regulatory Affairs, CMC, is responsible for coordinating and preparing high-quality global regulatory filings. This role will provide regulatory strategy input and oversee preparation of regulatory submissions in collaboration with other stakeholders including CMC, Supply Chain and QA. The Director is responsible for providing regulatory guidance on Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) regulatory activities for assigned product(s) in coordination with key internal stakeholders. This role will manage regulatory CMC aspects of compounds (large molecules) through all phases of development and provide strategic and operational management of preparation and maintenance of CMC regulatory filings to support ongoing clinical activities as well as marketing applications.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute CMC regulatory strategies for Clinical Phase and Commercial Development as life cycle management.

• Manages the preparation of high quality Regulatory CMC submissions including, IND, IMPD, BLA, MAA and post approval supplements as needed to meet global regulatory requirements.

• Represent Regulatory CMC in project teams and provide strategic regulatory CMC input to ensure successful product development

• Work closely with the CMC, Supply Chain, Quality and Regulatory Affairs team in the implementation of Regulatory Strategies to meet the Company Goals

• Plan and participate in the preparation of Health Authority meeting requests, briefing books and responses to Health Authority information requests

• Review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, IMPD, BLA etc) for compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with company strategies.

• Lead and participate in Regulatory interactions with Health Authorities (HA), as appropriate.

• Develop Regulatory CMC strategies and Risk assessments for assigned projects.

• Identify areas of continuous process improvement and engage RA teams and key stakeholders as necessary.

• Support in providing interpretation of global CMC regulations and guidelines, to Summit personnel for assigned programs

• Provide support during Health Authority inspections as necessary.

• Escalate issues that affect regulatory compliance, promptly to CMC RA Management

• Maintain up to date knowledge of global regulations and guidances pertaining to CMC issues

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, pharmacy, engineering, biochemistry or related science required. Master's Degree or other advanced degree preferred

• 10 or more years Regulatory CMC experience and/ or related Pharmaceutical industry experience required.

• Experience in biologics required

• Thorough and extensive knowledge of FDA, EU and global regulations required

• Significant experience in developing regulatory strategy for complex products and experience in the preparation of CMC sections for complex regulatory submissions Excellent understanding of IND, CTA, BLA and MAA processes.

• Experience in engaging with health authorities on regulatory CMC topics

• Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written) is highly desirable

• Proficient user of standard of Office suite (e.g., Word, Excel), experience using electronic document management systems, and document review tools desirable

• Strong computer and database skills

• Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality.

• Clear and concise oral and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills

• Critical thinking, problem solving, ability to work independently.

• Must be able to effectively multi-task and manage time-sensitive and highly confidential documents.

• Communicate effectively and articulate complex ideas in an easily understandable way

• Prioritize conflicting demands.

• Work in a fast-paced, demanding and collaborative environment.

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$190,000—$237,000 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

Summit does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@smmttx.com to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in creating and maintaining diverse environment. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training or promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.




THE OPPORTUNITY

The SandboxAQ AI team is looking for an AI Engineer to help us build the future of agentic collaboration, trust and ROI. Our goal is to make agents work well on their own, in teams, and with humans. This includes the following aspects:

 - Security: Discovery of agents, evaluation, red teaming, monitoring, guardrails, etc.

 - Quality: Measuring ROI of agents and suggesting improvements

 - Collaboration: Bringing humans and agents together into one place with shared context



A successful candidate thrives at the intersection of AI and software engineering. You deeply understand how models and agents work, how they can fail, how they can be protected and improved. You have hands-on experience with agents in production, know what works and what doesn’t, know the latest trends and you’re opinionated about the future. You know what you don’t know and enjoy learning to close those gaps. You’ll turn your insights and innovation into real world features baked into our platform - shipping code to production.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll break things, fix them and then harden them for good. At the same time, you’ll have freedom to explore, collaborate, publish, and deploy, shaping the field of agentic collaboration and trust from all angles.

We’re looking for somebody with the curiosity of a researcher, the rigor of an engineer, and the creativity of a hacker. You will be part of a diverse team consisting of ML experts, security experts, mathematicians, and software engineers, each playing a key role in efficient and effective enablement of the cutting-edge technologies being developed at SandboxAQ.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Create new agentic capabilities - frameworks for monitoring, guardrailing, and evaluating them, and to make them work together more effectively.

 - Perform classical ML tasks - exploratory data analysis, feature engineering and fine-tuning models using the latest frameworks.

 - Work closely with Product and Research to translate AI research into applicable features and software engineering projects.

 - Rapidly iterate on prototypes and features based on feedback and evolving product needs.

 - Contribute production ready code, working across engineering to deliver scalable software.

 - Stay on the edge of the latest agentic developments and explore new opportunities.
   
   


ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - MSc in Computer Science or related field with exposure to AI/ML.

 - Deep expertise in AI/ML, software engineering, or AI security.

 - Strong programming skills in Python, and relevant ML and/or agentic frameworks.

 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with a high degree of end-to-end ownership, delivering real world outcomes.

 - Ability to pick up other programming languages and technologies as required to ship scalable and reliable software.
   
   


HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - PhD in Computer Science or related field with focus on AI/ML or similar.

 - Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: agent orchestration, agent harnesses, agent teams, jailbreaking / prompt injection, red teaming, data poisoning or evasion attacks, secure model deployment or sandboxing, detection and monitoring for AI misuse.

 - Experience contributing to open source projects.

 - Experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Experience in cybersecurity is a plus, but not essential.
   


WHY JOIN US?

We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

 - Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

 - Career Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.




SANDBOXAQ WELCOMES ALL

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Accommodations: We provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in job application procedures for open roles. If you need such an accommodation, please let a member of our Recruiting team know.

jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Pharmacist

Type of Work: Per-Diem, Part-Time, or Full-Time available
Location: 1351 Kearns Blvd Suite 110-B, Park City, UT 84060
Pay Rate: $60-65/hr, flexible for the right candidate!

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

• No dealing with insurance companies or vaccines! Spend more time providing personalized guidance to medical patients.

• We offer weekdays, evenings, weekends, and holidays with a focus on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

• Join a team that values collaboration, respect, and exceptional care for our customers.

Who You Are:

As a Pharmacist at Curaleaf, you’ll play a key role in our retail dispensary, ensuring smooth operations and compliant distribution of cannabis products. You are a customer-focused and detail-oriented professional passionate about patient care. You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, guiding patients and dispensary staff with your expertise in product knowledge, dosing, and consumption methods.

You excel at educating, consulting, and ensuring compliance with inventory, security, and regulatory protocols, helping create an outstanding patient experience while supporting business goals.

What You’ll Do:

• Patient Consults: Provide patients with accurate product recommendations, dosing, consumption methods, and product details.

• Patient Care: Assist patients with questions, concerns, and complaints, adjusting recommendations and/or dosing based on patient feedback.

• Team Training: Train team members on product knowledge, ensuring they provide proper recommendations to patients.

• Patient and Physician Outreach: Build and maintain relationships with physicians, patients, politicians, and professionals in the community.

• Cannabis Knowledge: Deepen your understanding of cannabis products, dosing, drug interactions, side effects, and the efficacy of different strains and delivery methods.

• Store Operations: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and all federal and state laws. Oversee inventory audits and dispensing operations.

• Inventory Monitoring: Assist with inventory forecasting, product intake, and maintaining systems for regulatory reporting and sales analysis.

What You’ll Bring:

• An active Pharmacy License in the state you’re applying for.

• Strong knowledge of the retail and pharmacy landscape.

• A passion for patient care and the medical cannabis industry.

• Effective communication skills at all levels inside and outside the organization.

• Outstanding customer service skills, with the ability to address concerns professionally.

• Flexibility with scheduling, able to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, talk or hear, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, use hands and finger to feel, reach with hands and arms, and lift up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to climb, balance, and lift up to 25 pounds. This position requires close vision (clear vision at 20 inches or less).

Work Environment:

This job operates in a professional retail environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, POS systems, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. This position has allergen warnings including potential exposure to dust, pollen, and plant pathogens and requires the ability to work in confined spaces, have a high stress tolerance, adaptability, and be flexible to work in an ever-changing environment.

Curaleaf Pay Transparency

$60—$65 USD

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

Follow us on Social Media:
Instagram: @curaleaf.usa

jobs.title: Fortinet Network Security Engineer - North Central region
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Fortinet Network Security Engineer to support our Network Security & PKI Practice in designing, implementing, and managing Fortinet based security solutions for our managed service and consulting clients. This role will engage in the development of resilient firewall, VPN, and SD-WAN architectures while providing “Wow Them” service to clients and/or internal customers or co-workers.

The Fortinet Network Security Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive network security programs that will align the delivery with business objectives and priorities.

About the Network Security & PKI Practice - North Central region

The Network Security & PKI Practice is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the network security and encryption technologies that protect our clients’ environments. We deliver firewall, secure connectivity, segmentation, and public key infrastructure solutions across the organization and for our managed service and consulting clients.

Our team of network security engineers, consultants, and architects focuses on next generation firewalls, SD-WAN, secure remote access, and zero trust architecture across leading vendor platforms. We partner with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and internal practices to translate security requirements into reliable, well documented outcomes.

Current initiatives and areas of focus include:

• Delivering managed Fortinet security services across multi-tenant, multi-client environments

• Advancing zero trust architecture and network segmentation for clients in regulated industries

• Standardizing repeatable, well documented deployment and operational practices

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and support network security solutions using Fortinet technologies (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch).

• Configure and manage firewall policies, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), SD-WAN, and UTM features.

• Utilize FortiManager for centralized management and policy deployment across multiple FortiGate devices.

• Use FortiAnalyzer for event correlation, log analysis, and reporting.

• Perform regular health checks, upgrades, and policy audits on Fortinet equipment.

• Support networking infrastructure, including switching, VLANs, static and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP), and subnetting.

• Troubleshoot network and security issues across multiple clients or environments.

• Collaborate with clients and internal teams to recommend and implement security best practices.

• Document configurations, diagrams, and standard operating procedures.

Required Experience and Education:

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with Fortinet security technologies (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch).

• Solid understanding of core networking concepts: subnetting, NAT, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), switching, and VLANs.

• Experience with firewall policy creation, security profiles, and VPN configurations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Basic Fortinet certification required prior to hire (NSE 4 or higher preferred).

• Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education

• Experience with multi-tenant firewall environments and managing clients in regulated industries.

• Familiarity with FortiAP, FortiClient EMS, and FortiAuthenticator.

• Exposure to network segmentation, zero trust architecture, or compliance-driven security implementations.

• Experience working with MSPs or in a consulting/VAR role.

Travel Requirements:

• Up to 25% travel

Physical Requirements:

• Sedentary work

• Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

• Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)

• Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)

• Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

• 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program

• Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance

• Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment

• Pet Benefit Option

jobs.title: O&M Technician
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Under the direction of Project Management, performs work involving the day-to-day operation and maintenance of the Drinking Water facility including all related infrastructure, equipment, buildings, and grounds.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Performs technical O&M activities related to the Drinking Water facility, including all related infrastructure, equipment, processes, and systems.
• Performs routine PM activities related to the including all related infrastructure, equipment, processes, and systems.
• Conducts Drinking Water sampling and laboratory monitoring per Project and Regulatory requirements.
• Assists in ensuring all equipment and processes are well maintained and functioning properly.
• Perform work in a safe and professional manner by following all corporate and regulatory policies, procedures, and emergency response procedures.
• Work weekends, holidays, and be on-call on a rotating basis/schedule with fellow operators.
• Respond to emergencies, work additional hours as required to complete tasks as/and when needed.
• Assists project and department to develop a culture of focus and engagement at the project to achieve EH&S excellence.
• Completes and maintains proper operational and maintenance documents and records.
• Operates equipment and processes manually and through instrument control panels.
• Operates project vehicles.
• Performs cleanup/housekeeping activities at all facilities, buildings, and grounds.
• Carries out other duties as assigned.

Work Environment:

• Work is performed both inside and outside with exposure to all kinds of weather conditions.
• Incumbent may be occasionally exposed to some noise, silica, dust, fumes, smoke, gases, greases, oils, electrical energy, solvents, and vibrations.
• Incumbent may work on slippery/uneven surfaces, around machinery with moving parts, moving objects/vehicles, and ladder/scaffolding, below ground and may be exposed to water and other liquid materials.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.
• 5+ years of experience working in the Drinking water or industry or related fields.
• Experience in a laboratory or utility related field, or a combination of education and experience required.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Strong reading, math, writing, and verbal communication skills
• Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to read, interpret, and record data from meters, gauges, scales, panels, computer consoles, and other equipment.
• Computer skills, knowledge of Windows/Google, Office, Operations, Lab and CMMS programs, SCADA and PLC equipment and systems.
• Troubleshooting/problem solving skills, provides input for corrective actions and implements corrective actions as needed.
• Ability to understand/execute written and oral instructions, read/understand technical instructions and manuals.
• Working knowledge and skills to operate specialty tools specific to Departmental needs and requirements.
• Ability to operate complex controls, processes, and equipment.
• Ability to maintain and repair equipment, have a strong mechanical aptitude.
• Knowledge of Drinking water treatment systems, processes, and equipment.
• Knowledge of Drinking water regulations, requirements & reporting.
• Cooperative interactions with fellow employees and within the project organization.
• Must be able to work as a team in a teamwork-oriented environment.
• Must be safety conscious and at times be able to work independently with little/no supervision.
• Must be able to work closely with local contractors.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Valid Massachusetts T-2/D-2 or higher Drinking Water Treatment/ Distribution License.
• Willingness to obtain T-3 in one year from the date of hire.
• Valid MA Driver’s license.
• Willingness to upgrade licenses in a mutually agreed upon amount of time.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Manager to lead and oversee residential electrical service and installation operations. This role is responsible for managing daily department activities, developing and supporting a high-performing team, maintaining technical and safety standards, and driving operational efficiency, revenue growth, and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate combines strong electrical expertise with proven leadership and business management capabilities. This individual will oversee workforce planning, scheduling, job quality, labor productivity, and department performance while partnering with leadership and other departments to support business objectives. The successful candidate will lead by example, promote accountability, develop talent, and ensure customers receive reliable, high-quality electrical solutions.

• Competitive compensation package with performance-based bonus opportunities

• Company vehicle and gas card

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

• Supportive team environment with opportunities for career growth and advancement

Key Responsibilities

• Department Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop electricians and apprentices while supporting hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management.

• Service and Installation Operations: Oversee daily operations, scheduling, workload distribution, and resource allocation to ensure efficient, timely, and high-quality service delivery.

• Technical Quality and Safety: Ensure compliance with applicable electrical codes, permitting requirements, and safety standards while overseeing inspections, troubleshooting, and quality control.

• Financial and Operational Performance: Monitor revenue, profitability, job costs, labor productivity, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to improve department efficiency and business results.

• Estimating and Project Coordination: Partner with sales, estimating, and operations teams on job scopes, pricing, project planning, and resource requirements.

• Customer Satisfaction: Oversee escalated service issues, resolve customer concerns, and promote quality workmanship, professional communication, and ethical service recommendations.

• Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve workflows, technician performance, service capacity, and overall departmental effectiveness.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 10 years of electrical industry experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role.

• Residential electrical service and installation experience strongly preferred.

• Valid Master Electrician license, as required by applicable state and local regulations.

• Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop electricians and apprentices.

• Strong knowledge of electrical systems, troubleshooting, installation practices, electrical codes, and safety standards.

• Experience overseeing service operations, scheduling, job costing, labor productivity, and departmental performance.

• Familiarity with field service management software, such as ServiceTitan, and experience using KPIs to drive operational improvements.

• Working knowledge of estimating, project planning, and reading blueprints, schematics, and technical drawings.

• Strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and customer service skills, with a valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.

• Candidates must successfully complete applicable background checks, drug screening, physical examinations, and lift assessments, where permitted by law.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This position combines office-based administrative and management responsibilities with regular field activity at residential job sites. The role requires the ability to visit job sites, communicate with customers and employees, inspect electrical work, and provide technical guidance in active work environments.

Field activities may include climbing ladders, navigating uneven surfaces, working in confined spaces, operating or inspecting the use of hand and power tools, and exposure to outdoor weather, noise, dust, and other job-site conditions. The position may require occasional lifting, pushing, or pulling of materials weighing up to 50 pounds. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As Growth Marketing Lead, you’ll own how ClassDojo reaches new families beyond our existing network. For two exciting consumer products: Dojo Sparks, and Dojo Islands. Both products have grown fast, with Islands reaching millions of kids every month. You’ll set the strategy and personally execute on high-leverage acquisition experiments—building, testing, and scaling channels that drive net-new paid users for our consumer products.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy, IC-first role. You’ll operate like a one-person growth marketing team initially: setting direction, running experiments end to end, analyzing results, and scaling what works. Over time, you’ll help build the systems, processes, and partnerships that allow growth to compound efficiently.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Creative, Data, and Marketing leaders, and work alongside another growth leader focused on internal ClassDojo network growth. Your mandate is external acquisition—finding repeatable ways to reach and convert families who don’t yet know ClassDojo.

This role requires a builder’s mindset: someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly without perfect resources, and uses strong judgment and data to decide where to double down.

 


YOU WILL: 

 - Set and own the strategy for new user acquisition across paid and unpaid channels, with an early focus on social and influencer partnerships

 - Personally run growth experiments end to end—defining hypotheses, launching tests, analyzing results, and making scale/kill decisions

 - Identify and validate new acquisition channels through scrappy, manual approaches first, then scale successful bets via agencies, tooling, and automation

 - Establish clear success metrics and ROI thresholds to guide investment and prioritization

 - Partner closely with Product and Creative and Product Marketing to test value propositions, landing experiences, and onboarding flows that improve conversion

 - Build a durable experimentation and measurement framework that enables fast iteration across messaging, targeting, and funnel steps

 - Leverage external resources and modern tools (including AI) to maximize impact without overbuilding internal teams

 - Help shape the long-term growth marketing muscle at ClassDojo, with potential to take on people leadership as impact is proven




YOU WILL BE A MATCH IF:

 - 8+ years of experience in growth, performance, or consumer marketing, ideally at high-growth consumer or marketplace companies

 - A proven track record of owning acquisition outcomes end to end—not just managing a single channel

 - Strong analytical judgment and comfort using data to evaluate ROI, conversion, and growth tradeoffs

 - Experience operating as a generalist in small or mid-sized teams (e.g., 30–150 people) where you “owned the whole thing”

 - Depth in at least one acquisition channel (e.g., paid social, influencer, partnerships, SEO, SEM), with strong mental models across others

 - A hands-on, execution-oriented mindset: you balance strategy with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and drive details

 - Comfort operating with high autonomy and ambiguity—able to self-direct and prioritize without heavy process

 - Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to partner effectively across Product, Creative, and Data




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You’ve built or scaled influencer- or creator-led growth programs

 - You’ve worked on consumer subscription or paid consumer products

 - You’ve operated in early-stage or fast-scaling environments as a builder or first marketing hire

 - You’re excited about using AI and new tools to move faster and experiment more effectively

 - You care deeply about product quality and long-term, sustainable growth—not just short-term wins

jobs.title: Electrician Maintenance
jobs.location: Offutt Air Force Base, NE, United States
jobs.description:
The Electrician Maintenance performs preventive and corrective maintenance, inspection, testing, troubleshooting, installation, and repair of real property and real property installed electrical systems supporting CMI’s customer in Omaha, NE.

Key Job Functions

• Supports continuous mission readiness by maintaining safe, reliable low- and medium-voltage distribution, emergency power, lighting, grounding, lightning protection, and related electrical infrastructure in accordance with applicable codes, manufacturer requirements, and Government procedures.
• Maintain, inspect, test, troubleshoot, repair, and install low- and medium-voltage electrical systems below 4,160 volts, including switchgear, transformers, panelboards, branch circuits, distribution equipment, controllers, circuit breakers, motors, outlets, and manual and automatic transfer switches.
• Operate, inspect, test, and maintain emergency generators and associated backup-power equipment; support restoration of backup power within 15 minutes of an outage when assigned to operate emergency generators.
• Perform quarterly inspections and annual load testing of uninterruptible power supply systems and batteries that support life-safety real property installed equipment.
• Repair or replace interior and applicable exterior lighting fixtures, matching existing material, type, color temperature, and lumen output.
• Maintain, test, and repair grounding, lightning protection, and applicable corrosion-control systems in accordance with current UFC, NFPA, Air Force, and manufacturer requirements.
• Perform standard electrical maintenance within and supporting HEMP-protected areas without disturbing the HEMP shield or specialized points-of-entry devices; coordinate required outages or work affecting HEMP interfaces with the Government.
• Read and interpret blueprints, as-built drawings, electrical diagrams, layouts, specifications, and manufacturer instructions; perform load calculations and use electrical hand tools, meters, and testing instruments.
• Document labor, materials, equipment usage, as-found and as-left conditions, cause and remedy, asset information, and completion notes in NexGen IT/TRIRIGA or other Government-designated systems.
• Support preventive maintenance schedules, asset inventories, condition assessments, lifecycle planning, calibration records, electrical coordination studies, redline drawings, and required outage and generator reports.
• Respond to Priority 1 electrical emergencies, initiate on-site mitigation within required response times, and participate in root-cause analysis for qualifying failures.
• Coordinate planned outages at least 14 calendar days in advance and immediately report unplanned outages, restoration status, and known causes to designated Government representatives.
• Comply with lockout/tagout, arc-flash, fall protection, confined-space, PPE, environmental, security, and controlled-area access requirements, and maintain safe, orderly electrical and mechanical work areas.

• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• Completion of a formal electrical apprenticeship or equivalent combination of technical training and directly related experience required.
• Minimum 5 years of experience maintaining electrical systems in large commercial, industrial, mission-critical, or comparable facilities.
• Must hold and maintain all electrician licenses and certifications required by Nebraska, a state recognized by Nebraska, and applicable local electrical codes.
• Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code, NFPA requirements, OSHA standards, applicable Unified Facilities Criteria, Air Force electrical requirements, and manufacturer specifications.
• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, maintain, and repair electrical distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, transfer switches, generators, UPS systems, motors, controls, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection systems.
• Training and demonstrated competency in electrical and arc-flash safety, lockout/tagout, PPE, fall protection, ladders, mobile elevated work platforms, confined spaces, rigging, and other safety topics applicable to assigned work.
• Ability to use computerized maintenance management systems and accurately document work orders, asset data, labor, materials, testing results, and corrective actions; NexGen IT/TRIRIGA experience is preferred.
• Must be able to obtain and maintain required Government credentials, including a Common Access Card when needed for system access, and comply with background investigation requirements.
• Must possess and maintain at least a Secret security clearance; a Top Secret clearance is required when assigned access to Top Secret or TS/SCI areas. U.S. citizenship is required for clearance eligibility.
• Must be available to support 24/7 mission-essential operations, emergency response, federal holidays, severe weather events, and Government shutdown periods as assigned.

COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

• Teamwork
• Results orientation/operational excellence
• Holding self and other accountable
• Operational business thinking

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Who we are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who you are

Metropolis is seeking a Senior Data Scientist, Growth Marketing to join our growing data team. In this role, you will serve as the primary quantitative partner to our Growth Marketing leadership, turning massive real-world transactional and behavioral datasets into engines for user acquisition, retention, and gross profit expansion. You bring a deep background in marketing measurement and causal inference, with proven experience building multi-touch attribution systems, modeling customer lifetime value (LTV), and designing rigorous marketing experiments. You excel not only at building complex predictive models, but also at translating high-level data insights into clear business strategies for cross-functional stakeholders across Growth, Product, and Finance.

What you'll do

• Design, deploy, and refine predictive models for Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency to guide multi-channel marketing budget allocation

• Conduct deep-dive cohort analyses and retention modeling to uncover drivers of user conversion, repeat behavior, and churn across our location-based growth funnel

• Lead the growth experimentation roadmap by designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests, geo-experiments, holdout tests, and incrementality studies across digital and physical acquisition channels

• Partner directly with Growth Marketing and Finance leaders to optimize unit economics, justify marketing spend against gross profit targets, and set channel-level growth goals

• Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish event tracking requirements, build scalable growth data pipelines, and develop automated executive dashboards

• Utilize advanced AI tools and modern analytics frameworks to transform static analytical workflows into responsive, high-output processes

What we're looking for

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field

• 6+ years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or Analytics Lead, with a distinct focus on growth marketing, performance media, or adtech

• Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics

• Deep domain expertise in growth measurement frameworks, multi-touch attribution, cohort retention modeling, and LTV/CAC dynamics

• Hands-on experience with statistical experimentation and causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, geo-testing, synthetic controls, and media mix modeling

• Strong business acumen with a track record of partnering with senior executives in Growth, Product, and Finance to drive measurable bottom-line growth

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to make complex data stories intuitive and actionable

• Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

While not required, these are a plus:

• Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS S3, SageMaker, and Airflow

• Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Looker, and Tableau

• Familiarity with Media Mix Modeling (MMM) frameworks including Robyn and LightweightMMM

• Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch applied to user segmentation or churn prediction

• Ability to write clean, efficient, robust, and well-commented code to produce high-quality data science procedures

4 Days in Office: Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection.

When you join Metropolis, you’ll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $170,000 USD to $200,000 USD annually. The actual base pay offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base pay is one component of Metropolis’s total compensation package, which usually includes: healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans, and more. #LI-RR1 #LI-Onsite

As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records.

jobs.description:

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. jobs.location: Offutt Air Force Base, NE, United States
jobs.description:
The General Maintenance Worker supports 24/7/365 operations, maintenance, repair, and sustainment of CMI’s customer site in Omaha, Nebraska.

Key Job Functions

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance, responds to service requests, documents work in the Government-designated work management system, and helps maintain mission-ready real property and installed equipment.
• Perform assigned preventive, predictive, corrective, and emergency maintenance on facility architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, and other real property installed equipment within training, authorization, and trade limitations.
• Complete minor repairs and sustainment work, including touch-up painting, drywall and interior-finish repairs, minor carpentry, fixture hardware replacement, filter changes, basic plumbing repairs, furniture assembly, and other routine upkeep.
• Inspect and maintain doors and associated hardware; facility exteriors; roofing, flashing, gutters, and drains; interior finishes; plumbing fixtures; drainage components; lighting; and other assigned building systems and promptly report deficiencies requiring specialized repair.
• Repair or replace authorized lighting components and fixtures, matching existing material, color temperature, and lumen output; perform work on energized systems only when properly qualified and authorized.
• Support HVAC and mechanical maintenance activities such as filter and belt replacement, lubrication, minor adjustments, winterization assistance, equipment-room upkeep, and documentation of observed operating conditions.
• Respond to Priority 1 emergencies and routine service requests as assigned, initiate mitigation actions, protect personnel and property, and immediately elevate mission, safety, security, utility, environmental, or equipment risks.
• Use NexGen IT/TRIRIGA or the Government-designated system to receive work, update status, record labor and materials, document as-found and as-left conditions, enter cause and remedy notes, and close assigned work accurately and promptly.
• Perform work in accordance with manufacturer instructions, applicable Unified Facilities Criteria, Air Force requirements, and accepted industry standards; strive for first-time quality and avoid repeat deficiencies.
• Follow all safety programs and procedures, including lockout/tagout, confined-space, fall-protection, electrical/arc-flash, ladder, material-handling, personal protective equipment, hazard communication, and spill-response requirements.
• Maintain clean, orderly mechanical and electrical work areas; safeguard Government property, keys, tools, materials, and controlled information; and restore work areas and affected surfaces after maintenance or repair.
• Coordinate planned outages, access, dig permits, and work near controlled or HEMP-protected areas through the supervisor and designated Government representatives; do not disturb HEMP shield components or create or modify penetrations.
• Support inventories, condition assessments, preventive-maintenance schedules, inspections, equipment records, and required reports; identify missing, damaged, failing, or out-of-tolerance assets.
• Maintain a professional appearance, provide responsive customer service, participate in emergency drills and mission-essential operations, and perform other duties consistent with the contract requirements and assigned skill level.

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• At least three (3) years of related facilities maintenance experience, including preventive maintenance, basic building repairs, and service-request response.

• Ability to obtain and maintain required installation credentials and access, including DBIDS and, when duties require Government network access, a Common Access Card and favorable background investigation.

• Applicable federal, state, local, and industry licenses or certifications are required when performing regulated trade work; duties outside the employee’s qualifications must be referred to appropriately licensed or certified personnel.
• Ability to learn and accurately use NexGen IT/TRIRIGA and other Government-designated maintenance or reporting systems.
• Working knowledge of OSHA requirements and the ability to complete required training in lockout/tagout, confined space, fall protection, hazard communication, personal protective equipment, and other job-specific safety programs.

jobs.title: Customer Sucess Manager III - San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

As a Customer Success Manager III at OpenGov, you are a strategic architect of customer value. You will own a dedicated portfolio of ~40 high-impact customers, serving as their primary long-term partner tasked with understanding their unique goals, challenges &  workflows. This is a senior-level role for a CSM who excels at navigating complex political landscapes, driving process transformation, and securing long-term retention through measurable business outcomes. You won't just manage accounts; you will influence the digital transformation of modern government.

 
 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategic Portfolio Leadership: Own the end-to-end success strategy for ~40 customers, aligning OpenGov’s platform with their specific legislative goals and operational challenges.

 - Executive Advisory: Build and nurture deep relationships with Department Heads, City Managers, and Finance Directors, acting as a trusted advisor to drive high retention and platform stickiness.

 - Complex Change Management: Guide customers through significant process changes, leveraging industry best practices to ensure deep product adoption and workflow optimization.

 - Business Impact Reporting: Design and deliver high-impact Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) that translate usage data into tangible value and ROI for stakeholders.

 - Retention & Growth: Proactively monitor portfolio health to mitigate churn risk and identify expansion opportunities that align with the customer’s long-term roadmap.

 - Adoption & Value Consulting: Be able to design programs to maximize the adoption of OpenGov across your customers, resulting in a measurable increase in value.

 - Cross-Functional Advocacy: Partner with Sales, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex roadblocks and ensure the "Voice of the Customer" informs our future product development.

 - Process Innovation: Contribute to the "playbook." As a CSM III, you’ll help build our workflows for churn prevention and onboarding efficiency.

 
 


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - SaaS Expertise: Minimum of 3–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related high-touch SaaS role.

 - Proven Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer relationships, hit high Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets, and drive revenue growth.

 - Strategic Thinking: A customer-centric mindset with the ability to move between high-level strategy and tactical execution.

 - Advanced Communication: Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, specifically the ability to command a room of executive-level decision-makers.

 - Technical Proficiency: Willingness to be hands-on in product; Mastery of CRM and CS tools such as Salesforce, Gong, or Gainsight.

 - Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field.

 - Industry Context: Previous experience in GovTech or working directly with government agencies is highly preferred.

 - Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to meet with key customers in person (approx. 25-30%).




COMPENSATION 

San Francisco, CA: $120,000 - $135,000



On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

 




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.description:
The Heating, Ventilation, and Air-Conditioning (HVAC) Mechanic operates, maintains, calibrates, troubleshoots, repairs, programs, and balances real property HVAC equipment and facility-related control systems at CMI’s customer site in Omaha, Nebraska.

Key Job Functions

• Support continuous, safe, efficient, and reliable operation of mission-critical facilities, including primary HVAC systems serving communications and server rooms, Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC) units, associated ductwork, controls, and water-treatment components.
• Operate, inspect, maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, repair, program, and balance HVAC equipment and facility-related control systems in accordance with manufacturer requirements, applicable Unified Facilities Criteria, ASHRAE standards, and approved maintenance procedures.
• Maintain mission-critical HVAC systems, including primary units serving communications and server rooms and all Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC) units, to support continuous facility readiness and required critical-system availability.
• Perform predictive, preventive, corrective, and emergency maintenance; respond to priority work orders; mitigate equipment failures; and support root-cause analyses for emergencies, repeated failures, and major repairs.
• Inspect, clean, repair, insulate, and balance ductwork; fabricate and install duct sections and HVAC components using approved hand tools, portable metalworking tools, and welding or joining equipment as qualified.
• Install, service, and replace compressors, condensers, evaporators, motors, valves, piping, tubing, filters, belts, fittings, controls, thermostats, switches, fuses, and related electrical components within authorized trade scope.
• Recover, charge, and handle refrigerants in compliance with EPA Section 608 requirements; test systems for pressure, vacuum, and leaks; and submit required refrigerant reports whenever refrigerant is added, recovered, or lost.
• Winterize air-handling equipment as required to prevent coil freezing and support semiannual testing of the Collective Protection System.
• Maintain Direct Digital Control (DDC), Energy Management Control System (EMCS), and Building Management System (BMS) functions, including schedules, set points, setbacks, backups, alarms, trending data, and control calibration.
• Support HVAC water-treatment and corrosion-control activities through inspections, sampling, chemical treatment, minor remediation, and monthly documentation of water analysis, chemical usage, and corrective actions.
• Use NexGen IT/TRIRIGA or the Government-designated work management system to receive and update work orders, record labor and materials, document as-found and as-left conditions, enter cause-and-remedy notes, identify deficiencies, and request follow-on corrective work.
• Maintain accurate equipment, calibration, maintenance, warranty, and condition records; assist with physical asset inventories, preventive-maintenance task lists, and lifecycle condition assessments.
• Read and work from as-built drawings, blueprints, engineering specifications, manufacturer manuals, control diagrams, shop sketches, and verbal or written work instructions.
• Follow lockout/tagout, confined-space, fall-protection, refrigerant-safety, electrical/arc-flash, personal protective equipment, hazardous-material, and other applicable OSHA, Air Force, and site safety requirements.
• Coordinate planned outages and work affecting controlled or HEMP-protected areas; do not disturb HEMP shield components, specialized points of entry, filters, seals, waveguides, or penetrations; immediately report potential damage or configuration concerns.
• Maintain clean and orderly mechanical rooms, protect Government property, restore work areas after maintenance, and provide professional customer service while coordinating with Government representatives and other contractors.
• Support 24/7 mission-essential operations, emergency response, after-hours callout, and continuity during holidays, base closures, emergencies, or Government shutdowns as directed.

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Journeyman-level HVAC qualification, license, or demonstrated experience equivalent to a recognized journeyman HVAC mechanic; must maintain all applicable federal, Nebraska, local, and industry-required trade credentials.
• At least five (5) years of related commercial or industrial HVAC operations and maintenance experience, preferably in a mission-critical, secure, or continuously operating facility.
• Current EPA Section 608 certification appropriate for the refrigerants and equipment serviced.
• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and maintaining refrigeration systems, air handlers, CRAC units, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, pumps, motors, duct systems, and associated hydronic or refrigerant piping.
• Working knowledge of DDC, EMCS, BMS, and facility-related control systems, including control calibration, programming, set points, schedules, backups, alarms, and trending; OEM-specific certification may be required for proprietary systems.
• Knowledge of HVAC water treatment, corrosion control, refrigerant management, system balancing, and applicable ASHRAE, manufacturer, and Unified Facilities Criteria requirements.
• Ability to use electronic work-management systems and accurately document labor, materials, asset information, inspection results, equipment condition, and cause-and-remedy details.
• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, as-built drawings, control diagrams, engineering specifications, equipment nameplates, and manufacturer operation and maintenance manuals.
• Knowledge of and ability to comply with lockout/tagout, confined-space, fall-protection, electrical/arc-flash, hazardous-material, refrigerant, and personal protective equipment requirements; additional site safety training may be required.

jobs.title: Load Balancer / WAF Engineer - North Central region
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Load Balancer / WAF Engineer to support our Network Security & PKI Practice in deploying and managing cloud based DDoS protection, Web Application Firewall, and application delivery solutions for our enterprise and managed service clients. This role will engage in the development of secure, resilient, high performing traffic delivery architectures while providing “Wow Them” service to clients and/or internal customers or co-workers.

The Load Balancer / WAF Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive edge and application security programs that will align the delivery with business objectives and priorities.

About the Network Security & PKI Practice - North Central region

The Network Security & PKI Practice is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the network security and encryption technologies that protect our clients’ environments. We deliver firewall, secure connectivity, segmentation, and public key infrastructure solutions across the organization and for our managed service and consulting clients.

Our team of network security engineers, consultants, and architects focuses on edge security, web application firewalls, DDoS mitigation, load balancing, and application delivery across leading cloud and on-premises platforms. We partner with application, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to ensure secure and resilient traffic flow to internet facing assets.

Current initiatives and areas of focus include:

• Delivering cloud WAF and DDoS mitigation services for enterprise clients

• Migrating on-premises application delivery platforms to modern cloud edge equivalents

• Strengthening API security, bot mitigation, and application-layer protection

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Design, deploy, and manage cloud based security platforms, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, bot protection, and CDN configuration (Cloudflare, Akamai, etc.).

• Build and manage custom rules (page rules, rate limits, transform rules, iRules) to enforce security policies and traffic optimization.

• Work closely with application, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to ensure secure and resilient traffic flow to internet facing assets.

• Optimize configurations for latency, performance, and availability, including global traffic routing, failover, and load balancing.

• Support incident response efforts involving DDoS events or WAF bypass attempts.

• Document configurations and provide operational runbooks for client handoffs or internal support teams.

• Conduct WAF and edge security assessments to identify improvements or misconfigurations.

• Assist in migration from or integration with on-premises platforms such as F5, including custom logic translation to cloud WAF equivalents.

• Stay up to date on evolving threat actor behaviors, industry DDoS tactics, and mitigation techniques.

Required Experience and Education:

• 2 to 4 years of experience managing cloud WAF/DDoS platforms in enterprise environments.

• Deep familiarity with Cloudflare and/or Akamai edge protection services.

• Experience building custom page rules, rate limiting policies, or traffic filtering logic.

• Strong knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, load balancing, NAT, routing).

• Hands-on experience with on-premises application delivery controllers such as F5 BIG-IP, especially iRules, SSL offloading, and WAF modules.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across application-layer traffic and network-layer protection.

• Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and edge integration patterns (e.g., using Cloudflare with AWS ALB).

• Experience automating WAF/DNS/DDoS configurations via API or Terraform.

• Certifications related to Cloudflare, Akamai, F5, or network security (e.g., F5 CTS, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

• Experience with API security protections, client fingerprinting, and bot mitigation strategies.

• Experience working in consulting, MSP, or client-facing roles.

Travel Requirements:

• Up to 25% travel

Physical Requirements:

• Sedentary work

• Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

• Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)

• Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)

• Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us:

A global SaaS leader for seamless digital document workflows, Nitro offers a suite of solutions for PDF, eSigning, identity verification and analytics supported by a best-in-class customer success and change management team. With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.

How We Work:

We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:

• One team, One mission Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.

• Own it We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.

• Accountable to our customers We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.

• Excellence in execution Driven by passion and precision, ​we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.

• Be bold, fail fast, learn faster We learn as we grow, dare to try, ​and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

The Role:

We're looking for an experienced Strategic Account Executive to play a pivotal role in producing incremental sales revenue within the sales department. In this role, you will actively and consistently attain Nitro quarterly and annual sales targets. Your ability to prospect and close your own net-new business is imperative to your success and over achievement at Nitro.

The Strategic Account Executive role is expected to deliver Nitro’s differentiated message to key decision makers, demonstrating how the knowledge worker adoption of Nitro drives productivity, increases information security and resource sustainability. The Strategic Account Executive is expected to manage their time and customer engagement effectively to deliver the highest revenue return by activity type. Nitro’s Account Executives shall be a trusted adviser to assist prospects and customers during this transformative process.

What you'll be doing:

• Hunting, prospecting and developing a network within your set territory to acquire net-new logos

• Engage and empower channel partners to build partner led pipeline within your territory

• Developing a deep understanding of pipeline development and pipeline diversification with the ability to answer questions including: what pipeline coverage do I require to maximize on target success? What is my gap and what activities do I need to undertake to fill them? What are the sources that contribute to my pipeline and how do I ensure I have a good mix of large and small opportunities?

• Applying time and intelligence to move prospects through Nitro’s sales cycle – from prospecting to close
