jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIGHTFIELD

Lightfield is reimagining CRM as a world model of a business. By learning from emails, meetings, and customer conversations, we’re building a living understanding of how a company works—so AI can help teams anticipate what comes next, make better decisions, and take action.

More than 5,000 companies have used the product since its November launch. We’ve raised more than $70M from Andreessen Horowitz, Coatue, Maverick Ventures, and Greylock to attack the biggest software category in the world. We previously built Tome, which reached more than 25 million users, and our team brings experience from Llama, Instagram, Google, and Salesforce.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring founding Deployment Strategists for our Growth & Delivery team.

The team deploys Lightfield for customers, delivers their pipeline generation motion, supports strategic deals alongside our leadership team, and drives special projects across GTM and business operations.

You'll work directly with founders and their teams to deploy Lightfield as the system their company runs on, build their customer memory, put agents to work generating pipeline, and help their business grow. The agents do the work—you bring the judgment and taste that guide them, and the advisory relationship with the customer.

You're both an operator and a builder: running many customer deployments at once, and turning what works into playbooks the whole team can run.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own each customer's deployment end to end: set up their workspace, migrate their data, build their customer memory, and enable their team, so Lightfield becomes the system their company runs on

 - Deliver pipeline generation for a portfolio of customers: understand each business, define the ICP and targeting strategy, and direct Lightfield's agents from first outreach to booked meetings

 - Advise founders and GTM leaders on their go-to-market and how to put AI agents to work in it

 - Own the outcomes: time-to-activation, meetings booked, and the quality of the pipeline behind them

 - Support strategic deals alongside our leadership team, from scoping POCs to helping convert evaluations into customers

 - Take on special projects across GTM and business operations, from business analysis to competitive research to new initiatives

 - Turn what works into playbooks, and feed what you learn back to product so the agents get better




WHO YOU ARE

 - 3+ years of experience in consulting, banking, investing, or go-to-market and operating roles

 - A strong generalist, comfortable across delivery, growth, and customer-facing work. You don't wait to be handed a lane and instead figure out what needs to happen and do it

 - A trusted advisor to founders and GTM leaders - curious and analytical, able to read a business and its customers quickly, move from qualitative signals to a clear hypothesis, and back your view with data.

 - A systems thinker who brings structure to open-ended problems and builds playbooks and repeatable processes, not just completed tasks

 - High agency and thrives in ambiguity, able to independently drive projects and deliver results in a fast-moving environment

 - Comfortable going technical: you can reason about data models and integrations, configure workflows, and tune how an agent behaves

 - You're excited about AI agents and the opportunity to deliver customer outcomes with them

 - Eager to learn GTM and outbound. Prior experience is a plus, not a prerequisite




BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive salary

 - Meaningful early equity

 - Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)

 - 3 weeks of PTO

 - 11 paid company holidays + we enjoy a winter holiday break

 - 3 months of paid family leave

 - Wednesdays work from home

 - Regular team dinners, events, offsites, and retreats

 - 401k plan

 - Other perks include: commuter and lunch stipend

jobs.title: Chronic Care Management Program Lead, Fee for Service
jobs.description:
At Diverge Health we are passionate about improving health access and outcomes for those most in need. We partner with primary care providers to improve the engagement and management of their Medicaid patients, offering independent practices with specialized resources and clinical programs to close gaps in care. Our teams work to address medical, social and behavioral patient needs, lowering healthcare costs and improving patient lives. Guided by our core values of humility, continuous learning and feeling the weight, our team is on a mission to strengthen communities from within, unlocking people's ability to live their healthiest lives.

We are seeking a Chronic Care Management Program Lead, Fee for Service to join our team! In this role, you will be the hands-on expert who understands our fee for service care management work end to end, from care planning and medication reconciliation through documentation and billing. You will support health centers as they decide whether to partner with us, guide them through onboarding, and be the go-to resource for our delivery team as this work scales.

What you'll do

As Chronic Care Management Program Lead, Fee for Service, you will play a pivotal role in making sure our fee for service care management work is grounded in real, hands-on expertise at every stage, from the first conversation with a health center to the claim that gets billed.

Key areas you'll add value

• Support Practice Liaisons during health center pitches by answering the detailed clinical and billing questions that come up as centers decide whether to sign on.

• Own onboarding of newly signed health centers in partnership with Practice Liaisons, translating the fee for service model into the practical steps a center's staff need to get started.

• Serve as the tactical subject matter expert for the team delivering fee for service care management day to day, answering real time questions grounded in hands on experience with the work.

• Be the point of contact when health centers hit billing issues, tracing the problem back to its root cause in documentation or workflow rather than treating it as a standalone billing error.

• Build and maintain the frequently asked questions and training materials that let the broader team, and eventually health center staff themselves, answer more of these questions without you.

• Scale your expertise across the fee for service portfolio as it grows, training the trainers so one person's knowledge becomes the whole team's capability.

What you'll bring

• Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing, or equivalent clinical licensure

• 5 to 10 years of experience in fee for service chronic care management, transitions of care, or advanced primary care, including hands-on experience across the full workflow: care plan development, medication reconciliation, EMR documentation, and billing.

• Experience working within or supporting Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) or similar community-based healthcare settings.

• Demonstrated ability to trace a billing issue back to the documentation or process step that caused it, not just flag that it happened.

• Comfort fielding detailed, state specific and payer specific questions from health center staff who are still deciding whether to sign on.

Preferred Experience

• Certification in Case Management (CCM), APCM, ToC and CoCM

• Experience training or onboarding new staff or partner organizations on a clinical workflow.

• Familiarity with value-based care models and population health strategies.

Who we're looking for

• Closer to the work than to managing people, energized by being the go-to expert rather than a supervisor.

• Patient and precise when explaining complex clinical and billing logic to people encountering it for the first time.

• Comfortable being pulled into sales conversations, onboarding, and troubleshooting, sometimes all in the same week.

• Builds trust with health center staff by having real answers, not just process pointers.

• A strong representative of Diverge Health's mission, vision, and values in every interaction and every deliverable.

This is a full-time, exempt, salaried position. Commensurate on candidate experience, the expected base salary range for this role is $110,000 - $120,000.

Our Investors

Diverge Health is funded by GV and incubated by Triple Aim Partners, which since 2019 has partnered with entrepreneurs to co-found and launch eight companies focused on improving the quality, experience and total cost of healthcare.

At Diverge Health we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and enable us to realize our mission. If you do not have experience in all areas detailed above, we encourage you to share your unique background with us and how it might be additive to our team.

Special Considerations

Diverge Health is dedicated to the principles of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Employment Opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, reproductive health decisions, family responsibilities or any other characteristic protected by the federal, state or local laws. Our decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

At this time, we are unable to support hiring in Alaska and Hawaii due to our primary operations being based in the Eastern and Central time zones.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

To coordinate services between Palos Health and the PH Home Care for patients who have chosen Palos Health Home Health Care services.

To function as Home Care resource to other hospital departments and members of the community.

jobs.title: Seasonal Retail Ambassador - Newbury

SEASONAL RETAIL AMBASSADOR

Boston, MA - Newbury

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - Previous retail or customer service experience preferred

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

jobs.title: Care Management Clinical Lead, Fee for Service
jobs.description:
At Diverge Health we are passionate about improving health access and outcomes for those most in need. We partner with primary care providers to improve the engagement and management of their Medicaid patients, offering independent practices with specialized resources and clinical programs to close gaps in care. Our teams work to address medical, social and behavioral patient needs, lowering healthcare costs and improving patient lives. Guided by our core values of humility, continuous learning and feeling the weight, our team is on a mission to strengthen communities from within, unlocking people's ability to live their healthiest lives.

We are seeking a Care Management Clinical Lead, Fee for Service to join our team! In this role, you will be the hands-on expert who understands our fee for service care management work end to end, from care planning and medication reconciliation through documentation and billing. You will support health centers as they decide whether to partner with us, guide them through onboarding, and be the go-to resource for our delivery team as this work scales.

What you'll do

As Care Management Clinical Lead, Fee for Service, you will play a pivotal role in making sure our fee for service care management work is grounded in real, hands-on expertise at every stage, from the first conversation with a health center to the claim that gets billed.

Key areas you'll add value

• Support Practice Liaisons during health center pitches by answering the detailed clinical and billing questions that come up as centers decide whether to sign on.

• Own onboarding of newly signed health centers in partnership with Practice Liaisons, translating the fee for service model into the practical steps a center's staff need to get started.

• Serve as the tactical subject matter expert for the team delivering fee for service care management day to day, answering real time questions grounded in hands on experience with the work.

• Be the point of contact when health centers hit billing issues, tracing the problem back to its root cause in documentation or workflow rather than treating it as a standalone billing error.

• Build and maintain the frequently asked questions and training materials that let the broader team, and eventually health center staff themselves, answer more of these questions without you.

• Scale your expertise across the fee for service portfolio as it grows, training the trainers so one person's knowledge becomes the whole team's capability.

What you'll bring

• Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing, or equivalent clinical licensure

• 5 to 10 years of experience in fee for service chronic care management, transitions of care, or advanced primary care, including hands-on experience across the full workflow: care plan development, medication reconciliation, EMR documentation, and billing.

• Experience working within or supporting Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) or similar community-based healthcare settings.

• Demonstrated ability to trace a billing issue back to the documentation or process step that caused it, not just flag that it happened.

• Comfort fielding detailed, state specific and payer specific questions from health center staff who are still deciding whether to sign on.

Preferred Experience

• Certification in Case Management (CCM), APCM, ToC and CoCM

• Experience training or onboarding new staff or partner organizations on a clinical workflow.

• Familiarity with value-based care models and population health strategies.

Who we're looking for

• Closer to the work than to managing people, energized by being the go-to expert rather than a supervisor.

• Patient and precise when explaining complex clinical and billing logic to people encountering it for the first time.

• Comfortable being pulled into sales conversations, onboarding, and troubleshooting, sometimes all in the same week.

• Builds trust with health center staff by having real answers, not just process pointers.

• A strong representative of Diverge Health's mission, vision, and values in every interaction and every deliverable.

This is a full-time, exempt, salaried position. Commensurate on candidate experience, the expected base salary range for this role is $110,000 - $120,000.

Our Investors

Diverge Health is funded by GV and incubated by Triple Aim Partners, which since 2019 has partnered with entrepreneurs to co-found and launch eight companies focused on improving the quality, experience and total cost of healthcare.

At Diverge Health we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and enable us to realize our mission. If you do not have experience in all areas detailed above, we encourage you to share your unique background with us and how it might be additive to our team.

Special Considerations

Diverge Health is dedicated to the principles of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Employment Opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, reproductive health decisions, family responsibilities or any other characteristic protected by the federal, state or local laws. Our decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

At this time, we are unable to support hiring in Alaska and Hawaii due to our primary operations being based in the Eastern and Central time zones.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

jobs.title: Lead, Fraud Analytics
jobs.description:
About Arena Club

Arena Club is building the number one digital marketplace for collectibles. We started by reinventing the hobby with the first-ever digital card show, and we are expanding into new categories so collectors can buy, sell, grade, and showcase everything they care about in one place. Spearheaded by 5x World Series Champion Derek Jeter and serial entrepreneur Brian Lee, our fully digital marketplace is grounded in trust, transparency, and fun, featuring grading and authentication, vaulting, and digital pack openings that let collectors build and display their collections in a personalized online showroom from anywhere in the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead to own our fraud analytics and mitigation strategy. As our founding fraud hire, you will build a proactive, quantitative environment by leading data analysis, developing a robust rules framework, and designing the systemic logic that protects our users.

Over time, you will establish the foundational data architecture for risk operations, paving the way for dedicated data science support as the team expands. This role requires a highly analytical, sharp data problem-solver who can dissect complex transaction anomalies while building the long-term infrastructure to scale and protect our marketplace ecosystem.

What You Will Do

• Establish, statistically test, and scale transactional rules and logic to maximize detection while minimizing friction for legitimate power users

• Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and monitoring frameworks to provide clear visibility into fraud performance, portfolio health, and emerging risks

• Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose fraud losses, control gaps, false positives, and unexpected performance changes, translating findings into actionable recommendations

• Analyze complex fund flows across credit cards, ACH, digital wallet balances, internal transfers, and high-value payouts to balance platform growth with risk exposure

• Define trusted fraud performance metrics and analytical datasets, including fraud loss rates, approval and decline rates, false-positive rates, customer friction, and operational efficiency

• Quantify and systematically mitigate financial risks, including promotional/referral abuse, card cashing, money laundering, account takeovers, and multi-account abuse

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to improve fraud strategies, strengthen operational feedback loops, and support new product launches

• Collaborate closely with Compliance to align fraud detection rules with broader BSA/AML policies, escalation procedures, regulatory reporting, and transaction monitoring processes

Qualifications

• A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, or Mathematics

• 3+ years of fraud domain experience in financial transaction analysis, anti-money laundering frameworks, and identifying digital payment abuse

• 5+ years of applied analytical experience outside of academia

• Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to pull data, analyze fraud trends, and build automated alerts independently

• Thorough understanding of payment mechanics, transactional fund flows, clearing windows, and risk profiles across ACH, deposits, credit cards, withdrawals, and chargebacks

• Ability to evaluate false-positive rates, analyze data anomalies, and make data-driven decisions to optimize risk controls

• Exceptional judgment and the capacity to operate autonomously, document analytical processes, and solve complex problems in a high-growth startup environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Metabase

• A solid grasp of e-commerce marketplace vulnerabilities

• Direct experience configuring and optimizing Stripe Radar or Stripe Radar Pro rules

• Broader experience with platform integrity or trust and safety alongside hard financial fraud prevention

The base salary range listed is a guideline. Actual compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the impact you bring. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity.

Salary Range

$120,000—$175,000 USD

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Why Blee:

Blee is an AI-first marketing content compliance platform. PayPal, NerdWallet, and Brex already trust us. We're YC-backed, founded by an ex-Adobe marketing ops leader and former lawyer, and we're defining a category that didn't exist two years ago—across Fintech, Financial Services, CPG, Travel, and Life Sciences..






With offices in San Francisco and New York, we value in-person work but offer remote-opportunities for the right people. No matter where you join us, you can expect quarterly off-sites and opportunities to join other offices when you feel it’s important. You’ll be joining a team that values clarity, ownership, and shared responsibility—and is focused on building something that genuinely improves how teams work.



The Role

We're hiring our first product marketer to help name, shape, and own how this category gets understood—by buyers, by the market, and eventually by everyone else trying to compete in it.



You'll be the second marketer on the team, working directly with our Head of Marketing (who comes from content and brand in the compliance space and is hiring you specifically for the PMM craft she doesn't bring). You'll have unusual ownership: foundational messaging exists but is industry-agnostic, and making it land in financial services, healthcare, beauty, travel, and beyond is largely yours to figure out.



What You’ll Do

In your first six months, you'll rewrite our core narrative for our top three industries, build the ICP and persona work that sales is currently improvising around, and create the sales enablement layer from scratch—the decks, narratives, objection handling, and competitive positioning that don't exist yet in any usable form—and get close enough to customers that you can predict what they'll say before they say it.



After that, the job is whatever the company needs most—competitive positioning, sales enablement that actually gets used, launch playbooks, category-defining content. We'll figure it out together.



 - Own messaging and positioning across our core industries—financial services first, then healthcare, beauty, and beyond

 - Build the ICP and persona work for our split buyer/user dynamic (legal and compliance buy; marketing uses)

 - Create the sales enablement foundation from scratch—decks, narratives, one-pagers, objection handling, competitive positioning

 - Run a customer insight engine—regular conversations with customers and prospects that feed messaging, content, and product

 - Lead go-to-market for new product and feature launches as they come

 - Partner with content, social, events, and web to keep the story consistent everywhere it shows up



Who You Are

 - Five-plus years in B2B product marketing, with at least one tour at an early-stage company where you built from scratch rather than inheriting a playbook. You've sold to technical or regulated buyers before—legal, compliance, security, finance, infosec, something in that family. You know what it's like when the buyer and the user are different people with different incentives.

 - You write well. Not "marketing well"—actually well. You have opinions about language, you can tell the difference between a real insight and a reframed feature, and you've probably killed more decks than you've shipped.

 - You look past templated SaaS messaging and buzzwords to find the real narrative and you think most positioning could be much more bold. You have a point of view on what good looks like.

 - You're comfortable being the PMM voice in a room full of product, sales, and customer success people—and comfortable being wrong out loud when someone has a better idea
   
   

Bonus if you've done category creation before. Bigger bonus if you've worked in or around regulated industries.

#LI - REMOTE





How We Work:

We have offices in New York and San Francisco and value in-person collaboration, but we're open to remote for the right person. Wherever you're based, expect bi-annual off-sites and the chance to spend time in our other offices when it matters.



What You’ll Get:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Bi-annual get-togethers

 - Free access to OneMedical (US Only)

 - Company-paid life insurance (US Only)

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Voice)
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What You'll Do:

• Design, build, and operate services that power inbound/outbound call control, BXML processing, webhooks, and real-time media (e.g., WebSocket media streaming, WebRTC endpoints via BRTC).

• Contribute to APIs and SDKs (REST, webhooks, SDKs across Node, Python, Java, and others) that developers use to build voice applications.

• Work cross-functionally with product managers, senior engineers, and support teams to ship features like conferencing, TTS/IVR, call recording and transcription, and answering machine detection.

• Troubleshoot and improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of high-volume, low-latency voice infrastructure.

• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and on-call rotations; write tests and documentation to a high bar.

• Use AI tools effectively across the development lifecycle, holding AI-generated code to the same security, style, and compliance standards as human-written code.

What You Need:

• 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally with distributed systems or APIs operating at scale.

• Proficiency in Java (or a comparable statically typed language) and comfort working with REST APIs, webhooks, and asynchronous/event-driven systems.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS or similar) and SQL/relational data stores.

• Solid debugging and analytical skills — able to trace issues through multi-service, real-time systems.

• Clear communicator who can collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices (e.g., GitHub Actions).

• Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems or telecom/CPaaS platforms.

The Whole Person Promise:

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

• 100% company-paid Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out-of-pocket expenses.

• All new hires receive four weeks of PTO.

• PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email.

• Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.

• “Mahalo moments” program grants additional time off for life’s most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.

• 90-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist.

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you’re 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered ‘yes’ to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won’t want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

jobs.title: Associate, Workforce & Education Investments
jobs.location: Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA; Washington, D.C.
jobs.description:
About Us

Social Finance is a national nonprofit and registered investment adviser expanding economic opportunity in America. We bring government, philanthropy, and business leaders together to improve systems and put capital to work in new ways. Since our founding in 2011, we have mobilized more than $500 million to create measurable results in workforce and education, health, and housing.

We are driven by the belief that social and economic systems should enable all people to thrive, and the conviction that we can create the most meaningful and measurable change in our communities when governments and markets work together. Our organization is built upon five core values: people, performance, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion.

Our work spans four areas: Impact-first Investing, Workforce and Education Investments, Advisory & Public Sector Practice, and the Social Finance Institute. Our Impact-first Investment team designs, launches, and manages investments that provide solutions for effectively deploying impact capital across a range of social outcomes. Our Workforce and Education Investments team designs, launches and manages financial solutions focused on addressing workforce challenges, including skills acquisition and training access. Our Advisory team partners with government and philanthropy leaders to implement data-driven programs for advancing social impact. And through the Social Finance Institute, we aim to build the field and change systems through actionable research, communities of practice, and educational outreach.

Role and Responsibilities

We are seeking an Associate to join our Workforce and Education Investments team. Associates are integral members of project teams and contribute actively to all phases of a project lifecycle (supporting new business development, designing a new fund or investment, managing active funds and investments) and perform a diverse set of functions, including:

• Financial modeling, research, and data analysis to support fund design decisions, test hypotheses, and drive recommendations

• Sourcing and due diligence for new fund investments

• Data visualization and data dashboard creation to track portfolio performance and visualize trends

• AI tool and infrastructure development to help test and implement improved operational processes across funds

• Presentation material creation and delivery to share analysis, key findings and recommendations with both internal team and external partners

• Management of service provider partners to optimize operations and help achieve project outcomes

• Support of contract and governance document drafting

• Capital raise and investor management, as relevant

• Support of new business development efforts, including responses to Requests for Proposals, drafting of concept notes, and preparation for exploratory calls with prospective new clients

• Business-line and organization-level capacity-building initiatives, such as recruiting, professional development, knowledge management, fundraising, or other internal projects

• Support of team culture of well-being and belonging, and support of team members’ professional growth by providing real-time feedback

Qualifications

We are looking for entrepreneurial candidates with flexibility, aptitude and passion for our mission. Candidate requirements:

• 2-5 years of full-time professional experience with at least 2 years of transactional experience within impact investing, investment banking, private credit, venture capital, or private equity (demonstrated formal investment training is a plus)

• Advanced experience in Excel and financial modeling; Advanced PowerPoint experience

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including experience or demonstrated capacity to learn data visualization programs (i.e., Power BI or Tableau) and statistical coding programs (i.e., R or Stata)

• Experience with AI tools or platforms in a professional setting (e.g. prompt engineering, AI-assisted workflows, or data infrastructure)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to quickly research, synthesize and summarize key takeaways on unfamiliar topics

• Ability to communicate and work closely with many types of partners across multiple sectors; willingness to constructively express your point of view and hear the point of view of others, both internally and externally

• Commitment to high-quality work and accuracy, with an ability to manage multiple and competing priorities simultaneously

• Capacity to work independently while contributing to team projects as appropriate

• Demonstrated interest in and knowledge of or willingness to learn about key issues in nonprofit management, social interventions, government services, and/or impact investing

• Ability to adapt and be flexible

• Commitment to enhancing a team culture of inclusion, belonging and equity

• Experience in or with the systems we seek to impact is preferable

Benefits

At Social Finance, we strive to deliver a benefits program that will enhance our overall value proposition to employees. Our current benefit offerings include:

• Comprehensive health care coverage: medical, dental and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts; Employee Healthy Actions programs and more

• Retirement savings plan with employer contribution

• Short-term, long-term and life insurance policies

• Commuter benefits and cell phone reimbursements

• Hybrid work model (in office a minimum of two days per week and on an ad-hoc basis as needed)

• Dedicated budgets for team building and employee recognition

• Annual budget for external professional development opportunities

• Mentorship and onboarding programs

• Collaborative and energizing workspaces in downtown Boston, San Francisco, Austin, Washington, D.C., and New York

• Paid vacation and paid holidays (with 12/24-1/1 off every year)

• Paid parental leave

• A truly stellar team of high performing, values-driven and fun (!) professionals

Salary

Social Finance uses a lockstep compensation model for purposes of equity and transparency - we strive for everyone coming in at a given level to be paid equitably. For this position, at the Associate level, the starting base salary is $81,000; however, during the interview process, we will take into account a candidate's full work experience and may adjust the job title, and commensurate starting salary, as appropriate. If joining our San Francisco office, this hire would receive an additional $1,000 for every month they are residing in the state of California within a commutable distance of our office in San Francisco.

At this level, employees typically receive a $2,500 salary increase annually and are eligible to participate in our firmwide annual bonus program (bonuses are typically between 5-10%, though bonuses are not guaranteed and are dependent on both organizational and individual performance).

Review of applications will begin immediately. No phone calls, please.

Applicants must be permanently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Please note that, at this time, to be in-person at a Social Finance office, client location or Social Finance-sponsored event, you must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, including receiving a booster shot.

Social Finance, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will be afforded equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of actual or perceived race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, citizenship, ancestry, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, political affiliation, military status, status as a protected veteran, genetic information or any other legally protected status.

Social Finance is committed to providing an accessible and supportive work environment to ensure individuals are able to contribute at their best. We will discuss and provide reasonable accommodations to those in the recruiting process who need them.

jobs.title: Adolescent Therapist/Counselor
jobs.description:
Job Title: Adolescent Therapist/Counselor

Reports To: Adolescent Program Director

Location: Nampa, ID

Facility: Imagine Nampa (Adolescent outpatient)

Schedule: Monday-Friday with 4 days 8:30am-5pm and 1 day 11am-7:30pm (Mon, Tues, or Thurs)

Compensation: $34-45/hour

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to seventeen across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

POSITION SUMMARY: As a key member of the Northpoint team, the Adolescent Therapist/Counselor will oversee the therapeutic services provided to a caseload of clients. This individual will act as the treatment plan coordinator for the multi-disciplinary team in the development and implementation of the master treatment plan and the discharge plan for each client. The Adolescent Therapist/Counselor will provide individual, group and family therapy for assigned clients, as required by contractual and licensure obligations. This person will actively communicate with support staff, treatment teams, and outside agencies on treatment and safety issues pertaining to clients and their family members. The Adolescent Therapist/Counselor will complete all documentation associated with these duties in a professional and timely manner.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

• Provide counseling, assessments and group facilitation to individuals and families

• Coordinate all aspects of direct clinical care from admission to discharge

• Consult with the multidisciplinary treatment team to provide quality client care

• Provide orientation and education to clients, families and others to aid in the therapeutic process

• Collaborate with assigned clients in the development of written treatment plans; include client and family involvement in assessment, treatment, education and discharge planning

• Monitor clients on an ongoing basis to continually assess needs and facilitate treatment and interventions

jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About Serif Biomedicines

Are you ready to help build the next generation of molecular biology tools and platforms? At Serif Biomedicines, we push the boundaries of DNA design, precise cloning, and cell-based engineering to accelerate the discovery and development of transformative therapeutics and diagnostics.

About Flagship Pioneering

Serif Biomedicines was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

About the Role

As a member of our molecular biology team, you’ll work at the forefront of hands-on research from constructing DNA plasmids to analyzing cell phenotypes and protein expression.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and QC DNA constructs using restriction cloning, Gibson/Golden Gate assembly, and PCR.

• Run agarose DNA gels to analyze PCR products and digests; perform gel extraction and DNA purification.

• Set up restriction enzyme digests and ligations; optimize reaction conditions and troubleshoot cloning workflows

• Perform core molecular and cell biology tasks, including DNA/RNA extraction, qPCR/RT-qPCR, transfection/transduction, and clonal line generation

• Analyze and clearly communicate experimental results; iterate protocols in collaboration with experienced scientists

What We're Looking For

• Highly motivated and enthusiastic co-op students eager to dive into fast-paced, impactful bench science

• Curious problem solvers who learn new techniques quickly and think creatively

• Individuals with a strong foundation in molecular biology and cell culture; experience with synthetic biology, genome engineering, or assay development is a plus.

Qualifications:

• Pursuing a MS in Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, or a related field

• Hands-on experience with core techniques: miniprep/midiprep, PCR, agarose gel electrophoresis, restriction enzyme digests, ligation, and DNA purification

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and clear written/verbal communication

Why Join Us:

• Contribute directly to impactful, platform-scale molecular biology

• Collaborate with a tight-knit, multidisciplinary team that values mentorship and scientific rigor

• Build a diverse toolkit spanning cloning, gel-based analysis, cell engineering, assay development, and data analysis

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

Embark on an exhilarating journey with Serif Biomedicines, where your contributions at the bench will accelerate breakthrough molecular biology and shape what’s possible in biotech. To apply, please send your resume and a brief note on your relevant coursework and lab experience.

jobs.title: Multi-Site Functional Lead
jobs.description:
Pay Rate: $60k-$65k

About Carvana

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and everyday we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now. Want more of the story? Check out our background here.

About the team and position

The Safe & Secure Team helps to keep our 20,000+ associates, who work at our 200+ various locations, safe and secure every day. By collaborating with various Carvana teams, the Safe & Secure Team delivers strategic planning, operational risk program development, operational Safe & Secure processes, data analytics, inventory reconciliation and control, learning and awareness program support, and project management. In partnership with the Field and Operations Team, the Safe & Secure Support Team plays an integral function in delivering our mission to every associate at every site.

The Area Lead will be a part of the Field Safe & Secure Team providing execution of core Safe & Secure routines to deliver upon the team’s mission while providing support to Market Operations and Logistics partners. The Area Lead will work closely with teams and leaders in an assigned geographical area in supporting the safety of our people and the protection of our assets in a dynamic working environment. The Area Lead will be responsible for executing key tactics defined within the Safe & Secure/Market Operations Partnership Guide focusing on safety, physical security, environmental support, fraud resolution and other processes. This position will provide day to day on-site support in primarily high-risk locations within their assigned geographical area.  The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership, strong communication skills, quantitative rigor, ability to execute quickly and efficiently, and must be able to exercise independent judgment while working collaboratively with Carvana’s varied operational functions. Most importantly, the Area Lead will see their insights have an immediate, tangible impact every day in a disruptive and rapidly growing company. The position is field based and reports directly to the Area Manager, Field Safe & Secure.

What you’ll be doing

• Travel between sites in assigned geographical area according to risk level and on-site support needed. Determination of travel schedule to be done in collaboration with Area Manager.

• Availability to work non-standard hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays to meet business needs. Flexibility to respond to incidents at sites outside of standard business hours.

• Helps troubleshoot scanning and inventory control concerns as they arise at all assigned locations. Lead efforts to track and reduce unit loss due to missing units, forcible removals, or fraud-related activity.

• Execution of Incident Management Program, focusing on sustainable awareness and effective preparedness. Key supporter in an emergency situation for sites.

• In partnership with the Inventory Control team, supports execution of efforts relating to the identification and tracking of units taken “off lot,” to ensure effective inventory controls are in place.

• Execution of efforts relating to fraud mitigation to ensure adherence to downstream tactics and in support of overall unit loss reduction.

• Champions a culture of safety by executing initiatives relating to incident reduction and leading by example. Ensures engagement of field teams through leading various EH&S and Safety compliance programs from training and implementation to application.

• Directly lead the processes related to our Safe & Secure Technology that supports the site. Ensure equipment is properly functioning, that issues are addressed, and that our processes relating to badge access, server room controls, monitoring alerts, and overall health of the program are running like a well oiled machine.

• Ensure all “Aclaimant” incidents are properly recorded and system information is accurate and actionable. Complete after action reviews to determine root causes of reported safety incidents and make improvement recommendations to the Area Manager.

• Utilize data to assess the Safe & Secure business at the site reporting key wins and opportunities to the Area Manager. As directed, provides support to specific tasks that need to be completed to drive metric improvement.

• Foster open and productive working relationships with other applicable company departments.

• Exercise prudent discretion regarding confidential and sensitive personnel information.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Key Metrics

• Unit Loss tracking

• Completion percentage of EH&S Training

• Inventory Scanning percentage and scan frequency tracking

• Inventory reconciliation in partnership with Inventory Control Team

• Completion percentage of after incident Safety reviews and suggestions for improvement

• Safety incident reduction and root cause analysis

• Hauler safety observation completion

• Fraud unit reduction

• Improvement of Driver Safety Scores

What you should know/have

• High School Diploma or equivalent is required.

• At least 5 years of Security/Asset Protection experience.

• At least 1 year of multi-site leadership experience.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong analytical and data-driven skill set.

• Experience implementing Risk Mitigation programs to improve company profitability in collaboration with partners within a complex business environment.

• Experience working closely and communicating effectively with a diverse set of stakeholders in an ever-changing, rapid growth environment with tight deadlines; Ability to take initiative in a constantly-changing work environment while maintaining flexibility and a collaborative attitude.

• Experience investigating and resolving theft and fraud issues.

• Able to help create, develop and implement process improvement(s).

• Exceptional organizational skills with attention to detail and ability to prioritize multiple tasks.

• Crisis Management/Incident Response experience.

• Must promote the company culture and mission to all employees, vendors, clients, and business partners.

• Knowledge of how to utilize Google Microsoft systems.

• Valid driver's license, and insurable DMV required.

• Must live within the assigned geographical area and work out of a Carvana location when not traveling between sites.

• Domestic travel required - 60-75%.

We’d love it if you also have

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university preferred.

• Experience implementing Risk Mitigation programs to improve company profitability in collaboration with partners within a complex business environment.

• Crisis Management Leadership experience.

• Experience leading OSHA Program implementation within a distribution, warehousing, and fulfillment environment.

• OSHA 10 Hour Training Certification preferred.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more..

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Bitfocus

At Bitfocus, our mission is simple but ambitious: help end homelessness. We build and support Clarity Human Services, the technology that powers communities across the country in connecting people experiencing homelessness with the resources they need.

We lead with care, innovate with insider knowledge, and believe deeply in the power of community. We know strong candidates don't always look the same on paper, so if you're excited about this role, we'd love to hear from you. People with lived experience of homelessness are strongly encouraged to apply.

About the role

Your work decides what gets built next in the software that homelessness response systems rely on every day. You'll turn what communities need into clear requirements and thoughtful designs, so Engineering can build with confidence and the right features reach the people doing this work. As you grow, you'll take on larger features and a wider share of the product, with a defined career path to help you get there.

About the Product team

The Product team defines, documents, and designs the features that Engineering builds into Clarity Human Services and our data products. We work closely with Engineering, customer-facing teams, and the communities we serve.

• Solutions analysis and business process mapping

• Technical writing: requirements, specifications, and process documentation

• User experience design: workflows, wireframes, and prototypes

• Usability testing and customer feedback

• HMIS data standards and interoperability

• Cross-team prioritization and planning with Engineering

What you'll do

• Shape the product. Define, prioritize, and drive enhancements based on user needs, market trends, and what the system can do today.

• Write requirements Engineering can build from. Produce clear, structured requirements and specifications, supported by flowcharts and basic UML diagrams where they help, and keep them current as requirements and project goals change.

• Design with users in mind. Create and refine user workflows, wireframes, and prototypes, then test them before they reach development.

• Listen to customers. Take part in customer onboarding, usability testing, user interviews, and our Feature Focus Q&A rotation, and turn what you hear into product decisions.

• Partner across teams. Work with Engineering, customer-facing teams, and senior stakeholders to align on priorities, adjusting how you explain complex topics to each audience.

• Keep the backlog ready. Get documentation and design done ahead of engineering capacity so the teams you support always have meaningful work queued.

• Spot risks early. Identify gaps, dependencies, and unclear requirements before they slow a release, and use data and stakeholder input to make the call on what to do about them.

• Work with modern tools. Use Jira, Confluence, Figma, Claude, Gemini, and similar tools to track, document, and design your work.

You'll know you're succeeding when...

• Within your first 90 days, small and medium features reach Engineering ready to build, and large features do with support. You can explain Clarity and HUD data standards in your own words.

• Engineering accepts your documents without rework and builds without repeated clarification, and you deliver against agreed timelines, raising risks before they affect release plans.

• By month 6, large features go from idea to ready for Engineering on your own, and you're taking part in Feature Focus Q&A, customer onboarding, and usability testing.

• Customer and usability feedback is documented, reflected in design changes before release, and traceable to the enhancements you prioritize.

• Stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and customer-facing teams can explain current priorities and the reasoning behind them.

• By month 12, you're carrying a full product manager workload across all engineering teams, and each team's backlog stays stocked with ready work.

What you bring

• Product or analysis experience. At least 3 years in product management, business analysis, or a related role.

• Requirements writing. Experience documenting software requirements and producing structured technical documentation.

• Sound judgment. You find creative and effective solutions to complex problems with minimal direction, weigh competing priorities, raise risks early, and explain what comes first and why.

• User-centered design instincts. You apply UX principles and user personas and can design basic user flows and prototypes.

• Clear communication and teamwork. You explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, share context early, work well asynchronously, build working relationships, and welcome feedback.

• Integrity and discretion. You handle sensitive customer and community information with care, keep your commitments, and are honest about what you don't know or got wrong.

• Technical curiosity. You're eager to explore and evaluate emerging technologies and modern software tools, including AI tools, and you can recommend where they apply to product work.

Nice to have

• Experience with social services software, particularly Clarity Human Services or similar HMIS platforms.

• An understanding of homeless response systems, HMIS functions, and industry regulations.

• Familiarity with API design, data integrations, and interoperability standards, such as RESTful APIs and data exchange protocols.

• Experience with cloud data platforms, such as Snowflake.

• Experience with data analytics or visualization tools, such as Looker or Tableau.

• A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, human services, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Knowledge of the pain points and trends in human services.

Why Bitfocus

We invest in your health, growth, and life outside of work:

• Exceptional culture, real mission. Join a team that leads with care and is genuinely committed to getting this work right.

• Comprehensive healthcare. 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees, including free virtual medical and mental health visits through Healthiest You regardless of plan enrollment.

• Mental health support. A confidential Employee Assistance Program plus in-network therapy options.

• Generous parental leave. 12 weeks paid, for growing families.

• Real time to recharge. Three weeks paid vacation, two paid volunteer days, and a paid R&R Week at year-end.

• Retirement match. 401(k) with a 4% company match.

• Remote-life stipends. Monthly internet and home office stipends to help you do your best work from wherever you are.

• Wellness programming. Year-round physical, emotional, financial, and social wellness resources through our EmpowerLinc program.

• A path forward. Defined career growth plans for every role.

• Optional extras. Voluntary pet and legal insurance.

Compensation

We're committed to competitive, equitable pay. Compensation bands reflect market data for comparable roles in and adjacent to the HMIS industry, adjusted for the specialized nature of our work. Where you land depends on your experience, skills, and the complexity you bring to the role. Compensation is not location-based.

The targeted compensation range for this role is $64,000-$125,000, which includes variable compensation (bonus) eligibility.

Remote work

Bitfocus is a fully distributed team, and this role is remote. You'll need a reliable internet connection and a workspace where you can focus and take calls without interruption. We provide a monthly stipend to help cover your internet costs, plus a home office stipend when you join, so you're set up to succeed from day one.

Equal opportunity

Bitfocus is an equal opportunity employer. We don't tolerate discrimination on the basis of gender, age, sexual orientation, race, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, or veteran status. We hire and promote based on skills, experience, and potential, and we work to reduce bias at every stage of our process, including through structured interviews. We're also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process.

A note on AI use during hiring

We know candidates use AI tools to help prepare applications, and that's okay — we'd just ask that what you submit and say in interviews reflects your own understanding and experience. On our end, a human is always involved in reviewing your application and making hiring decisions; AI may support parts of our process, but it doesn't replace our judgment about who you are and whether this is a good fit.

A note on your security

To protect yourself from recruitment scams: all official communication about this role will come from an @bitfocus.com email address or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. Bitfocus will never ask you for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal financial information as part of our hiring process. If something feels off, reach out to us directly to confirm before responding.

A note on timing

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To ensure consideration, please apply by 11/21/2026.

Direct internal management of a defined team of Delivery Directors to support the growth and execution objectives of the service line.

Technical knowledge and ability to connect at all levels are essential to success in this role. Accountable for all solutioning/delivery methodologies – including the evolution to more managed service offerings utilizing scalable fundamentals related to people, process and technology. Ensure all services projects, initiatives, and processes are in conformance with organizations and customers established policies and objectives. Focus on ensuring standards and consistency with each employee and client.

Reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO), you will assist the CLO in managing outside counsel, personally overseeing certain key corporate initiatives, and ensuring all M&A activities align with legal requirements and support the company's strategic objectives. You will advise and collaborate with Axon's Board of Directors, C-Suite, Corporate Development Team, and SEC & Financial Reporting Team.

Critically, you should bring a passion for technology, public safety and Axon’s mission to Protect Life.

Location: Boston or NYC

• Advise the company on Securities laws and reporting requirements.

• Advise on and ensure compliance with securities laws.

What You Bring:

• Demonstrated legal expertise in M&A, securities law and corporate governance.

About Intuitive Surgical

Intuitive Surgical is a global leader in minimally invasive care and innovative surgical robotics. We advance the boundaries of medical care by continually fostering an environment rich in discovery, problem-solving, and growth. Our mission is to drive better, safer outcomes for patients, care teams, and hospitals, while cultivating a culture where professionals are empowered and inspired.

Role Summary

We are seeking an exceptional Assistant General Counsel, Intellectual Property, with deep expertise in patent portfolio management, IP-related transactions, and IP counseling.

This role offers the chance to work at the intersection of some of the most exciting technologies in robotics and medtech today: robotic assisted surgery, AI, computer vision, advanced instrumentation, imaging, and digital surgery. As an in-house IP attorney, you would partner directly with world-class engineers, scientists, physicians, and business leaders to help develop IP strategy for technologies that have the potential to improve patient outcomes and transform how surgery is performed around the world.

Intuitive is entering an exciting period of growth as we continue to expand our platforms, integrate AI and digital technologies, and push the boundaries of what is possible in minimally invasive care. If you enjoy working on breakthrough technology, working closely with innovators, and seeing your work directly influence the trajectory of a business and an industry, we invite you to apply to join our dynamic team.

Primary Function of Position

The Assistant General Counsel, IP will lead and manage an active patent portfolio, including management of patent application preparation, patent prosecution, and IP strategic development to identify and protect Intuitive’s valuable innovations.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP will support a wide variety of IP-related transactional matters, including NDAs and other agreements covering collaboration, product development, and suppliers.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP will support strategic deals and investments, such as M&A and licensing, including conducting IP-related due diligence, crafting and negotiating deal agreements, and advising on IP-related deal strategies.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP will provide additional comprehensive IP-related legal support, including: litigation support (as needed), trademark protection, and trade secret protection.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP l will engage directly with engineers, scientists, management, clinical specialists, and executives, to translate technology developments into strong IP protection and support key business objectives.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP should become informed on industry trends and provide advice about industry and regulatory developments as well as development and implementation of operational and risk management processes and procedures.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP will report to the Associate General Counsel, IP Strategy, and must escalate issues, as appropriate, and partner with all legal team members.

The Assistant General Counsel, IP must represent Intuitive Surgical with external parties with professionalism and strategic insight, including customers, regulators, affiliates, and industry trade groups

Job/Skill Requirements

Minimum of 10+ years experience in intellectual property law as a practitioner at a law firm and/or in-house legal department experience, with a substantial focus on patent prosecution.

At least 2+ years of in-house counsel experience strongly preferred, where responsibilities included patent portfolio management as well as IP-related transactions (with support of litigation and due diligence a plus).

Technical degree, professional background, and/or significant experience related to medical devices, robotics, mechanical engineering, or a related field (electrical engineering or other engineering specialties considered).

J.D. degree and membership in good standing with the California bar or eligible for immediate registration as a Registered In House Counsel “RHIC”.

Admitted to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office.

Ability to assess legal and business opportunities and risks related to IP assets in support of M&A, investment opportunities, licensing, and purchasing or selling of patent portfolios.

Exceptional communication and writing skills, able to distill complex technical and legal concepts for varied audiences.

Ability to closely manage outside counsel and control matter costs.

Willingness to travel on occasion as required.

Other Personal Characteristics:

Engaging, courageous, and self-directed, accustomed to managing with a collaborative, fact-based approach.

Collaborative, resourceful and adaptable—able to anticipate needs and navigate a rapidly changing environment.

Intellectually curious and eager to learn new areas of law and technology and apply knowledge effectively.

jobs.location: Beverly Hills LAND, Beverly Hills, CA (HQ-L)
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

The Program Manager, International Payroll Implementation leads the end-to-end coordination of payroll-impacting activities for new country launches, payroll implementations, and related global transformation initiatives. This role ensures that required inputs, decisions, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables across Legal, HR, Benefits, Finance, IT, Payroll, local business stakeholders, and external vendors are identified, sequenced, tracked, and delivered in time to support a successful payroll go-live.

The role is accountable for the integrated implementation plan, governance, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and overall payroll readiness across each rollout.

While the Program Manager must bring a strong understanding of payroll and the upstream and downstream processes that affect it, this role does not own functional payroll configuration, complete provider implementation workbooks, or process payroll. Those activities are led by the Payroll team and relevant implementation partners; this role ensures the work is connected, on track, and ready for each key implementation milestone and go-live.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the overall program management of global payroll implementations and country rollouts, from initial planning through go-live, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations.

• Apply a consistent global implementation approach across country rollouts while coordinating country-specific payroll requirements, local stakeholders, vendors, dependencies, and readiness considerations.

• Establish and manage a repeatable implementation methodology, including templates, governance routines, readiness criteria, escalation paths, and post-implementation lessons learned.

• Develop and maintain integrated project plans that capture payroll-impacting milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, risks, decision points, and critical paths across all relevant workstreams.

• Coordinate payroll-impacting dependencies across Legal, HR, Benefits, Finance, IT, Payroll, Treasury, local business stakeholders, and external implementation partners.

• Ensure payroll-impacting requirements, decisions, and deliverables are appropriately owned, handed off across workstreams, and delivered in time to support implementation and go-live.

• Coordinate with payroll providers, systems vendors, and implementation partners to align delivery plans, dependencies, timelines, and readiness requirements with the broader country rollout plan.

• Coordinate data readiness and testing milestones with Payroll, IT, and implementation partners, ensuring data migration and validation, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and parallel payroll testing, where applicable, have clear owners, completion criteria, issue resolution plans, and required sign-offs.

• Facilitate cross-functional working sessions and governance forums; drive timely decisions, clarify ownership, and escalate risks or blockers that could affect payroll implementation timelines or go-live readiness.

• Monitor implementation progress against agreed milestones and provide clear, concise status reporting to project teams and senior stakeholders, including risks, decisions needed, and recommended mitigation plans.

• Coordinate cutover and go-live planning across workstreams, including final approvals, payroll processing deadlines, production transition activities, contingency plans, and initial hypercare coverage.

• Support change management and operational readiness activities, including process documentation, handoff planning, communications, training coordination, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation controls, strengthen cross-functional ways of working, reduce manual effort, and standardize the global payroll rollout approach.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Finance, Operations, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional projects or programs, including demonstrated experience managing global or multi-country payroll implementations across countries with differing payroll, regulatory, and operational requirements.

• Demonstrated experience managing multi-workstream initiatives with interdependent deliverables, competing priorities, external vendors, and senior stakeholder groups.

• Working knowledge of the end-to-end payroll lifecycle and the upstream and downstream processes that affect payroll, including HR data, employment terms, working time, leave, benefits, integrations, banking and payment processes, and statutory employer requirements.

• Experience working with or supporting implementations involving global payroll platforms, time and attendance platforms, HRIS/HCM systems, and related integrations.

• Experience developing and managing integrated project plans, governance structures, milestone tracking, risk and issue logs, and executive-level status reporting.

• Experience building scalable implementation playbooks, templates, readiness assessments, and governance processes.

• Proven ability to influence and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex cross-functional dependencies into clear actions, decisions, and implementation plans.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working across countries, cultures, and evolving local requirements.

• Flexibility to adjust working hours periodically to collaborate across global time zones, based on the countries and projects being supported.

• Familiarity with Workday, ADP Celergo, UKG Dimensions, and related payroll and timekeeping integrations.

• Experience supporting retail, hourly, or multi-location workforces.

• Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools; PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar certification is a plus.

• Familiarity with change management, operational readiness, process standardization, and continuous-improvement approaches.
