• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

• Fumes from food odors.

• Exposure to cornmeal dust.

• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.

• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

• Depth perception.

• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to thefollowing:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

• Workers reach above 72occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.




WHO WE ARE:

We're a team of hardcore engineers who live and breathe aerospace. We’re generalists who each have subject matter expertise and operate in a flat organizational structure. We move fast and build world-changing technology in a pragmatic and competent workplace culture.




WHO YOU ARE:

You’re a principal-level mechanical engineer who has led the design of complex hardware from a blank sheet to a fielded product, and you’ve built the judgment that comes from seeing designs succeed and fail in test. You set technical direction, make the hard architecture calls, and raise the bar for everyone around you, while staying close to the hardware yourself. You might come from aerospace, automotive, motorsport, energy, industrial turbomachinery, or another field where hardware runs at the edge of its limits. Propulsion experience is highly valued but not required. What matters most is a record of leading hard mechanical programs to success.

At Astro Mechanica, you’ll be a technical leader on Duality™, our jet engine built to be efficient from takeoff through supersonic flight. You’ll own the mechanical architecture of major engine systems and guide them from early prototype through flight qualification, vehicle integration, and aircraft flight. You’ll set the test-like-you-fly standard for the team.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the mechanical architecture of major engine subsystems, defining requirements, interfaces, and design approach

 - Lead trade studies that shape engine configuration, and make clear, defensible decisions when the data is incomplete

 - Set design standards, analysis practices, and review rigor across the mechanical design team

 - Lead design reviews and serve as the technical authority on mechanical design questions

 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, hands-on guidance, and day-to-day collaboration

 - Work across propulsion, aircraft, test, and manufacturing teams to resolve system-level tradeoffs

 - Stay hands-on in CAD, analysis, prototype builds, and testing when the work calls for it

 - Lead root-cause investigations on hardware failures and drive corrective actions to closure

 - Identify technical risks early and build the plans to retire them




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, including technical leadership of complex hardware programs from concept through build and test

 - A track record of owning the architecture of a major system or product, not just individual components

 - Deep expertise in a major CAD package (Siemens NX preferred; we’ll support your transition from CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks)

 - Expert knowledge of manufacturing processes, including machining, additive, and sheet metal, along with precision measurement and GD&T

 - A strong command of structural analysis, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics, with the judgment to know when analysis is good enough and when to go test

 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team

 - The ability to communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, leadership, and external stakeholders

 - Comfort making decisions under uncertainty in a fast-moving environment




NICE TO HAVE: 

 - Experience designing propulsion systems, such as gas turbines, rocket engines, or other turbomachinery

 - Experience with high-temperature, high-speed rotating, or pressurized hardware

 - Flight hardware design, qualification, or certification experience

 - Familiarity with data acquisition, instrumentation, and test program design

 - Exposure to electromechanical systems or power electronics integration

 - Experience at an early-stage hardware company during rapid growth




PERKS AND BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment 

 - Company-funded perks, including weekly team lunches and Astro Mechanica swag




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Manager in Training- Fox River Mall
jobs.description:
Position: Manager in Training

Hours: 40 Weekly

INTERNAL DEADLINE: October 26th, 2026

Ever wondered what it’s like behind the bubbles?  #lushcareers

Lush North America has been creating fresh and handmade cosmetics for the past 20 years- keeping our customers’ bathtubs and showers a little more magical through our retail shops across Canada and the US. We are dedicated to the practices of fair trade sourcing and supporting sustainable communities as well as giving back to organizations that can make a difference.

We Offer:

• A fun and funky store atmosphere where individualism is encouraged

• A 50% discount off all our products to keep you smelling and feeling fresh

• An unconventional retail structure to support your entrepreneurial spirit

• The opportunity for growth as Lush loves to promote from within

Manager in Training

As Manager in Training, you bring Lush’s Leadership Practices into all elements of your business interactions with customers, fellow staff and operations: Be Real, Be Curious, Lead Fearlessly, Adapt and Evolve, Grow Talent, and Live with Purpose.

The MIT supports the Store Manager as needed in all business areas and as delegated by their Retailer; as second-in-command, the MIT will pick up Manager duties as required to support a strong customer experience, staff experience, shop operational excellence, and exceeding sales goals.

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Customer Service: collaborate with your team on plans to exceed daily sales goals and ensure a unique and inclusive customer experience that makes every visitor feel welcome, meets their needs and makes their day.

• Building the Brand: educate our customers and staff on our brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed and product recommendations for every need

• Driving Sales: demonstrate strong business acumen and understanding of your metrics, budgets and reports and how to impact them through behaviors on the floor to deliver profitable results.

Team Leadership:

• Lead Fearlessly: Be present to support your team on the sales floor, answer questions, remove obstacles, problem solve, and motivate them to meet their sales goals

• Grow Talent: by owning your own development, assessing your performance, seeking feedback and resources and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities; and supporting the growth of your team through coaching and leading by example.

• Be Real: with your needs and feedback for your team and leaders and adaptable to the needs of the business as required

• Live with Purpose: engage your team at every level of your business to ensure they are inspired, motivated and building strong peer and customer relationships and are connected to the brand values

• Recruitment and Selection: Support the staffing of your shop with top-performing staff by working actively within your markets to network, recruit, hire and succession plan.

• Staff Development: collaborate with your Manager on creating and executing plans that improve staff engagement, retention, performance, and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging practices.

Operational Excellence:

• Policies and Procedures: Support your manager to keep your shop complaint and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, health and safety and daily communication. · Stock and Inventory: Support the training of your inventory team to abide by fresh standards and rotation rules and manage ordering to ensure the right products, in the right amounts are in the store at the right times within your allocated budget.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Identify and support the development of your team to take pride in a clean and beautiful work environment and follow the merchandising and design standards to provide a consistent customer experience and drive sales.

• Scheduling, Time and Attendance: ensure the right number of staff with the right skill levels are scheduled at peak times and that breaks and meals are allocated and recorded appropriately to ensure staff wellbeing and payroll accuracy.

Qualifications:

Required:

• 1-3 years managing or supervising in a retail environment

• Excellent listening and communication skills

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.

• Excellent organization and time management skills

• Strong customer service, supervisory and sales skills

• Knowledge and interest in skincare, natural beauty and ethical business

• Ability to work flexible hours to meet the needs of the shop including holidays, evenings and weekends

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Ability to develop and train staff through positive coaching and feedback

• Proficient in excel, Microsoft suit, and adaptable to other systems as required

• Basic HR skills in hiring, scheduling, training, and performance management

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

At Lush, we believe when we continue to foster a culture of inclusion and respect within a diverse workforce, we are doing our part in building a world where there is equal opportunity for all. We recruit from a variety of employment agencies, community groups, non-profits, and online social and job sites, and in our business practices, strive to leverage the gift that diversity brings.

Lush North America unequivocally supports equal opportunity employment for all applicants regardless of religion, race, color, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ancestry, ability, adverse mental health, and other characteristics both defined, protected and enforced by the law under federal or provincial/state jurisdiction.

Fox River Pay

$22.48—$22.48 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

YouTube
LinkedIn

Lush Cosmetics North America respectfully recognizes that our business operates on Indigenous territory across Turtle Island. As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.

Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92. We recognize that our facilities, along with our settler and newcomer staff are guests on this land and as we act to repair past harm, we do it together in allyship with Indigenous People everywhere, including staff, customers and with leadership from organizations and communities we work with.

jobs.title: Deputy Lead, Community Sales
jobs.description:
The Company

Faraday Future is a California-based technology company focused on the design, engineering, and development of intelligent, connected electric vehicles and related artificial intelligence-enabled technologies. Founded in 2014, the Company's mission is to disrupt the automotive and technology industries by creating user-centric, technology-first experiences. The Company, together with its controlled subsidiaries, operates across multiple technology-driven areas, including AI electric vehicles, robotics, and its crypto business (AIXC), all under its upgraded Global EAI Industry Bridge Strategy, marking the beginning of a new chapter in AI mobility and Web3 integration. FF is committed to redefining mobility through AI innovation. Join us in shaping the future of intelligent transportation and technology by creating something new, something connected, and something with a true global impact.

Your Role

The Deputy Lead, Community Sales will serve as the deputy to the Head of Community Sales, driving the day-to-day execution of user acquisition, community operations, and sales conversion for Faraday Future's robotics and education products across three core audience groups: developers, shareholders and retail investors, and the education market, including parents and families. This is a hands-on operator role: building communities, running referral campaigns, managing creators and community leaders, and turning engagement into product sales. The ideal candidate genuinely lives in communities: someone who spends their days on TikTok, Instagram, Discord, X, and Reddit, understands how attention turns into purchase, and can run a growth campaign end to end without a manual.

Key Responsibilities

• User acquisition and profiling: Own target-user identification, tiering and tagging, and acquisition entry points for all three audience groups; unify intake forms and source tagging; ensure new users receive first contact within 24 hours; drive onboarding and retention.

• Developer community: Build and run Discord servers, a GitHub presence, and X channels for robotics developers; host demos, tutorials, and AMAs; convert developer interest into product purchases and qualified leads.

• Shareholder and investor community: Support shareholder-facing community initiatives and retail investor engagement in coordination with IR and legal, always using publicly disclosed information only; grow engagement among retail shareholders and investor communities.

• Education market, including parents and families: Run TikTok, Instagram, Facebook Groups, and livestream campaigns for STEM education and family audiences; drive course-trial and product sales; capture leads from demos and events.

• Referral and growth campaigns: Design and execute invite-a-friend and referral-code programs, plus creator-driven growth mechanics across all three audience groups; track referral attribution and reward fulfillment.

• Creator and community leader network: Recruit and manage US creators, influencers, and community moderators across developer, investor, and parent communities; maintain a roster covering pricing, content schedules, and campaign results.

• Online and offline events: Plan and run livestreams plus in-person demo events (e.g., developer meetups, investor events, robot experience days and pop-ups); capture leads and drive structured follow-up.

• Data and reporting: Maintain the growth dashboard (followers, views, livestream conversion, leads, sales) segmented by audience group; produce weekly reports and the month-end operating review.

• Deputy duties: Stand in for the Head of Community Sales when needed; coordinate with product, legal, finance, and IR teams on campaigns, incentive rules, and compliance.

Basic Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in community management, social media growth, or creator partnerships in the US market, with a track record of running referral campaigns and growing communities from zero.

• Deep immersion in US internet culture: a daily active user of TikTok, Instagram, Discord, X, or Reddit who understands formats, memes, and what makes content travel.

• Experience engaging at least one of the three target audiences: developers, retail investors or shareholders, or parents and families in the education space.

• Experience designing referral and incentive mechanics, including attribution and basic anti-fraud controls.

• Strong short-form copywriting and social content skills in English.

• Data literate: comfortable with funnel tracking, basic metrics, and spreadsheets.

• Native or near-native English; Mandarin is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling consumer tech, education products, toys, or hardware through social channels in the US.

• Experience with developer relations, robotics communities, or STEM education communities.

• Experience with retail investor or shareholder communications in a public company setting.

• Livestream selling experience (TikTok Live, Instagram Live, or YouTube).

• Familiarity with robots, smart devices, or the US creator economy.

• Bachelor's degree preferred but not required: proven community results matter more than credentials.

Salary Range

$120,000 - $150,000

Perks + Benefits

• Healthcare + dental + vision benefits (Free for you / discounted for family)

• 401(k) options

• Casual dress code + relaxed work environment

• Culturally diverse, progressive atmosphere

• "Soul of Faraday" community outreach team

Faraday Future is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

The Utilities & Tools team builds scalable digital products that provide horizontal support across the company. Our products enable a range of business units and product teams to operate more effectively, move faster, and scale with confidence.

As a Staff Technical Product Manager, you will own a portfolio of internal platform products that help teams manage fleets, individual vehicles, locations, and access to shared operational resources. You will define how these resources are represented, assigned, tracked, governed, and used across the business, partnering with engineering and internal stakeholders to turn complex operational needs into reliable, scalable tools.

As Staff Technical Product Manager, you'll own a portfolio of tools for managing internal fleets, individual vehicles, Scout locations, and the shared operational resources teams depend on, plus the access model that governs all of it.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager of Digital Products. Asset access controls

jobs.title: CFD / Aero Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Company

Whisper Aero is pioneering a more compelling and connected future by delivering cleaner, quieter, and more efficient propulsion solutions. Today's open rotor propulsion systems are challenged by safety, noise, and performance limitations at all scales. Whisper's breakthrough technologies allow aircraft to fly anywhere at any time without disturbing communities, at greater speeds, and with incredible improvements in efficiency and cost. Their innovations also enable a new generation of air moving products that can blend into the soundscapes of daily life. Whisper was founded by industry veterans, Mark Moore and Ian Villa, and continues to innovate a future that’s as considerate as it is compelling with its world-class team in Tennessee.

About the Role

Whisper Aero is seeking a diligent, creative and hardworking Aerodynamics Engineer familiar with commercial CFD codes to assist with the design and analysis of advanced electric propulsion systems and their integration with novel advanced airframes. This role will be focused on CFD analysis of components, propulsors and aeropropulsive trades in terms of airframe integration. It will involve both steady analysis for design optimization as well as transient analysis supporting acoustics, aeroelasticity and identifying and ameliorating system instabilities.   They will drive key aero, aero-structural and aeroacoustic design decisions and work closely with our Flight Sciences Lead, Flight Sciences team, Chief Engineer, and Technical Project Leads regularly. In this role you will work with the team to identify high level needs for future propulsor/airframe integration, future airplane designs, address core customer requirements, provide pre-test predictions, code validation and then develop approaches/concepts/design modifications to address these needs.

What You’ll Do

• Participate in and present during reviews, provide feedback to the design, flight sciences teams, and technical project managers.

• Use lower order aerodynamic analysis and CFD to carry out analysis of aircraft systems, flow component systems and external airframe/aerodynamic analysis.

• Perform design optimization trades involving aerodynamic performance, acoustics, heat transfer and aeroelastic response.

• Provide testing support for flight projects, study tasks & proposals.

• Provide aero engineering knowledge to project personnel and contractors through all phases of the project lifecycle.

• Develop and validate flow process methods and models needed to support novel aspects of the propulsor and aero-propulsive integration.

• Author analysis tools for designers to use in sizing new parts (scripts, spreadsheets, etc...)

• Provide support to customers for issues that arise in product integration

• Write technical reports that are accurate and comprehensive to be peer-reviewed by other team members.

Basic Qualifications

• US Citizenship / Green Card Status

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mathematics, Computational Sciences technical discipline with typically a minimum of 4 years of related experience; or a graduate degree Masters degree in similar disciplines with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or PhD in similar disciplines.

• Familiarity with Aerodynamic analysis methods (Potential Flow Codes, Streamline Curvature codes etc.

• CFD experience with commercial codes like Ansys, StarCCM+

• Experience with a 3D CAD package such as Solidworks, NX, CATIA V5, or Fusion 360

• Expertise in Python programming, Matlab and Julia preferred.

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with aeroelasticity applications either for turbomachinery or airframe applications

• Experience with force accounting for aeropropulsive applications

• Exposure to aeroacoustic methodologies

• Experience with Multidisciplinary Design Optimization methods and/or Machine Learning Surrogate Models, development of Digital Twins

• Experience with electric machines and motors, hybrid electric powertrains

• Familiarity with data management, revision and version control: Git

• Pilot experience and/or aircraft maintenance experience

The Team

Whisper Aero is propelling quiet electric technologies from ducted fans to novel flightworthy aircraft designs. Everyday, the world harnesses the power of air to make our world more productive from fans cooling large data farms, to leaf blowers cleaning our yards, to propellers driving drones, aircraft, and more. But moving air has resulted in more and more noise, interrupting the peace and tranquility we expect in our homes and communities. As the world’s cities grow denser, noise becomes an increasingly critical barrier to our growing energy, data, delivery, and transportation needs.

At Whisper Aero, we use first-principles physics to develop products that make moving air cleaner, more efficient, and quiet enough to blend into the background, transforming the soundscape of our cities forever.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Control Technician at Lexington Medical, you will inspect and disposition surgical stapler components using GD&T and OGP and Keyence vision systems. Engineering, manufacturing, and quality share one building in Bedford, so when a part looks out of spec, you are the one who confirms whether it truly fails or was fixtured or measured incorrectly, before it ever reaches engineering.

About Lexington Medical

Lexington Medical designs and manufactures AEON™ surgical stapling technology at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts, just outside Boston. Our products are used in minimally invasive surgery, where precision, reliability, and quality matter every time. Because engineering, manufacturing, and quality work together under one roof, the people building and supporting our products are close to both the process and the decisions behind it.

About the Role

As a Senior Quality Control Technician at Lexington Medical, you will be the experienced inspector behind the incoming components and assemblies that go into our AEON™ Endostapler. Your time will be split roughly evenly between hands-on inspection and reviewing lots on hold: reading engineering drawings with complex GD&T callouts, deciding how each feature should be measured, and using OGP and Keyence vision inspection systems alongside calipers, micrometers, and optical comparators.

When a part looks out of spec, you will check the drawing, the fixturing, and the measurement before making the call, so engineering only sees true failures. You will review inspection documentation to release accepted material, write clear NCRs that follow the dispositions engineering has already defined, and help refine the inspection process from inside QC.

Responsibilities

• Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspection of AEON™ stapler components and finished devices per documented procedures and engineering drawings.

• Interpret GD&T callouts such as position, profile, flatness, and runout, including datum structures, and choose the right measurement method for each feature.

• Run inspections on OGP and Keyence vision systems, and recognize when a result is driven by fixturing or measurement setup rather than the part itself.

• Perform dimensional and visual inspections with calipers, micrometers, and optical comparators.

• Review lots on hold and questionable inspection results, confirm whether parts truly fail, and determine disposition so only genuine issues go to engineering.

• Identify, segregate, and document nonconforming material, and write clear, complete NCRs that follow established engineering disposition plans.

• Review inspection documentation to release accepted material, and maintain full lot and component traceability to Good Documentation Practices in a regulated medical device cleanroom environment.

• Recommend improvements to inspection methods, work instructions, and fixtures based on what you see at the bench.

Qualifications

• 4+ years of quality inspection experience in medical device, aerospace, or other precision manufacturing.

• Strong working knowledge of GD&T, with the ability to read complex, custom-designed engineering drawings (not only off-the-shelf components) and explain how you would measure a given callout.

• Hands-on experience using vision measurement systems such as OGP SmartScope or Keyence.

• Proficiency with precision measurement tools including calipers, micrometers, and optical comparators, and with Microsoft Excel for recording and summarizing inspection data.

• Experience writing and documenting nonconformance reports (NCRs).

• Experience working in a cleanroom or controlled manufacturing environment and following Good Documentation Practices.

• Experience working with engineers on drawing reviews, including giving feedback that led to drawing updates.

• Technical certificate, associate degree, or equivalent hands-on experience in quality, metrology, or manufacturing technology.

• A plus: vision system programming, CMM experience, ASQ CQI or CQT certification, or experience under ISO 13485 and FDA quality system requirements.

What Success Looks Like

• By 3 months, you are inspecting independently across our incoming component families on the OGP and Keyence systems, and catching fixturing or measurement errors before they turn into engineering reviews.

• By 1 year, you are confidently dispositioning lots on hold, far fewer parts go to engineering for review, and you have improved at least one inspection method, fixture, or work instruction.

• What makes someone excellent here: you catch problems before they reach the line, and you can explain the reasoning behind every measurement to a technician or an engineer.

Location & Work Arrangement

This position is based at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts, in the Greater Boston area, and is an on-site role. This is a full-time, day-shift position, Monday through Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.

Hourly Rate

$28—$36 USD

jobs.title: Sr. Cost Control Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The role

We are hiring a Cost Control Engineer to own the cost baseline, the forecast, and change control on Mariana's capital projects.

You will build the cost breakdown structure, convert the sanctioned estimate into a control budget, track commitments and actuals, and produce the forecast at completion that the business plans against. The role sits between engineering, procurement, construction, and finance — the path where a commitment becomes an accrual becomes an invoice becomes a capitalized asset — and your job is to make sure the number is the same in all four places. Cost control here is not a monthly report assembled by hand. The reporting is expected to come out of the system and building that pipeline is as much the job as running it.

What you'll do

 - Set the baseline. Build the WBS and cost breakdown structure with the planner and estimator, convert the sanctioned estimate into a control budget, and lock it

 - Track commitments and actuals. Purchase orders, subcontracts, change orders, and field costs, reconciled to the ERP every month with no unexplained variance

 - Forecast. Maintain estimate to complete and estimate at completion by control account, with the basis for each forecast written down rather than carried in your head

 - Measure earned value. Set rules of credit with the planner, measure physical progress, and report cost and schedule performance at a level where someone can act on it

 - Run the trend and change process. Identify potential changes early, quantify them, route them for approval, and keep the approved budget log clean

 - Manage contingency drawdown. Track contingency and management reserve against the risk register and report what is left honestly

 - Produce cash flow. Maintain the project cash flow and funding curve for finance and treasury

 - Verify payments. Review contractor invoices and progress claims against measured progress and contract terms

 - Report. Create, issue and present the project cost report and the dashboards leadership actually opens

 - Automate the pipeline. Cost data should move from the ERP, procurement, and the schedule into the report/dashboard without re-keying. Build the connections, the reconciliations, and the exception checks that catch a bad number before a person does

Desired qualifications

 - Education. BS in engineering, construction management, finance, or a related field

 - Experience. 5–12 years of project cost control on capital projects in mining, minerals, refining, chemicals, power, or heavy civil. Senior candidates will have owned cost on a project above $100M total installed cost

 - Earned value in practice. You have applied earned value management on a live project, not only in training, and can describe where it broke down

 - Systems. Hands-on with a project cost management system such as EcoSys, InEight, Prism, or Procore, and with an ERP such as SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite

 - Data fluency. Advanced Excel, plus SQL, Power BI, or Python at a level where you build your own reporting instead of requesting it

 - Change discipline. You have run a trend and change management process end to end and can say what you would do differently

 - Accounting interface. Comfortable with commitments versus actuals, accruals, capitalization, and funding authorization mechanics

 - Certification. AACE Certified Cost Professional or Certified Cost Technician, or PMI credentials, are a plus


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The Role

As a Construction & Commissioning Quality Engineer, you will lead site quality across all of Mariana Minerals’ industrial process facilities, from construction and installation through testing, commissioning, handover, and project closeout. You’ll make sure quality requirements are built into field execution, verified at every hold point, and documented so each plant is turned over complete, compliant, and ready to run.

This is a company-wide role covering every Mariana Minerals project, not a single site. You’ll be the primary quality interface between site teams, Construction Management, Field Engineering, Design Engineering, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, contractors, vendors, and Operations, and you’ll set consistent quality standards across all of our builds. Your work will be vital to building plants that start up safely, reliably, and right the first time.

What You’ll Do

Site Quality Leadership & Planning:

 - Lead site quality activities across construction, installation, testing, commissioning, handover, and closeout on every Mariana Minerals project.

 - Develop and execute site-specific Quality Plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), inspection checklists, and quality schedules.

 - Ensure contractual, regulatory, local statutory, environmental, and Mariana Minerals quality requirements are understood and verified in the field.

 - Support kick-off meetings, handovers to site and commissioning teams, project coordination meetings, and final handover reviews.

Inspections & Commissioning Quality:

 - Execute C&C ITPs and verify that inspections, tests, witness points, hold points, and acceptance criteria are completed per project requirements.

 - Coordinate internal and third-party inspection resources for mechanical, electrical, dimensional, welding, coating, NDE, calibration, and functional testing.

 - Plan and run witness inspections, site audits, and surveillance activities, including readiness checks, required equipment, and calibration status.

 - Ensure nonconforming work is not built upon, concealed, or handed over until it is dispositioned and corrected.

NCRs, Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement:

 - Initiate, investigate, and close NCRs, deviations, punch-list items, and corrective actions with clear objective evidence.

 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action with site teams, engineering, contractors, and suppliers.

 - Monitor quality risks, NCR trends, and overdue actions; escalate issues affecting schedule, safety, environmental compliance, or cost.

 - Capture lessons learned across all sites and standardize quality processes company-wide to reduce rework on future builds.

Turnover Documentation & Records:

 - Manage site quality records, including inspection reports, test records, commissioning records, and turnover packages, so they are complete, traceable, and contract compliant.

 - Compile quality data books, dossiers, and closeout packages, and track open actions and approvals through closure.

 - Coordinate with Document Control to keep records available for review, acceptance, and archive.

Contractor & Supplier Quality Oversight:

 - Hold contractors, vendors, and site suppliers to Mariana Minerals quality requirements, site procedures, and specifications.

 - Monitor contractor and vendor quality performance and drive resolution of issues affecting construction, commissioning, or turnover.

 - Partner with Supply Chain when supplier documentation, NCRs, or shipment release records affect site acceptance.

Systems & Automation:

 - Collaborate with software engineering to digitize ITPs, inspection records, and NCR tracking, and support ongoing automation of quality workflows.

Health, Safety & Environment:

 - Promote a safe work culture and build safety and environmental requirements into inspection and acceptance criteria.

 - Ensure site quality activities align with HSE plans and local regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, or a related technical field; or equivalent experience.

 - Experience in construction, commissioning, field, or project quality on industrial, mining, processing, or power generation projects.

 - Hands-on experience with ITPs, quality plans, witness and hold points, NCR management, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action.

 - Ability to interpret specifications, contracts, drawings, procedures, and acceptance criteria, including applicable codes and standards.

 - Experience with mechanical, electrical, dimensional, welding, coating, NDE, calibration, or commissioning inspection preferred.

 - Auditing experience (supplier or site audits) preferred.

 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office, document management systems, and digital quality or tracking tools.

 - Excellent communication, judgment, and decision-making abilities, with the ability to influence without direct authority across multiple teams and sites.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.




WHO WE ARE:

We're a team of hardcore engineers who live and breathe aerospace. We’re generalists who each have subject matter expertise and operate in a flat organizational structure. We move fast and build world-changing technology in a pragmatic and competent workplace culture.




WHO YOU ARE:

You’re an experienced mechanical design engineer who takes full ownership of hardware from concept to production, and you understand how your designs affect the systems around them. You solve technical problems from first principles, and you’d rather build and test than theorize. You might come from aerospace, automotive, motorsport, robotics, energy, industrial machinery, or another field where hardware has to perform under real loads, temperatures, and pressures. Prior propulsion experience is a plus but not required. We’ll teach you the engine; we’re hiring for design judgment and hands-on rigor.

At Astro Mechanica, you’ll design hardware for Duality™, our jet engine built to be efficient from takeoff through supersonic flight. You’ll carry your designs from early prototype through flight qualification, vehicle integration, and aircraft flight, and you’ll embody the test-like-you-fly philosophy along the way.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the mechanical design of engine components and subsystems, from trade studies through detailed design and release

 - Weigh system-level impacts in your design trades, working closely with the propulsion, aircraft, and test teams

 - Complete detailed design and support structural, thermal, and fluid analyses

 - Present design reviews and use feedback from stakeholders to strengthen your designs

 - Assemble prototypes firsthand, design supporting tooling, and write work instructions

 - Test hardware and analyze the data to verify requirements and performance

 - Diagnose hardware problems quickly and drive corrective actions
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 5+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, taking hardware from concept through build and test

 - Proficiency in solid, surface, and sheet metal CAD modeling in a major CAD package (Siemens NX preferred; we’ll support your transition from CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks)

 - Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, including machining, additive, and sheet metal, along with precision measurement and GD&T

 - A working understanding of structural analysis, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics

 - A track record of designing parts that got built, tested, and improved based on what the tests showed

 - Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities change as test results come in

 - High standards for detail and quality in your work
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with propulsion systems, such as gas turbines, rocket engines, or other turbomachinery

 - Experience with high-temperature, high-speed rotating, or pressurized hardware

 - Familiarity with data acquisition and instrumentation

 - Exposure to electromechanical systems or power electronics integration

 - Experience with flight hardware or qualification testing




PERKS AND BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment 

 - Company-funded perks, including weekly team lunches and Astro Mechanica swag




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

You will work with stakeholders from across the Intelligence Community and will need to be comfortable communicating with both military and civilian personnel. Responsibilities:

• Design and implement agentic workflows that coordinate approved services, tools, data sources, and human actions.

• Develop reusable orchestration components, APIs, connectors, tool interfaces, and workflow templates

• Develop, secure, test, and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools for approved enterprise services and data sources.

• Implement workflow state management, conditional routing, retries, timeouts, error handling, and recovery.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

As Customer Marketing Manager, you’ll own the programs that turn Rippling’s happiest customers into our most powerful growth engine. You’ll build and run Wavemakers, our customer advocacy program, recruiting and engaging a community of advocates with meaningful incentives. You’ll also own our customer reference program, building a roster of referenceable customers and making sure Sales has what they need to close deals, with an eye toward scaling the program as our product suite and international footprint grow.

From day one, you’ll have the autonomy to shape these programs to meet the needs of the business, and there’s plenty of room to dream up new ways to spotlight our customers and their success stories.

What you will do

• Own Wavemakers, our customer advocacy program, including defining segments, nomination criteria, and recruitment strategy, refining a tier and points model with real incentives, and driving ongoing engagement
• Own the customer reference program and rep engagement playbook, including recruiting and building a roster of referenceable customers, fulfilling sales requests for references, and tracking program performance
• Run customer awards at XFN, Rippling’s annual customer conference
• Partner with Sales and Account Management to turn happy customers into advocates, references, and case studies
• Identify opportunities to improve and automate advocacy and reference workflows, including partnering with Marketing Operations
• Support product betas by collecting customer proof points that support launches
• Track and report on program health, including reference fulfillment rate and time-to-fulfill, win rate on deals with a reference versus without, Wavemakers Hub membership and engagement, and the percentage of customers who convert into a reference or case study

What you will need

• 3+ years of experience in a customer marketing-related role (customer marketing, product marketing, or similar), ideally in B2B SaaS or AI
• Experience running advocacy and reference programs, including recruiting and activating advocates, incentivizing participation, and scaling a program to meet growing business needs
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex information into clear, concise messaging
• A self-starter mindset, with a track record of driving projects end-to-end, standing up new processes from scratch, and scaling existing ones
• High EQ and a proven ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously with timely, responsive follow-through
• Experience with Salesforce and UserEvidence (nice to have)

Additional Information

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.title: IT Manager
jobs.description:
IT Manager

Who We Are

Boston-based company Piaggio Fast Forward Inc. (PFF) was founded in 2015 by the Piaggio Group (the Italian manufacturer that created the iconic Vespa scooter). We are on a mission to build technology products that move the way that people move. To bring products to market today, PFF is solving the problem of robotic interaction with people in dynamically changing environments. We’re innovators, neighbors, and creators with a passion for local living and pushing the limits on urban transportation. We support a sustainable mobility ecology with healthy lifestyles and social connectivity available to all, regardless of age or abilities.

The Role

Piaggio Fast Forward (PFF) is seeking a versatile, proactive, and highly organized IT Manager to serve as the primary technology resource for our company. As our in-house IT expert, you will wear many hats—from troubleshooting daily user issues and provisioning equipment, to managing our network infrastructure and safeguarding our data. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment and can translate technical concepts to non-technical team members with patience and clarity.

What You'll Do

• IT Operations & Strategy: Build, manage, and optimize all internal IT operations, systems, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Vendor Management: Act as the primary liaison with third-party technology vendors, internet service providers, and software support teams.

• Budgeting & Planning: Develop and manage the annual IT budget, forecast technology expenditures, and align software/hardware investments with business objectives.

• Policy & Compliance: Establish and enforce IT security, data privacy, device usage, and remote work policies. Ensure compliance with relevant industry regulations.

• Project Management: Plan and execute IT projects end-to-end, including cloud migrations, system upgrades, office expansions, and software rollouts.

• Infrastructure & Systems Administration: Install, configure, and maintain local network infrastructure (switches, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi), servers, and storage systems.

• Cloud & User Administration: Manage identity and access management systems (e.g., Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Azure AD / Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta).

• Cybersecurity & Data Protection: Implement network security measures, endpoint protection, patch management, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and automated backup/disaster recovery solutions.

• End-User Support: Provide primary or escalation support for workstation hardware, operating systems (Windows/macOS), software applications, and network connectivity issues.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of progressive experience in IT systems administration, network administration, or IT support engineering.

• 2+ years in a supervisory, team lead, or sole-contributor IT manager role with direct responsibility for overall IT environment health.

• Proven track record of managing end-to-end IT projects without heavy external assistance.

• Deep familiarity with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, VLANs, firewalls (e.g., Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco Meraki), and wireless networking.

• Expert administrative capability in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or Google Workspace, as well as Windows Server or Linux environments.

• Experience with MDM/RMM tools (e.g., Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, Datto) for automated device provisioning, patching, and monitoring.

• Hands-on experience configuring firewalls, antivirus/antimalware systems, spam filtering, and automated cloud/on-premise backups (e.g., Datto).

• Successful applicants will be asked to show proof that they can legally work in the U.S

Yearly Base Salary Range for this position is $125.000 to $155,000

We like you just the way you are.

Diversity fuels our innovation. Inclusion, belonging, equity, and neurodiversity drives our best-in-class culture. We strive to create workplaces where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, grow at their own pace, and work together towards a shared vision while holding each other to a higher standard. For us, DEI&B is the only way forward.

Employment Eligibility Verification
Piaggio Fast Forward participates in E-Verify, an electronic employment verification program operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA), to verify the employment eligibility of newly hired employees. Piaggio Fast Forward is an E-Verify Employer, and as such, the company will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

For more information about E-Verify, please visit the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) website: https://www.e-verify.gov/

Naked Farmer is proud to announce the opening of a new location! Coming Soon 2026! West Palm Beach, we cannot wait to serve you!  Let's get cooking!

As we prepare to expand into this community, we are seeking dedicated and motivated individuals to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a restaurant from the ground up, helping to establish a strong culture, deliver exceptional hospitality, and grow with us as we continue our mission to build a better food system.

CHEF DE CUISINE

Naked Farmer is a pioneering farm-to-table restaurant group with multiple locations, cooking and serving scratch-made, healthy, and affordable meals. Our restaurants celebrate the seasonality of vegetables and the spirit of innovation, striving to create a sustainable food system that strengthens the connection between farmers and the community.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Chef De Cuisine, you will lead the culinary team in our scratch kitchen, acting as the culinary nuts-and-bolts of our restaurant. Your role will be to manage and guide your team of chefs to run an efficient kitchen where chefs love to work. With a talent for balancing culinary excellence with operational savvy, you will lead and inspire others, demonstrating both leadership and culinary skills. Your ability to maintain strong relationships with farmers, partners, and suppliers is essential, as is your oversight of daily kitchen operations, adherence to sanitation standards, and maintenance of kitchen equipment. You will be responsible for supervising food preparation, menu planning, staffing, and ensuring that every kitchen station operates smoothly.

BENEFITS:

• Competitive salary and a vibrant work culture

• Profit-sharing incentives

• 401(k)

• Annual paid vacation

• Affordable health, dental, and vision insurance

• Opportunities for career progression within our rapidly growing company

• A complimentary Naked Farmer meal daily

At Naked Farmer, we are cultivating the next generation chefs. Our scratch-based kitchens are a hub for individuals passionate about real, good food. Your passion for cooking delicious food will be evident as you are a farmer of people who enjoys helping other chefs master various cooking stations, ensuring each recipe is prepared consistently to showcase the best of the season. You will inspire and lead those eager to share their love for cooking and transform others into skilled chefs. If you are driven by a sense of purpose and a craving for shaping the future of food, join us on our mission to build a better food system.

YOU WILL:

• Cultivate a kitchen culture that embodies our best practices and standards, inspiring your team through every service.

• Lead and mentor the chef trainees, setting an example of culinary expertise and positivity to consistently deliver exceptional food.

• Guarantee the quality and presentation of food across all business channels, treating dine-in, pick-up, and delivery orders with equal dedication.

• Act as the go-to resource for the kitchen staff on recipe inquiries, preparation checklists, and food quality, maintaining order and consistency.

• Manage the receipt and quality control of fresh ingredients from our farm partners, and oversee inventory, supplies, and quality assurance processes.

• Organize prep lists and collaborate with the Chef Operator on food inventory and ordering to ensure the kitchen is well-prepared and organized.

• Setup your team for success on each service by managing the deployment board and prep schedules effectively.

• Perform line checks, assess readiness of food, anticipate needs, and manage potential waste to ensure seamless service.

• Set the kitchen up for success, completing all tasks with timeliness and a focus on safety.

• Introduce and test food preparation techniques that enhance kitchen efficiency, and remain open to innovative systems and processes.

• Uphold stringent kitchen operations, including storage, labeling, preparation, and safety protocols, ensuring compliance with health standards and guidelines.

• Lead in placing orders and managing kitchen facilities, and collaborate with the Chef Operator on labor and food costs.

• Grow your kitchen team through active recruitment, training, performance management, mentorship, and disciplinary procedures when necessary.

YOU HAVE:

• A minimum of 2 years' experience leading a culinary team in a high-volume setting.

• A deep passion for quality food and a desire to constantly improve.

• Strong culinary expertise with a willingness to learn and adapt.

• A proven work ethic and the ability to perform the job's physical demands, such as lifting up to 50 pounds.

• A collaborative spirit and readiness to contribute as needed.

• Respect and appreciation for your team and a commitment to fostering a positive work environment.

• Exceptional communication skills.

• A vision for mentoring and developing chefs into future restaurant leaders.

• Reliability and a consistent performance record.

• Adaptable interpersonal skills and the ability to meet new challenges with agility.

• An unwavering attention to detail.

ABOUT NAKED FARMER:

Born during a global pandemic, Naked Farmer quickly adapted, delivering fresh food directly from farm to doorstep. Our ethos is founded on resilience, transparency, and telling the story of the farmers behind our local food supply. With a commitment to becoming 100% locally-sourced, we are now embarking on an expansion phase, opening new locations and furthering our mission of transparency in sourcing and cooking while supporting local farmers, communities, and chefs. We have 11 locations in 3 states, FL, NC and TN.

And yes, all employees enjoy complimentary Naked Farmer meals every day—don't miss out on the sweet potatoes.

Join us as we build the future of food together.

Naked Farmer participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility for all newly hired employees.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, OT
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Threat model OT systems and environments across the fleet: SCADA platforms, BMS and EPMS, cooling and power systems, and the sensor networks that feed them.

 - Design the architecture and segmentation that keeps a gigawatt-scale OT estate defensible: network zones, remote access paths, and the IT/OT boundary.

 - Forward-deploy with controls engineering to secure operational deployments, from PLC code pipelines and virtualized controllers to the SCADA layer above them.

 - Serve as the security consultant to power, controls, commissioning, and site teams as new capacity energizes, turning review requests into guidance teams can actually deploy.

 - Work with the detection and response org to understand and tune OT-environment detection coverage, and respond alongside incident responders when attacks reach OT infrastructure.

 - Lead engagements with hardware OEM’s on product security requirements and use cases such as firmware security, tamper evidence, and counterfeit detection to address supply chain risk.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've secured substations, SCADA, or controls systems in production: Ignition or comparable platforms, PLCs, relays, and the industrial protocols beneath them.

 - You've threat modeled OT environments and turned the results into segmentation and controls that operators could live with.

 - You think in the Purdue Model and know when to break it, because virtualized PLCs and software-defined OT don't always fit the reference architecture.

 - You've worked hands-on with common OT security tooling (Claroty, Nozomi, Dragos, or similar) and know what each class of tool can and can't see.

 - You know BMS, EPMS, and cooling systems well enough to hold your own with the engineers who run them.

 - You've moved security forward in engineering teams that don't report to you, through consultation and design review rather than mandate.

 - Bonus: NERC CIP or IEC 62443 depth. Securing virtualized or containerized industrial control. Commissioning-phase security work at construction sites.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
