jobs.description:
We're looking for Customer Advocates with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to build an exciting career at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500!

Whether it's delivering happiness to customers on the driveway or getting involved in the local community, our Customer Advocates are leading the charge in reintroducing happiness into the car-buying process. Ready to join the 'Hauler-Life'?

Shift Requirement: The hours for this position are from 7am - 5pm, 9am - 7pm or 11am - 9pm. We ask that team members be available to work 7 days a week. Days off will rotate between weekdays and weekend days.

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $19/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

• Pay Range: $19-$21 hourly

• Starting Pay: $19/hr

• At 3 Months: $19.50/hr

• At 6 Months: $20/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $19/hr to $21/hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. As part of this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.50 increase in their pay every 90 days.

And that's not all! Market Operations may offer other performance-based incentive programs specific to your location, potentially unlocking even greater earnings.

Benefits + Perks:

We continually invest in our team members’ success because when our team members grow, we grow. Here is how we invest in you:

• Compensation: Competitive, Performance-Based Compensation PLUS 401(k) with Carvana match, opportunity for overtime during busy seasons

• Fast Track Advancement Opportunities: Stellar performers achieve higher pay rates sooner based on performance. Hard work and stellar performance won't go unnoticed.

• Health & Wellness: 100% Company Paid Healthcare Premiums plus Dental + Vision benefits. Wellness program to support mental, physical and financial health. We know pets are family too! Benefit from our pet care savings program to keep your furry friends healthy and happy.

• Time Off & Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off (13 days for the first year, increases to 20 days thereafter)

• Education Support: We support you depending on where you are at in your education journey - if you are looking to pursue a bachelor's degree, we offer tuition reimbursement. And if you already have your bachelors degree we have a student loan repayment program!

• Equity: Carvana Shares is something that we grant to our team members on an annual basis where you get to be an ‘owner’ in the company. We also offer an Employee Stock Purchase Plan discount!

• Professional Development: Extensive internal growth and professional development opportunities

• And more!

About the Role:

We're looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players with at least 2 years of customer-facing experience to:

• Deliver vehicles straight to customers' doors with our custom car haulers (don't worry - a commercial license is not required to drive the hauler and you will receive ample training)

• Frequently load/unload vehicles onto the hauler (this part does require getting physical!) and regularly inspect the car-hauler to make sure the vehicle maintains safe to drive

• Complete customer paperwork and include thorough notes in our customer tracking system

• Consistently drive safe and maintain a clean driving record in accordance with Carvana's CMV Driver Qualification policy.

* Candidates must have (or be able to obtain) a Notary in your local jurisdiction within the first 90 days of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). This process may involve satisfying state-specific requirements. For further details, candidates can review their local state notary requirements here: State Notary Requirements.

* Candidates must be able to satisfy state-specific requirements related to access DMV/title and registration systems.

* Illinois, Michigan, Louisiana, and Missouri employees must obtain a Chauffeur's license or any other state specialty license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana).

* California employees must obtain a Vehicle Verifier license within the first 90 days of employment (Process sponsored by Carvana).

* Nevada, Tennessee, and Virginia employees must apply for a Salesperson license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). Obtaining this license is a condition of employment; failure to secure it may impact continued employment in this role.

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to perform physically demanding tasks like detailing vehicles and loading/unloading vehicles onto our haulers in indoor and outdoor conditions with occasional exposure to inclement/extreme weather (some markets may require deliveries to be made in the snow, while other markets require deliveries to be made in the summer heat).

• Ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours)

• Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

• Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat

• Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items of 50lbs.

• Frequent driving requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity. Reasonable accommodations may be granted to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Legal stuff

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

All applicants must pass a drug test and obtain a DOT Medical Card. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.”

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview 

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

The Role

Our Software Test Engineer will have the aptitude, ambition, attitude, and solid professional experience to support and grow our software test team. This position is part of the Integration and Test team and develops and executes manual and automated tests for augmented reality software systems. 

Working under the guidance of senior test engineers and the test lead, this engineer translates assigned requirements into test cases and procedures, captures objective test evidence, documents defects, and helps maintain reliable test environments. 

The role collaborates daily with software development and product teams and occasionally supports the Hardware Test team during integrated activities involving electronics, computing, and optical hardware.

KEY RESPONSIBILIITES

· Translate assigned product and system requirements into detailed test cases, procedures, and contributions to research and development, qualification, and acceptance test plans.

· Execute manual and automated software tests, including hardware in the loop testing, using established test environments and procedures.

· Create process and procedures, as well as identify opportunity for improvement, for executing software test, reporting, and defect adjudication.

· Establish plans for testing during large test campaigns.

· Document test results, defects, reproduction steps, and verification evidence with clear traceability to requirements.

· Troubleshoot software issues on Linux based systems using logs, controlled recreations, and collaboration with software engineers.

· Develop and maintain automated checks within existing continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines under guidance.

· Partner with software developers to understand new functionality, identify testability concerns, and develop corresponding test coverage.

· Support the preparation and execution of large test campaigns, including flight test briefs and debriefs when assigned.

· Occasionally support the Hardware Test team with integrated test activities.

· Participate in design discussions and code reviews as they relate to software quality, testability, and defect prevention.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

· Two to five years of experience in a software test or software development role within an Agile product development environment.

· Experience designing and executing detailed test cases, procedures, and test plans.

· Hands on experience with software testing methods and tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, Jira, Jenkins, GitLab, Qase, or comparable tools.

· Experience with integration and regression testing, defect tracking, and test result reporting.

· Working knowledge of white box, black box, and functional testing methods.

· Experience using Linux based software systems and analyzing application logs.

· Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

· Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Python experience for test automation or test tooling.

· Exposure to C++ codebases or the ability to read C++ for test analysis and issue investigation.

· Experience testing web applications or user-facing software products.

· Experience contributing to automated test environments or hardware in the loop test systems.

· Experience with augmented reality, virtual reality, computer vision, six degree of freedom tracking, or wearable display systems.

· Experience in a military, aviation, or defense technology environment.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

 - Healthcare, Dental, and Vision (100% coverage for Employees)

 - Paid time off, including vacation, sick, paid holidays, and parental leave

 - Short and Long-Term Disability

 - Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan

 - Voluntary Worksite Benefits (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity)

 - May be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to plan terms.

Red 6 has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications, and benefits. jobs.title: Audit Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

You will run the external audit calendar for our SOX 404 program as we scale toward an IPO. That means coordinating with our external auditors across the year, aligning testing windows with control owners, educating our control owners, and keeping requests and deliverables on schedule. You will also own SOX scoping and risk assessment cycles, deficiency tracking, and status reporting, and help roll out our GRC platform so the program runs from one system of record instead of spreadsheets. You will scale the program through AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and speed up our SOX program.

This role reports to the Head of Business Controls and works closely with everyone on the SOX and Internal Audit team. This is an individual contributor role for someone who keeps a complex program on schedule, writes clearly, and makes the program simpler each cycle.

Key responsibilities

• Own the annual SOX audit calendar, including interim and year-end testing windows, walkthrough schedules, and key deliverable dates agreed with external auditors.

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for external auditor requests. Triage, route, and track each request to closure, including PBC (provided-by-client) lists and evidence deliveries.

• Coordinate auditor walkthroughs and fieldwork with process owners, control owners, and the SOX Testing team, so each control owner is asked for the same evidence once.

• Track auditor findings, management responses, and deficiency follow-ups, and report status to Internal Audit leadership.

• Prepare control owners and process owners for auditor sessions, and get evidence delivered on time without direct authority over them.

• Lead the annual SOX scoping and risk assessment, including quarterly refreshes, and support the annual Fraud Risk Assessment, so the program has appropriate scope and coverage under COSO.

• Monitor BP and IT SOX testing and report status to leadership and share status with external auditors

• Lead work with the business to improve control documentation, including education of templates and SOX guidance.

• Find optimization and automation opportunities across the SOX lifecycle through the use of AI.

• Support the rollout of the GRC tool for SOX, including control libraries, workflows, evidence requests, and testing templates.

• Define the data and reporting requirements the platform must meet, and test that it produces what the program needs.

• Run the quarterly sub-certification process and report results to leadership

• Own SOX program status reporting: dashboards and metrics for leadership, audit calendar progress, and deficiency and remediation status.

• Own status reporting for the full SOX lifecycle: scoping and risk assessment, testing, deficiencies and remediation, segregation of duties (SOD), SOC 1 report reviews, the fraud risk assessment, and audit calendar progress.

Minimum qualifications

• Big 4 audit firm experience on SOX 404 or ICFR engagements, including managing audit calendars, PBC requests, and fieldwork with external audit teams.

• Experience working directly with external auditor teams on requests, testing schedules, and findings, from the company side.

• Several years of hands-on SOX 404 experience, including scoping, risk assessment, control documentation, testing, and deficiency evaluation.

• Working knowledge of the COSO framework, ICFR, and PCAOB standards.

• Experience developing or maintaining Risk and Control Matrices and process documentation or flowcharts.

• Experience implementing or administering a GRC systems

• Experience reporting program status, metrics, and issues to senior leadership.

• Ability to get control owners to deliver on time without authority over them.

• Clear writing and calm coordination under deadline pressure.

• A Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications

• In-house SOX experience at a pre-IPO or newly public company.

• Experience running a fraud risk assessment.

• CPA, CISA, or similar certification.

• Comfort with SQL or data tools for reporting, and experience building lightweight automations, including with Claude.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Build Fluidstack's offensive security program from the ground up, including its methodology, tooling, and engagement cadence.

 - Run red and purple team operations emulating advanced threat actors across our cloud infrastructure, endpoints and bare metal deployments.

 - Pen test critical systems, including tenant isolation, bare metal GPU hosts, firmware and BMCs, and data center OT.

 - Partner with security and engineering teams on AI-specific attack scenarios, including  agentic systems and other novel AI-enabled risks.

 - Contribute to AI-assisted offensive testing tools and workflows.

 - Present findings to technical and executive audiences as clear, actionable risk that shapes the security roadmap.

 - Live on the bleeding edge of AI-enabled offensive operations inside and outside our environments


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You have years of hands-on experience in red teaming and offensive security operations.

 - You have deep expertise in at least two of: macOS, Linux, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines.

 - You've found novel attack paths and chained vulnerabilities into full compromise.

 - You've run adversary simulations against well-defended environments.

 - You write quality code in Python, Go, or similar languages.

 - You write findings that get fixed and help teams prioritize risk.

 - You've worked closely with blue teams.

 - Bonus: State-nexus threat models (frontier AI, government, critical infrastructure). Testing AI and ML systems (agentic workflows, model serving). Defensive experience (detection engineering, SIEM, EDR). Hardware and data center attacks (firmware, BMC, OT/ICS). Interest in AI safety and security.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Lead Math Tutor
jobs.description:
Lead Math Tutor – Leadership & Career Growth Opportunity

Location: Redwood City, CA | Onsite

Employment Type: Part-Time | Approximately 10–20 hours/week

Start Date: ASAP

Compensation: $19–$22/hour

Teach Math. Take Initiative. Grow Into Management.

Are you an experienced math tutor or educator who's ready to take on more responsibility and explore a future in education management?

At Think Zone Learning Center, we're looking for a personable, dependable, and motivated Lead Math Tutor to support K–8 students and help maintain a positive, high-quality learning environment at our Redwood City location.

This is a hands-on role where you'll continue tutoring students while providing guidance to fellow tutors, supporting daily instructional activities, and working closely with center management.

Previous management experience isn't required! We're looking for someone with strong math skills, strong communication skills, leadership skills and a willingness to learn.

About Think Zone

Think Zone Learning Center, part of TAL Education Group, provides in-person K–8 math enrichment programs designed to help students strengthen their academic foundations, build confidence, and develop critical thinking skills.

We believe great learning experiences start with passionate educators, supportive families, and strong teams.

What You'll Do

Teach & Support Students

• Provide engaging math tutoring to K–8 students, adapting instruction to different learning styles and academic needs.

• Help students build confidence, strengthen problem-solving skills, and develop a positive attitude toward math.

• Monitor student progress and work with center staff to address learning challenges.

Support Fellow Tutors

• Serve as a resource for fellow tutors by sharing teaching strategies, materials, and best practices.

• Provide guidance and constructive feedback when needed to support consistent instructional quality.

• Help new tutors become familiar with Think Zone's teaching methods and expectations.

• Support a collaborative, welcoming, and student-focused learning environment.

Take Initiative in Center Operations

• Work closely with center management to support daily tutoring activities and classroom coordination.

• Help ensure tutoring sessions run smoothly and students receive consistent support.

• Communicate student progress, instructional needs, and feedback to center staff.

• Gain exposure to parent communication, student management, and daily center operations.

• Take on additional responsibilities as you develop your leadership and organizational skills.

Who We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Strong K–8 math knowledge and the ability to explain concepts clearly.

• Previous experience tutoring or teaching mathematics.

• Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

• Comfortable working with students of different ages and learning abilities.

• Patient, personable, organized, and dependable.

• Able to take initiative and provide support to fellow tutors when needed.

• Interest in developing leadership and management skills.

Preferred, But Not Required

• Currently pursuing or holding a degree in Mathematics, Education, STEM, or a related field.

• Previous mentoring, training, or team coordination experience.

• Experience communicating with parents or supporting student progress.

• Interest in education management, center operations, or student enrollment.

We value potential as much as experience.

Schedule & Compensation

• Pay: $19–$22/hour.

• Hours: Approximately 10–20 hours per week.

• Availability: Ideally 4–6 hours per day, approximately four days per week.

• Preferred Availability: Saturday and weekday afternoons.

• Location: Redwood City, CA (Onsite).

Career Growth at Think Zone

We believe strong center leaders can grow from strong educators. This Lead Tutor position offers an opportunity to develop both teaching and operational skills while exploring a future in education management.

Your Potential Career Path

Lead Math Tutor → Assistant Learning Center Manager → Learning Center Manager

1. Lead Math Tutor — Develop Your Leadership Foundation

Continue tutoring students while supporting fellow tutors, helping maintain instructional quality, and gaining exposure to daily center activities.

2. Assistant Learning Center Manager — Learn Center Operations

Build experience in parent communication, student enrollment, scheduling, tutor coordination, and daily center operations. Develop the organizational and customer service skills needed to support a learning center's growth.

3. Learning Center Manager — Take Ownership of a Center

Oversee center operations, build strong relationships with families, support the teaching team, and take responsibility for student enrollment, retention, and overall center performance.

Advancement opportunities depend on individual performance, demonstrated skills, business needs, and position availability.

Training & Professional Development

As a Lead Tutor, you'll have opportunities to strengthen your teaching, communication, and leadership skills while learning more about the operational side of running a learning center.

For those interested in management, this position can provide a foundation for developing skills in parent relationships, enrollment support, team coordination, and center operations.

Ready to Grow With Us?

If you're passionate about math education, enjoy supporting students and fellow tutors, and are excited about the opportunity to develop into a future center leader, we'd love to hear from you!

Join Think Zone Learning Center and take the next step in your career in education and leadership!

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Exposure and Vulnerability Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own exposure and vulnerability management across the estate: external attack surface, cloud and Kubernetes, corporate endpoints, network infrastructure, and the bare-metal fleet beneath them.

 - Extend exposure and vulnerability management across the corporate fleet (macOS, Windows, Linux): OS and application patch posture, first-party and third-party software, and drift from approved baselines.

 - Cover software outside our managed and approved catalogs: unmanaged apps and SaaS, package-level software on endpoints (npm, PyPI, Homebrew), and browser and IDE extensions. Identify it, assess it, and drive it to remediation or removal.

 - Build the engineering that makes it work: asset inventory, scanner orchestration, deduplication, and prioritization built on reachability and real-world exploitation rather than raw CVSS.

 - Engineer remediation into the workflows teams already use, so findings land as owned tickets, fixes ride existing pipelines, and closure verifies automatically.

 - Remediate alongside the teams that own the systems: write the patch PR, harden the base image, fix the IaC module, and ship the config change rather than just requesting it.

 - Extend the program past where enterprise playbooks run out: BMC and device firmware, GPU drivers, host images at fleet scale, and the long tail of data center equipment.

 - Run intake for pen test findings and external reports, and report exposure honestly: what's reachable, what's exploited in the wild, what's accepted and by whom.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've built vulnerability management as an engineering problem: pipelines, automation, and integrations rather than spreadsheet triage.

 - You write production-quality automation (Python or similar) and have wired scanners, asset systems, and ticketing into something coherent.

 - You've run prioritization that survives contact with reality: KEV, EPSS, reachability, and the judgment to overrule all three.

 - You've fixed vulnerabilities yourself, in someone else's codebase or infrastructure, and your pull requests got merged because they were good, not because security demanded it.

 - You've driven remediation at scale through teams that don't report to you and kept SLAs credible without burning the relationships.

 - You can take a technology class most programs never touch, firmware or GPU stacks or data center equipment, and stand up a defensible assessment approach instead of waiting for a vendor to sell you one.

 - You've run vulnerability and exposure coverage on corporate endpoints and third-party software, including the unmanaged long tail of shadow apps, packages, and extensions.

 - Bonus: External attack surface management platforms. Firmware or BMC security depth. CSPM/KSPM tooling. Exploit development or reachability validation. Endpoint management and patching tooling (MDM, EDR), software inventory, and extension and supply chain risk.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.title: Director, People Technology
jobs.description:
At Western Digital, we are transforming the way technology enables HR services and the employee experience. We are looking for a strategic and hands on Director, People Technology to lead a team of Business Systems Analysts responsible for delivering scalable, business focused technology solutions across People functions. This leader will mentor and grow a high performing business analysis team. This team is responsible for translating business needs into effective process and technology solutions across HR domains.

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership, deep business analysis expertise, systems thinking, and a passion for developing talent. This role sits at the forefront of delivering high-quality outcomes across the People Technology portfolio.

About the Role

Team Leadership

This role leads, mentors, and develops a team of Business Systems Analysts by fostering accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and user centric problem solving. The Director establishes clear expectations, creates meaningful development plans, and opens career growth opportunities for team members while defining the capabilities and skills required for a strong business systems analysis function. Just as importantly, this leader builds a culture of knowledge sharing, constructive challenge, innovation, and impact.

Technology Leadership

The Director is responsible for driving our HR technology vision, roadmap, and execution. They provide direction and oversight across the full tech lifecycle, including requirements discovery, process analysis, functional design, testing, implementation, and post-launch optimization. This leader ensures consistent standards for documentation, quality controls, and delivery methods across the team, while coaching analysts to translate complex business challenges into clear, scalable, and sustainable process and technology solutions. The role also requires functional and technical depth to evaluate tradeoffs, challenge solution approaches, and engage credibly with business and technology partners.

Stakeholder Partnership

This leader serves as a trusted advisor to the People team, our IT technology partners, and company cross-functional stakeholders. The Director owns strong relationships across the organization to understand strategy, clarify priorities, and identify opportunities for transformation and optimization. They facilitate complex discussions, resolve ambiguity, align stakeholders, and drive decisions on requirements and solution direction, while creating transparency around priorities, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and expected business outcomes. This role will be tightly aligned with our IT organization, as delivery bridges across both groups.

Improvement & Innovation

This leader drives continuous improvement through process simplification, standardization, automation, and thoughtful technology enablement. They encourage the team to identify root causes, question legacy practices, and recommend solutions that improve employee experiences. They also champion responsible adoption of emerging capabilities and new ways of working to create measurable business value.

Required Qualifications

•  Proven experience leading and developing Business Systems Analysts/HRIS Analysts. Success building high performing teams, developing talent, and creating clear accountability for outcomes.

•  Deep expertise in business analysis practices, including requirements management, process design, functional solution design, testing, implementation, and optimization. Establishing and improving operating models, user enablement, and governance frameworks.

•  Strong understanding of enterprise HR technology, the HR domain, and its processes. The ability to connect company business priorities to HR programs and deliver meaningful, impactful outcomes.

•   Demonstrated experience with Workday HCM & ServiceNow specifically, and broader HR tech SaaS solutions in general. Familiarity with operating in shared models where configuration and administration is co-owned between HR and IT.

•   Expertise in modern SaaS HR systems architecture, integration principles, data quality practices, and emerging technologies such as AI.

•   Significant experience and ability in designing and then delivering multi-year roadmaps, balancing quick wins with longer term transformative work.

•  Exceptional communication, facilitation, influencing, stakeholder management, and problem solving skills.

About you

•  You are a people leader who builds high performing teams through clarity, coaching, accountability, and meaningful development. You empower decision making, develop enterprise talent, and create the conditions for others to do their best work. You’re known for growing future leaders.

•  You are curious, pragmatic, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You ask the right questions, simplify complexity, and turn broad business needs into clear priorities, scalable solutions, and impactful outcomes.

•  You bring strong HR technology and business systems expertise, with the ability to connect processes, data, user experience, and technology decisions to distinct business outcomes. You can build a multi-year roadmap, balance backlog work with transformative change, and successfully deliver it.

•  You lead with an enterprise mindset. You build trust across HR, IT, and business stakeholders. You align competing priorities, balance tradeoffs, and help teams debate, decide, and commit. You can align and co-deliver with your IT partners as one unified team.

•  You are energized by continuous improvement and innovation. You challenge legacy ways of working with respect, identify opportunities to automate and simplify, and champion responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including AI.

•  You care deeply about the employee experience and understand that great HR technology is more than just technical quality; it is intuitive, sensible, accessible, and built for durable scale.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior IT Systems Engineer to own the identity, authentication, and automation layer of Baseten’s internal IT environment. You will design and maintain how employees access every system at the company, from the day they’re hired to the day they leave.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on engineering, not frontline support. You will lead our Okta environment, build automated workflows that replace manual IT processes, and partner closely with Security to enforce access controls as we scale. You will also serve as a technical escalation point for the IT Support team on complex identity and systems issues.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco or New York office, following our standard policy of three days per week in person.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the architecture, configuration, and ongoing administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA, authentication policies, group structure, and application integrations

 - Lead the ongoing Okta migration and integration of new and existing applications via SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

 - Design and build automated joiner, mover, and leaver workflows across HRIS, Okta, Google Workspace, MDM, and SaaS applications

 - Develop automation using Okta Workflows, REST APIs, and scripting to eliminate manual IT processes

 - Implement and maintain role-based access control, least-privilege access models, and periodic access reviews in partnership with the Security team

 - Integrate identity with endpoint management to support device trust and compliance enforcement

 - Support compliance requirements such as SOC 2 through access controls, audit evidence, and documentation

 - Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams for identity and automation systems

 - Serve as an escalation point and technical resource for the IT Support team



REQUIREMENTS

 - 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, identity engineering, or a related role

 - Deep hands-on experience administering Okta, including Okta Identity Engine, Okta Workflows, authentication policies, and lifecycle management

 - Strong working knowledge of SAML, OIDC, SCIM, and MFA implementations

 - Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and experience working with REST APIs

 - Experience administering Google Workspace and an MDM platform (e.g. Kandji or Jamf)

 - Track record of designing and delivering automation that measurably reduced manual IT work

 - Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document systems for both technical and non-technical audiences



NICE TO HAVE

 - Okta certifications (Certified Professional, Administrator, or Consultant)

 - Experience managing identity or SaaS configuration as code (e.g. Terraform)

 - Experience with AWS IAM or cloud identity

 - Experience at a high-growth startup



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

jobs.title: Principal Network Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox runs a global scale network with a number of data centers and public clouds to provide services to millions of users, and creates a broad threat landscape. As a Principal Security Software Engineer on the Network Security pod, you will help shape and implement our network security strategy and controls. You'll have a big impact while collaborating with security and cross-functional teams to secure our networks, protect our services and platforms.

In this role, you’ll work closely with other people in the Information Security (InfoSec) team as well as partner with multiple Roblox infrastructure engineering teams.

You will

• Identify security vulnerabilities & gaps in our network infrastructure, propose solutions and drive engineering effort for implementation, partner with our infrastructure teams on improvements.

• Design, develop, and optimize novel solutions & systems using your software engineering skills and system thinking, to protect Roblox’s networks from external threats and internal risks.

• Provide design reviews & guidelines from network security perspective for Roblox’s tools, services, and platforms.

You have

• 8+ years: of relevant professional experience.

• Programming Proficiency: Able to write high-performance code for large scale distributed services with at least one programming language such as Golang or C++, and you are eager to learn new languages and technologies.

• Hands-on experience: Designing and building production level services in fields of networking and security, such as L4/L7 network proxies, load balancers, IDS/IPS, firewalls, etc.

• In-depth knowledge of: Network routings and protocols (TCP/UDP, DHCP, DNS, etc.), attack vectors, techniques, and remediations.

• Experience with: advanced packet processing technologies and frameworks, such as DPDK, eBPF, is a big plus.

You are

• Collaborative: You love working with your direct team and cross-functional partners.

• A Self-driving Software Engineer: You’re well-versed in the depths of networks or security, with hands-on experience in building high performance and reliable systems.

• Comfortable with ambiguity: You can gather data and make informed decisions when there is no clear answer.

• Eager to solve hard problems: You challenge the status quo when it no longer makes sense, and don’t shy away from big challenges.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

Annual Salary Range

$326,060—$385,050 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Customer Service Rep (01689) - 203 N. Henry Clay Blvd
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members including, but not limited to

• Operate all equipment.

• Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

• Prepare product.

• Receive and process telephone orders.

• Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

• Make and label boxes

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the

phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

• Must be able to make correct monetary change.

• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

• Fumes from food odors.

• Exposure to cornmeal dust.

• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.

• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

• Depth perception.

• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking: For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls and perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Crouching or squatting may be performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

• Workers reach above 72occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: IT Asset Manager
jobs.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

The IT Asset Manager will be a key member of the IT Customer Experience (ITCX) team, responsible for the comprehensive lifecycle management of all IT hardware and software assets across the enterprise. This role ensures compliance with internal policies, vendor licensing agreements, and financial accountability, leveraging ServiceNow IT Asset Management (ITAM) to drive automation, accuracy, and visibility.

This individual will work closely with Procurement, Finance, Security, and IT Operations teams to optimize asset utilization, reduce risk, and support strategic decision-making through data-driven insights. You will have a hybrid schedule with at least two days/week at our Miami headquarters in Brickell.

Your Impact

Asset Lifecycle Management

• Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of IT assets (hardware, software, peripherals) from procurement through retirement.

• Maintain an accurate, up-to-date asset repository within ServiceNow ITAM, ensuring data integrity and alignment with the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

• Partner with IT Customer Experience Analysts to streamline asset issuance, returns, and refresh processes.

Governance, Compliance & Reporting

• Develop and enforce IT asset management policies and procedures in collaboration with IT leadership and Security.

• Ensure compliance with software licensing agreements, maintenance contracts, and internal audit requirements.

• Conduct regular asset audits and reconciliation activities to validate inventory accuracy and policy adherence.

• Generate and analyze asset utilization, depreciation, and compliance reports to support strategic planning.

Vendor & Financial Management

• Collaborate with Procurement and Finance to manage vendor relationships, purchase orders, renewals, and budgeting for IT assets.

• Support cost optimization initiatives by identifying opportunities to consolidate vendors or reduce underutilized assets.

ServiceNow ITAM Administration

• Serve as the subject matter expert for ServiceNow ITAM, defining workflows, automation, and integrations with CMDB, Discovery, and Procurement.

• Partner with ServiceNow administrators and developers to enhance ITAM modules and reporting dashboards.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Act as a liaison between IT and business stakeholders to align asset management practices with organizational goals.

• Support training and awareness programs to promote proper asset handling and accountability across the enterprise.

Your Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in IT Asset Management or related IT Operations roles.

• Hands-on experience with ServiceNow IT Asset Management (Hardware and Software Asset Management modules).

• Strong understanding of ITIL processes, asset lifecycle management, and CMDB relationships.

• Excellent analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency in Excel or data visualization tools.

• Exceptional organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience working in a mid-to-large enterprise environment.

• Familiarity with ServiceNow Discovery, SAM Pro, and integrations with procurement systems.

• Certifications such as ITIL, ServiceNow ITAM, or Certified Hardware/Software Asset Manager (CHAMP/SAMPro).

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

• Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.

• Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

jobs.title: Creative Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. 
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Creative Marketing Manager, щоб разом піднімати планку результату.



ЩО РОБИТЬ ЦЮ РОЛЬ ОСОБЛИВОЮ

 - Масштаб тестування: гіпотези запускаються системно на широкому міксі каналів.

 - Рутина автоматизована: автобриф для постановки задач, шаблони і готова структура для варіацій, AI-стек для текстовок і ресерчу. Свої автоматизації можна викатити на всю команду.

 - Команда топових експертів ринку: User Acquisition, дизайн, MarTech та аналітика працюють пліч-о-пліч, і прямі партнерства з Meta і Google.

 - Два треки розвитку: поглиблення експертизи до Senior Creative Marketer або перехід у лідерську роль Creative Lead.
   


ВИКЛИКИ, ЯКІ ЧЕКАЮТЬ НА ЦІЙ РОЛІ

 - Досліджувати ринок і конкурентів через спай-тули (Meta Ad Library, Adheart і тп) та формувати на основі цього креативні гіпотези.

 - Оформлювати гіпотези у ТЗ для дизайнерів і писати текстовки: хедлайни, дескрипшени, UGC-сценарії.

 - Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

 - Масштабувати креативи, що показали результат, і створювати частину креативів самостійно за допомогою автоматизацій і шаблонів.
   


ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

 - 2+ роки досвіду у перфоменс маркетингу, зокрема повний цикл роботи з дизайнером — від постановки ТЗ і запуску до відповідальності за результат.

 - Досвід роботи зі спай-тулами та аналізу конкурентів, інтерес до автоматизації процесів.

 - Робота з метриками: вмієш аналізувати результати тестів та аргументувати рішення даними.

 - Буде плюсом: базові навички Figma / Adobe, робота з рекламними кабінетами Meta / Google, англійська для написання текстовок.
   


ЩО ТИ ОТРИМАЄШ ДОДАТКОВО РАЗОМ З НАМИ

 - Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: аналітика, продукт, маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і рекрутинг.

 - Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

 - Світлі та сучасні офіси в Києві й Варшаві, а також можливість повністю працювати віддалено.

 - Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

 

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

 - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

 - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

 - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Process Engineer, Battery
jobs.description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

Job Overview

The Process Engineer Battery is responsible for supporting daily production operations while driving continuous improvement across safety, quality, delivery, and cost. This role serves as the primary engineering resource for resolving manufacturing issues, optimizing manufacturing processes, implementing engineering changes, and ensuring products are built to specification. The Process Engineer works closely with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and Product Engineering to improve production performance and manufacturing capability.

What You’ll Do:

• Daily Operations and Escalation protocol: Resolve manufacturing, safety, quality, and production issues. Escalate critical production tasks and drive timely resolution minimizing impact to production.

• Documentation: Develop and maintain standard work instructions, process flows, PFMEAs, and control plans.

• Training: Train and coach technicians on updated manufacturing procedures.

• Root Cause Analysis: Lead investigations (5 Why, Fishbone, DOE, Pareto) and implement corrective actions. Support containment and recovery activities related to quality, supplier and production issues.

• Continuous Improvement: Drive throughput, cycle time, OEE, yield, and cost improvements via Lean/Six Sigma.

• Engineering & Systems Support: Support engineering change orders (ECOs), new product introductions, part revisions, process changes and enhancements to MES and traceability systems.

• Process Optimization: Manage line balancing, capacity planning, ergonomics, and workflow.

Who You Are:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience: 3+ years of experience with battery manufacturing processes (cell to module and module to pack integration); experience in high-volume battery, automotive, EV, aerospace, or industrial production preferred.

• Safety Compliance: Knowledge and adherence to safety protocols for hazardous materials and toxic chemicals used in HV battery manufacturing.

• Methodologies & Tools: Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and RCCA.

• Systems Knowledge: Experience with MES, ERP, quality systems and manufacturing data analysis (JIRA/Confluence).

• Soft Skills: Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

Key Benefits & Perks:

• Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered

• Early-stage Stock Options

• Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave

• Annual Vacation Bonus

• Wellness & Fertility Benefits

• Cell Phone Stipend

• Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens

California Pay Range

$100,000—$150,000 USD

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com.

Candidate Data Privacy

Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

jobs.title: Claims Adjudication Specialist
jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

As a Claims Adjudication Specialist, you will play a critical role within our Operations Department, focused on evaluating and servicing claims related to our Product and Shipping Protection plans, which are offered by over 1,000+ Merchant Partners. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert, supporting our Customer Support and Service Technician partners to ensure accurate and timely service of complex claims that require deeper investigation.

This position requires strong analytical skills, critical thinking, and the ability to interpret multiple policies across a wide range of product categories. On a daily basis, you’ll review complex claim submissions, manage escalations, and investigate unusual claim patterns. Success in this role relies on meticulous attention to detail, evidence-based decision-making and ability to adapt to frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment.

You'll collaborate closely with customers, service partners, and internal teams to deliver accurate claim decisions while ensuring an exceptional customer experience. The role involves inbound and outbound calls, as well as written communications with customers, service providers, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

• Serves as the escalation point of contact from outsourced partners, customer support teams and service technician partners.

• Investigate and resolve complex claim situations, ensuring decisions align with contract terms and internal policies.

• Troubleshoot delays in claims processing, ensuring timely resolutions and enhanced customer satisfaction.

• Coordinate service technician dispatching and parts ordering when necessary to support claim resolution.

• Resolve escalated customer issues by proposing fair resolutions within policy guidelines and clearly communicating outcomes to the customer.

• Maintain detailed and organized documentation of all customer and partner interactions.

• Investigate suspected fraudulent claims and report findings as needed.

• Recommend process improvements and opportunities to automate routine tasks.

• Provide timely responses to claim inquiries via phone and email, in line with established SLAs.

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and escalate unresolved claim issues.

• Stay up to date on product offerings, service workflows, and policy updates to better support customers.

• Identify and communicate training needs for front-line support teams to improve service quality.

• Keep internal systems current with relevant technical issues, customer feedback, and insights.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge:

• Active adjuster licenses (preferred).

• 3-5 years of technical customer service, claims management/adjudication, insurance adjusting, or contact center experience. Claims adjudication preferably in a protection plan environment.

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written with the ability to convey complex claim details and supporting rationale for decisioning in a clear and concise way both to customers and internal system notations.

• Embraces frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in managing evolving challenges.

• Experienced with claims management systems, contact center platforms, and Google suites of products.

• Proven ability to to navigate and work effectively across various software systems simultaneously.

• Ability to analyze complex issues, identify solutions, and make decisions efficiently.

• Thrive in environments of high claim volumes with exponential company growth while maintaining excellent performance and accuracy.

Estimated Pay Range: $45,000 - $55,000 per year salaried*

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, work location and job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

• Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.

• Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.

• Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.

• Generous, flexible paid time off policy.

• 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

Extend CCPA HR Notice
