jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
POWER A WORLD OF TRUST

Incode is the leading provider of world-class identity solutions that is reinventing the way humans authenticate and verify their identities online to power a world of digital trust.

Through our revolutionary identity solutions, we are unleashing the business potential of universal industries including finance, government, retail, hospitality, gaming, and more, by reducing fraud and transforming human interactions with data, products, and services.

We’re in the process of rapidly scaling our diverse global team and we’re looking for entrepreneurial individuals and leaders who are curious, driven, and excited by ownership to join a Unicorn-status scale-up!

About Incode

Incode is a Series B unicorn ($1.25 B valuation) rewriting how the world proves identity. Our AI-powered platform lets leading banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and governments deliver friction-free experiences while defeating fraud and safeguarding privacy. Customers such as Citi, AirBnB, Block, Chime, Sixt, and TikTok rely on Incode to power their identity verification and security. Recently named a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Identity Verification, we’re scaling fast—and we need a product-marketing leader who can turn breakthrough technology into a category-defining narrative.

The Impact You’ll Make

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Incode, you’ll help the largest companies in the world reduce cyber fraud and enhance identity verification experiences. Be ready to develop deeper relationships with our existing customers and to attract new large enterprises. You’re in for a lot of fun!

The B2B Enterprise Account Executive requires prospecting, customer developing, and a track record of closing new businesses in the region. We're on the lookout for a team player with a deep drive to sell the products they work on and will be taking ownership of the entire sales pipeline and processes.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with enterprise companies but also understand the hands-on culture of a startup sales organization. Ideally, your product sales experience focuses on complex, high-end technical solutions. Experience selling biometrics or AI solutions, nurturing leads and engaging teams departments (product, tech, business and compliance) are great to have. We are currently focused on several sales verticals such as Banking, Gaming & Gambling and other Digitally Native Businesses; hence, special industry expertise in any of these is highly desired. You can contribute to achieve our sales KPIs with the revenue that you bring to the table and keep our current customers happy.

What You’ll Own & Drive

• Build upon the growth & adoption of Incode’s clients in the enterprise market.

• Handle the full sales cycle from prospect to close.

• Forecast and build consistent pipeline to achieve Monthly, Quarterly and Yearly sales quotas.

• Manage, develop, and maintain client relationships and trusted partnerships that will optimize profitability, revenue, and client satisfaction.

• Cultivate and grow relationships with industry leaders that will lead to sales opportunities and new business.

• Apply a thorough understanding of the marketplace, industry trends, competitor offerings and products to all management activities and strategic sales decisions.

• Lead and deliver compelling sales pitches, presentations, and product demonstrations to a broad range of audiences, from C-level executives to individual contributors.

• Leverage and coordinate cross-functional internal teams (Sales Development, Legal, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, Product) to efficiently navigate complex sales cycles.

• Travel to industry events and conferences – up to 25%.

• Manage Salesforce data daily with meeting notes, accurate sales funnel update, etc.

• Provide professional after-sales support to enhance the customers’ satisfaction.

• Stay up-to-date with your customer’s industry and business to understand the customer’s environment and challenges, both present and future, and use the information to develop opportunities and value to the customer.

The Qualities That Set You Apart

• Security, fraud, privacy, identity, or biometric related industry experience

Your Background

• 5+ years of outstanding results selling SaaS/AI Solutions to customers where typical contract size ranges from $500K - $3M /year.

• Former identity experience is ideal for quick ramp, but broader SaaS experience with strategic enterprise sales experience in other relevant sectors such as Security, Cyber and Fraud are a plus.

• Experience working with large customers to deliver an integrated, end-to-end approach.

• Prior experience in a startup technology company.

• Experience selling to our target sectors such as Financial Services, FinTechs, Banks, Gaming & Gambling or other Digitally Native Businesses such as Gig Economy, Sharing, Social Media or Digital Mobility are desired.

• Up-to-date on digital and enterprise technology trends and regulatory changes.

• Outstanding CRM software experience (eg. Salesforce).

• Confident and polished communicator who is able to build strong and lasting working relationships.

• Outstanding negotiation skills.

• Motivated by success and a target-driven sales environment, managing your own accounts.

• Proven success navigating large organizations and the ability to quickly identify the decision-makers and the decision-making process with proven experience reducing decision time.

• Having a technical background and analytical mindset a huge plus.

• Strong sales track record and progressive attainment of goals and quotas.

Why Incode?

• Mission with Meaning – Shape how billions of people prove identity—safely, simply, and ethically.

• Rocket-Ship Growth – Join at an inflection point where your strategies will compound in value for years.

• Elite Team & Backing – Work a truly global with top engineers, designers, and investors who share your ambition to dominate a category.

• Ownership & Autonomy – Operate like a founder with the resources of a unicorn.

• Global Impact – Every program you launch will reverberate across industries and continents.

Ready to ignite the future of trust?

Lead the narrative. Empower the field. Join Incode and turn innovation into unstoppable market momentum.

Aspects of our Culture:

• High performance

• Freedom & responsibility

• Context, not control

• Highly aligned, loosely coupled

• Continuous Feedback

• Promotions & Development

• Learn more about Life at Incode!

Benefits & Perks:

• Flexible Working Hours & Workplace

• Open Vacation Policy

Equal Opportunities:

Incode is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We take great pride in having an inclusive, diverse, and global team, and we are always looking for talented and passionate individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. As part of our commitment to inclusion, we ensure that reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process. If you require any accommodation due to a disability or specific need, please let our Talent Acquisition team know—we’ll do our best to support you.

Applicant Data Privacy:

We will only use your personal information concerning Incode’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By day 90:
   
   - Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.
   
   - Build a deep understanding of onboarding and activation, and how paid acquisition connects to downstream user quality; partner with Growth PM and Ecosystems PM on meaningful improvements.
   
   - Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

 - By the end of year one:
   
   - Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.
   
   - Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.
   
   - Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.

 - Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.

 - Expert measurement and performance-analysis judgment: you can interpret geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context, identify meaningful patterns, understand what is driving them, and make clear kill/scale decisions.

 - Strong product and systems judgment across technical and marketing domains, with the ability to connect the parts into a coherent strategy and translate an ambiguous frontier into a system with a high quality bar.

 - High-agency cross-functional ownership: you can work across BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing to align decisions and deliver the full loop from strategy through operating model and infrastructure to outcomes.

For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $191,000 - $225,000 per year.

jobs.title: Security Architect, AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the attack surface unique to frontier compute: model weights custody, training environment isolation, accelerator and interconnect security, and multi-tenant boundaries under real adversarial pressure.

 - Design the reference architectures and standards that security engineering builds to, keeping the seam between design and build clean enough that both sides move fast.

 - Treat the workload as part of the threat model, and architect environments that stay defensible even when the thing running inside them is the adversary.

 - Run security design review for the systems that touch training and inference environments, from bare metal and fabric to scheduler and storage.

 - Track where frontier compute is going (new accelerators, interconnect generations, confidential computing, agentic workloads) and have the architecture ready before it lands.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've secured AI, ML, or HPC infrastructure where the assets were genuinely worth stealing: lab infrastructure security, supercomputing centers, or research environments that drew nation-state attention.

 - You can architect isolation at every layer it exists: hardware, firmware, hypervisor, kernel, container, network fabric, and physical.

 - You understand AI compute infrastructure as a system (accelerators, high-speed interconnects, parallel storage, schedulers) and know where each component breaks a classical security assumption.

 - You've done original work in systems or ML security, published or shipped, and can turn research into architecture that engineers actually build.

 - You defend design decisions in review on their merits, and change them when someone closer to the metal proves you wrong.

 - Bonus: Confidential computing and attestation depth. Weights custody or cryptographic key custody at scale. A publication record in systems or ML security.

• Verify that technicians perform thorough, consistent HVAC tune-ups and professional cleanings.

• Coach maintenance technicians in the field, including working alongside them on warranty calls and supporting the installation department when needed.

• Participate in the year-round on-call rotation. During assigned one-week shifts, answer after-hours calls from field technicians and the answering service.

What You'll Bring

• Strong hands-on HVAC maintenance, diagnostic, and repair experience, with the ability to explain your troubleshooting process to other technicians.

• A coaching mindset: patience when teaching, clear and constructive feedback, and a willingness to hold yourself and others accountable for quality work.

• Strong customer service and communication skills, with a focus on quality workmanship and resolving problems.

This role works in customer homes and residential field settings, including outdoor areas with uneven or rough terrain. Work may involve extended exposure to heat, cold, and changing weather conditions, as well as occasional work in cramped or confined spaces.

Physical duties include standing and walking for up to eight hours per day; occasionally lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; and regularly gripping, reaching, bending, stooping, crouching, climbing, squatting, kneeling, and working overhead. jobs.title: Lab Automation - Robotics Systems & Simulation Engineer
jobs.location: South San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

About the Role

We are building a next-generation lab automation and robotics platform that brings together robotic systems, simulation, computer vision, and AI to improve the speed, reliability, reproducibility, and scale of experimental biology.

As a Robotics Systems & Simulation Engineer, you will connect digital environments with physical systems and make robotic capabilities easier to adapt to new equipment and settings. You will own the simulation and digital-twin infrastructure that lets us bring vision-guided robots to new instruments quickly, and build the venue to test robotics control, perception and embodied AI. Working alongside robotics, AI, software, and automation engineers, you will develop and validate integrated systems from prototype through real-world operation.

This is a on-site hands-on role spanning software, 3D geometry, simulation, and hardware. We value strong fundamentals, practical problem-solving, and the ability to learn across disciplines using modern engineering and AI development tools.

What You’ll Do

• Build integrated Real2Sim and Sim2Real workflows that can be reused across robotic platforms and laboratory environments.

• Create and validate digital twins from CAD, robot and sensor models, and reconstructed scenes, including coordinate alignment, articulation, and collision geometry.

• Connect simulation, perception, motion planning, and physical execution through the existing robot control stack, including robot state feedback and synchronization; investigate discrepancies between simulated and measured behavior.

• Integrate AI models and task-level state machines with simulation and robotic tools, including structured requests, action validation, and execution feedback.

• Build synthetic-data and augmentation workflows, along with synchronized video and telemetry capture, replay, and evaluation tools.

• Benchmark system accuracy, reliability, latency, and GPU resource use; improve performance across local and cloud computing environments.

• Collaborate with software engineers on reusable configuration and operator tools; validate new installations and reduce manual setup effort.

jobs.title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Automated Safety
jobs.location: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine.

Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles.

What You'll Be Building

• Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful.

• Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks.

• Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings.

• Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves.

• Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks.

• Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems.

• The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly.

• An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists.

• For the Research Scientist profile: evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas.

• For the Research Engineer profile: evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation.

Bonus Points For

• Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research.

• Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments.

• Experience with safety monitoring, model-based evaluators or scalable experimental infrastructure.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$180,000—$298,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Lead Physician Associate/Assistant (PA) - Urgent Care

jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

We’re seeking a compassionate and experienced Physician Associate/Assistant (PA) to join our team as a Lead Provider, responsible for providing exceptional care and making a real impact on the lives of our patients within our urgent care clinic. Lead Providers at ConvenientMD act as clinical leader for all clinical staff, mentoring and supporting new-grad providers as well as allied healthcare professionals.

This role is perfect for a PA who thrives in a collaborative environment, enjoys mentorship, and is passionate about delivering high-quality care.

Your Impact

• Provide Patient-Centered Care: Conduct health assessments, physical exams, and review medical histories to address short- and long-term patient needs while staying committed to high-quality, efficient patient care. Assess patient health: Interview patients, perform physical examinations, obtain, update, and study medical histories. Determine abnormal conditions: Administer or order diagnostic tests (e.g., x-rays, electrocardiograms, laboratory studies) and interpret test results. Perform therapeutic procedures: Administer injections and immunizations, suture, manage wounds and infections. Educate and counsel: Empower patients with knowledge about their health, describe therapeutic regimens, give information on normal growth and development, discuss family planning, and wellness through counseling and guidance.

• Documentation & Compliance: Prepare clear, complete, accurate, and legible medical records for each patient under your care. Type, edit, and electronically sign all office notes, reports and records using EMR in accordance with company policies. Maintain a safe and clean working environment in compliance with company and state procedures, rules, and regulations. Protect patients and employees by adhering to infection-control policies and protocols. Comply with legal and professional requirements including studying existing and new legislation, anticipating future legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, advising management on needed actions.

• Collaborate with a Team: Work collaboratively and pro-actively with other providers and health care practitioners within your clinic to efficiently treat patients, and plan coordinated, efficient, and thoughtful dispositions (including transfer), all in a timely manner.

• Continuing Education & Mentorship: Act as a clinic leader, especially when the Practice Manager is not in-clinic. Provide support and mentorship to new-graduate providers as well as other clinic staff. Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies. Act as a preceptor to new provider staff, providing information, educational opportunities, and experiential growth opportunities.

Who You Are

• Education, Licensure, & Certifications: Master's degree and certification by Physician Assistant (PA) certifying body. Must have and maintain a DEA license with no restrictions. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification: American Heart Association or American Red Cross BLS certification. We do not accept CPR, ACLS certifications, or online only classes.

• Relevant experience: Clinical experience in emergency medicine, urgent care, or ambulatory care setting is preferred.

• Strong leadership skills: Willing and able to mentor provider as well as non-provider clinic staff.

• Excellent team player: Enjoy collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software and clinical management systems (EMR).

• Strong knowledge of: Principles and processes for providing customer and personal services, including customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction. Applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations including the requirements of the HIPAA and OSHA and applicable state rules and regulations pertinent to medical practices. Relevant drugs and their chemical composition, structure, and properties of substances and of the chemical processes and transformations that they undergo. Non-pharmaceutical patient care aids, their applicable uses, and relevance to patient care. Current principles, methods, and procedures for the delivery of medical evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

jobs.title: Staffing Associate (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About The Role

The Staffing Associate at Invisible Technologies gets qualified experts onto client projects and billing fast. Working with the Sr. Manager, Staffing, you'll turn client demand into staffed, productive teams: sourcing and vetting contractors, matching them to the right engagement, and moving them through onboarding to their first billed client hour. Demand shifts quickly, and projects often need to be staffed in days, not weeks.

This is a 6-month, 40-hour-per-week contract with real potential to extend or convert. It suits a seasoned, agency-trained staffing professional who measures success in fill rates and billed hours, thrives on urgency, and wants to make an immediate impact.

What You’ll Do

• Staff client projects end to end, turning incoming client demand into qualified contractors who are onboarded and billing hours.

• Partner with delivery and operations leads to understand each project's skill, volume and timeline needs, then build a staffing plan to meet them.

• Source high volumes of contractors and subject-matter experts through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, talent communities and existing talent pools.

• Screen and vet candidates quickly against project requirements, including skills assessments where needed.

• Match and assign contractors to the right engagements, balancing skills, availability and client priorities.

• Move contractors from offer through contracting, onboarding and training to their first billed hour, clearing blockers along the way.

• Track every contractor's path to billing and follow up quickly with anyone who stalls between acceptance and active work.

• Redeploy contractors as projects ramp up, wind down or change scope to keep utilization high.

• Re-prioritize daily as urgent client needs open, working alongside the Sr. Manager, Staffing.

• Keep the ATS and staffing trackers accurate and report weekly on fill rate, time-to-staff, time-to-first-billed-hour and utilization.

What We Need

• 5+ years of recruiting or staffing experience, including meaningful time in a staffing agency with a track record of meeting fill, placement and billable-hours targets.

• Proven success in high-volume contract or contingent staffing, filling dozens of seats at once while keeping quality high.

• A strong sense of urgency: you're energized by tight deadlines and can get qualified contractors from first contact to working in days.

• Advanced sourcing skills, including Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter and creative channels for niche or hard-to-find skills.

• Experience managing contractor onboarding, including contracts, compliance and readiness, in partnership with operations teams.

• Comfort working directly with delivery teams and client stakeholders, and pushing back when needed to keep staffing on track.

• Hands-on expertise with an ATS or staffing system (e.g., Greenhouse, Bullhorn, Workday, iCIMS) and strong spreadsheet skills for tracking pipelines.

• Sound judgment with confidential candidate, rate and client information.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay for our contractors, ensuring that rates reflect both market conditions and the value each contractor brings. Our contractor rate structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living.

As a contractor, you will not be eligible for Invisible’s employee benefits, bonus, or equity programs. Final rates are determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, and overall market conditions. Additional details on rate, contract duration, and terms will be discussed during the hiring process.

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in.

Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

You will conduct original computational biology research for AI safety and build an integrated understanding of biological risks. You will investigate how capabilities across large language models, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories combine to change what is biologically feasible. Our work spans protein and nucleic-acid design, cellular systems and biological delivery; we welcome other specialisms that bring relevant scientific depth and risk judgment.

What You'll Be Building

• Formulate and pursue original computational biology research questions relevant to safety, developing computational approaches and designing and running studies that generate new evidence about biological capabilities, risks and safeguards.

• Build and update an integrated picture of risks, examining how capabilities across LLMs, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories interact within scientific workflows and change practical constraints.

• Combine your research with literature, model assessments, experimental findings and expert input to judge biological feasibility, uncertainty and the significance of emerging capabilities for misuse.

• Identify gaps in expertise, frame questions for external specialists and critically integrate their findings with support from the expert-program team.

• Translate scientific risk judgments into dual-use policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that preserve beneficial biological research.

• Work with threat modelers, automated-safety researchers, experimental scientists and mitigation engineers to design informative evaluations and red-teaming studies, test assumptions and assess safeguards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in computational biology or a related quantitative biological discipline, with a record of original research from question formulation and computational study design through to defensible findings.

• Substantive experience assessing biological dual-use risks, with a strong understanding of relevant harmful applications, including pathogen- or toxin-related risks or other consequential biological misuse.

• Prior experience applying biological expertise to AI safety through analysis informing threat models, evaluation or red-teaming work, or mitigation design.

• Sound judgment about the relationship between computational predictions, biological function and experimental evidence, including uncertainty and the limits of your expertise.

• Strong quantitative analysis and scientific programming skills, with the ability to develop computational approaches, run reproducible studies and critically investigate model outputs and biological data.

• The ability to investigate unfamiliar questions, identify appropriate specialists and communicate defensible conclusions across scientific, engineering and policy teams.

Bonus Points For

• Experience connecting biological modeling or design to experimental validation, including workflows combining LLMs, specialized models, agents or laboratory automation.

• Experience commissioning specialist research or coordinating external scientific collaborators.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$268,000—$384,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

jobs.title: Insider Risk Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Stand up FluidStack's insider risk and counterintelligence program from zero: operating model, roadmap, and the controls that protect some of the most targeted compute infrastructure in the world.

 - Design and land technical controls by working through the rest of the security org: detection engineering for monitoring and analytics, IT and infrastructure for identity and data controls, physical security for the badge-to-bare-metal seam.

 - Run insider risk incidents end to end with legal and HR, from first signal through resolution.

 - Write the program's policy library and carry it through legal, HR, and leadership to adoption.

 - Own the program's stakeholder relationships: align with legal and HR on process, and keep the program legible and credible to the workforce it protects.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've built or rebuilt an insider risk program in a commercial environment before, more than once, and you know which parts of the playbook survive contact with a private-sector workforce.

 - You came up through the intelligence community or an adjacent national security mission, and you've already made the translation of counterintelligence tradecraft into corporate practice.

 - You've shipped technical controls by working through teams that don't report to you: detection, identity, IT, physical security.

 - You've written monitoring and investigations policy that got adopted, surviving scrutiny from legal and HR rather than sitting on a shelf.

 - You work fluently with legal and HR, and can take a sensitive incident to each of them in their own language.

Our Data Center Operations team is at the physical core of our business, responsible for building, maintaining, and operating the infrastructure that powers the cloud. We are seeking Data Center Technicians across a range of experience levels to ensure service availability, physical reliability, and operational excellence across our facilities.

In this salaried, 100% on-site position, you will perform hands-on hardware and network diagnostics, equipment installations, structured cabling, and physical repairs. Candidates will be leveled during the interview process based on technical expertise, depth of experience, and problem-solving ability.

• Data Center Operations & Maintenance: Assemble, rack, stack, and maintain data center server, storage, and networking hardware. Maintain hot/cold aisle containment, conduct inventory audits, and perform routine physical maintenance.

• Hardware Foundation: Hands-on experience or coursework in computer hardware assembly, installation, and physical and logical troubleshooting.

• Communication & Teamwork: Strong organizational and communication skills, a collaborative and curious mindset, and a commitment to high reliability standards.

• Learning & Development: Willingness to build technical skills, learn new systems, and take on responsibilities that match your experience.

Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while performing diagnostics and repairs. Access equipment in confined spaces, under-floor areas, and on ladders. Handle small hardware components, connectors, and cabling with precision. Work in data center environments with hot/cold aisle temperatures ranging from 60°F to 90°F.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with Linux OS administration, command-line tools, and device provisioning.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Materials Scientist, AI Safety
jobs.location: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats.

What You'll Be Building

• Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances.

• Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change.

• Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories.

• Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape.

• Translate dual-use judgments into policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that support beneficial materials research.

• Work with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and engineering and experimental colleagues to assess capabilities, interpret red-team findings and evaluate safeguards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in materials science or a closely related discipline, with a strong grasp of the relationships between structure, properties, processing and applications. Relevant backgrounds include particulate, porous and formulated systems; and structural and functional materials, including thin films, electrochemical materials and metals and alloys.

• Substantive experience assessing dual-use risks in a relevant area, with a strong understanding of harmful applications such as nuclear proliferation, radiological misuse, weapons-related capabilities (e.g. energetics) or other consequential materials risks.

• Sound judgment about physical possibility, practical feasibility and uncertainty, together with the ability to investigate risks beyond your immediate specialism.

• The ability to identify appropriate specialists, evaluate technical evidence and synthesize contributions across scientific and security disciplines.

• Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy.

Bonus Points For

• Prior experience applying materials or related physical-science expertise to AI safety through one or more of: threat analysis, evaluations or red teaming, or mitigation design.

• Experience commissioning specialist research or assessing emerging technologies across disciplinary boundaries.

• Experience with computational materials science, advanced manufacturing or automated synthesis and characterization.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$268,000—$384,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Visual Design
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Visual Design to lead and elevate Dandy’s graphic design team. This role will serve as the creative authority and steward of Dandy’s visual identity, and oversee multiple designers, providing art direction, feedback, and clear quality standards while building design systems that scale. While this role does include hands-on design for high impact projects, its primary focus is leadership, resourcing, team development, and creative oversight.

As a leader at Dandy, you will operate with high autonomy, influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders, and shape how our brand shows up across campaigns, events, product marketing, performance channels, and beyond. You will be responsible for upleveling the team’s craft, strengthening creative rigor, and ensuring we consistently deliver high-impact, integrated, and beautifully executed work.


What You'll Do

 - Serve as the art director and visual authority for Dandy’s graphic design team – setting and holding the visual standard across all channels and touchpoints.

 - Lead, manage, and develop a team of designers, elevating craft, conceptual thinking, and execution across the team.

 - Establish and evolve scalable design systems, campaign frameworks, and governance processes that ensure consistency and efficiency across global markets.

 - Oversee creative execution across all marketing channels and high impact initiatives to ensure best-in-class output.

 - Own design team resourcing and capacity planning, balancing internal workloads while strategically leveraging agencies, freelancers, and contractors as needed.

 - Partner cross-functionally across GTM teams to translate business objectives into high-impact creative.

 - Lead structured design reviews and provide clear, actionable feedback that strengthens both the work and the team.

 - Stay at the forefront of emerging design tools and technologies — including AI-powered creative workflows — identifying opportunities to improve speed, quality, scalability, and innovation across the team.

 - Drive continuous elevation of Dandy’s visual identity through innovation, trend awareness, and a deep commitment to design excellence.

What We're Looking For

 - 8+ years of experience in visual design, including significant experience at the Art Director or Senior Manager level design roles.

 - Proven experience leading and developing multiple designers (more than two direct reports), with a track record of raising the creative bar across a team.

 - A standout portfolio demonstrating integrated, multi-channel campaigns, strong art direction, and experience building scalable brand systems.

 - Deep expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma, with fluency across digital, print, performance, events, and campaign design.

 - Experience working in an agency or managing multiple brands, with a strong understanding of how to scale creative across diverse touchpoints.

 - Strong cross-functional collaborator with experience partnering with senior and executive stakeholders.

 - Exceptional creative judgment, with the ability to interpret briefs, navigate ambiguity, and deliver strategically aligned design solutions.

 - High ownership, accountability, and operational rigor, with the ability to balance leadership oversight and selective hands-on contribution.

Bonus Points For

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Performs a variety of water and sewer infrastructure activities. The service work includes but is not limited to inspection, installation, repair and troubleshooting, and maintenance of water and sewer collection system.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Water System Support: Water meter reading, managing flushing programs for mains and dead-ends, and coordinating service shutoffs and restorations. Perform valve exercising and maintenance on water distribution system valves. Install and maintain fire hydrants, including flushing, painting, and repairs. Perform pressure testing on repaired water lines to ensure integrity. Inspect and maintain air release valves, pressure reducing valves, and blow-off assemblies Tap water mains for new service connections
• Sewer Maintenance: Cleaning and inspecting sanitary sewer mains and laterals using jet/vac trucks and CCTV cameras, and performing root removal.
• Infrastructure Repair: Repairing or replacing damaged sewer pipes, fittings, manholes (including structural inspections), and sewer service lines from the main to the property line. Install, replace, and repair water meters, meter boxes, and service connections. Repair or replace water service lines from main to meter
• Emergency and Compliance: Responding to water line breaks, sewer backups, overflows, and spills, and conducting inspections for grease traps and backflow preventers.
• Participate in on-call rotation for emergency response.
• Operation of heavy equipment including track excavators, dump trucks, sewer jetters.

Work Environment:

• Required to work in confined spaces, climb ladders, scaffolding and stairs.
• Required to work in all weather conditions, both indoors and outdoors.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.
• 3 - 5 plus years of experience working in water and sewer collection systems.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Possession of NC Distribution and/or Collection System certifications, or ability to obtain.
• Valid NC Driver's License - Class A CDL or ability to obtain.

Physical Requirements:

• Required to wear a half face respirator or powered air respirators (PAPR) where proper safety procedures warrant their use.
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
• The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; climb stairs or ladders; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and taste or smell.
• The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
• Specific vision abilities required by this job include ability to distinguish color, close vision and distance vision.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Nurse Team Lead - Clin Rev
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Clinical Review Team Lead is the team’s clinical subject matter expert for prospective utilization review. The Team Lead resolves complex criteria and guideline questions, audits and coaches nurse reviewers, manages daily case inventory and turnaround times, and performs case reviews as assigned.

This is a working lead role: the Team Lead balances production review with lead duties based on business needs and staffing and provides secondary coverage for the Supervisor. The ideal candidate is a proven high-performing reviewer who is analytical, highly organized and able to teach others.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Clinical expertise and case review

• Serves as the clinical subject matter expert for assigned programs and modalities, answering nurses’ criteria, guideline and process questions, including through the team’s clinical education mailbox.
• Performs prospective case reviews as assigned and maintains the established Team Lead productivity (cases per hour) and quality standards during production hours.
• Handles complex, escalated and expedited cases and escalated inbound provider calls and requests.
• Interprets HealthHelp clinical guidelines, client medical policies and regulatory requirements for the team, and identifies guideline gaps or inconsistencies for Nursing Management.
• Coordinates daily physician reviewer case flow and notifications.

Workflow and inventory

• Monitors case inventory, queues and turnaround times throughout the day, and adjusts the nurse assignment tool based on staffing, proficiency, request type and volume so client service levels and regulatory turnaround times are met.
• Uses productivity, turnaround-time and queue reports to identify backlogs, outliers and trends, and recommends staffing or workflow changes to the Supervisor.
• Uses AVAYA, ADP Workforce Now and related systems to manage daily phone and staffing metrics.

Quality, training and coaching

• Audits nurse case work for appropriateness of determinations, documentation and denial-related language, and identifies individual and team training needs.
• Supports new nurses through orientation and ramp, including QA audits and feedback, in coordination with Nursing Management and the Clinical Review Training Department.
• Conducts regular one-on-ones with Clinical Review Nurses on review quality, productivity and process.
• Recommends improvements to clinical review processes, criteria application, tools and job aids.

Team support and communication

• Provides secondary Nursing Management coverage when the Supervisor or Manager is unavailable.
• Communicates assignments, expectations and changes clearly and professionally, and acts as liaison between frontline staff and management.
• Listens to team feedback, resolves day-to-day issues or escalates them, and fosters a respectful, motivating team environment.
• Leads or participates in team meetings as directed.
• Collaborates with other departments and client personnel to resolve concerns and obtain clarifications.

STANDARD DEPARTMENTAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Knows the requirements of each assigned benefit management program, including regulatory compliance, accreditation standards, and client service levels by line of business and geographic region.
• Refers complaints to the Compliance Officer as appropriate and works with the Quality Department to investigate and correct errors.
• Evaluates and reports HIPAA breaches according to policy.
• Collaborates with Human Resources to ensure adherence to company policies.
• Adheres to all HIPAA, state and federal regulations and to URAC and NCQA standards pertinent to the role.
• Performs other related duties and projects as assigned.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
• Current, active, unrestricted RN or LPN/LVN license in a U.S. state or territory.
• Minimum of three (3) years of prospective utilization management experience making medical necessity determinations (prior authorization, pre-service review or precertification) at a health plan, utilization management organization, or specialty or radiology benefit manager.
• Experience auditing or reviewing other reviewers’ case work, precepting or training new staff, or serving as a go-to clinical resource for a team.
• Sustained performance at or above productivity and quality (QA audit) standards in the current or most recent review role.
• Expert application of evidence-based criteria (e.g., InterQual, MCG, or proprietary guidelines) across more than one program or modality, with the ability to explain the clinical rationale to nurses and providers.
• Working knowledge of utilization management regulatory and accreditation requirements, including URAC, NCQA, CMS and state turnaround times, Medicare NCDs/LCDs, and denial notice requirements.
• Strong analytical skills: uses Excel (sorting, filtering, formulas, pivot tables) and operational reports to monitor productivity, queues and turnaround times and to spot trends.
• Highly organized, with the ability to manage inventory and multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment.
• Clear, professional written and verbal communication, including giving constructive feedback.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint; Visio a plus).

Preferred

• Review experience in two or more specialty program areas (e.g., Diagnostic Imaging, Cardiology, Musculoskeletal, Physical Medicine, Sleep, Oncology, Radiation Therapy, Genetic Testing).
• Formal team lead, QA auditor, trainer or preceptor role within a utilization management department.
• Experience with workforce or inventory tools such as a case assignment tool, AVAYA or ADP Workforce Now.
• Knowledge of adverse determination and denial letter language requirements.
• UM or quality certification (e.g., CPUM, CPUR, CCM or CPHQ).
• Multistate (compact) nursing license.

ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• HIPAA-compliant remote location with reliable high-speed internet.
• Shift assigned within HealthHelp’s utilization management operating hours of 7:00 AM–7:00 PM CT, which may include a late shift; after-hours on-call may be required.
• Ability to use the telephone, sit, enter data and view a PC screen for up to 8 hours.
• Ability to prioritize in a multi-task environment

Shift 10:30am - 7:00pm

Compensation Disclosure

The base salary for this position is LVN/LPN Team Lead $74,880 and RN Team Lead $85,280 annually. This represents the base pay range that we reasonably expect to offer for this position.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for performance-based bonuses, incentive pay, or commissions, which are not included in the listed base salary range.

jobs.title: MSW Field Director & Non-Tenure Track Faculty, Social Work
jobs.description:
The Social Work Department at Augsburg University invites applications for a non-tenure track MSW Field Director position to begin January 2027. This is a full-time, 10-month, benefits-eligible three-year limited-term position.

The Augsburg Social Work Department is distinctive for its anti-oppressive and culturally responsive emphasis as well as deep-seated commitment to social justice and global issues. We value student-centered learning, emphasizing experiential learning strategies. We offer small class sizes and we leverage our strong community connections. MSW classes meet in-person two weekends per month and asynchronously on-line.

The MSW Field Director is responsible for the overall administration of the MSW field education program and teaching MSW courses. Duties include:

Departmental Representation to the Community

• Represents and promotes the MSW Field Program with existing and potential field sites
• Recruits, develops, approves and maintains field placements for MSW students in generalist, clinical, and macro field placements
• Represent Augsburg’s MSW programs at community events, outreach opportunities, and with the the Twin Cities MSW Field Consortium
• Coordinate orientation and continuing education for field agencies and field instructors
• Recruit external field instructors, as needed

Field Program Management

• Assures maintenance and communication of database of field agencies, coordinates with the social work program coordinator and student workers as needed
• Assures delivery, maintenance, and archiving of all MSW student learning agendas in collaboration with staff
• Conduct evaluations of MSW Field program and maintains appropriate documentation;
• Matches and refers students to field placements
• Engages in problem-solving and decision-making around significant field placement difficulties in consultation with the MSW Program Director
• Implements MSW field policies and practices
• Consults and coordinates with the Department Chair, the MSW Program Director and the BSW Field Director to ensure consistent collaboration and integration of field programming and academic programs
• Develops and conducts field orientations for all MSW students

Field Education Responsibilities within the Department

• Teach MSW courses, including field seminars
• Updates and maintains the MSW Field Manual
• Develops, implements, and maintains a field program consistent with accreditation standards of the Council of Social Work Education
• Adapt field learning agreements consistent with new accreditation standards
• Implements policies and procedures established by the Department for student field education
• Initiates consideration of new policies and procedures for maintaining and improving the quality of student field education
• Initiates expansion of field placement options using innovation and creativity to grow programs in conjunction with the Social Work Department
• Co-chairs the Field Committee of the Social Work Department
• Organizes internal departmental continuing education events
• Uphold standards of the profession including the NASW Code of Ethics and the Guidelines for Field Education as developed by the CSWE

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• A Master’s of Social Work from a CSWE-accredited social work program is required
• A minimum of 3 years of direct social work practice experience
• A current graduate level social work license (LGSW, LICSW, or LISW), or eligibility for licensure in the state of Minnesota
• Ability to foster a positive and inclusive learning environment.
• Skills to navigate technological platforms for data collection, management and communication and hybrid and online learning pedagogies
• Excellent communication, organizational, and multi-tasking skills with proven ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders
• Strong interpersonal skills required to work with students, faculty, staff, other academic professionals and with community partners
• Demonstrated commitment to social work education, and familiarity with fulfilling the requirements of the Council on Social Work Education accreditation standards
• Ability to commit to the core attributes of the departmental mission, particularly in terms of our focus on anti-racist and anti-oppressive social work practice

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Teaching experience in higher education
• Experience serving as a MSW field instructor
• Experience in program development and/or administration
• Familiarity and experience with the Council on Social Work Education accreditation standards

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $62,000 - $67,000, annually, depending on hiring rank and qualifications.

Augsburg University offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including:

• Medical, dental and vision insurance coverage. Medical plans include Kavira direct care, which provides free or low-cost virtual and in-home primary care appointments and labs
• A generous 403(b) retirement program with an employer contribution of up to 8% upon eligibility
• Up to 100% tuition remission for employees, spouses and dependents, and participation in the Tuition Exchange program with colleges and universities throughout the US
• Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all employees
• Paid parental leave

Application Instructions and Requirements

To ensure full consideration, application materials should be received by November 15, 2026. Position open until filled.

To apply for this position, please upload the following documents:

• Cover letter: please address why you are interested in Augsburg University and this position, how your previous professional and academic experiences make you a strong candidate for this position, and how you believe you would contribute to and enhance the Augsburg Social Work Department
• Curriculum Vitae
• Unoffical MSW transcripts (official transcripts are required at time of hire)

As part of the online application process, candidates are asked to provide the name, email address, and nature of professional relationship for three professional references. One of the references must be able to address your teaching or teaching potential. If your application advances in this search, you will be notified prior to Augsburg contacting your references.

If you have questions regarding the position, please contact the Search Chair: Erin Sugrue at sugrue@augsburg.edu.
