jobs.title: Manager, Cyber Incident Response
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, event monitoring, incident response, and threat hunting across the enterprise in a highly collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment. Cyber Response Operations serves as NBCUniversal’s 24x7 first line of defense against cyber threats. Event Analysts and Incident Responders follow the Incident Response Plan to identify, assess, contain, remediate, and document cyber events and incidents.

The Manager of Cyber Incident Response leads the Incident Response team while guiding and supporting the Event Analyst function. The role oversees escalations involving containment, remediation, forensic analysis, and coordination with impacted businesses and partner teams. This leader establishes the operating rigor needed for consistent performance while enabling responders to exercise sound judgment, creativity, and ownership.

The Manager is accountable for team readiness, workflow prioritization, escalation quality, process maturity, and employee development. The role requires regular engagement with business stakeholders, Information Security Officers, technical teams, vendors, and senior leadership during both routine operations and active incidents.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Manage Incident Response operations, including prioritization, resource allocation, shift coverage, tooling requirements, workflow management, and escalation processes.
• Ensure the NBCUniversal Incident Response Plan and supporting procedures are implemented and followed in day-to-day operations.
• Oversee and manage cyber incidents across the NBCUniversal enterprise, from escalation and validation through containment, remediation, recovery support, and closure.
• Serve as an Incident Handler or Incident Commander for significant incidents, coordinating response activities with impacted businesses, technical owners, and partner teams.
• Act as the managerial escalation point for potential cyber incidents, responder support needs, and decisions requiring leadership awareness or approval.
• Participate in the manager on-call rotation for cyber incident escalation and handling in a 24x7x365 global environment.
• Supervise operational performance across shifts, ensuring consistent prioritization, ticket ownership, escalation discipline, and adherence to company standards.
• Review shift handovers, queue health, and open incidents to ensure continuity, clear accountability, and timely follow-through across operating periods.
• Maintain and enforce event and incident documentation standards, case-management requirements, key performance indicators, and process adherence.
• Monitor operational metrics and trends, identify gaps, and implement improvements that strengthen effectiveness, risk reduction, and business impact.
• Lead the review and governance of response processes, playbooks, tuning requests, automation opportunities, and technical procedures.
• Drive the maturity, enhancement, and strategy of the Incident Response program in alignment with business and enterprise priorities.
• Act as a strategic partner to Information Security Officers, business stakeholders, and other security and technology teams.
• Develop and maintain process documentation, including clear ownership, review cycles, approval requirements, and change management.
• Lead, coach, and develop Incident Response personnel, providing regular feedback and supporting technical, professional, and career growth.
• Create and deliver monthly metrics and executive reporting that communicate operational effectiveness, risk reduction, material trends, and business impact.
• Communicate incident status, operational concerns, decisions, and risk clearly to business VIPs and senior leadership.

Qualifications and Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in an information technology-related field and/or equivalent work experience.
• Seven or more years of cybersecurity or investigations experience, including at least four years in Incident Response, a Security Operations Center, threat intelligence, or a similar function.
• Previous experience leading incident response operations, cybersecurity personnel, or complex incident coordination.
• In-depth understanding of cyber threats, adversary techniques, response procedures, network and enterprise architecture, and threat detection.
• Demonstrated ability to make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and coordinate response activities across multiple teams.
• Willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-demand role that may require nonstandard working hours.
• Availability to support employee development and accept escalations arising in a 24x7x365 global environment.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams, incidents, and escalation paths.
• Working knowledge of core enterprise technology concepts, including web application architecture, networking, identity, endpoint, email, and cloud services.
• Experience with host-based and network-based forensic tools and analysis.
• Knowledge of recognized security and analysis frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, the Cyber Kill Chain, the Diamond Model, and NIST incident response guidance.
• Experience applying security concepts in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform environments.
• Knowledge of incident response technologies and capabilities such as EDR, XDR, SOAR, case management, and response automation.
• Experience developing or improving incident-management processes, playbooks, metrics, or automation.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief technical professionals, business stakeholders, and senior executives.
• Strong leadership, coaching, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt to changing and fast-paced environments.

Desired Characteristics

• Prior experience managing a Cyber Incident Response, Security Operations Center, or related cyber defense function.
• Experience supporting incident response or SOC operations for a large, complex, or global enterprise.
• Hands-on familiarity with endpoint detection and response, forensic, network-analysis, email-security, and cloud-security technologies.
• Relevant security certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCIA, CISSP, or equivalent.
• Demonstrated success improving operational discipline, employee development, cross-team coordination, and executive communication.

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range $110k - $170k (bonus eligible)

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

For LA County and City Residents Only:  NBCUniversal will consider for employment  qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner  consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

jobs.title: Part Time Bus Driver
jobs.description:
Part-Time School Bus Driver

KIPP OKC Public Schools

Position Type: Part-Time | Guaranteed 20 Hours Per Week

Position Summary

KIPP OKC Public Schools is seeking a dependable, safety-conscious, and student-centered Part-Time School Bus Driver to safely transport scholars to and from school. The ideal candidate is punctual, responsible, and committed to providing a safe, reliable, and welcoming transportation experience for our scholars.

This position offers guaranteed 20 hours per week and requires availability for both morning and afternoon transportation routes.

Schedule and Responsibilities

Morning Route: Approximately 5:30 AM – 7:35 AM

• Arrive on campus by 5:30 AM to complete the required pre-trip bus inspection and prepare for the morning route.
• Safely transport scholars to school, ensuring all scholars arrive on campus by 7:35 AM.
• Follow assigned routes and established transportation procedures.

Afternoon Route: Approximately 2:00 PM – 4:30 PM

• Return to campus by 2:00 PM to complete preparations for the afternoon route.
• Safely transport scholars from school to their designated drop-off locations.
• Ensure scholars arrive at their designated drop-off locations according to the established route schedule, with the final drop-off completed by 4:30 PM.
• Return the bus to campus after completing the route.
• Complete the required post-trip inspection and any necessary end-of-route documentation.

Additional Responsibilities

• Maintain a safe, orderly, and respectful environment on the bus.
• Comply with all applicable state and federal transportation regulations and school policies.
• Communicate transportation concerns, delays, vehicle issues, or student safety concerns to the appropriate school personnel.
• Maintain accurate transportation records and complete required inspections and reports.
• Participate in additional driver training as needed or required.

Required Qualifications

• Valid Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) appropriate for school bus operation.
• Valid school bus driver certification.
• Ability to pass all required background checks and drug screenings.
• Willingness to complete additional driver training as necessary.
• Reliable transportation and consistent, punctual attendance.
• Ability to safely operate and inspect a school bus.
• Strong communication skills and a commitment to scholar safety.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is dependable, patient, professional, and attentive to detail. They understand the responsibility of transporting children safely and demonstrate a commitment to creating a positive experience for scholars and families.

Compensation and Benefits

• Guaranteed 20 hours per week.
• Part-time employment.
• Consistent morning and afternoon route schedule.

How to Apply

Interested applicants are encouraged to apply and join our commitment to providing scholars with safe and reliable transportation every school day.

KIPP OKC Public Schools is committed to creating a safe, supportive, and welcoming environment for all scholars, families, and staff.

Required Qualifications

• Valid Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) appropriate for school bus operation.
• Valid school bus driver certification.
• Ability to pass all required background checks and drug screenings.
• Willingness to complete additional driver training as necessary.
• Reliable transportation and consistent, punctual attendance.
• Ability to safely operate and inspect a school bus.
• Strong communication skills and a commitment to scholar safety.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Director, Washington DC
jobs.description:
At BBYO, our mission drives everything we do, and it pushes us to make work fun, flexible, and fulfilling. We’re looking for a passionate, people-first Senior Regional Director to serve one of BBYO’s largest and most vibrant communities, Northern Region East (NRE). NRE is home to three active councils: Baltimore Council (Baltimore and Anne Arundel Counties), DC Council (Frederick, Howard, and Montgomery Counties, and the District), and Northern Virginia Council (Alexandria, Arlington, and Loudoun Counties).

In this role, you’ll lead a talented staff team, mentor teen leaders, and run the budgets and calendars behind hundreds of Jewish teen experiences each year. You’ll also take a lead role in NRE’s Regional Convention, which is the second-largest convention in the BBYO Movement and draws more than 550 teens every year.

Alongside your teammates, you’ll connect in a dynamic environment and create a positive impact on teens, our community, and the world.

SHAPING THE FUTURE FOR TEENS AND YOURSELF

As a Senior Regional Director, you will:

• Build, manage, and inspire a team of professionals across all three councils to hit ambitious goals for membership, experiences, and participation.

• Coach and mentor teen leaders to implement an annual calendar of impactful, high-quality, and fun programs, including regular leadership training

• Shape a strong team culture and supervise direct reports with high expectations and real investment in their growth.

• Lead the planning and execution of NRE’s Regional Convention, from vision to logistics to the moment 550+ teens walk through the doors.

• Own and manage major program budgets, balancing big ideas with responsible stewardship.

• Recruit, train, and build a strong community of volunteer advisors in every council.

• Seek out and cultivate relationships with parents, alumni and community partners, to mobilize more people to grow and support BBYO.

• Utilize data to drive decisions in building a robust member recruitment process.

• Coordinate and lead execution of other large-scale regional events throughout the year.

• Participate in organizational projects, teams, and summer programs as assigned to expand the movement and strengthen teen leadership.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS FOR MAKING A LASTING IMPACT

Our team has an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for innovation to drive positive change. Additionally, for Senior Regional Directors, these skills are key to success:

• Experience: 5+ years of work experience

• Education: A bachelor's degree or higher

• Abilities: Management experience preferred. Experience with youth or teens is preferred.

• Must reside in the Greater Washington, DC area, work from BBYO’s Washington, DC office three days a week, and be willing and able to travel regularly within the region.

• Ability to travel to organization-wide events and to staff a summer leadership program at a location in the U.S. for two to three weeks each summer.

• Ability to work nontraditional hours (some nights and weekends) when teens are available.

• Unrestricted authorization to work in the U.S. without holding a visa or sponsorship.

• To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty/function with or without reasonable accommodation in accordance with applicable law.

BENEFITS OF OUR DYNAMIC AND SUPPORTIVE WORKPLACE

• Own Your Balance

• Flexible work environment

• Unlimited paid time off (PTO)

• 18 paid secular and Jewish holidays

• PLUS two-week long office shutdowns

• Invest in Your Well-being

• Medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and 2.5x salary life insurance

• Generous 403(b) and Roth retirement plan with vested match

• Free access to WellHub, which includes access to gyms, online workouts, and wellness apps

• Family First Environment

• Teen Involvement Benefit stipend

• Flexibility in bringing child(ren) on business travel

• Generous paid parental leave

We also pay for your TSA PreCheck, provide a home technology allowance, and have pet insurance options!

BE A PART OF A LEGACY…

• that celebrates our rich, century-long history of enhancing the Jewish experience to build a meaningful, teen-led future

• with an inclusive culture where authenticity is celebrated, respect is given, and fun is encouraged

• built on trust and empowerment, offering flexibility in where you work and autonomy in how it gets done

Embracing our past and future, we are excited about our growth and the challenges ahead. Join us and embark on an exciting journey with BBYO. INSPIRING TODAY. BUILDING TOMORROW.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Engineer, Chassis & Vehicle Dynamic
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike.  We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact.  We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries.  As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries.  We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better

About the Role

We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to develop and improve chassis systems and vehicle dynamics performance for DOT, DoorDash’s autonomous delivery robot. You’ll combine hands-on mechanical design, engineering analysis, and vehicle testing to improve existing platforms and develop suspension and chassis solutions for future projects.

You’ll own engineering work from requirements and concept development through detailed CAD design, prototype evaluation, and validation. Working closely with internal teams and suppliers, you’ll assess designs, resolve technical challenges, and ensure chassis systems meet our performance, durability, and integration requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to influence how DOT rides, handles, brakes, and traverses real-world terrain while improving the reliability and serviceability of our deployed robots.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Design and improve suspension and chassis systems, including suspension geometry, linkages, wheel-end assemblies, and drivetrain and brake mounting interfaces.

• Own mechanical design execution, developing concepts, detailed CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, and tolerance analyses to support prototype builds and production release.

• Sustain and improve existing platforms, investigating field issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing validated engineering changes.

• Define chassis and vehicle dynamics requirements for ride quality, traction, braking, stability, ground clearance, and obstacle traversal across terrain and payload conditions.

• Provide technical oversight of supplier-developed hardware, reviewing designs, analyses, and test results to ensure systems meet vehicle requirements and integrate successfully.

• Develop and execute verification and validation plans with reliability, test, and integration teams, establishing measurable acceptance criteria for components and complete vehicles.

• Lead instrumented vehicle dynamics testing, analyze results, and translate findings into hardware improvements and operating limits.

• Partner with controls and autonomy engineers to characterize vehicle capabilities and improve motion performance.

• Support prototype builds, manufacturing, and service teams, resolving integration issues and improving durability, manufacturability, and maintainability.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience designing and developing suspension, chassis, or related mechanical systems for vehicles or mobile robots.

• You understand suspension kinematics, load transfer, tire behavior, stiffness and damping, braking, and vehicle stability—and can apply these fundamentals to hardware design.

• You are proficient in NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or a comparable CAD platform and have experience releasing detailed mechanical designs.

• You apply sound engineering judgment to load cases, structural integrity, fatigue, bearings, bolted joints, materials, and manufacturing processes.

• You can independently assess designs and analyses, identify technical risks, and drive issues to resolution with internal teams and suppliers.

• You have hands-on experience with prototype assembly, instrumentation, vehicle testing, and root cause analysis.

• You can translate requirements into test methods and acceptance criteria, then use Python, MATLAB, or similar tools to evaluate results.

• You take ownership from initial investigation through implementation and verification

jobs.title: Part Time Floor Leader - Memorial City Mall
jobs.description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

Memorial City Pay

$16.50—$16.50 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

YouTube
LinkedIn

Lush Cosmetics North America respectfully recognizes that our business operates on Indigenous territory across Turtle Island. As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.

Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92. We recognize that our facilities, along with our settler and newcomer staff are guests on this land and as we act to repair past harm, we do it together in allyship with Indigenous People everywhere, including staff, customers and with leadership from organizations and communities we work with.

jobs.title: Club Reception - Ludlow House
jobs.location: Ludlow House, 139 Ludlow St, New York, NY 10002
jobs.description:
The Role...

At Soho House, a Club Receptionist/Host is one of the first point of contacts for members guests and staff before being seated for their dining experience. As a Host, you are responsible for greeting guests, answering all incoming calls, and creating reservations for the Club or F&B Operation(s)/Restaurant(s). The Host, has acute organizational and people skills which often in infectious and promotes positive experience from the moment anyone arrives up until their departure. Responsibilities also entail excellent service to all guests, members and staff via friendliness, professional, and organizational efficiency.

A successful Host, you may be responsible for training other reception team members on process and service standards set at Soho House. As an experienced Host you are required to be able to master our phone system, have a warm and friendly disposition, ensure all anticipated covers are accounted for during service and tables are ready for the reservation’s arrival.

Main Duties

• Ensure every member is welcomed by name (if local) and guest is welcomed with open arms and in a hospitable manner

• Answer high-volume phone lines and calls for restaurant, roof and cinema reservations, general inquiries, and deliveries, messages for members and from employees; among other inquiries

• Well-versed on standard Q&A regarding menus, hours of operation and amenity availability/pricing

• Maintain a clean, sanitary and safe work environment, reception area, desk and coat check closet

• Perform Guest List duties on the floor level, club and/or Rooftop (if applicable)

• Support, redirect and problem solve in real-time to ensure any guest related concerns are addressed and action items have been set

• Assist guests by checking/ retrieving their coats and/or items they left with the bell person

• Build relationships with members and guests and communicate and red flags and positive feedback to management to assess

• Influence a fun and positive atmosphere by being approachable and professional

Required Skills/Qualifications

• Minimum of 3+ years’ experience in a similar role.

• Must have experience answering high-volume phone lines and answering inquiries professionally, timely and to the best of your abilities.

• OpenTable experience

• Salesforce and Opera experience is a plus

• Problem solving skills and bring conflict resolution to any anticipated or current matter

• Detail oriented, articulate and ability to multi-task in a high-volume and demanding work environment

• Strong communication skills and ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions

• Flexible schedule and ability to work nights, weekends and holiday’s (as needed)

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to seize, grasp, turn and hold objects with hands.

• Must be able to work on your feet for at least 8 hours.

• Fast paced movements are required to go from one part of the club to others.

• Must be able to move, pull, carry or lift at least 40 pounds.

• Occasionally kneel, bend, crouch and climb as required.

• Work indoors and outdoors

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

• Health Care + 401K: Full time employees are eligible for full benefits; Medical, Dental & Vision as well as Retirement fund with a 2% match

• Paid Time Off: Full- Time Employees have sick day's + vacation days

• Career Development: Soho House can progress your career domestically or internationally as well as managerially or technically

• Soho Impact: Empowering the Soho House Community to make positive change, through mentoring, apprenticeship, local outreach and sustainability

• Learning & Development: An extensive range of internally and externally run courses are available for all employees.

• Cookhouse & House Tonic: Celebrating our passion for food and drink. Check out our monthly calendars and get involved in trips, training's and events. Available to all.

• Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.

• Team Meal: Whilst on duty in our Houses & Restaurants you will be provided with a substantial meal free of charge.

In accordance with New York law, the salary range for this role if filled within New York is listed below. The range for the position in other geographies may vary based on market differences. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

Pay Range

$23—$23 USD
